-- 0x71a2d  to handle _CMS_EnterApplication bk, bookmarkFn
to handle _CMS_EnterApplication bk, bookmarkFn

	system STRING s_ASYM_LogDir

	thisSysBook = objectContainer(self,"book")

	moduleLogInfo = ASYM_CMS_LogInfo()
	logFn = item 1 of moduleLogInfo
	logType = item 2 of moduleLogInfo

	if logType is null
		logType = ASYM_LogType of bk
	end

	if logType <> null
		preferredLogFn = ASYM_LogName of bk

		if s_ASYM_LogDir <> null and ASYM_LogDestination of bk is "<special>"
			dest = s_ASYM_LogDir
		else
			get ASYM_CMS_LogDir()
			if it <> null
				s_ASYM_LogDir = it
				dest = it
			else
				dest = ASYM_LogDestination of bk
			end
		end

		logFn = _ASYM_MakeLogFileName(dest, "<auto>") of page "Logging" of thisSysBook

		CMSLogFn = ASYM_CMS_EnterApplication(ASYM_shortFileName(name of bk),\
		  bookmarkFn,logFn) of bk
		pop CMSLogFn
		if not it
			send _ASYM_ReaderExit
		else
			if CMSLogFn <> null
				logFn = CMSLogFn
			 end

			get ASYM_LogStart(bk, logFn, true, ASYM_LogEncrypt of bk, dest,\
			  logType, item 1 of moduleLogInfo, item 2 of moduleLogInfo)
			if it is "<exit>"
				send _ASYM_ReaderExit
			end
		end
	else
		get ASYM_CMS_EnterApplication(ASYM_shortFileName(name of bk),\
		  bookmarkFn,null) of bk
	end
end

-- 0x71ddf  to handle disableTaskSwitching how
to handle disableTaskSwitching how
	system s_ASYM_ModalState

	if this book is objectContainer(self,"book")
		break
	end
	LOCAL STACK hWndList
	linkdll "user"
		WORD GetDesktopWindow()
		WORD GetWindow(WORD,WORD)
		WORD GetWindowTask(WORD)
		INT EnableWindow(WORD,WORD)
		WORD IsWindow(WORD)
	end
	GW_HWNDFIRST = 0
	GW_HWNDNEXT = 2
	hTask = GetWindowTask(windowHandle of mainWindow)
	hWnd = GetWindow(windowHandle of mainWindow, GW_HWNDFIRST)
	while hWnd <> 0
		push hWnd onto hWndList
		hWnd = GetWindow(hWnd,GW_HWNDNEXT)
	end

	s_ASYM_ModalState = (how is TRUE)

	if how is TRUE
		how = 0
	else
		how = 1
	end
	while hWndList <> null
		pop hWndList into hWnd
		if isWindow(hWnd) <> 0 and GetWindowTask(hWnd) <> hTask
			get EnableWindow(hWnd, how)
		end
	end
	if how = 0
		translateWindowMessage for sysWindowHandle
			on 0x0112 send _WM_SYSCOMMAND to self
		end
		if targetWindow <> mainWindow
			translateWindowMessage for windowHandle of targetWindow
				on 0x0112 send _WM_SYSCOMMAND to self
			end
		end
		translateWindowMessage for GetDesktopWindow()
			on 0x0112 send _WM_SYSCOMMAND to self
		end
	else
		untranslateWindowMessage 0x0112 for sysWindowHandle
		untranslateWindowMessage 0x0112 for windowHandle of targetWindow
		untranslateWindowMessage 0x0112 for GetDesktopWindow()
	end
end

to handle _WM_SYSCOMMAND hWnd, wMsg, wp, lpLo, lpHi
	conditions
	when wp = 0xF050 -- SC_PREVWINDOW
	when wp = 0xF040 -- SC_NEXTWINDOW
	when wp = 0xF130 -- SC_TASKLIST
	when wp = 0xF020 -- SC_MINIMIZE
		beep 1
	else
		forward to system
	end
end

-- 0x721b9  to get _ASYM_FindFaxDriver
to get _ASYM_FindFaxDriver
	local STACK PossibleDrivers

	linkDLL ASYM_ProductPrefix() & "win.dll"
		STRING GetWinIniVar(STRING,STRING)
		STRING GetIniVar(STRING,STRING,STRING)
	end
	printList = GetWinIniVar("Devices","")

	LastFaxDevice = GetIniVar("Logs","Fax Driver",ASYM_IniFile())
	OK = false

	step i from 1 to ItemCount(printList)
		dev = item i of printList
		if LastFaxDevice <> null and LastFaxDevice = dev
			OK = true
			break step
		end
		if "FAX" is in dev or "FX" is in dev
			push dev onto PossibleDrivers
		end
	end
	if OK
		return LastFaxDevice
	end
	if PossibleDrivers <> null and itemCount(PossibleDrivers) = 1
		yes = ASYM_GetStandardString("<Yes>","Yes")
		no = ASYM_GetStandardString("<No>","No")
		msgTxt = ASYM_GetStandardString("<ConfirmFaxDriver>", \
				"The FAX driver is %1. Right?")
		msgTxt = expandString(msgTxt, possibleDrivers)
		request msgTxt with yes or no
		if yes is in it
			get SetIniVar("Logs","Fax Driver",PossibleDrivers,ASYM_IniFile())
			return PossibleDrivers
		else
			clear PossibleDrivers
		end
	end
	if itemCount(PossibleDrivers) > 1
		linkDLL ASYM_ProductPrefix() & "dlg.dll"
			STRING ListToTextLine(STRING)
		end
		prompt = ASYM_GetStandardString("<ChooseFaxDriver>",\
		  "Select the FAX driver to use to send the log at the end of this session:")

		dev = ASYM_ChooseFromTextLinesDlg(Info_Title of this book,\
		  prompt,\
		  ListToTextLine(PossibleDrivers))
		if dev <> null
			get SetIniVar("Logs","Fax Driver",dev,ASYM_IniFile())
			return dev
		end
	end
	tempDir = ASYM_TempDirectory()
	msgTxt = ASYM_GetStandardString("<NoFaxDriver>", ASYM_GetString("No Fax driver found."))
	msgTxt = expandString(msgTxt ,ASYM_tempDir())
	msgCaption = SPACE
	get ASYM_MessageBox(msgTxt, msgCaption, "INFO", "OK")
	return null
end

to get SendLogAsFax fN, printdefaults, faxDevice
	linkDLL ASYM_ProductPrefix() & "win.dll"
		STRING GetWinIniVar(STRING,STRING)
	end
	linkDLL ASYM_ProductPrefix() & "DOS.dll"
		LONG GetFileSize(STRING)
	end
	oldPrinter = printerName
	get GetWinIniVar("devices",oldprinter)
	push oldprinter onto it
	oldPrinter = it
	get GetWinIniVar("devices",faxDevice)
	push faxDevice onto it
	faxDevice = it
	ss = sysSuspend;sysSuspend = false; clear sysError
	printerName = faxDevice
	sysSuspend = ss
	if sysError is null
		if getFileSize(fN) > 2000
			get 1
		else
			get 0
		end
		get ASYM_FileToPrinter(fN, fN & printDefaults,sysWindowHandle,it)
		printerName = oldPrinter
		if it = 1
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

-- 0x727cf  to handle AutoGlossary hotWrd
to handle AutoGlossary hotWrd
	get name of hotWrd
	if it is null
		get text of hotWrd
	end
	sysCursor = 4
	if ASYM_TempViewer of this window is true
		get ASYM_GotoPage ("page" && quote & it & quote)
	else
		send ASYM_PopGlossary it to this page
	end
	send ASYM_ResetCursor to this page
end

to handle autoHotword fld, loc
	if text of fld is null
		break
	end
	if loc is null
		loc = MousePosition of targetWindow
	end
	get textFromPoint(loc) of fld
	if item 1 of it < 1 or item 2 of it < 1
		break
	end
	txt = textline item 1 of it of text of fld
	p1 = item 2 of it
	c = char p1 of txt
	if c <= space as text or c is in """,.:;!?"
		break
	end
	p2 = p1
	while p1 > 1
		c = char (p1-1) of txt
		if c <= space as text or c is in """,.:;!?"
			break while
		end
		decrement p1
	end
	maxCnt = charcount(txt)
	while p2 < maxCnt
		c = char (p2+1) of txt
		if c <= space as text or c is in """,.:;!?"
			break while
		end
		increment p2
	end
	pgName = chars p1 to p2 of txt
	if ASYM_IsNumber(pgName)
		break
	end
	if ASYM_TempViewer of this window is true
		get ASYM_GotoPage("page" && quote & pgName & quote)
	else
		send ASYM_PopGlossary pgName to this page
	end
end

-- 0x72ac5  to get _ASYM_Wait ms, breakKeys, yield
to get _ASYM_Wait ms, breakKeys, yield
	local DWORD startT
	local WORD breakKey

	if not isType(DWORD,ms)
		return -1
	end

	breakKey = 0
	broken = false
	startT = ASYM_Ticks()

	yield = (yield = true)

	if breakKeys = 0
		while FlushMessageQueue() > 0
			get FlushMessageQueue()
		end
		mpos = sysMousePosition
		do
			get FlushMessageQueue()
			if it > 0 and mPos <> sysMousePosition
				mPos = sysMousePosition
				it = 0
			end
			if yield
				mmYield
			end
		until ASYM_Ticks() - startT >= ms or it > 0
		if it > 0
			breakKey = 255
		end
	else
		kCnt = itemCount(breakKeys)
		do
			if kCnt > 0
				step i from 1 to kCnt
					if keyState(item i of breakKeys) is down
						breakKey = item i of breakKeys
						break step
					end
				end
			else
				if keyState(keyEscape) is down
					breakKey = keyEscape
				end
			end

			if yield
				mmYield
			end
		until ASYM_Ticks() - startT >= ms or breakKey <> 0
	end

	get FlushMessageQueue()
	return breakKey
end


-- ASYM_Sleep suspend's ToolBook's process to allow other 32-bit
-- processes to process messages. This is slightly different from the
-- mmYield and yieldApp() functions.
-- The pMs parameter allows the developer to specify how many
-- milliseconds to suspend ToolBook's thread. A value of 0 will
-- suspend ToolBook for the remainder of its current thread.
-- Note: __ASYM_Sleep() is linked in the Initialization page, on linkSysBook
to get _ASYM_Sleep pMs
	sleepMs = pMS
	if isType("DWORD", sleepMs) <> true then
		sleepMs = 0
	end if
	get __ASYM_Sleep(sleepMs)
	return TRUE
end

-- 0x72e73  to get _ASYM_Sleep pMs

	return TRUE
end

-- 0x72edb  to get _ASYM_CompareDates d1, d2, fmt
to get _ASYM_CompareDates d1, d2, fmt
	d1 = _ASYM_DateToSeconds(d1, fmt)
	d2 = _ASYM_DateToSeconds(d2, fmt)
	conditions
	when d1 < d2
		get -1
	when d1 > d2
		get 1
	else
		get 0
	end
	return it
end

to get _ASYM_DateToSeconds d, fmt
	system s_asym_LastDateFormat

	if fmt is null
		fmt = s_asym_LastDateFormat
		if fmt is null
			fmt = sysDateFormat
		end
	end
	ss = sysSuspend
	sysSuspend = false
	clear sysError
	format date d as "seconds" from fmt
	if sysError <> null
		clear sysError
		fmt = "mm/dd/yyyy hh24:min:sec"
		format date d as "seconds" from fmt
		if sysError <> null
			clear sysError
			fmt = "mm/dd/yyyy hh:min:sec AMPM"
			format date d as "seconds" from fmt
		end
	end
	sysSuspend = ss
	if sysError is null
		s_asym_LastDateFormat = fmt
	else
		clear s_asym_LastDateFormat
	end
	return d
end

to get _ASYM_MillisecondsToTime ms
	bs = ASYM_BlockSuspend()
	totalSecs = round (ms / 1000)
	error = ASYM_RestoreSuspend()

	if error <> null
		totalSecs = 0
	end

	if totalSecs < 946684800
		secs = totalSecs mod 60
		mins = truncate (totalSecs / 60)

		format number secs as "00"
		format number mins as "00"

		return mins & ":" & secs
	else
		format date totalSecs as "hh:min:sec" from "seconds"
		return totalSecs
	end
end

-- 0x731f1  to get _ASYM_GetParameter paramName
to get _ASYM_GetParameter paramName
	-- Looks for an item on the command line of the form "<parameter name>=<parameter value>" and
	-- returns the value that corresponds to paramName, if there is one.

	cmdLine = sysCommandLine

	if sysPluginMode = true
		cmdLine = replaceString (cmdLine, "&", " ")
	end

	step i from 1 to wordCount (cmdLine)
		param = word i of cmdLine

		-- Batman (Inst80) SPR#6018 - TimB - 11/28/00
		-- Quotes around a command line parameter would break things
		if first char of param = quote and last char of param = quote
			clear first char of param
			clear last char of param
		end

		get offset ("=", param)
		if it > 1
			thisParamName = chars 1 to it-1 of param
			if thisParamName = paramName
				cc = charCount (param)
				if it < cc
					return replaceEscapeChars(chars it+1 to cc of param)
				else
					return null
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return null
end

to get replaceEscapeChars txt
	txt = replaceString (txt, "+", " ")

	if charCount (txt) > 2
		step i from charCount (txt) - 2 to 1 by -1
			if char i of txt = "%"
				get "0x" & chars i+1 to i+2 of txt
				if ASYM_IsNumber(it)
					chars i to i+2 of txt = ansiToChar(it)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return txt
end

to get _ASYM_SetHTTPPostParameter paramName, paramValue
	system _s_ASYM_HTTPPostParameters

	if paramName = null or paramValue = null
		return false
	end

	paramName = escapeChars (paramName)
	paramValue = escapeChars (paramValue)

	push paramValue onto _s_ASYM_HTTPPostParameters
	push paramName onto _s_ASYM_HTTPPostParameters

	return true
end

to get _ASYM_HTTPPost url
	system _s_ASYM_HTTPPostParameters
	local STRING paramList
	local usedParams

	if url = null
		return null
	end

	while _s_ASYM_HTTPPostParameters <> null
		pop _s_ASYM_HTTPPostParameters into paramName
		pop _s_ASYM_HTTPPostParameters into paramValue

		-- If we've already handled a parameter name, we don't handle it again. As parameters
		-- specified later are at the start of the list, this means that parameters specified later
		-- over-ride parameters specified previously.

		if not ASYM_ItemInList (paramName, usedParams)
			push paramName onto usedParams

			get paramName & "=" & paramValue
			if paramList = null
				paramList = it
			else
				put "&" & it after paramList
			end
		end
	end

	if paramList = null
		return null
	end

	linkDLL32 "tbinet32.dll"
		STRING INetUrlPost(STRING, STRING)
		STRING INetNewObject(STRING, STRING, STRING)
		STRING INetDestroyObject(STRING, STRING)
		STRING INetSetProperty(STRING, STRING, STRING)
	end

	get INetNewObject("ASYM_HTTPPost", null, "UrlConnection")
	if it <> null
		get INetSetProperty("ASYM_HTTPPost", "Url", url)
		if it = "OK"
			retVal = INetUrlPost("ASYM_HTTPPost", paramList)
			clear _s_ASYM_HTTPPostParameters
		else
			retVal = null
		end
		get INetDestroyObject("ASYM_HTTPPost")
	else
		retVal = null
	end

	return retVal
end

to get escapeChars txt
	accept = "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz1234567890.-*_"

	step i from charCount (txt) to 1 by -1
		get char i of txt
		if it is not in accept
			if it = SPACE
				get "+"
			else
				get charToANSI (it)
				format number it as "@h00"
				get "%" & it
			end
			char i of txt = it
		end
	end

	return txt
end

-- 0x739c7  to handle DoDragObject tgt, obj, loc, whatButton
to handle DoDragObject tgt, obj, loc, whatButton
	SYSTEM s_asym_dragObj
	LOCAL WORD counter

	s_asym_dragObj = obj

	_startLoc of obj = position of obj

	send ASYM_BeginDrag obj to this page

	if _locked of obj = "TRUE"
		clear s_asym_dragObj --??
		break
	end

	Xoffset = item 1 of loc - item 1 of position of obj
	Yoffset = item 2 of loc - item 2 of position of obj

	if _position of obj = NULL
		_position of obj = position of obj
	end

	oldLayer = layer of obj
	if ASYM_StayOnLayer of obj is not TRUE
		layer of obj = objectCount of (objectContainer(obj,"page,background"))
	end

	if false
		if _layer of obj = NULL
			_layer of obj = layer of obj
			layer of obj = 0
		end
	end

	_cursor = syscursor
	syscursor = 44
	counter = 0
	while keystate(whatButton) = DOWN
		loc = sysMousePosition
		if oldloc <> loc
			oldloc = loc
			move obj to item 1 of loc - Xoffset, item 2 of loc - Yoffset
		end
		increment counter
		if counter > 500
			counter = 0
			send ASYM_idle to this page
		end
	end
	in ASYM_WorkWindow()
		syscursor = _cursor
	end

	layer of obj = oldLayer

	send ASYM_ObjectDropped obj, loc to objectContainer(tgt,"page,background")

	if ASYM_SnapBack of obj = "TRUE" and _position of obj <> NULL
		oldLock = lockScreen of this window
		lockScreen of this window = true
		move obj to _position of obj
		if _layer of obj <> NULL
			layer of obj = _layer of obj
		end
		clear _position of obj
		clear _layer of obj
		lockScreen of this window = false
	end

	clear s_asym_dragObj
end

to handle DoMatchItemDrag tgt, obj, loc, whatButton
	LOCAL AnsArray[][]
	_lineRef = _lineRef of obj
	lockScreen of this window = false
	while keystate(whatButton) = DOWN
		loc = sysMousePosition
		if oldloc <> loc
			oldloc = loc
			items 3 to 4 of vertices of _lineRef = loc
		end
	end
end

-- 0x73dfd  to get _UpdateTargetObject obj
to get _UpdateTargetObject obj

  -- Look for a target even if the editor
  --  that does the assignment has not been run

	LOCAL ntgt

	if obj is null
		obj = target
	end

	tgt = ASYM_WID_TargetObject of obj
	parentObj = objectContainer(obj,"page,background")
	if isObject(tgt) and (evaluate (tgt)) is not obj
		return tgt
	end
	objList = ASYM_CollectWidgets(parentObj)
	tgtName = ASYM_WID_TargetName of obj
	step i from itemCount(objList) to 1 by -1
		get item i of objList
		if it is obj
			clear item i of objList
			continue step
		end
		if tgtName <> null and name of it is tgtName
			ntgt = words 1 to 7 of it
			break step
		else
			if words 1 to 3 of it is words 1 to 3 of tgt
				ntgt = it
				break step
			end
		end
	end
	NotTimerWidget = "time" is not in ASYM_WID_Name of obj

	if ntgt is null  -- nothing found by name, look harder
		step i from 1 to itemCount(objList)
			get item i of objList
			if ASYM_WID_Qtype of it <> NULL and \
			  (NotTimerWidget or (ASYM_WID_TimeMax of it is not 0))
				ntgt = it
				break step
			end
		end
	end
	if ntgt <> null
		nam = name of ntgt
		ASYM_WID_TargetName of obj = nam
		if nam is null
			get words 1 to 3 of ntgt
		else
			get word 1 of ntgt && quote & nam & quote
		end
		if nam is name of obj
			get ntgt
		end
		ASYM_WID_TargetObject of obj = it
	end
	return ntgt
end

-- 0x74191  to handle _ASYM_FlushMsgQ
to handle _ASYM_FlushMsgQ
	system s__ASYMMsgQ
	clear s__ASYMMsgQ
	linkdll "User"
		WORD RegisterWindowMessage(STRING)
		INT PeekMessage(POINTER, WORD, WORD, WORD, WORD)
	end
	lpMsg = ASYM_GetMemBlock(32)
	msgID = RegisterWindowMessage("ASYM_PostCO")
	if item 1 of lpMsg <> 0
		do
			get PeekMessage(lpMsg, 0, msgID, msgID, 1)
		until it = 0
		get ASYM_FreeMemBlock(lpMsg)
	end
end

to get _ASYM_RandomList numItems, inList
	LOCAL STACK outList

	conditions
		when numItems = NULL and inList = NULL
			return NULL
		when numItems = NULL
			numItems = itemcount(inList)
			maxCount = numItems
		when inList = NULL
			step i from 1 to numItems
				push i onto inList
			end
			maxCount = numItems
		else
			maxCount = itemcount(inList)
			if maxCount = 1
				return inList
			end
	end

	numItems = min(numItems, maxCount)

	step i from 0 to numItems - 1
		get random(maxCount - i)
		push item it of inList onto outList
		clear item it of inList
	end
	return outList
end

to get _ASYM_DrawFocusRect pBounds, pViewer

	local INT x1, y1, x2, y2

	linkDLL "USER"
		WORD getDC(WORD)
		INT releaseDC (WORD, WORD)
		INT DrawFocusRect(WORD, POINTER)
	end linkDLL

	if (isObject(pViewer) = true) AND (object of pViewer = "viewer") then
		refViewer = pViewer
	else
		refViewer = targetWindow
	end if

	bs = ASYM_BlockSuspend()
	hDC = getDC(clientHandle of refViewer)

	bounds_Pixels = pageUnitsToClient(pBounds)
	x1 = item 1 of bounds_Pixels
	y1 = item 2 of bounds_Pixels
	x2 = item 3 of bounds_Pixels
	y2 = item 4 of bounds_Pixels

	pRect = ASYM_GetMemBlock (8)
	get pointerInt (0, pRect, x1)
	get pointerInt (2, pRect, y1)
	get pointerInt (4, pRect, x2)
	get pointerInt (6, pRect, y2)

	get DrawFocusRect(hDC, pRect)

	get releaseDC (clientHandle of refViewer, hDC)
	get freeMemBlock (pRect)

	err = ASYM_RestoreSuspend(bs)

	if err = NULL then
		retVal = true
	else
		retVal = false
	end if

	return retVal

end

to get _ASYM_DeleteHandler obRef, handlerName
	-- Deletes handler <handlerName> from script of <obRef>.
	-- <handlerName> follows same conventions as for getHandlerScript().

	-- It works by setting the handler to a known minimum handler, then
	-- doing a search and destroy on that text in the script.

	-- Returns the existing handler script.

	if not isObject (obRef)
		return null
	end

	if not ASYM_ItemInList (word 1 of handlerName, "to,notifyBefore,notifyAfter")
		put "to " before handlerName
	end

	-- construct minimal handler
	handlerType = words 1 to 2 of handlerName
	conditions
	when handlerType = "to get"
		txt = CRLF & handlerName & CRLF & "	return null" & CRLF & "end" & CRLF
	when handlerType = "to set"
		txt = CRLF & handlerName && "to value" & CRLF & "end" & CRLF
	else
		txt = CRLF & handlerName & CRLF & "end" & CRLF
	end

	-- replace existing handler
	bs = ASYM_BlockSuspend()
	oldScript = setHandlerScript (obRef, txt)
	bs = ASYM_RestoreSuspend(bs)

	if bs <> null
		sysError = bs
		return null
	end

	-- search for and delete the new handler
	scr = script of obRef
	get offset (txt, scr)
	if it > 0
		clear chars it to it + charCount (txt) - 1 of scr
		bs = ASYM_BlockSuspend()
		script of obRef = scr
		bs = ASYM_RestoreSuspend(bs)

		if bs = null
			return oldScript
		else
			sysError = bs
			return null
		end
	else
		return null
	end
end

to get _ASYM_DisableBackup
	-- temporarily turn off the backup feature by setting MaxBackups to 0
	-- and stashing its old value in oldMaxBackups

	oldMaxBackups = getToolBookIniItem("ToolBook","oldMaxBackups")

	-- if oldMaxBackups is not null, don't change it
	if oldMaxBackups = null
		-- store current MaxBackups in the OldMaxBacks
		curMaxBackups = getToolBookIniItem("ToolBook","MaxBackups")
		get setToolBookIniItem("ToolBook","oldMaxBackups",curMaxBackups)
	end

	-- Set MaxBackups to 0
	get setToolBookIniItem("ToolBook","MaxBackups",0)

	return TRUE
end

to get _ASYM_RestoreBackup
	-- restore the MaxBackups setting from the OldMaxBackups setting

	oldMaxBackups = getToolBookIniItem("ToolBook","oldMaxBackups")

	if oldMaxBackups <> null
		-- set MaxBackups to the OldMaxBackups
		get setToolBookIniItem("ToolBook","MaxBackups",oldMaxBackups)

		-- set the OldMaxBackups to null
		get setToolBookIniItem("ToolBook","oldMaxBackups",null)
	end

	return TRUE
end

	get pointerInt (6, pRect, y2)

	get DrawFocusRect(hDC, pRect)

	get releaseDC (clientHandle of refViewer, hDC)
	get freeMemBlock (pRect)

	err = ASYM_RestoreSuspend(bs)

	if err = NULL then
		retVal = true
	else
		retVal = false
	end if

	return retVal

end

to get _ASYM_DeleteHandler obRef, handlerName
	-- Deletes handler <handlerName> from script of <obRef>.
	-- <handlerName> follows same conventions as for getHandlerScript().

	-- It works by setting the handler to a known minimum handler, then
	-- doing a search and destroy on that text in the script.

	-- Returns the existing handler script.

		return null
	end

	end

		end

	end

to get _ASYM_DisableBackup
	-- temporarily turn off the backup feature by setting MaxBackups to 0
	-- and stashing its old value in oldMaxBackups

	oldMaxBackups = getToolBookIniItem("ToolBook","oldMaxBackups")

	-- if oldMaxBackups is not null, don't change it
	if oldMaxBackups = null
		-- store current MaxBackups in the OldMaxBacks
		curMaxBackups = getToolBookIniItem("ToolBook","MaxBackups")
		get setToolBookIniItem("ToolBook","oldMaxBackups",curMaxBackups)
	end

	-- Set MaxBackups to 0
	get setToolBookIniItem("ToolBook","MaxBackups",0)

	return TRUE
end

to get _ASYM_RestoreBackup
	-- restore the MaxBackups setting from the OldMaxBackups setting

	oldMaxBackups = getToolBookIniItem("ToolBook","oldMaxBackups")

	if oldMaxBackups <> null
		-- set MaxBackups to the OldMaxBackups
		get setToolBookIniItem("ToolBook","MaxBackups",oldMaxBackups)

		-- set the OldMaxBackups to null
		get setToolBookIniItem("ToolBook","oldMaxBackups",null)
	end

	return TRUE
end

-- 0x74509  to get _ASYM_ProductDirectory
to get _ASYM_ProductDirectory
	SYSTEM s_ASYM_ProductDirectory, s_ASYM_LongProductDirectory

	if s_ASYM_ProductDirectory = NULL or s_ASYM_LongProductDirectory = NULL
		linkDLL "tbwin.dll"
			STRING GetIniVar(STRING,STRING,STRING)
		end

		s_ASYM_ProductDirectory = getIniVar("ToolBook Load Information", "TB" & ASYM_MTBVersion(), "ASYM.INI")
		if s_ASYM_ProductDirectory <> NULL
			s_ASYM_ProductDirectory = pathOfFile(s_ASYM_ProductDirectory)
			s_ASYM_LongProductDirectory = s_ASYM_ProductDirectory
		end
		if ASYM_Is32Bit()
			s_ASYM_LongProductDirectory = ASYM_GetLongFileName(s_ASYM_ProductDirectory, 1)
			s_ASYM_ProductDirectory = ASYM_GetShortFileName(s_ASYM_ProductDirectory, 1)
		end
	end

	return s_ASYM_ProductDirectory
end


to get _ASYM_LongProductDirectory
	SYSTEM s_ASYM_LongProductDirectory

	if s_ASYM_LongProductDirectory = NULL
		get ASYM_ProductDirectory()
	end

	return s_ASYM_LongProductDirectory
end


to get _ASYM_SystemDirectory
	SYSTEM s_ASYM_SystemDirectory, s_ASYM_ProductDirectory

	if s_ASYM_SystemDirectory = NULL
		s_ASYM_SystemDirectory = sysToolBookDirectory
		if ASYM_Is32Bit()
			s_ASYM_SystemDirectory = ASYM_GetShortFileName(s_ASYM_SystemDirectory, 1)
		end
	end

	return s_ASYM_SystemDirectory
end


to get _ASYM_DrawFocusRect pBounds, pViewer

	local INT x1, y1, x2, y2

	linkDLL "USER"
		WORD getDC(WORD)
		INT releaseDC (WORD, WORD)
		INT DrawFocusRect(WORD, POINTER)
	end linkDLL

	if (isObject(pViewer) = true) AND (object of pViewer = "viewer") then
		refViewer = pViewer
	else
		refViewer = targetWindow
	end if

	bs = ASYM_BlockSuspend()
	hDC = getDC(clientHandle of refViewer)

	bounds_Pixels = pageUnitsToClient(pBounds)
	x1 = item 1 of bounds_Pixels
	y1 = item 2 of bounds_Pixels
	x2 = item 3 of bounds_Pixels
	y2 = item 4 of bounds_Pixels

	pRect = ASYM_GetMemBlock (8)
	get pointerInt (0, pRect, x1)
	get pointerInt (2, pRect, y1)
	get pointerInt (4, pRect, x2)
	get pointerInt (6, pRect, y2)

	get DrawFocusRect(hDC, pRect)

	get releaseDC (clientHandle of refViewer, hDC)
	get freeMemBlock (pRect)

	err = ASYM_RestoreSuspend(bs)

	if err = NULL then
		retVal = true
	else
		retVal = false
	end if

	return retVal

end

-- 0x74f49  to get _ASYM_MessageBox txt,titl,icn,btns,hlpTag,hlpFile
to get _ASYM_MessageBox txt,titl,icn,btns,hlpTag,hlpFile
	LOCAL WORD flags
	LOCAL TimerID

	linkDLL "USER"
		INT __MessageBox = MessageBox(WORD,STRING,STRING,WORD)
	end

	if hlpTag <> null or hlpFile <> null
		F1Msg = 0x0400+208
		translateWindowMessage for windowHandle of targetWindow
			on F1Msg send F1Pressed to self
		end
		my hlpTag = hlpTag
		my hlpFile = hlpFile
	end

	conditions
		when icn is "stop"
		when icn is "hand"
			increment flags by 0x0010
		when icn contains "question"
			increment flags by 0x0020
		when icn contains "exclamation"
		when icn contains "warning"
			increment flags by 0x0030
		when icn contains "info"
		when icn contains "asteri"
			increment flags by 0x0040
	end

	conditions
		when btns is "OKCancel"
			increment flags by 0x0001
		when btns is "RetryCancel"
			increment flags by 0x0005
		when btns is "AbortRetryIgnore"
			increment flags by 0x0002
		when btns is "YesNo"
			increment flags by 0x0004
		when btns is "YesNoCancel"
			increment flags by 0x0003
	end

	msgsBlocked = ASYM_SetPostMsgBlock(TRUE)
	retVal = __MessageBox(windowHandle of targetWindow,txt,titl,flags)
	get ASYM_SetPostMsgBlock(msgsBlocked)

	conditions
		when retVal = 1
			get "OK"
		when retVal = 2
			get "cancel"
		when retVal = 3
			get "abort"
		when retVal = 4
			get "retry"
		when retVal = 5
			get "ignore"
		when retVal = 6
			get "yes"
		when retVal = 7
			get "no"
	end

	if hlpTag <> null or hlpFile <> null
		F1Msg = 0x0400+208
		untranslateWindowMessage F1Msg for windowHandle of targetWindow
		clear my HlpTag
		clear my HlpFile
	end

	return it
end


to handle F1Pressed
	get ASYM_WinHelp(my HlpTag, my HlpFile)
end

end

to get _ASYM_LockWindows
	local winStateList

	my ss = sysSuspend; sysSuspend = FALSE; sysError = NULL
	winList = sysOpenWindows
	winCount = itemCount (winList)
	step i from 1 to winCount
		winRef = item i of winList
		item i of winStateList = enabled of winRef
		enabled of winRef = FALSE
	end
	return winList & CRLF & winStateList
end

to get _ASYM_UnlockWindows winDetails
	local OBJECT winRef

	winList = textline 1 of winDetails
	winStateList = textline 2 of winDetails

	winCount = itemCount (winList)
	step i from 1 to winCount
		sysError = NULL
		winRef = item i of winList
		if sysError = NULL and isOpen of winRef
			enabled of winRef = item i of winStateList
		end
	end
	sysError = NULL
	sysSuspend = my ss
	my ss = NULL
	return TRUE
end

	sysError = NULL
	sysSuspend = my ss
	my ss = NULL
	return TRUE
end

-- 0x7591a  to get __ASYM_SysCursor
to get __ASYM_SysCursor
	get ASYM_BlockSuspend()
	retVal = sysCursor
	get ASYM_RestoreSuspend (it)
	if it <> null or not ASYM_IsNumber(retVal)
		retVal = 1
	end
	return retVal
end


--************************************
to get _ASYM_WorkingCursor pShow
	retVal = sysCursor
	if pShow <> FALSE then
		pShow = TRUE
	end if
	if pShow = TRUE then
		myBook = objectContainer(self, "book")
		sysCursor = cursor "WorkingInBackground" of myBook
	else
		sysCursor = default
	end if
	return retVal
end

to get _ASYM_CursorInResizeHandle
	system _s_ASYM_ResizeCursors

	if _s_ASYM_ResizeCursors = NULL
		linkDLL "user"
			WORD GetCursor()
		end

		get sysCursor
		step i from 40 to 43
			sysCursor = i
			push getCursor() onto _s_ASYM_ResizeCursors
			bs = ASYM_BlockSuspend()
			sysCursor = it
			bs = ASYM_RestoreSuspend(bs)
			if bs <> null
				sysCursor = 1
			end
		end
	end

	get sysCursor
	sysCursor = 1
	hCursor = getCursor()
	bs = ASYM_BlockSuspend()
	sysCursor = it
	bs = ASYM_RestoreSuspend(bs)

	return ASYM_ItemInList (hCursor, _s_ASYM_ResizeCursors)
end


--************************************
to handle _ASYM_ElapsedCursor nmax, n, curName
	myBk = objectContainer(self, "book")
	if nmax is null or (nmax = 0 and n = 0)
		sysCursor = 1
		break
	end
	if curname is "t"
		n = 30 * n / nmax;c = cursor ("t" & round(n)) of myBk
	else
		n = 20 * n / nmax;c = cursor ("wait" & round(n)) of myBk
	end
	ss = sysSuspend; sysSuspend = false;get sysCursor;sysSuspend = ss
	if c <> it
		sysCursor = c
	end
end

-- 0x75ceb  to get ASYM_DuplicateClip clipRef
to get ASYM_DuplicateClip clipRef
	local STRING clipString

	if not isObject (clipRef)
		return null
	end

	-- get a book reference from the clip
	in mainWindow
		clipString = clipRef
		get offset (" of book" && quote, clipString)
		if it = 0
			bkRef = parent of mainWindow
		else
			bkRef = chars it + 4 to charCount (clipString) of clipString
		end
	end

	myBk = objectContainer (self, "book")
	copy resource clipRef to myBk
	tempClipRef = item 1 of resourceList ("clip", myBk)
	copy resource tempClipRef to bkRef
	remove resource tempClipRef
	newClipRef = item 1 of resourceList ("clip", bkRef)
	return newClipRef
end

to get ASYM_IsClip STRING pClip, pTargetBook
	local STRING myClip

	retVal = false

	refBook = pTargetBook

	-- user is allowed to pass in complete string: clip ID 5 of book "foo"
	-- or clip "foo" of book "foo"
	if " of book """ is not in pClip
		if (refBook = NULL) or (isObject(refBook) = false) or (object of refBook <>"Book")
			refBook = this book
		end

		myClip = pClip & " of " & refBook
	else
		myClip = pClip
	end

	bs = ASYM_BlockSuspend()

	nameOfMyClip = name of myClip

	bs = ASYM_RestoreSuspend(bs)

	if bs = NULL
		retVal = true
	end

	return retVal
end

-- 0x76001  to get _ASYM_ViewerContainer pObjRef
to get _ASYM_ViewerContainer pObjRef
	retVal = NULL

	if pObjRef = NULL
		pObjRef = target
	end if

	if isObject(pObjRef)

		objType = object of pObjRef
		objParent = NULL

		if objType = "viewer"
			retVal = pObjRef
		else

			if objType is in "page,background" then
				objParent = pObjRef
			else
				objParent = objectContainer(pObjRef, "page,background")
			end if

			vList = NULL
			conditions
				when objType = "book"
					workList = sysOpenWindows
					while workList <> NULL
						pop workList into thisViewer
						if parent of parent of currentPage of thisViewer = pObjRef then
							push thisViewer onto vList
						end if
					end while

				when object of objParent = "background"
					workList = sysOpenWindows
					while workList <> NULL
						pop workList into thisViewer
						if parent of currentPage of thisViewer = objParent then
							push thisViewer onto vList
						end if
					end while

				when object of objParent = "page"
					vList = shownBy of objParent

			end conditions

			numViewers = itemCount(vList)
			if numViewers > 1 then

				rankedViewers = targetWindow,focusWindow,ASYM_WorkWindow(),mainWindow
				numRanked = 4
				step i from 1 to numRanked
					thisViewer = item i of rankedViewers
					if thisViewer is in vList then
						retVal = thisViewer
						break step
					end if
				end

				if retVal = NULL then
					retVal = item 1 of vList
				end if

			else
				retVal = vList
			end

		end if

	end if

	return retVal
end _ASYM_ViewerContainer


to get _ASYM_SetWorkWindow object v
	system s_ASYMWorkWindow

	if isOpen of v
	 	s_ASYMWorkWindow = v
	 	return true
	end
	return false
end


to get _ASYM_WorkWindow
	SYSTEM s_ASYMWorkWindow
	LOCAL STRING vRef

	vRef = s_ASYMWorkWindow
	conditions
		when vRef is null
		when not isObject(vRef)
		when not isOpen of vRef
			s_ASYMWorkWindow = mainWindow
		else
			s_ASYMWorkWindow = vRef
	end
	return s_ASYMWorkWindow
end


to get _ASYM_DisableWindows
	local ret

	vl = sysOpenWindows
	while vl <> NULL
		pop vl
		if enabled of it
			push it onto ret
		end
		enabled of it = false
	end

	if sysRuntime = false
		-- hide any visible palettes that might cause us problems
		if visible of toolbar = true and tile of toolbar = "none"
			push "toolbar" onto ret
			hide toolbar
		end

		if visible of colorTray = true
			push "colorTray" onto ret
			hide colorTray
		end
	end

	return ret
end

to get _ASYM_EnableWindows val
	while val <> NULL
		pop val into ob

		conditions
		when ob = "toolbar"
			send showToolbar when idle
		when ob = "colorTray"
			send showColorTray when idle
		else
			if ASYM_ObjectExists(ob) and isOpen of ob
				enabled of ob = true
			end
		end
	end
	return true
end

to handle showToolbar
	if sysRuntime = false
		show toolbar
	end
end

to handle showColorTray
	if sysRuntime = false
		show colorTray
	end
end

-- 0x76683  to get _ASYM_ClearClipboard
to get _ASYM_ClearClipboard

	retVal = false

	if ASYM_Is32Bit() then
		linkDLL32 "USER32.DLL"
			INT CloseClipboard()
			INT EmptyClipboard()
			INT OpenClipboard(WORD)
		end linkDLL32
	else
		linkDLL "USER"
			INT CloseClipboard()
			INT EmptyClipboard()
			INT OpenClipboard(WORD)
		end linkDLL
	end

	openSuccess = OpenClipboard(sysWindowHandle)
	if openSuccess <> 0 then
		get EmptyClipboard()
		get CloseClipboard()
		retVal = true
	else
		-- another process has the clipboard open
	end if

	return retVal
end _ASYM_ClearClipboard

to get _ASYM_CopyTextToClipboard clipText
	-- Note that memory associated with data on the clipboard is freed by Windows when the clipboard
	-- is cleared, *NOT* by the application (but it must be left unlocked).
	-- limits to 32K characters as pointerString32 doesn't appear to be able to handle more than that.

	linkDLL32 "user32.dll"
		INT 	OpenClipboard32 	= OpenClipboard 	(DWORD)
		DWORD 	SetClipboardData32 	= SetClipboardData 	(DWORD, DWORD)
		INT 	CloseClipboard32 	= CloseClipboard	()
		INT 	EmptyClipboard32 	= EmptyClipboard	()
	end

	linkDLL32 "kernel32.dll"
		DWORD GlobalAlloc32 = GlobalAlloc (DWORD, DWORD)
		POINTER32 GlobalLock32 = GlobalLock (DWORD)
		INT GlobalUnlock32 = GlobalUnlock (DWORD)
	end

	GMEM_MOVEABLE = 0x0002
	GMEM_DDESHARE = 0x2000
	CF_OEMTEXT = 7

	get OpenClipboard32 (windowHandle of targetWindow)
	if it > 0
		get EmptyClipboard32()
		if it > 0
			num = min (32766, charCount (clipText))
			hGlobal = GlobalAlloc32 (GMEM_MOVEABLE, num + 1)
			if hGlobal > 0
				pClipText = GlobalLock32 (hGlobal)
				get pointerString32 (0, pClipText, chars 1 to num of clipText)
				get GlobalUnlock32 (hGlobal)
				get SetClipboardData32 (CF_OEMTEXT, hGlobal)
				if it = 0
					return false
				end
			else
				return false
			end
		else
			return false
		end
		get CloseClipboard32()
	else
		return false
	end

	return true
end

-- 0x76b4d  to get _ASYM_checkHyperSysBook
to get _ASYM_checkHyperSysBook
	hyperSBK = "TB" & ASYM_MTBVersion() & "hyp.sbk"
	if hyperSBK is in sysBooks
		return TRUE

to get _ASYM_EnableHyperlinks
	sbk = ASYM_ProductPrefix() & ASYM_MTBVersion() & "hyp.sbk"
	if sbk is in sysBooks
		return TRUE
	else
		sbk = sysToolBookDirectory & sbk
		if isObject("book" && QUOTE & sbk & QUOTE)
			item itemCount(sysBooks)+1 of sysBooks = sbk
			return TRUE
		end
	end
	return FALSE
end


to get _ASYM_GlossaryPage term, bkName
	if bkName is null
		si = ASYM_BlockSuspend ()
		get page (term) of background "glossary" of this book
		si = ASYM_RestoreSuspend (si)
		if si is null
			return it
		end
		bkName = ASYM_GlossaryName of this book
	end
	if bkName is null
		bkName = "GLOSSARY.TBK"
	end
	return ASYM_FindHyperPage (term, null, bkName)
end

-- 0x76e03  to get _ASYM_ExtensionName ob
to get _ASYM_ExtensionName ob
	local guid, ctlNm

	linkDLL "tbreg.dll"
		STRING RegistryGetKey (STRING, STRING)
	end
	bookRef = objectContainer (ob, "book")
	ctl = object of ob

	get ASYM_BlockSuspend()
	guid = clsidFromExtObjectName (ctl, bookRef)
	get ASYM_RestoreSuspend (it)

	if guid <> NULL
		get "HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT\CLSID\" & guid
		ctlNm = RegistryGetKey  (it,"")
	end
	if ctlNm = NULL
		ctlNm = ctl
	end
	return ctlNm
end


to get _ASYM_FileFromCLSID pCLSID

	retVal = NULL

	if pCLSID <> NULL

		-- Determine if the CLSID is registered on the user's machine
		linkDLL "tbreg.dll"
			STRING registryGetKey(STRING, STRING)
		end

		-- Root for CLSID entries:
		CLSIDRoot= "HKEY_CLASSES_ROOT\CLSID\"

		CLSIDToFind = CLSIDRoot & pCLSID & "\InProcServer32"

		CLSIDFile = registryGetKey(CLSIDToFind)

		if (CLSIDFile <> NULL) and (ASYM_IsFile(CLSIDFile) = TRUE)
			retVal = CLSIDFile
		end if

	end if

	return retVal

end

		CLSIDFile = registryGetKey(CLSIDToFind)

		if (CLSIDFile <> NULL) and (ASYM_IsFile(CLSIDFile) = TRUE)
			retVal = CLSIDFile
		end if

	end if

	return retVal

end

-- 0x770d9  to get _ASYM_InternationalFile pFileName, pValidateFile
to get _ASYM_InternationalFile pFileName, pValidateFile
	system DYNAMIC _s_ASYM_LocalizedFilenames[][]

	intl_Filename = NULL

	if pFileName <> NULL

		-- Check to see if this file has already been resolved and stored
		-- in the cache array
		numFiles = item 1 of dimensions(_s_ASYM_LocalizedFilenames)
		step i from 1 to numFiles
			if _s_ASYM_LocalizedFilenames[i][1] = pFileName then
				intl_Filename = _s_ASYM_LocalizedFilenames[i][2]
				break step
			end if
		end step

		if intl_Filename = NULL

			languageCode = sysLanguageCode

			if languageCode <> "ENU"
				intl_Filename = ASYM_PathOfFile(pFileName) & \
						ASYM_ParsePath(pFileName, "FILENAME_ONLY") & \
						"-" & languageCode & "." & ASYM_ParsePath(pFileName, "EXTENSION_ONLY")
			else
				intl_Filename = pFileName
			end if

			if pValidateFile = TRUE then
				if ASYM_IsAbsoluteFilePath(intl_Filename) <> TRUE then
					if object of targetBook = "book" then
						targetBook = target
					else
						targetBook = objectContainer(target, "book")
					end if
					put ASYM_PathOfFile(name of targetBook) before intl_Filename
				end if

				if bookVersion(intl_Filename) = NULL
					-- If we can't find the appropriate international file, try
					-- for the default version.
					intl_Filename = pFileName
					if ASYM_IsAbsoluteFilePath(intl_Filename) <> TRUE then
						targetBook = objectContainer(target, "book")
						put ASYM_PathOfFile(name of targetBook) before intl_Filename
					end if

					if bookVersion(intl_Filename) = NULL
						-- If we still can't find it, return NULL
						intl_Filename = NULL
					end if
				end if

				if intl_Filename <> NULL then
					-- We found one, so add it to the cache array.
					_s_ASYM_LocalizedFilenames[numFiles + 1][1] = pFileName
					_s_ASYM_LocalizedFilenames[numFiles + 1][2] = intl_Filename
				end if

			end if

		end if

	end if

	return intl_Filename
end

-- 0x7752f  to get ASYM_QuickSortList lst, asText
to get ASYM_QuickSortList lst, asText
	-- Sorts lst numerically using the QuickSort algorithm.

	-- as the whole point of QuickSort is to sort as quickly as possible, this
	-- function does no error checking. Thus it will ES if lst contains non-
	-- numeric values, for example.

	local dataArray[]
	local STACK retVal

	fill dataArray with lst in [item] order
	numItems = dimensions (dataArray)

	if asText = true
		get quickSortText (dataArray, 1, numItems)
	else
		get quickSort (dataArray, 1, numItems)
	end
	step i from numItems to 1 by -1
		push dataArray[i] onto retVal
	end

	return retVal
end

to get quickSort data[] by reference, left, right
	if left < right
		midPoint = partition (data, left, right)
		get quickSort (data, left, midPoint)
		get quickSort (data, midPoint + 1, right)
	end
	return true
end

to get quickSortText data[] by reference, left, right
	if left < right
		midPoint = partitionText (data, left, right)
		get quickSortText (data, left, midPoint)
		get quickSortText (data, midPoint + 1, right)
	end
	return true
end

to get partition data[] by reference, left, right
	x = data[left]
	i = left
	j = right

	while true
		while data[j] > x
			decrement j
		end
		while data[i] < x
			increment i
		end

		if i < j
			if data[i] <> data[j]
				temp = data[i]
				data[i] = data[j]
				data[j] = temp
			else
				decrement j
			end if
		else
			break while
		end
	end

	return j
end

to get partitionText data[] by reference, left, right
	x = data[left]
	i = left
	j = right

	while true
		while data[j] > x as text
			decrement j
		end
		while data[i] < x as text
			increment i
		end

		if i < j
			if data[i] <> data[j]
				temp = data[i]
				data[i] = data[j]
				data[j] = temp
			else
				decrement j
			end if
		else
			break while
		end
	end

	return j
end

-- 0x78043  to get _ASYM_PageUnitsToStandardUnits
to get _ASYM_PageUnitsToStandardUnits
	local STACK retVal

	englishUnits = (sysUnits = "English")

	args = itemCount (argList)
	step i from 1 to args
		pageUnits = item i of argList
		if englishUnits
			standardUnits = pageUnits / 1440
			format standardUnits as "0.00"
		else
			standardUnits = pageUnits / 1440 * 2.54
			format standardUnits as "0.00"
		end
		item i of retVal = standardUnits
	end
	return retVal
end

to get _ASYM_StandardUnitsToPageUnits value, noRounding
	local STACK retVal

	englishUnits = (sysUnits = "English")
	xPix = item 1 of sysPageUnitsPerPixel

	args = itemcount (value)
	step i from 1 to args
		standardUnits = item i of value
		if englishUnits
			pageUnits = round (standardUnits * 1440)
		else
			pageUnits = round (standardUnits * 1440 / 2.54)
		end
		if noRounding <> true
			pageUnits = round (pageUnits / xPix) * xPix
		end if
		item i of retVal = pageUnits
	end
	return retVal
end

-- 0x78142  to get _ASYM_StandardUnitsToPageUnits value, noRounding

-- 0x78293  to get tooltip targetRef
to get tooltip targetRef
	tooltip = textline 1 of ASYM_ToolTip of targetRef
	if charCount(tooltip) = 1
		put " " before tooltip
	end if
	startPos = offset ("<", tooltip)
	while startPos > 0
		endPos = offset (">", tooltip)
		if endPos = 0
			break while
		end
		insertName = chars startPos + 1 to endPos - 1 of tooltip
		insertVal = ASYM_TooltipInsert (insertName) of targetRef
		chars startPos to endPos of tooltip = insertVal
	end
	return tooltip
end

to handle doToolTip targetRef
	system _ASYM_Tooltip, _ASYM_TooltipOnTimer, _ASYM_TooltipOffTimer

	_ASYM_Tooltip = tooltip (targetRef)
	if _ASYM_Tooltip = NULL
		break
	end

	vRef = viewer "tooltip" of parent of parent of self

	if _ASYM_TooltipOffTimer <> NULL
		ss = sysSuspend; sysSuspend = FALSE; se = sysError
		get timerStop (_ASYM_TooltipOffTimer)
		sysSuspend = ss; sysError = se
		clear _ASYM_TooltipOffTimer
		send showTooltip _ASYM_Tooltip, mousePosition of targetWindow
	else
		if _ASYM_TooltipOnTimer <> NULL
			ss = sysSuspend; sysSuspend = FALSE; se = sysError
			get timerStop (_ASYM_TooltipOnTimer)
			sysSuspend = ss; sysError = se
		end

		_ASYM_TooltipOnTimer = timerStart ("single", 500, 100, self)
	end
end

to handle timerNotify timerID
	system _ASYM_TooltipOnTimer, _ASYM_TooltipOffTimer, _ASYM_Tooltip

	conditions
		when timerID = _ASYM_TooltipOnTimer
			clear _ASYM_TooltipOnTimer
			send showTooltip _ASYM_Tooltip, mousePosition of targetWindow
		when timerID = _ASYM_TooltipOffTimer
			clear _ASYM_TooltipOffTimer
		else
			msgTxt = ASYM_GetString("errToolTipInvalidTimerID", \
					"Error in tooltip system - Invalid timer ID")
			msgCaption = SPACE
			get ASYM_MessageBox(msgTxt, msgCaption, "WARNING", "OK")
	end
end

to handle showTooltip
	fRef = field "tooltip" of self
	vRef = viewer "tooltip" of parent of parent of self

	tooltipInfo = getTooltipInfo()
	tooltip = textline 1 of tooltipInfo

	text of fRef = tooltip

	maxWidth = 165 * charCount (tooltip)
	minWidth = 0

	do
		testWidth = (maxWidth + minWidth) / 2
		item 1 of size of fRef = testWidth
		ovf = textOverflow of fRef
		if textOverflow of fRef > 0
			minWidth = testWidth
		else
			maxWidth = testWidth
		end
	until maxWidth - minWidth < 60

	item 1 of size of fRef = maxWidth

	tipBounds = bounds of fRef

	toolInfo = getTooltipInfo()

	if toolInfo = NULL
		break
	end

	newTooltip = textline 1 of toolInfo

	if newTooltip <> tooltip
		if newTooltip <> NULL
			send showTooltip
		end
		break
	end

	pos = textline 2 of toolInfo
	inVRef = textline 3 of toolInfo
	pos = pageUnitsToScreen (pos, inVRef)
	increment item 2 of pos by 18
	pix = sysPageUnitsPerPixel
	vSize = item 3 of tipBounds / item 1 of pix + 5, item 4 of tipBounds / item 2 of pix + 1

	-- Check that we don't go off the edge of the screen.
	mousePos = pageUnitsToScreen(textline 2 of toolinfo, inVRef)
	mouseX = item 1 of mousePos
	mouseY = item 2 of mousePos

	screenBounds = ASYM_ScreenBounds (mousePos)

	if item 1 of pos < item 1 of screenBounds
		xPos = item 1 of screenBounds
		item 1 of pos = xPos
		-- are we placing it under the mouse?
		if mouseX >= xPos and mouseX <= xPos + item 1 of vSize
			item 1 of pos = mouseX + 1
		end
	else
		if item 1 of pos + item 1 of vSize > item 3 of screenBounds
			xPos = item 3 of screenBounds - item 1 of vSize
			item 1 of pos = xPos
			-- are we placing it under the mouse?
			if (mouseX >= xPos) and (mouseX <= xPos + item 1 of vSize) then
				item 1 of pos = (mouseX - item 1 of vSize) - 1
			end if
		end
	end

	if item 2 of pos < item 2 of screenBounds
		yPos = item 2 of screenBounds
		item 2 of pos = yPos
		-- are we placing it under the mouse?
		if mouseY >= yPos and mouseY <= yPos + item 2 of vSize
			item 2 of pos = mouseY + 1
		end
	else
		if item 2 of pos + item 2 of vSize > item 4 of screenBounds
			yPos = item 4 of screenBounds - item 2 of vSize
			item 2 of pos = yPos
			-- are we placing it under the mouse?
			if (mouseY >= yPos) and (mouseY <= yPos + item 2 of vSize) then
				item 2 of pos = (mouseY - item 2 of vSize) - 1
			end if
		end
	end

	ssm = sysSuspendMessages
	sysSuspendMessages = TRUE
	if not isOpen of vRef
		in mainWindow
			open vRef
		end
	end
	size of vRef = vSize
	position of vRef = pos
	if not visible of vRef
		show vRef as notActive
	end
	sysSuspendMessages = ssm
end

to get getTooltipInfo
	mousePos = pageUnitsToScreen (mousePosition of targetWindow, targetWindow)
	vRef = windowFromPoint (mousePos)

	if vRef = NULL or (sysLevel = "author" and alwaysReader of vRef = FALSE)
		return NULL
	end

	pos = mousePosition of vRef
	obRef = objectFromPoint (mousePosition of vRef, vRef)

	if obRef = NULL
		return NULL
	end

	tooltip = tooltip (obRef)
	if toolTip = NULL
		return NULL
	end

	return tooltip & CRLF & pos & CRLF & vRef
end


to handle hideTooltip targetRef
	system _ASYM_TooltipOffTimer, _ASYM_TooltipOnTimer

	_ASYM_Tooltip = tooltip (targetRef)
	if _ASYM_Tooltip = NULL
		break
	end

	vRef = viewer "tooltip" of parent of parent of self

	if _ASYM_TooltipOnTimer <> NULL
		ss = sysSuspend; sysSuspend = FALSE; se = sysError
		get timerStop (_ASYM_TooltipOnTimer)
		sysSuspend = ss; sysError = se
		clear _ASYM_TooltipOnTimer
	end

	if visible of vRef
		hide vRef
		if _ASYM_TooltipOffTimer <> NULL
			get timerStop (_ASYM_TooltipOffTimer)
		end
		_ASYM_TooltipOffTimer = timerStart ("single", 100, 100, self)
	end
end

to handle _killTooltipTimers
	-- tooltip timers are killed on enterWindow and leaveWindow to ensure
	-- they're not fired off spuriously.

	system _ASYM_TooltipOffTimer, _ASYM_TooltipOnTimer

	if _ASYM_TooltipOffTimer <> NULL
		get timerStop (_ASYM_TooltipOffTimer)
		_ASYM_TooltipOffTimer = NULL
	end

	if _ASYM_TooltipOnTimer <> NULL
		get timerStop (_ASYM_TooltipOnTimer)
		_ASYM_TooltipOnTimer = NULL
	end

	vRef = viewer "tooltip" of parent of parent of self
	if visible of vRef
		hide vRef
	end
end

		yPos = item 2 of screenBounds
		item 2 of pos = yPos
		-- are we placing it under the mouse?
		if mouseY >= yPos and mouseY <= yPos + item 2 of vSize
			item 2 of pos = mouseY + 1
		end
	else
		if item 2 of pos + item 2 of vSize > item 4 of screenBounds
			yPos = item 4 of screenBounds - item 2 of vSize
			item 2 of pos = yPos
			-- are we placing it under the mouse?
			if (mouseY >= yPos) and (mouseY <= yPos + item 2 of vSize) then
				item 2 of pos = (mouseY - item 2 of vSize) - 1
			end if
		end
	end

	ssm = sysSuspendMessages
	sysSuspendMessages = TRUE
	if not isOpen of vRef
		in mainWindow
			open vRef
		end
	end
	size of vRef = vSize
	position of vRef = pos
	if not visible of vRef
		show vRef as notActive
	end
	sysSuspendMessages = ssm
end

to get getTooltipInfo
	mousePos = pageUnitsToScreen (mousePosition of targetWindow, targetWindow)
	vRef = windowFromPoint (mousePos)

	if vRef = NULL or (sysLevel = "author" and alwaysReader of vRef = FALSE)
		return NULL
	end

	pos = mousePosition of vRef
	obRef = objectFromPoint (mousePosition of vRef, vRef)

	if obRef = NULL
		return NULL
	end

	tooltip = tooltip (obRef)
	if toolTip = NULL
		return NULL
	end

	return tooltip & CRLF & pos & CRLF & vRef
end


to handle hideTooltip targetRef
	system _ASYM_TooltipOffTimer, _ASYM_TooltipOnTimer

	_ASYM_Tooltip = tooltip (targetRef)
	if _ASYM_Tooltip = NULL
		break
	end

	vRef = viewer "tooltip" of parent of parent of self

	if _ASYM_TooltipOnTimer <> NULL
		ss = sysSuspend; sysSuspend = FALSE; se = sysError
		get timerStop (_ASYM_TooltipOnTimer)
		sysSuspend = ss; sysError = se
		clear _ASYM_TooltipOnTimer
	end

	if visible of vRef
		hide vRef
		if _ASYM_TooltipOffTimer <> NULL
			get timerStop (_ASYM_TooltipOffTimer)
		end
		_ASYM_TooltipOffTimer = timerStart ("single", 100, 100, self)
	end
end

to handle _killTooltipTimers
	-- tooltip timers are killed on enterWindow and leaveWindow to ensure
	-- they're not fired off spuriously.

	system _ASYM_TooltipOffTimer, _ASYM_TooltipOnTimer

	if _ASYM_TooltipOffTimer <> NULL
		get timerStop (_ASYM_TooltipOffTimer)
		_ASYM_TooltipOffTimer = NULL
	end

	if _ASYM_TooltipOnTimer <> NULL
		get timerStop (_ASYM_TooltipOnTimer)
		_ASYM_TooltipOnTimer = NULL
	end

	vRef = viewer "tooltip" of parent of parent of self
	if visible of vRef
		hide vRef
	end
end

-- 0x78f31  to get _ASYM_ChooseFromTextLinesDlg dlgCaption, prompt, txtLines, deflt, helpTopicOrID
to get _ASYM_ChooseFromTextLinesDlg dlgCaption, prompt, txtLines, deflt, helpTopicOrID
	system s_tb80r_cftldb

	text of field "main list" of self = txtLines

	v = viewer "ChooseFromTextLinesDlg" of objectContainer(self,"book")
	defaultPage of v = self
	open v
	caption of v = dlgCaption

	text of field "prompt" of self = prompt
	my deflt = deflt
	enabled of button "OK" of self = false

	helpButton = button "help" of self
	if helpTopicOrID <> Null
		visible of helpButton = true
		helpTopicOrID of helpButton = helpTopicOrID
	else
		visible of helpButton = false
		helpTopicOrID of helpButton = null
	end

	clear s_tb80r_cftldb
	get FlushMessageQueue()
	sysCursor = 1
	show v as modal
	clear defaultPage of v
	get s_tb80r_cftldb & ""
	clear s_tb80r_cftldb
	return it
end

to handle enterPage
	forward
	fld = field "main list" of self
	customSize of self = "small"
	if textOverflow of fld > 0
		borderStyle of fld = "scrolling"
	else
		borderStyle of fld = "rectangle"
	end
	if textOverflow of field "prompt" of self > 0
		customSize of self = "medium"
	else
		get textRightOverflow of fld
		step i from 1 to itemCount(it)
			if item i of it > 0
				customSize of self = "medium"
				break step
			end
		end
	end
	get textRightOverflow of fld
	step i from 1 to itemCount(it)
		if item i of it > 0
			customSize of self = "large"
			break step
		end
	end
end

to handle Cancel
	send closeThisWindow
end

to handle closeThisWindow
	if this window <> mainWindow
		close this window
	end
end

to handle firstIdle
	fld = field "main list" of self
	if text of fld <> null
		i = 1
		get my deflt
		if it <> null
			txt = text of fld
			cnt = textLineCount(txt)
			step i from 1 to cnt
				if textline i of txt is it
					break step
				end
			end
		end
		selectedTextLines of fld = i
		okBtn = button "OK" of self
		enabled of okBtn = true
		if cnt > 1
			focus = fld
		else
			focus = okBtn
		end
	end
end

to handle idle
	forward
	fld = field "main list" of self
	if text of fld <> null
		get selectedTextLines of fld
		enabled of button "OK" of self = \
		  (it <> null and it > 0 and textline it of text of fld <> null)
	end
end

to handle OK
	system s_tb80r_cftldb

	fld = field "main list" of self
	get selectedTextLines of fld
	if it <> null and it > 0
		get textline it of text of fld
		if it <> null
			s_tb80r_cftldb = it
			send closeThisWindow
		end
	end
end

		bounds of grpList = 75,585,4755,2490
		position of OKbtn = 4875,45
		position of Cancelbtn = 4875,495
		position of Helpbtn = 4875,1095

		bounds of grpList = 75,585,7200,2490
		position of OKbtn = 7335,45
		position of Cancelbtn = 7335,495
		position of Helpbtn = 7335,1095
		size of this background = 8880,2595
	end
end

-- 0x796c7  to handle buttonClick
to handle buttonClick
	SYSTEM _s_ASYM_AskRequestCmdButtonResponse
	conditions
		when escape of target = true
			close this window
		when help of target = true
			helpFile   = helpFile   of myPage
			helpTopic  = helpTopic  of myPage

			-- try to launch the help file.
			in mainWindow
				get asym_winHelp(helpTopic,helpFile)
			end
		else
			_s_ASYM_AskRequestCmdButtonResponse = name of target
			hide this window
		end
end

to handle keyDown key
	if key = keyDownArrow OR key = keyRightArrow OR key = keyUpArrow or key = keyLeftArrow
		curObjs = objects of self

		-- gather list of cmd buttons that are visible
		step k from itemCount(curObjs) to 1 by - 1
			curObj = item k of curObjs
			if visible of curObj = false
				clear item k of curObjs
			end
		end

		-- how many are showing
		btnCount = itemCount(curObjs)

		-- which button # is in focus now?
		obNumber = name of target
		clear char 1 of obNumber

		-- determine which button should next be in focus
		conditions
			when key = keyDownArrow or key = keyRightArrow
				newObNumber = obNumber + 1
				if newObNumber > btnCount
					decrement newObNumber by btnCount
				end

			when key = keyUpArrow or key = keyLeftArrow
				newObNumber = obNumber - 1
				if newObNumber = 0
					newObNumber = btnCount
				end
		end
		focus = item newObNumber of curobjs
	else
		forward
	end
end

-- 0x79a84  to get moveDefRect object defRect, object obj
to get moveDefRect object defRect, object obj
	local stack bnds

	xp = item 1 of sysPageUnitsPerPixel
	yp = item 1 of sysPageUnitsPerPixel

	oldObj = my oldObj
	if oldObj is obj
		return false
	end

	if isObject(oldObj)
		get resetRect(oldObj)
	end

	bnds = bounds of obj

	x1 = item 1 of bnds
	y1 = item 2 of bnds
	x2 = item 3 of bnds
	y2 = item 4 of bnds

	vertices of defRect = \
		x1 + xp, y1 + yp, \
		x1 + xp, y1     , \
		x2 - xp, y1     , \
		x2 - xp, y1 + yp, \
		x2     , y1 + yp, \
		x2     , y2 - yp, \
		x2 - xp, y2 - yp, \
		x2 - xp, y2     , \
		x1 + xp, y2     , \
		x1 + xp, y2 - yp, \
		x1     , y2 - yp, \
		x1     , y1 + yp

	get layer of obj
	if layer of defRect > it
		layer of defRect = layer of obj
	else
		layer of defRect = it - 1
	end

	increment item 1 of bnds by xp
	increment item 2 of bnds by yp
	decrement item 3 of bnds by xp
	decrement item 4 of bnds by yp
	bounds of obj = bnds

	oldObj of self = obj

	return true
end

to get hideDefRect
	oldObj = oldObj of self

	if not isObject(oldObj)
		return false
	end
	get resetRect(oldObj)

	oldObj of self = null
	return true
end

to get resetRect object oldObj
	local stack bnds

	xp = item 1 of sysPageUnitsPerPixel
	yp = item 1 of sysPageUnitsPerPixel

	bnds = bounds of oldObj
	decrement item 1 of bnds by xp
	decrement item 2 of bnds by yp
	increment item 3 of bnds by xp
	increment item 4 of bnds by yp
	bounds of oldObj = bnds

	return true
end

to get createDefRect logical isBG
	if isBG
		send background
	end if

	draw irregularPolygon from \
		 0, 0 to \
		 1, 1 to \
		 2, 2 to \
		 3, 3 to \
		 4, 4 to \
		 5, 5 to \
		 6, 6 to \
		 7, 7 to \
		 8, 8 to \
		 9, 9 to \
		10,10 to \
		11,11 to \
		12,12

	strokeColor of selection = black
	lineStyle of selection = 1
	pattern of selection = none
	name of selection = "widget_defaultRect"

	return selection
end

to get defaultRect logical isBackground
	if isBackground
		container = this background
	else
		container = this page
	end
	ipList = getObjectList(container, "irregularPolygon", false)

	while ipList is not null
		pop ipList
		if name of it is "widget_defaultRect"
			return it
		end
	end
	return null
end

to get pushButtonList
	local stack pushButtonList
	btnList = getObjectList(this background, "button", false)
	btnList = btnList, getObjectList(this page, "button", false)
	while btnList is not null
		pop btnList
		if borderStyle of it is "pushButton"
			push it onto pushButtonList
		end
	end
	return pushButtonList
end

to get defPushButton
	btnList = pushButtonList()
	while btnList is not null
		pop btnList
		if default of it is true
			return it
		end
	end
	return null
end

to get escPushButton
	btnList = pushButtonList()
	while btnList is not null
		pop btnList
		if escape of it is true
			return it
		end
	end
	return null
end

to get isBackground obj
	parentObj = parent of obj
	while object of parentObj is not in "page, background"
		parentObj = parent of parentObj
	end
	if object of parentObj is "background"
		return true
	else
		return false
	end
end

to get showDefRect
	defBtn = defPushButton()
	get showRect(defBtn)
	return true
end

to get showRect obj
	if obj is not null
		isBG = isBackground(obj)
		defRect = defaultRect(isBG)
		if defRect is null
			defRect = createDefRect(isBG)
		end
		get moveDefRect(defRect, obj)
	else
		get hideDefRect()
	end if

	return true
end

notifyBefore enterField
	get showDefRect()
end

notifyBefore enterRecordField
	get showDefRect()
end

notifyBefore enterCombobox
	get showDefRect()
end

notifyBefore enterButton
	if borderStyle of target is "pushButton" and exclude of target <> TRUE
		get showRect(target)
	else
		get showDefRect()
	end
end

notifyBefore keyDown key
	local buttonRef

	buttonRef = null

	conditions
		when key is keyEscape
			buttonRef = escPushButton()
			break conditions
		when key is keyEnter
			buttonRef = defPushButton()
			get focus
			if it is not null
				if object of it is "button" and borderStyle of it is "pushButton" and exclude of target <> TRUE
					buttonRef = focus
				end
			end
			break conditions
	end conditions

	if buttonRef is not null
		send buttonClick to buttonRef
	end
end

notifyBefore author
	show self
	get hideDefRect()
end

notifyBefore reader
	hide self
end

notifyBefore enterPage
	if alwaysReader of this window = FALSE and sysLevel is author
		show self
	else
		hide self
	end
end

notifyBefore leavePage
	if sysLevel is "reader" or alwaysReader of this window
		get hideDefRect()
	end
end

notifyBefore selectionChanged
	if sysLevel is author and my visible is false
		show self
	end
end

notifyBefore setWidgetScript tbk_wid_name, newScript
	if tbk_wid_name = my tbk_wid_name
		set my script to newScript
	end
end

to get escPushButton
	btnList = pushButtonList()
	while btnList is not null
		pop btnList
		if escape of it is true
			return it
		end
	end
	return null

		parentObj = parent of parentObj

	if object of parentObj is "background"
		return true
	else
		return false
	end

	if obj is not null
		isBG = isBackground(obj)
		defRect = defaultRect(isBG)
		if defRect is null
			defRect = createDefRect(isBG)
		end
		get moveDefRect(defRect, obj)
	else
		get hideDefRect()
	end if

	return true
end

-- 0x79e09  to get createDefRect logical isBG
to get createDefRect logical isBG
	if isBG
		send background
	end if

	draw irregularPolygon from \
		 0, 0 to \
		 1, 1 to \
		 2, 2 to \
		 3, 3 to \
		 4, 4 to \
		 5, 5 to \
		 6, 6 to \
		 7, 7 to \
		 8, 8 to \
		 9, 9 to \
		10,10 to \
		11,11 to \
		12,12

	strokeColor of selection = black
	lineStyle of selection = 1
	pattern of selection = none
	name of selection = "widget_defaultRect"

	return selection
end

to get defaultRect logical isBackground
	if isBackground
		container = this background
	else
		container = this page
	end
	ipList = getObjectList(container, "irregularPolygon", false)

	while ipList is not null
		pop ipList
		if name of it is "widget_defaultRect"
			return it
		end
	end
	return null
end

	local stack pushButtonList

	while btnList is not null
		pop btnList
		if borderStyle of it is "pushButton"
			push it onto pushButtonList
		end
	end
	return pushButtonList
end

-- 0x7a4b3  to get _ASYM_PopRTFHelp fN, captn
to get _ASYM_PopRTFHelp fN, captn
	if ASYM_isFile(fN)
		myBk = objectContainer(self,"book")
		ss = sysSuspend;sysSuspend = false;clear sysError
		openFile fN
		if sysError is null
			readFile fN to eof
		end
		if sysError is null
			closeFile fN
		end
		if sysError is null
			v = viewer "rtf help popup" of myBk
			if not isOpen of v
				defaultPage of v = self
				open v
			else
				currentPage of v = self
			end
			if sysError is null
				fld = field "Text" of self
				if ".rtf" is in fN
					richText of fld = it
				else
					text of fld = it
				end
				scroll of fld = 0
			end
			send fixSize
			if captn is null
				captn = ASYM_GetStandardString("<help>","Help") of this book
			end
			caption of v = captn
			show v
		end
		sysSuspend = ss
		if sysError <> null
			msgTxt = ASYM_GetString("errPopRTFHelpError", "%1" & CRLF & CRLF & "%2")
			msgTxt = expandString(msgTxt, ASYM_GetStandardString("<Error>", ""), sysError)
			msgCaption = SPACE
			get ASYM_MessageBox(msgTxt, msgCaption, "WARNING", "OK")
			return false
		end
	else
		return false
	end
	return true
end

to handle ASYM_Reset
	v = viewer "rtf help popup" of objectContainer(self,"book")
	if isOpen of v
		close v
	end
	clear text of field "text" of self
end

to handle cancel
	if this window <> mainWindow
		close this window
	end
end

to handle copy
	f = focus
	lockScreen of this window = true
	fld = field "text" of self
	scrl = scroll of fld
	select text of fld
	send copy to system
	scroll of fld = scrl
	focus = f
end

to handle fixScroll fld
	if textOverflow of fld > 0 or textUnderflow of fld > 0
		get "scrolling"
	else
		get "rectangle"
	end
	borderStyle of fld = it
end

to handle fixSize
	send sizeToViewer
	fld = field "text" of self
	sz = size of my parent
	pop sz into r
	pop sz into b
	get bounds of fld
	item 1 of it = -15
	item 2 of it = item 4 of bounds of rectangle "toolbar" of self
	item 3 of it = r + 15; item 4 of it = b + 15
	bounds of fld = it
	send fixScroll fld
end

to handle keyUp x, iss, isc
	conditions
	when x = 27
		send cancel
	when (x = keyC or x = keyInsert) and isc
		send copy
	end
end

to handle leavePage
	clear text of field "text" of self
end

to handle windowSized
	send fixSize
end

-- 0x7aa6c  to handle enterBackground
to handle enterBackground
	if sysLevel = "author"
		my size = my _defSize
		----
		-- Size the video players (in a loop b/c orig sizing code doesn't work on first try).
		----
		vPages = my pages
		while vPages <> NULL
			pop vPages into vPg
			vObj = group "Video Player" of vPg
			while size of vObj <> my _defPlayerSize
				size of vObj = my _defPlayerSize
			end
		end
	end
end

----
-- Given the size of the video player frame (in the main book), calculate the size
-- of the media (play) area taking into account the height of the control buttons
-- and the stage's outside area. Return value is in pixels.
----
to get actualMediaSize STACK pFrameSizeInPageUnits
	local  STACK	vRetval

	vXFrame = item 1 of pFrameSizeInPageUnits
	vYFrame = item 2 of pFrameSizeInPageUnits
	vXpix = item 1 of sysPageUnitsPerPixel
	vYpix = item 2 of sysPageUnitsPerPixel
	vNonMediaAreaSizes = nonMediaAreaStageSizes()
	vXToSubtract = item 1 of vNonMediaAreaSizes
	vYToSubtract = item 2 of vNonMediaAreaSizes
	vRetval = round((vYFrame - vYToSubtract)/vYPix)
	push round((vXFrame - vXToSubtract)/vXPix) onto vRetval

	return vRetval
end

to get nonMediaAreaStageSizes
	local  STACK	vRetval

	vX = 0; vY = 0
	vXpix = item 1 of sysPageUnitsPerPixel
	vYpix = item 2 of sysPageUnitsPerPixel
	vPageRef = item 1 of my pages
	vStage = stage "mmwidget_stage" of vPageRef
	vControlButtons = group "mmwidget_controls" of vPageRef

	vStageAreaNonMedia = borderWidth of vStage + innerBevelWidth of vStage + outerBevelWidth of vStage

	vCaptionHeight = windowCaptionHeight()
	vBorderHeight = windowBorderHeight()
	vBorderWidth = windowBorderWidth()

	vX = (2 * vStageAreaNonMedia) + vXPix + vBorderWidth
	vY = (2 * vStageAreaNonMedia) + 360 + \
	  (item 4 of bounds of vStage - item 2 of bounds of vControlButtons) + vYPix + vCaptionHeight + \
	  vBorderHeight

	push vY onto vRetval;push vX onto vRetval

	return vRetval
end

to get windowCaptionHeight
	linkDLL "user";INT GetSystemMetrics(INT);end
	vCaptionHeight = GetSystemMetrics(31) -- SM_CYCAPTION

	if not ASYM_IsNumber(vCaptionHeight) or (vCaptionHeight < 0) then
		vCaptionHeight = 18
	end if

	vCaptionHeight = vCaptionHeight * (item 2 of sysPageUnitsPerPixel)
	return vCaptionHeight
end

to get windowBorderHeight
	linkDLL "user";INT GetSystemMetrics(INT);end
	vHeight = GetSystemMetrics(32) -- SM_CXFRAME

	if not ASYM_IsNumber(vHeight) or (vHeight < 0) then
		vHeight = 4
	end if

	vHeight = vHeight * (item 1 of sysPageUnitsPerPixel)
	return vHeight
end

to get windowBorderWidth
	linkDLL "user";INT GetSystemMetrics(INT);end
	vWidth = GetSystemMetrics(33) -- SM_CYFRAME

	if not ASYM_IsNumber(vWidth) or (vWidth < 0) then
		vWidth = 4
	end if

	vWidth = vWidth * (item 2 of sysPageUnitsPerPixel)
	return vWidth
end

	if not ASYM_IsNumber(vHeight) or (vHeight < 0) then
		vHeight = 4
	end if

	vHeight = vHeight * (item 1 of sysPageUnitsPerPixel)
	return vHeight
end

to get windowBorderWidth
	linkDLL "user";INT GetSystemMetrics(INT);end
	vWidth = GetSystemMetrics(33) -- SM_CYFRAME

	if not ASYM_IsNumber(vWidth) or (vWidth < 0) then
		vWidth = 4
	end if

	vWidth = vWidth * (item 2 of sysPageUnitsPerPixel)
	return vWidth
end

-- 0x7b376  to handle buttonDown
to handle buttonDown
	s_tmp_bnds = bounds of rectangle "back" of self
	bnds = bounds of button "thumb" of self
	s_tmp_wid1 = (item 3 of s_tmp_bnds - item 1 of s_tmp_bnds)
	s_tmp_wid2 = (item 3 of bnds - item 1 of bnds) div 2

	while keyState(keyLeftButton) = down
		newX = item 1 of sysmouseposition
		conditions
			when newX < item 1 of s_tmp_bnds
				newX = item 1 of s_tmp_bnds
			when newX > item 3 of s_tmp_bnds
				newX = item 3 of s_tmp_bnds
		end

		newY = item 2 of s_tmp_bnds
		move button "thumb" of self to newX-s_tmp_wid2,newY

		send updateMedia max(0,(newX - s_tmp_wid2 - item 1 of s_tmp_bnds) / s_tmp_wid1)
	end
end

-----------------------

to handle updateMedia frame
	myStage = whatStage()
	myClip = myClipSpec() of parent of myStage
	if myClip <> NULL
		mmTF = mmTimeFormat of myClip
		mmTimeFormat of myClip = milliseconds
		len = mmLength of myClip
		newPos = round(frame*len)
		send seekClip newPos to parent of self
		mmTimeFormat of myClip = mmTF
	end
end

-- 0x7d01f  to get _ASYM_AddString strgName, s, tgt
to get _ASYM_AddString strgName, s, tgt
	local strgs[][]

	strgName = ASYM_Trim(strgName)
	if strgName = null
		return false
	end

	bk = GetStringTargetBook(tgt)

	ss = sysSuspend;sysSuspend = false; clear sysError
	strgs = _ASYM_StringArray of bk
	sysSuspend = ss
	if sysError = null
		get _ASYM_FindString(strgs, strgName)
		pop it into i
		if i = 0
			i = item 1 of dimensions(strgs) + 1
		end
	else
		i = 1
	end
	strgs [i][1] = strgName
	strgs [i][2] = s
	_ASYM_StringArray of bk = strgs
	return true
end

to get _ASYM_ClearString strgName, tgt
	local strgs[][], newStrgs[][]

	bk = GetStringTargetBook(tgt)

	ss = sysSuspend;sysSuspend = false; clear sysError
	strgs = _ASYM_StringArray of bk
	sysSuspend = ss
	if sysError is null
		get _ASYM_FindString(strgs, strgName)
		pop it into i
		if i <> 0
			strgs = _ASYM_StringArray of bk
			n = item 1 of dimensions(strgs)
			conditions
			when i = 1 and n = 1
				clear _ASYM_StringArray of bk
			else
				m = item 2 of dimensions(strgs)
				if i > 1
					step j from 1 to i-1
						step k from 1 to m
							newStrgs[j][k] = strgs[j][k]
						end
					end
				end
				step j from i to n - 1
					step k from 1 to m
						newStrgs[j][k] = strgs[j+1][k]
					end
				end

				_ASYM_StringArray of bk = newStrgs
			end
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end


to get __ASYM_FindString fixed strgs[][] by reference, strgName
	step i from 1 to item 1 of dimensions(strgs)
		if strgs[i][1] = strgName
			get strgs[i][2]
			push i onto it
			return it
		end
	end
	return 0
end


to get _ASYM_GetStandardString pTarget, strgName, strgDflt
	in ASYM_WorkWindow()
		get ASYM_GetString(strgName,"") of this book
	end in
	if it is strgName
		get ASYM_GetString(strgName,strgDflt) of pTarget
	end
	if it is strgName
		myBk = objectContainer(self, "book")
		get ASYM_GetString(strgName,strgDflt) of myBk
	end
	return it
end


to get _ASYM_GetString pTarget, strgName, strgDflt
	local strgs[][]

	bk = GetStringTargetBook(pTarget)

	get ASYM_BlockSuspend ()
	strgs = _ASYM_StringArray of bk
	get ASYM_RestoreSuspend (it)
	if it = null
		get _ASYM_FindString(strgs, strgName)
		if itemcount(it) > 1
			pop it into i
			s = it
		else
			i = 0
		end
	else
		i = 0
	end

	if i = 0
		s = strgDflt
		if s is null
			s = strgName
		end
	end
	return s
end


to get _ASYMA_GetStringList pTarget
	local strgs[][]
	local result

	bk = GetStringTargetBook(pTarget)

	bs = ASYM_BlockSuspend()
	strgs = _ASYM_StringArray of bk
	bs = ASYM_RestoreSuspend(bs)
	if bs = null
		step i from 1 to item 1 of dimensions(strgs)
			push strgs[i][1] onto result
		end
	end
	return result
end


to get GetStringTargetBook pTarget
	bk = pTarget
	if object of bk <> "book"
		bk = objectContainer(pTarget, "book")
	end

	if (ASYM_MultiLanguageSupport of bk = true) and (sysLanguageCode <> "ENU") then
		myBk = objectContainer(self, "book")
		bkName = ASYM_InternationalFile(name of bk, TRUE)
		if bkName <> NULL then
			bk = book (bkName)
		end if
	end if
	return bk
end

-- 0x7d755  to get _ASYM_FileToPrinter fn, options, hParentWnd, showAbortDlg
to get _ASYM_FileToPrinter fn, options, hParentWnd, showAbortDlg
--TextToPrinter(<text to print>, <print options>, <handle of parent for abort dlg>, <show abort dlg>)
--<Print options> - list of textlines specifying:
--Document Name
--Font Face
--Font Style
--Font Size
--Margins in inches
--
--<show abort dlg> - 0 for not, 1 for show

	OK = ASYM_IsFile(fn)

	if OK
		if hParentWnd is null
			hParentWnd = sysWindowHandle
		else
			OK = isType("WORD", hParentWnd)
		end
	end
	if OK
		conditions
		when ShowAbortDlg is null or showAbordDlg is true
			showAbortDlg = 1
		when ShowAbortDlg is false
			showAbortDlg = 0
		else
			OK = isType("WORD", showAbortDlg)
		end
	end
	if OK
		return FileToPrinter(fn, options, hParentWnd, showAbortDlg)
	else
		sysError = "ASYM_FileToPrinter: Bad Parameter"
	end
	return 0
end

to get _ASYM_TextToPrinter txt, options, hParentWnd, showAbortDlg
--TextToPrinter(<text to print>, <print options>, <handle of parent for abort dlg>, <show abort dlg>)
--<Print options> - list of textlines specifying:
--Document Name
--Font Face
--Font Style
--Font Size
--Margins in inches
--
--<show abort dlg> - 0 for not, 1 for show

	OK = isType("STRING", txt)

	if OK
		if hParentWnd is null
			hParentWnd = sysWindowHandle
		else
			OK = isType("WORD", hParentWnd)
		end
	end
	if OK
		conditions
		when ShowAbortDlg is null or showAbordDlg is true
			showAbortDlg = 1
		when ShowAbortDlg is false
			showAbortDlg = 0
		else
			OK = isType("WORD", showAbortDlg)
		end
	end
	if OK

		txt = cleanUpText(txt)

		return TextToPrinter(txt, options, hParentWnd, showAbortDlg)
	else
		sysError = "ASYM_TextToPrinter: Bad Parameter"
	end
	return 0
end


to get cleanUpText pText
	numLines = textLineCount(pText)
	step i from 1 to numLines
		if textline (i) of pText = "" then
			textline (i) of pText = " "
		end if
	end step
	return pText
end cleanUpText

-- 0x7db8b  to handle ASYM_ShowYourScore obj, score, mode, playFB, _target
to handle ASYM_ShowYourScore obj, score, mode, playFB, _target
	system s_ASYM_LogType,s_ASYM_LogAnswers

	if ASYM_WID_IsScored of obj = "TRUE" or ASYM_WID_ShowScore of obj = "TRUE"
		send _ASYM_ShowYourScore obj, score, mode, playFB, _target
		if s_ASYM_LogAnswers is true
			txt = ASYM_GetString("LogShowScore", "Q=%1 : E=ShowScore! : S=%2")

			if ASYM_WID_QType of obj <> NULL
				if s_ASYM_LogType is "ResponseData"
					txt = name of obj & tab & "ShowScore!" & tab & quote & ASYM_WID_Responses() of obj & quote
				else
					get ASYM_QuestionStatus (obj, score, mode, true) of obj

					-- Item 1 = actual score. Item 2 = maximum score.
					clear item 2 of it
					txt = expandString(txt,name of obj,it)
				end
			else
				_score = item 1 of score
				_maxScore = item 2 of score
				if item 1 of mode = "percent" or item 1 of mode = "%" and _score <> NULL and _maxScore <> NULL
					item 1 of score = _score * _maxScore
				end
				txt = expandString(txt,name of obj,score)
			end
			get ASYM_LogWriteEntry(txt & CRLF) of _target
		end
	end
end

to handle _ASYM_ShowYourScore obj, score, mode, playFeedback, _target

	if obj = NULL
		obj = _target
	end

	if score = NULL
		score = ASYM_WID_MaxScore of obj


		push ASYM_WID_Score(mode, null, playFeedback) of obj onto score
	end

	if itemcount (score) <> 2
		break _ASYM_ShowYourScore
	end

	conditions
	when item 1 of mode = "percent"
	when item 1 of mode = "%"
		scoreText = ASYM_GetStandardString("<ScoreisX>","")
		scoreText = expandString(scoreText, item 1 of score * 100)
	when item 1 of mode = "decimal"
		scoreText = ASYM_GetStandardString("<ScoreisXoutofX>","")
		scoreText = expandString(scoreText, item 1 of score, item 2 of score)
	else
		scoreText = ASYM_GetStandardString("<ScoreisXoutofX>","")
		scoreText = expandString(scoreText, item 1 of score, item 2 of score)
	end

	fld = ASYM_FindField("score")
	if fld = null
		fld = ASYM_FindField("feedback")
	end

	if playFeedback = TRUE then
		-- display feedback WITHOUT registering an attempt at the question
		send ASYM_PlayFeedback NULL, obj, mode, FALSE to obj
	end if

	if fld <> null
		text of fld = scoreText
	else
		spot = item 4 of bounds of obj + (4*item 2 of syspageunitsperpixel)
		push truncate(item 1 of ASYM_ObjectCenter(obj)) onto spot
		get ASYM_GetStandardString("<ScoreForX>","")
		get ASYM_ModalPopText(ASYM_ExpandString(it, name of obj),\
		  scoreText, spot)
	end


end

to get _ASYM_WID_Correctness _target
	local ansArray[][]
	local _score

  	ansArray = ASYM_WID_AnsArray of _target
  	maxIndex = item 1 of dimensions(ansArray)
	respIDs = ASYM_WID_ResponseIDs of _target
	QType = ASYM_WID_QType of _target
	_score = 0

	conditions
		when QType = "TRUEFALSE"
		when QType = "MULTICHOICE"
		when QType = "MULTIDROP"
		when QType = "SLIDER"
		when QType = "NAMEPART"
		when QType = "MULTIDROP"
		when QType = "MULTIOBJ"
		when QType = "TYPEIN"
		when QType = "MATCHITEM"
		when QType = "MATCHOBJ"
			while respIDs <> NULL
				pop respIDs
				get ansArray[it][11]
				if it <> NULL
					increment _score by it
				end
			end

		when QType = "ORDEROBJ"
			resps = respIDs & ""
			isRandomAnchor = ASYM_WID_RandomAnchor of _target is TRUE
			if not isRandomAnchor
				while resps <> NULL
					pop resps
					get ansArray[it][11]
					if it <> NULL
						increment _score by it
					end
				end
			end
			if ASYM_WID_UseAnchor of _target and maxIndex > 0
				if isRandomAnchor = TRUE
					-- need to compensate for missing value
					tot = 0
					diff = 0
					step i from 1 to maxIndex
						if ansArray[i][10] is not TRUE
							increment tot by ansArray[i][11]
						end
					end
					diff = max(0, 1 - tot)
					if diff > 0
						diff = diff / (maxIndex-1)
					else
						diff = 0
					end
					resps = respIDs
					while resps <> null
						pop resps
						if ansArray[it][10] is not true
							get ansArray[it][11]
							if it <> null
								increment _score by it + diff
							end
						end
					end
				else
					step i from 1 to maxIndex
						if ansArray[i][10] = TRUE
							get ansArray[i][11]
							if it <> NULL
								increment _score by it
							end
							break step
						end
					end
				end
			end

		when QType = "ORDERTEXT"
			answerList = text of _dragField of _target
			if answerList is ansArray[1][1]
				_score = 1
				break conditions
			end

			sortByWord = ASYM_WID_SortByWord of _target
			if sortByWord = TRUE
				cnt = wordCount(ansArray[1][1])
			else
				cnt = textLineCount(ansArray[1][1])
			end
			if cnt = 0
				_score = 0
				break conditions
			end
			inc = 1 / cnt
			_score = 0
			if ASYM_WID_PartialScore of _target = "TRUE"
				-- would be nice to do an item by item *relative* position
				-- check, but it's too complicated
				step i from 1 to cnt
					if sortByWord
						if word i of ansArray[1][1] = word i of answerList
							increment _score by inc
						end
					else
						if textline i of ansArray[1][1] = textline i of answerList
							increment _score by inc
						end
					end
				end
			else
				_score = 1
				step i from 1 to cnt
					if sortByWord
						if word i of ansArray[1][1] <> word i of answerList
							_score = 0
							break conditions
						end
					else
						if textline i of ansArray[1][1] <> textline i of answerList
							_score = 0
							break conditions
						end
					end
				end
			end
		else
			-- unknown QType

			SYSTEM s_tbrrflg1

			if s_tbrrflg1 = NULL
				s_tbrrflg1 = 1
				_score = ASYM_WID_Score(null, true) of _target
			end
			clear s_tbrrflg1

			if _score = NULL
				_score = 0
				while respIDs <> null
					pop respIDs
					get ansArray[it][11]
					if it <> NULL
						increment _score by it
					end
				end
			end
	end

	_score = min(1,round(_score,-4))

	return _score
end


to get _ASYM_WID_Score _target, mode
	SYSTEM s_tbrrflg1

	if ASYM_WID_IsScored of _target <> true or s_tbrrflg1 = 1
		return NULL
	end

	_score = ASYM_WID_Correctness of _target

	maxScore = ASYM_WID_MaxScore of _target
	minScore = ASYM_WID_MinScore of _target
	if not IsType(REAL,maxScore)
		maxScore = 1
	end
	if not IsType(REAL,minScore )
		minScore = 0
	end
	_score = max(minScore, min(maxScore, _score * maxScore))

	asPercent = item 1 of mode is in "percent %"
	get ASYM_WID_RoundScore of _target
	conditions
	when it is null and mode is null
		-- this is a CBT 3.0 widget that has
		-- not been touched by a 4.0 widget editor
		_score = round(_score,0)

	when it is "roundToMin" or it is "Min"
		if _score < (maxScore - 0.0005)
			if asPercent
				_score = 0
			else
				_score = minScore
			end
		else
			if asPercent
				_score = 1
			end
		end

	when it is "roundToMax" or it is "Max"
		if _score > minScore
			if asPercent
				_score = 1
			else
				_score = maxScore
			end
		else
			if asPercent
				_score = 0
			end
		end
	else
		get item 1 of mode
		conditions
		when it is "percent" and maxScore <> 0
		when it is "%" and maxScore <> 0
			_score = round(_score / maxScore,-2)
		when it is "decimal"
		when it contains "round"
		when it is "value"
			get item 2 of mode
			if it is null
				get 0
			end
			_score = round(_score,-(it))
		when IsType(REAL,it)
			_score = round(_score,-(abs(it)))
		else
			--  DO NOT ROUND TO INTEGER AS IN VERSION 3.0, BUT TO 2 PLACES
			_score = round(_score,-2)
		end
	end
	return _score
end

		if passSkip and skipNavigation of pg
			continue step
		end
		widList = ASYM_CollectWidgets(pg)
		while widList <> null

to get _ASYM_CollectTotalScore includeSkip
	local LOGICAL passSkip
	system s__ASYM_TempTotalScore

	totalScore = 0
	totalMax = 0
	passSkip = (includeSkip <> true)

	step i from 1 to pageCount of this book
		pg = page i of this book
		if passSkip and skipNavigation of pg
			continue step
		end
		widList = ASYM_CollectWidgets(pg)
		while widList <> null
			pop widList into obj
			if ASYM_WID_IsScored of obj = true
				s = ASYM_WID_Score (null, null, false) of obj
				m = ASYM_WID_MaxScore of obj
				if isType(REAL,s) and isType(REAL,m)
					increment totalScore by s
					increment totalMax by m
				end
			end
		end
	end

	push totalScore onto totalMax
	s__ASYM_TempTotalScore = totalMax
	return totalMax
end
