-- 0x7eec1  to get _ASYM_NumberToRoman num, case, formatStyle
to get _ASYM_NumberToRoman num, case, formatStyle
	if num = null OR isNumber(num) = FALSE
		return NULL
	end

	conditions
		when formatStyle = 1
			roman   = "I,IV,V,IX,X,XL,VL,L,XC,VC,C,CD,LD,D,CM,LM,M"
			rValues = "1,4,5,9,10,40,45,50,90,95,100,400,450,500,900,950,1000"

		when formatStyle = 2
			roman   = "I,IV,V,IX,X,XL,VL,IL,L,XC,VC,IC,C,CD,LD,XD,D,CM,LM,XM,M"
			rValues = "1,4,5,9,10,40,45,49,50,90,95,99,100,400,450,490,500,900,950,990,1000"

		when formatStyle = 3
			roman   = "I,IV,V,IX,X,XL,VL,IL,L,XC,VC,IC,C,CD,LD,XD,VD,D,CM,LM,XM,VM,M"
			rValues = "1,4,5,9,10,40,45,49,50,90,95,99,100,400,450,490,495,500,900,950,990,995,1000"

		when formatStyle = 4
			roman   = "I,IV,V,IX,X,XL,VL,IL,L,XC,VC,IC,C,CD,LD,XD,VD,ID,D,CM,LM,XM,VM,IM,M"
			rValues = "1,4,5,9,10,40,45,49,50,90,95,99,100,400,450,490,495,499,500,900,950,990,995,999,1000"

		else
			roman   = "I,IV,V,IX,X,XL,L,XC,C,CD,D,CM,M"
			rValues = "1,4,5,9,10,40,50,90,100,400,500,900,1000"
	end

	retVal  = null
	step k from itemCount(rValues) to 1 by - 1
		curValue = item k of rValues
		while num >= curValue
			decrement num by curValue
			put item k of roman after retVal
		end
	end
	if case = TRUE
		retVal = lowercase(retVal)
	end
	return retVal
end

to get _ASYM_RomanToNumber rom
	put "0" after rom
	roman   = "0,I,V,X,L,C,D,M"
	numVals = "0,1,5,10,50,100,500,1000"

	ct = charCount(rom)

	retVal  = 0
	step k from 1 to ct
		curVal = char k of rom
		if curVal is not in roman
			-- invalid roman number
			return NULL
		end
		Ref2 = char k + 1 of rom
		Ref3 = ASYM_ItemOffset(curVal,roman)
		if Ref3 >= ASYM_ItemOffset(Ref2,roman)
			increment retVal by item Ref3 of numVals
		else
			decrement retVal by item Ref3 of numVals
		end
	end
	return retVal
end

to get _ASYM_CompareByCase string1, string2
	conditions
		when string1 = NULL and string2 = NULL
			return TRUE
		when string1 = NULL
		when string2 = NULL
			return FALSE
	end

	linkdll "user"
		INT lstrcmp(STRING,STRING)
	end
	return (lstrcmp(string1, string2) = 0)
end


to get _revOffset s1, s2
	L = charcount(s1) - 1
	step i from charcount(s2) to 1 by -1
		if chars i to i + L of s2 is s1
			return i
		end
	end
	return 0
end


to get _ASYM_Trim s

	txt = SPACE & CR & LF & TAB

	while s <> null and (last char of s is in txt or last char of s <= space as text)
		clear last char of s
	end
	while s <> null and (first char of s is in txt or first char of s <= space as text)
		clear first char of s
	end
	return s
end


to get _wordContains x, txt
	step i from 1 to wordcount(txt)
		if word i of txt contains x
			return i
		end
	end
	return 0
end


to get _wordOffset x, txt
	step i from 1 to wordcount(txt)
		if word i of txt is x
			return i
		end
	end
	return 0
end


to get _ASYM_FindWordStart whatText, whatChar, whatLine
	wordBreak = SPACE & TAB & QUOTE & CRLF & ".,;:?!¿«»"
	while char whatChar of textline whatLine of whatText is not in wordBreak and whatChar > 1
		decrement whatChar
	end
	return whatChar
end


to get _ASYM_Offset str, src, pos
	if pos = NULL then
		return offset (str, src)
	else
		-- Check parameter validity
		if (isType("word", pos) = false) or (pos < 1) then
			return 0
		end if
		get charCount (src)
		if pos > it then
			return 0
		else
			get offset (str, chars pos to it of src)
			if it = 0 then
				return 0
			else
				return it + pos - 1
			end if
		end if
	end if
end


to get _ASYM_ReverseStack STACK stk
	local STACK temp

	while stk <> null
		pop stk
		push it onto temp
	end
	return temp
end


to get _ASYM_StringOf str, cnt
	local STRING txt1, txt2, txt3

	if isType("word", cnt) = false
		-- Must be an integer
		return NULL
	end if

	num1 = truncate (sqrt (cnt))
	if num1 = 0
		num2 = 0
	else
		num2 = truncate (cnt / num1)
	end
	num3 = cnt - (num1 * num2)

	step i from 1 to num1
		put str after txt1
	end

	step i from 1 to num2
		put txt1 after txt2
	end

	step i from 1 to num3
		put str after txt3
	end

	return txt2 & txt3
end

to get _ASYM_TextlineFromPos pPos, pText
	retVal = 0
	if (isType("WORD", pPos) = true) and (pPos > 0)
		retVal = textlineCount(chars 1 to pPos of pText)
	end if
	return retVal
end

to get _wordContains x, txt
	step i from 1 to wordcount(txt)
		if word i of txt contains x

	else

			return 0

			return 0

to get _ASYM_StringOf str, cnt
	local STRING txt1, txt2, txt3

	if isType("word", cnt) = false
		-- Must be an integer
		return NULL
	end if

	num1 = truncate (sqrt (cnt))
	if num1 = 0
		num2 = 0
	else
		num2 = truncate (cnt / num1)
	end
	num3 = cnt - (num1 * num2)

	step i from 1 to num1
		put str after txt1
	end

	step i from 1 to num2
		put txt1 after txt2
	end

	step i from 1 to num3
		put str after txt3
	end

	return txt2 & txt3
end

-- 0x7f3d7  to get _ASYM_CompareByCase string1, string2
to get _ASYM_CompareByCase string1, string2
	conditions
		when string1 = NULL and string2 = NULL
			return TRUE
		when string1 = NULL
		when string2 = NULL
			return FALSE
	end

	linkdll "user"
		INT lstrcmp(STRING,STRING)
	end
	return (lstrcmp(string1, string2) = 0)
end


to get _revOffset s1, s2
	L = charcount(s1) - 1
	step i from charcount(s2) to 1 by -1
		if chars i to i + L of s2 is s1
			return i
		end
	end
	return 0
end


to get _ASYM_Trim s

	txt = SPACE & CR & LF & TAB

	while s <> null and (last char of s is in txt or last char of s <= space as text)
		clear last char of s
	end
	while s <> null and (first char of s is in txt or first char of s <= space as text)
		clear first char of s
	end
	return s
end

-- 0x7f9f7  to get _ASYM_LMS_UniqueName obRef
to get _ASYM_LMS_UniqueName obRef
	return textline 2 of _ASYM_LMS_UniqueNameInfo (obRef)
end


to get _ASYM_LMS_UniqueNameInfo obRef, truncateFlag
	-- textline 1 of ret: TRUE if already has unique name
	-- textline 2 of ret: Correct unique name

	local STRING ret


	truncateFlag = (truncateFlag = TRUE)

	nm = name of obRef
	tp = object of obRef

	conditions
	when tp = "page" or tp = "background"
		if wordCount (nm) = 3 and words 1 to 2 of nm = tp && "id" and isType ("word", word 3 of nm)
			ret = true
			clear nm
		else
			wc = wordCount (nm)
			lw = last word of nm
			conditions
			when (wc > 2 and words wc-1 to wc-2 of nm = "(" & tp && "id" and last char of lw = ")" and isType ("word", chars 1 to charCount (lw) - 1 of lw))
				ret = true
				clear words wc-2 to wc of nm
			when (wc > 1 and word wc-1 of nm = "(id" and last char of lw = ")" and isType ("word", chars 1 to charCount (lw) - 1 of lw))
				ret = true
				clear words wc-1 to wc of nm
			else
				ret = false
			end
		end

		if nm = NULL
			return ret & CRLF & tp && "id" && idNumber of obRef
		else
			pID = " (id" && idNumber of obRef & ")"
			if truncateFlag
				nm = chars 1 to 32 - charCount (pID) of nm
			end
			return ret & CRLF & nm & pID
		end
	else
		-- determine if already has a unique name identifier
		get last word of nm
		cc = charCount (it)

		colonPos = offset(":", it)
		if cc > 3 and colonPos > 3 and char 1 of it = "(" and char 2 of it is in "pb" and last char of it = ")" and \
			isType ("word", chars 3 to colonPos - 1 of it) and isType ("word", chars colonPos + 1 to cc - 1 of it)
			ret = true
			clear last word of nm
		else
			ret = false
		end

		-- determine correct unique name identifier
		layerRef = objectContainer (obRef, "page,background")
		if layerRef = NULL
			if nm = NULL
				return ret & CRLF & obRef
			else
				return ret & CRLF & name of obRef
			end
		else
			if nm = NULL
				if ASYM_WID_QType of obRef = NULL
					nm = object of obRef
				else
					nm = "Question"
				end
			end
			obID = " (" & char 1 of layerRef & idNumber of layerRef & ":" & idNumber of obRef & ")"
			if truncateFlag
				nm = chars 1 to 32 - charCount (obID) of nm
			end
			return ret & CRLF & nm & obID
		end
	end
end

to get _ASYM_LMS_DisplayName obRef
	local STRING ret

	nm = name of obRef
	if nm = NULL
		if ASYM_WID_QType of obRef = NULL
			ret = words 1 to 3 of obRef
		else
			ret = "Question" && words 2 to 3 of obRef
		end
		return ret
	else
		return nm
	end
end

to get _ASYM_LMS_QuestionType obj
	qt = ASYM_WID_QType of obj

	conditions
	when qt = "TRUEFALSE"
		retVal = "true-false"
	when qt = "MULTICHOICE"
	when qt = "MULTIOBJ"
		retVal = "choice"
	when qt = "TYPEIN"
		retVal = "fill-in"
	when qt = "MATCHITEM"
	when qt = "MATCHOBJ"
	when qt = "ORDEROBJ"
	when qt = "MULTIDROP"
	when qt = "NAMEPART"
		retVal = "matching"
	when qt = "ORDERTEXT"
		retVal = "sequencing"
	else
		retVal = "performance"
	end

	return retVal
end

-- 0x7ff68  to get _ASYM_LMS_DisplayName obRef
to get _ASYM_LMS_DisplayName obRef
	local STRING ret

	nm = name of obRef
	if nm = NULL
		if ASYM_WID_QType of obRef = NULL
			ret = words 1 to 3 of obRef
		else
			ret = "Question" && words 2 to 3 of obRef
		end
		return ret
	else
		return nm
	end
end

-- 0x8034d  to get _ASYM_GetFileDate fName, formatString
to get _ASYM_GetFileDate fName, formatString
	linkDll "tbdos.dll"
		STRING getFileDate(STRING)
	end
	fDate = getFileDate(fName)
	if fDate is not NULL
		stop = offset(space, fDate) - 1

		if (stop - 7) < 3		--if we didn't get a four-digit year
			chars 7 to stop of fDate = chars 7 to stop of fDate + 1900
		end

		if formatString = NULL
			formatString = sysDateFormat
			if "h" is not in formatString and "sec" is not in formatString and "min" is not in formatString
				put " " & sysTimeFormat after formatString
			end
		end

		format date fDate as formatString from "mm/dd/yyyy h24:min:sec"
	end
	return fDate
end


to get _ASYM_AddFileExtension fn, ext
	fn = trim (fn)
	pth = ASYM_PathOfFile (fn)
	fn = ASYM_ShortFileName (fn)

	pos = offset (".", fn)
	if pos = 0
		return pth & fn & "." & ext
	end

	cc = charCount (fn)
	lastPos = pos
	while pos <> 0 and pos < cc
		lastPos = pos
		get offset (".", chars pos + 1 to cc of fn)
		if it = 0
			pos = 0
		else
			pos = pos + it
		end
	end

	conditions
	when pos = cc
		return pth & fn
	when chars lastPos to cc of fn contains " " or lastPos = 1
		return pth & fn & "." & ext
	else
		return pth & fn
	end
end


to get _ASYM_ReplaceFileExtension fn, ext
	fn = trim (fn)
	pth = ASYM_PathOfFile (fn)
	fn = ASYM_ShortFileName (fn)

	pos = offset (".", fn)
	if pos = 0
		return pth & fn & "." & ext
	end

	cc = charCount (fn)
	lastPos = pos
	while pos <> 0 and pos < cc
		lastPos = pos
		get offset (".", chars pos + 1 to cc of fn)
		if it = 0
			pos = 0
		else
			pos = pos + it
		end
	end

	conditions
		when pos = cc
			return pth & fn & ext
		when chars lastPos to cc of fn contains " " or lastPos = 1
			return pth & fn & "." & ext
		else
			chars lastPos+1 to cc of fn = ext
			return pth & fn
	end conditions
end

----------------------------------------------
to get _ASYM_GetFileVersion fName, productFlag
----------------------------------------------
--fname
--	full path to file from which to get version info
--productFlag
--	TRUE:            returns product full version as xx,xx,xx,xx
--	FALSE (default): returns file full version as xx,xx,xx,xx
------------------------------------------

	linkDLL32 "kernel32.dll"
		LONG GetLastError()
		POINTER32 GlobalAlloc(LONG, LONG)
		LONG GlobalFree(POINTER32)
	end
	linkDLL32 "version.dll"
		LONG GetFileVersionInfoA(STRING, LONG, LONG, POINTER32)
		LONG GetFileVersionInfoSizeA(STRING, POINTER32)
		LONG VerQueryValueA(POINTER32, STRING, POINTER32, POINTER32)
	end

	productFlag = (productFlag = TRUE)

	rv = NULL

	gmemflags = 0x40	--GMEM_FIXED | GMEM_ZEROINIT
	dummy = GlobalAlloc(gmemFlags, 4)
	bufSize = GetFileVersionInfoSizeA(fName, dummy)

	if bufSize > 0	--otherwise no version info in file

		verBuf = GlobalAlloc(gmemFlags, bufSize)
		--get the version info
		get GetFileVersionInfoA(fName, 0, bufSize, verBuf)
		--get the pointer to the VS_FIXEDFILEINFO structure
		ffiBuf = GlobalAlloc(gmemFlags, 4)
		get VerQueryValueA(verBuf, "\", ffiBuf, dummy)
		ffiPtr = pointerPointer32(0, ffiBuf)

		--ffiPtr now points to a VS_FIXEDFILEINFO structure:
		--Type VS_FIXEDFILEINFO
		--  0     dwSignature As Long
		--  4     dwStrucVersion As Long         '  e.g. 0x00000042 = "0.42"
		--  8     dwFileVersionMS As Long        '  e.g. 0x00030075 = "3.75"
		-- 12     dwFileVersionLS As Long        '  e.g. 0x00000031 = "0.31"
		-- 16     dwProductVersionMS As Long     '  e.g. 0x00030010 = "3.10"
		-- 20     dwProductVersionLS As Long     '  e.g. 0x00000031 = "0.31"
		-- 24     dwFileFlagsMask As Long        '  = 0x3F for version "0.42"
		-- 28     dwFileFlags As Long            '  e.g. VFF_DEBUG Or VFF_PRERELEASE
		-- 32     dwFileOS As Long               '  e.g. VOS_DOS_WINDOWS16
		-- 36     dwFileType As Long             '  e.g. VFT_DRIVER
		-- 40     dwFileSubtype As Long          '  e.g. VFT2_DRV_KEYBOARD
		-- 44     dwFileDateMS As Long           '  e.g. 0
		-- 48     dwFileDateLS As Long           '  e.g. 0
		--End Type

		--sanity check: signature should always be the following value
		if PointerDword32(0, ffiPtr) = 0xfeef04bd
			if productFlag
				offset = 16
			else
				offset = 8
			end
			major = PointerDword32(offset, ffiPtr)
			majorLeft = major div 0x10000
			majorRight = major bitAnd 0xffff

			minor = PointerDword32(offset+4, ffiPtr)
			minorLeft = minor div 0x10000
			minorRight = minor bitAnd 0xffff

			rv = minorRight
			push minorLeft onto rv
			push majorRight onto rv
			push majorLeft onto rv
		end

		get GlobalFree(ffiBuf)
		get GlobalFree(verBuf)

	end

	get GlobalFree(dummy)

	return rv
end

to get _ASYM_GetTempFile pExt
	retVal = NULL
	linkDLL32 "kernel32.dll"
		INT  GetTempFileNameA(STRING,STRING,WORD,POINTER32)
		POINTER32 GlobalAllocPointer32 = GlobalAlloc(DWORD,DWORD)
		DWORD GlobalFreePointer32 = GlobalFree(POINTER32)
	end

	lpBuffer32 = GlobalAllocPointer32(0,1024)

	if lpBuffer32 = NULL or lpBuffer32 = "0,0"
		sysError = "Unable to allocate memory."
		retVal = NULL
	else
		ext = pExt
		if ext = NULL then
			ext = "TMP"
		else
			if charCount(ext) > 3 then
				ext = chars 1 to 3 of ext
			end
		end

		get GetTempFileNameA(ASYM_TempDir(),ext,0,lpBuffer32)

		if it = 0 then
			sysError = "Unable to generate temporary file."
			retVal = NULL
		else
			retVal = pointerString32(0,lpBuffer32)
		end

		get GlobalFreePointer32(lpBuffer32)

	end

	retVal = ASYM_getShortFileName(retVal,1)

	return retVal
end

to get _ASYM_GetShortFileName fName, opt
	linkDLL "tbfile32.dll"
		STRING getShortFileName32(STRING, WORD)
	end

	if opt = null
		opt = 1
	end

	get getShortFileName32(fName,opt)
	if it <> null
		fName = it
	end

	return fName
end

	end

	if opt = null
		opt = 1

	if it <> null
		fName = it
	end

	return fName
end

-- 0x807b9  to get _ASYM_GetFileVersion fName, productFlag
to get _ASYM_GetFileVersion fName, productFlag
----------------------------------------------
--fname
--	full path to file from which to get version info
--productFlag
--	TRUE:            returns product full version as xx,xx,xx,xx
--	FALSE (default): returns file full version as xx,xx,xx,xx
------------------------------------------

	linkDLL32 "kernel32.dll"
		LONG GetLastError()
		POINTER32 GlobalAlloc(LONG, LONG)
		LONG GlobalFree(POINTER32)
	end
	linkDLL32 "version.dll"
		LONG GetFileVersionInfoA(STRING, LONG, LONG, POINTER32)
		LONG GetFileVersionInfoSizeA(STRING, POINTER32)
		LONG VerQueryValueA(POINTER32, STRING, POINTER32, POINTER32)
	end

	productFlag = (productFlag = TRUE)

	rv = NULL

	gmemflags = 0x40	--GMEM_FIXED | GMEM_ZEROINIT
	dummy = GlobalAlloc(gmemFlags, 4)
	bufSize = GetFileVersionInfoSizeA(fName, dummy)

	if bufSize > 0	--otherwise no version info in file

		verBuf = GlobalAlloc(gmemFlags, bufSize)
		--get the version info
		get GetFileVersionInfoA(fName, 0, bufSize, verBuf)
		--get the pointer to the VS_FIXEDFILEINFO structure
		ffiBuf = GlobalAlloc(gmemFlags, 4)
		get VerQueryValueA(verBuf, "\", ffiBuf, dummy)
		ffiPtr = pointerPointer32(0, ffiBuf)

		--ffiPtr now points to a VS_FIXEDFILEINFO structure:
		--Type VS_FIXEDFILEINFO
		--  0     dwSignature As Long
		--  4     dwStrucVersion As Long         '  e.g. 0x00000042 = "0.42"
		--  8     dwFileVersionMS As Long        '  e.g. 0x00030075 = "3.75"
		-- 12     dwFileVersionLS As Long        '  e.g. 0x00000031 = "0.31"
		-- 16     dwProductVersionMS As Long     '  e.g. 0x00030010 = "3.10"
		-- 20     dwProductVersionLS As Long     '  e.g. 0x00000031 = "0.31"
		-- 24     dwFileFlagsMask As Long        '  = 0x3F for version "0.42"
		-- 28     dwFileFlags As Long            '  e.g. VFF_DEBUG Or VFF_PRERELEASE
		-- 32     dwFileOS As Long               '  e.g. VOS_DOS_WINDOWS16
		-- 36     dwFileType As Long             '  e.g. VFT_DRIVER
		-- 40     dwFileSubtype As Long          '  e.g. VFT2_DRV_KEYBOARD
		-- 44     dwFileDateMS As Long           '  e.g. 0
		-- 48     dwFileDateLS As Long           '  e.g. 0
		--End Type

		--sanity check: signature should always be the following value
		if PointerDword32(0, ffiPtr) = 0xfeef04bd
			if productFlag
				offset = 16
			else
				offset = 8
			end
			major = PointerDword32(offset, ffiPtr)
			majorLeft = major div 0x10000
			majorRight = major bitAnd 0xffff

			minor = PointerDword32(offset+4, ffiPtr)
			minorLeft = minor div 0x10000
			minorRight = minor bitAnd 0xffff

			rv = minorRight
			push minorLeft onto rv
			push majorRight onto rv
			push majorLeft onto rv
		end

		get GlobalFree(ffiBuf)
		get GlobalFree(verBuf)

	end

	get GlobalFree(dummy)

	return rv
end

-- 0x82a17  ␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀to get _ASYM_SelectObjectTarget pReturnType, pFullReference, pTargetWindow, pObjectTypes, pN
␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀to get _ASYM_SelectObjectTarget pReturnType, pFullReference, pTargetWindow, pObjectTypes, pNamedOnly, \
		pObjectsToInclude, pObjectsToIgnore, pObjectsWhere, pExportableOnly

	local stack selectionList

	bs = ASYM_BlockSuspend()

	myBk = objectContainer(self, "book")
	oldCursor = sysCursor
	sysCursor = cursor "TargetSelectorCursor" of myBk

	linkDLL "USER"
		WORD getDC(WORD)
		INT releaseDC (WORD, WORD)
		INT DrawFocusRect(WORD, POINTER)
		INT InflateRect (POINTER, INT, INT)
	end linkDLL

	-- Define structure for focus rectangle API
	ptrFocusRect = ASYM_GetMemBlock (8)

	selectionBoundsOffset_Pixels = 3
	PUPP_Y = sysPageUnitsPerPixel
	pop PUPP_Y into PUPP_X
	selectionBoundsOffset_X = selectionBoundsOffset_Pixels * PUPP_X
	selectionBoundsOffset_Y = selectionBoundsOffset_Pixels * PUPP_Y

	-- Resolve type of return value required
	returnType = pReturnType
	if not ASYM_ItemInList(returnType, "All,Top,SelectPopup,SelectDialog") then
		returnType = "SelectPopup"
	end if

	-- Resolve the window to work with
	authorViewerOnly = (pTargetWindow = "authorOnly")
	if (isObject(pTargetWindow) = true) and (object of pTargetWindow = "viewer")
		selectTargetWindow = pTargetWindow
	else
		selectTargetWindow = NULL
	end if

	-- Which objects are we interested in?
	validObjectTypes = pObjectTypes

	-- Make sure we are working with uniqueNames for the include list
	objectsToInclude = NULL
	if selectTargetWindow <> NULL then
		workList = pObjectsToInclude
		while workList <> NULL
			pop workList into thisObj
			in selectTargetWindow
				if isObject(thisObj) = true then
					push uniqueName of thisObj onto objectsToInclude
				end if
			end in
		end
	else
		objectsToInclude = pObjectsToInclude
	end

	-- Make sure we are working with uniqueNames for the ignore list
	objectsToIgnore = NULL
	if selectTargetWindow <> NULL then
		workList = pObjectsToIgnore
		while workList <> NULL
			pop workList into thisObj
			in selectTargetWindow
				if isObject(thisObj) = true then
					push uniqueName of thisObj onto objectsToIgnore
				end if
			end in
		end
	else
		objectsToIgnore = pObjectsToIgnore
	end if

	-- Do we want to return full object references?
	returnFullReference = (pFullReference = TRUE)

	-- Do we only want named objects?
	returnNamedOnly = (pNamedOnly = true)

	-- Do we only want exportable objects (that is, not objects within groups that are tagged "export as bitmap"
	returnExportableOnly = (pExportableOnly = true)

	-- Are groups allowed?
	allowGroups = (validObjectTypes = NULL or ASYM_ItemInList("group", validObjectTypes))

	focusRect = NULL

	leftButton = ASYM_PrimaryMouseButton()

	sls = sysLockScreen
	sysLockScreen = true

	ssm = sysSuspendMessages
	sysSuspendMessages = true

	linkDLL "tbwin.dll"
		INT yieldApp()
	end

	hiddenObjects = null
	selectWindow = null

	while keyState(leftButton) = "down"
		get yieldApp()

		if selectTargetWindow = NULL then
			selectWindow = windowFromPoint(ASYM_MouseScreenPos())
			-- check if we only want to accept author level viewers
			if authorViewerOnly and selectWindow <> null and selectWindow <> mainWindow and alwaysReader of selectWindow
				selectWindow = null
			end
		else
			selectWindow = selectTargetWindow
		end if

		thisObj = null
		foundObj = false

		if selectWindow <> NULL then
			mousePos = mousePosition of selectWindow

			do
				thisObj = objectFromPoint(mousePos, selectWindow)

				if thisObj <> null
					-- objectFromPoint returns the page component of a recordField - we need the background component
					if object of thisObj = "recordField"
						thisObj = words 1 to 3 of thisObj && "of" && objectContainer (thisObj, "background")
					end

					if validObjectTypes = "group" then
						-- If we're looking for ONLY groups, then assume the shift key
						-- is ALWAYS down
						topLevelOnly = true
					else
						topLevelOnly = keyState(keyShift) = "down"
					end if

					-- If shift is down, only top-level objects are of interest, but
					-- only if we are looking for them
					thisObj = processGroupStuff (thisObj, topLevelOnly, allowGroups, returnExportableOnly)

					acceptedObject = validateObject (thisObj, objectsToInclude, objectsToIgnore, validObjectTypes, returnNamedOnly, pObjectsWhere)

					-- if an object is a hotword and it is rejected, we can't hide it to look
					-- at the object behind it, so instead we work from the hotwords parent.
					if acceptedObject = null and object of thisObj = "hotword"
						thisObj = parent of thisObj
						acceptedObject = validateObject (thisObj, objectsToInclude, objectsToIgnore, validObjectTypes, returnNamedOnly, pObjectsWhere)
					end

					if acceptedObject = null
						if returnType = "top"
							thisObj = null
						else
							if selectWindow is not in selectionList
								push selection of selectWindow onto selectionList
								push selectWindow onto selectionList
							end
							push thisObj onto hiddenObjects
							hide thisObj
						end
					else
						thisObj = acceptedObject
						foundObj = true
					end
				end if
			until thisObj = null or foundObj = true
		end if

		if thisObj <> lastObj
			lastObj = thisObj

			if focusRect <> null
				get drawFocusRect (hDC, ptrFocusRect)
				get releaseDC (hWnd, hDC)
				clear focusRect
			end

			if thisObj <> null
				newBounds = bounds of thisObj

				focusRect = pageUnitsToClient (newBounds)
				get pointerInt (0, ptrFocusRect, item 1 of focusRect)
				get pointerInt (2, ptrFocusRect, item 2 of focusRect)
				get pointerInt (4, ptrFocusRect, item 3 of focusRect + 1)
				get pointerInt (6, ptrFocusRect, item 4 of focusRect + 1)
				get InflateRect (ptrFocusRect, selectionBoundsOffset_Pixels, selectionBoundsOffset_Pixels)

				hWnd = clientHandle of selectWindow
				hDC = getDC(hWnd)

				get drawFocusRect (hDC, ptrFocusRect)
			else
				if focusRect <> null
					get drawFocusRect (hDC, ptrFocusRect)
					get releaseDC (hWnd, hDC)
					clear focusRect
				end
				clear lastObj
			end if
		end if
	end while

	if hiddenObjects <> null
		show hiddenObjects
	end

	sysCursor = oldCursor

	if focusRect <> null then
		get drawFocusRect (hDC, ptrFocusRect)
		get releaseDC (hWnd, hDC)
		clear focusRect
	end if

	-- Get all of the objects under the current mouse position
	objList = NULL

	if selectWindow <> null
		hiddenObjects = NULL

		do
			thisObj = objectFromPoint(mousePosition of selectWindow, selectWindow)

			-- objectFromPoint returns the page component of a recordField - we need the background component
			if thisObj <> null and object of thisObj = "recordField"
				thisObj = words 1 to 3 of thisObj && "of" && objectContainer (thisObj, "background")
			end

			thisObj = processGroupStuff (thisObj, topLevelOnly, allowGroups, returnExportableOnly)

			includeObj = validateObject (thisObj, objectsToInclude, objectsToIgnore, validObjectTypes, returnNamedOnly, pObjectsWhere)

			if includeObj <> null then
				if not ASYM_ItemInList(includeObj, objList) = true
					if (returnFullReference = true) and not (" of book " is in includeObj) then
						put " of " & objectContainer(thisObj, "book") after includeObj
					end if
					push includeObj onto objList
				end if
			end if

			conditions
			when returnType = "Top"
				thisObj = NULL
			else
				if thisObj <> null
					if selectWindow is not in selectionList
						push selection of selectWindow onto selectionList
						push selectWindow onto selectionList
					end
					hide thisObj
					push thisObj onto hiddenObjects
				end
			end conditions
		until thisObj = NULL

		if hiddenObjects <> NULL
			show hiddenObjects
		end
	end

	while selectionList <> null
		pop selectionList into selectWindow
		pop selectionList into obRef
		in selectWindow
			selection = obRef

-- 0x8414a  to get ASYM_SelectObjectFromList pObjList, selectType, pDialogTitle

				thisLine = object of thisObj & QUOTE & objName & QUOTE & "  (ID " & objID & ")"
			else
				thisLine = object of thisObj & " ID " & objID
			end if

		end if

to handle init pObjList
	clear returnValue of self
	refSelectField = field "objectSelection" of self
	clear text of refSelectField

	listText = NULL
	workList = pObjList
	while workList <> NULL
		pop workList into thisObj
		objName = name of thisObj
		objID = IDNumber of thisObj
		if objName <> NULL then
			thisLine = object of thisObj & QUOTE & objName & QUOTE & "  (ID " & objID & ")"
		else
			thisLine = object of thisObj & " ID " & objID
		end if
		put LF & thisObj after thisLine
		put thisLine & CRLF after listText
	end while

	while last char of listText is in CRLF
		clear last char of listText
	end while

	text of refSelectField = listText

	if textOverflow of refSelectField > 0 then
		borderStyle of refSelectField = "scrolling"
	else
		borderStyle of refSelectField = "rectangle"
	end if

end


to handle OK
	refSelectField = field "objectSelection" of self
	selIndex = selectedTextlines of refSelectField
	if selIndex <> NULL then
		selectedObj = textline (selIndex) of text of refSelectField

		-- Strip out object reference
		clear chars 1 to (offset(LF, selectedObj)) of selectedObj

		returnValue of self = selectedObj
	end if

	if targetWindow <> mainWindow then
		hide targetWindow
	end if
end

to handle cancel
	if targetWindow <> mainWindow then
		close targetWindow
	end if
end

to get ASYM_ObjectBitmapGroup thisObj
	local retVal
	LOCAL animationSettings[]

	-- If this isn't an HTML book, we allow the user to select objects in groups that will be
	-- exported as a single object, because export is irrelevant.
	if object of thisObj = "book"
		bkRef = thisObj
	else
		bkRef = objectContainer(thisObj, "book")
	end
	if ASYM_DeploymentMethod of bkRef <> "HTML"
		return null
	end

	if not ASYM_ItemInList (object of thisObj, "page,background,book,view")
		-- Check to see if this object is in a group that has "export as bitmap" set, or in a group
		-- that has a path animation with cell animation turned on.
		obRef = parent of thisObj
		obType = object of obRef
		while obType = "group"
			if ASYMI_ExportAsBitmap of obRef = true  or (sharedScript of obRef <> NULL AND name of sharedScript of obRef = "WID_ImageMap")
				retVal = obRef
			else
				animNum = 1
				animationSettings = objectAnimation(animNum) of obRef
				while dimensions(animationSettings) > 0
					if animationSettings[4] = true
						retVal = obRef
						break while
					end
					increment animNum
					animationSettings = objectAnimation(animNum) of obRef
				end
			end
			obRef = parent of obRef
			obType = object of obRef
		end
	end

	return retVal
end

-- 0x84598  to handle init pObjList
to handle init pObjList
	clear returnValue of self
	refSelectField = field "objectSelection" of self
	clear text of refSelectField

	listText = NULL
	workList = pObjList
	while workList <> NULL
		pop workList into thisObj
		objName = name of thisObj
		objID = IDNumber of thisObj
		if objName <> NULL then
			thisLine = object of thisObj & QUOTE & objName & QUOTE & "  (ID " & objID & ")"
		else
			thisLine = object of thisObj & " ID " & objID
		end if
		put LF & thisObj after thisLine
		put thisLine & CRLF after listText
	end while

	while last char of listText is in CRLF
		clear last char of listText
	end while

	text of refSelectField = listText

	if textOverflow of refSelectField > 0 then
		borderStyle of refSelectField = "scrolling"
	else
		borderStyle of refSelectField = "rectangle"
	end if

end


to handle OK
	refSelectField = field "objectSelection" of self
	selIndex = selectedTextlines of refSelectField
	if selIndex <> NULL then
		selectedObj = textline (selIndex) of text of refSelectField

		-- Strip out object reference
		clear chars 1 to (offset(LF, selectedObj)) of selectedObj

		returnValue of self = selectedObj
	end if

	if targetWindow <> mainWindow then
		hide targetWindow
	end if
end

to handle cancel
	if targetWindow <> mainWindow then
		close targetWindow
	end if
end

to handle _linkDLLs
	linkDll ASYM_ProductPrefix() & "win.dll"
		INT	ASYM_popText = popText (STRING,STRING,STRING)
		INT SetIniVar(STRING,STRING,STRING,STRING)
		STRING GetIniVar(STRING,STRING,STRING)
		INT yieldApp()
	end

	linkDLL "MMSystem.DLL"
		DWORD ASYM_Ticks = TimeGetTime()
	end

	linkDLL "user"
		int ASYM_PostMessage = PostMessage(WORD,WORD,WORD,DWORD)
	end

	-- Other links here as required
	ctbDLLfN = ASYM_ProductPrefix() & "cbt.dll"
	ss = sysSuspend
	sysSuspend = FALSE
		clear sysError
		linkDLL ctbDLLfN
			string ASYM_getUserName = getNetworkUsername()
		end
		if sysErrorNumber = 8108
			ctbDLLFn = shortFileName(ctbDLLFn)
			linkDLL ctbDLLfN
				string ASYM_getUserName = getNetworkUsername()
			end
		end
		se = sysError
		linkDLL ctbDLLfN
			INT FileToPrinter(STRING,STRING,WORD,WORD)
		end
		sysError = se
		linkDLL ctbDLLfN
			INT TextToPrinter(STRING,STRING,WORD,WORD)

			INT ASYM_ItemOffset = itemOffset(STRING,STRING)
			INT ASYM_ItemContains = itemContains(STRING,STRING)
			INT TextlineOffset(STRING,STRING)
			INT TextlineContains(STRING,STRING)
			STRING MakeKeyedPassword(STRING)
			STRING KeyedPasswordEncrypt(STRING,STRING)
			STRING ASYM_Decode = Decrypt(STRING,STRING)
			STRING ASYM_Encode = Encrypt(STRING,STRING)
			INT ASYM_CreateEncryptedFile = CreateEncryptedFile(STRING,STRING)

			STRING MakeKeyedPasswordEX(STRING,DWORD)
			STRING KeyedPasswordEncryptEX(STRING,STRING,DWORD)
			STRING ASYM_DecodeEX = DecryptEX(STRING,STRING,DWORD)
			STRING ASYM_EncodeEX = EncryptEX(STRING,STRING,DWORD)
			INT ASYM_CreateEncryptedFileEX = CreateEncryptedFileEX(STRING,STRING,DWORD)

			INT ASYM_WriteEncryptedFile = WriteEncryptedFile(STRING,STRING,STRING)
			STRING shortFileName(STRING)
			STRING PathOfFile(STRING)
			STRING PathOfFile(STRING)
			POINTER ASYM_GetMemBlock = GetMemBlock(DWORD)
			WORD ASYM_FreeMemBlock = FreeMemBlock(POINTER)
			STRING EllipsizeFileName(STRING,WORD)

			INT ASYM_ModalPopText = ModalPopText(STRING,STRING,STRING)

		end

		linkDLL32 "KERNEL32.DLL"
			INT __ASYM_Sleep = Sleep(DWORD)
		end linkDLL32

	sysSuspend = ss

	oldSTF = sysTimeFormat
	sysTimeFormat = "seconds"
	seed (sysTime mod 32768)
	sysTimeFormat = oldSTF

end

to handle _linkSysBook
	get FlushMessageQueue()

	oldSTF = sysTimeFormat
	sysTimeFormat = "seconds"
	seed (sysTime mod 32768)
	sysTimeFormat = oldSTF

	send _doNeuronCheck

	send _linkDLLs
	send initSysBooks
end

to handle _doNeuronCheck
	-- before we do anything else, check if we're running Neuron in secure mode, and bail out
	if sysPluginMode
		if sysSecureMode
			msgTxt = ASYM_GetString("msgErrRunningNeuronInSecureMode", \
					"You are attempting to run a click2learn.com ToolBook II course " & \
					"under Neuron in secure mode." & \
					CRLF & \
					"For the course to work, Neuron must be configured to " & \
					"run in non-secure mode." & \
					CRLF & \
					"Click OK to exit.")
			request msgTxt
			sysSuspendMessages = TRUE
			send exit to system
			break to system
		else
			if ASYM_Is32Bit() and "tb80aicc.sbk" is not in sysbooks
				ss = syssuspend
				syssuspend = FALSE
				push "tb80aicc.sbk" onto sysbooks
				syssuspend = ss
				clear sysError
			end
		end
	end
end

to handle _unLinkSysBook
	system s_ASYM_ModalState
	if s_ASYM_ModalState is TRUE
		in mainWindow
			set ASYM_ModalState of this book to FALSE
		end
	end
end

to get GetFreeDosMem maxm
	linkdll "kernel"
		DWORD GlobalDosAlloc(DWORD)
		WORD GlobalDosFree(DWORD)
	end
	if maxm is null or maxm = 0
		set maxm to 300000
	end
	set i to maxm
	set j to i div 2
	set good to 0
	while j <> 0
		get GlobalDosAlloc(i)
		if it <> 0
			selector = it mod 65536
			get globalDosFree(selector)
			set good to i
			increment i by j
		else
			set bad to i
			set j to abs(good - bad) div 2
			decrement i by j
		end
	end
	return good
end

to handle initSysBooks
end


to get SetSysBooksInOrder bkFnList
	-- Make sure that the right sysbooks are in the right order

	local WORD bkPos[]
	local STACK missing

	sysBks = sysBooks
	bkFnCnt  = itemCount(bkFnList)

	step i from 1 to bkFnCnt
		bkPos[i] = itemcontains(ASYM_ShortFileName(item i of bkFnList),\
		  sysBks)
		if bkPos[i] = 0
			push item i of bkFnList onto missing
		end
	end

	-- Add books to list as necessary and add sort tags
	step i from 1 to bkFnCnt
		format number i as "00"
		conditions
		when bkPos[i] = 0 and item i of bkFnList <> "*"
			if sysBks <> null
				put "," after sysBks
			end
			put i & space & item i of bkFnList after sysBks
		when bkPos[i] <> 0
			put i & space before item bkPos[i] of sysBks
		end
	end
	sysBkCnt = itemCount(sysBks)

	step i from 1 to itemCount(sysBks)
		if wordCount(item i of sysBks) = 1
			put "00 " before item i of sysBks
		end
	end

	sysBks = sortList(sysBks)

	step i from 1 to sysBkCnt
		clear word 1 of item i of sysBks
	end

	if sysBooks <> sysBks
		sysSuspend = false
		clear sysError
		sysBooks = sysBks
		sysSuspend = true
		if sysError <> null
			request sysError
			return false
		end
	end

	return true
end

to get shortFileName fName
	ccnt = charcount(fName)
	step i from ccnt to 1 by -1
		if char i of fName is in ":\"
			return chars i+1 to ccnt of fName
		end
	end
	return null
end

to get _ASYM_Ellipsize s, len, side
	if len = 0; return null;end
	s = ASYM_Trim(s)
	cCnt = charcount(s)
	if cCnt <= len
		return s
	end
	dotss = "...";dotCnt = 3
	p1 = offset("\", s)
	if p1 > 0
		if side is "center" and len < 18;side = "left";end
		conditions
		when side is "left"
			s = chars (cCnt - len + 1) to cCnt of s
			p = offset("\", s)
			if p > 0;s = chars p to cCnt of s;end
			dotsL = (len - charcount(s))+1
			if dotsL > 0;put chars 1 to dotsL of dotss before s;end
		when side is "center"
			s = ellipsizeFileName(s, len) -- in DLL
		else
			s = chars 1 to len - 1 of s
			step i from charcount(s) to 1 by -1
				if char i of s is in ":\"
					s = chars 1 to i of s
					break step
				end
			end
			dotsL = (len - charcount(s))+1
			if dotsL > 0;put chars 1 to dotsL of dotss after s;end
		end
	else
		conditions
		when side is "left"
			s = dotss & chars (cCnt - len + 4) to cCnt of s
		when side is "center"
			p = round((len - 3) / 2 + 0.1)
			s1 = chars 1 to p of s & dotss
			while charcount(s1) + 1 + p > len;decrement p;end
			s = s1 & chars cCnt - p to cCnt of s
		else
			s = chars 1 to len - 3 of s & dotss
		end
	end
	return s
end

to get _ASYM_ExpandString templStr
	if templStr is null or "%" is not in templStr
		return templStr
	end
	ss = sysSuspend
	sysSuspend = false
	i = 1
	while i < charcount (templStr)
		increment i
		if char (i - 1) of templStr = "%"
			if char i of templStr is "%"
				clear char i of templStr
			else
				-- check for the format %n
				n = char i of templStr & ""
				if isType(REAL,n) and n > 0
					n2 = char i + 1 of templStr
					if isType(REAL,n2)
						n = n*10 + n2
						extra = 1
					else
						extra = 0
					end
					get argument (n + 1)
					put it into chars i-1 to i + extra of templStr
					increment i by charcount(it) - 1
					clear it
				else
					-- check for the %<expression>% form
					set p to offset("%", chars i to\
					  charcount(templStr) of templStr)
					if p <> 0
						get chars i to i + p - 2 of templStr
						if ASYM_Trim(it) <> null
							get evaluate(it)
						end
						chars i-1 to i + p - 1 of templStr = it
						increment i by charcount(it) - 1
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	sysSuspend = ss
	return templStr
end

--*************************************
to get _ASYM_EllipsizeFileToField pField, pFileName, pFileOpt, pDirOpt

	retVal = NULL

	if (isObject(pField) = TRUE) and (object of pField is in "field,recordField") then

		if (ASYM_IsFile(pFileName)) and (charCount(pFileName) > 2) and \
				((chars 1 to 2 of pFileName = "\\") or (chars 2 to 3 of pFileName = ":\")) then

			linkDLL "TBFILE32.DLL"
				STRING getEllipsisByFont32(STRING, INT, INT, INT, STRING, INT, INT, INT)
			end linkDLL

			_fontName = fontFace of pField
			_fontSize = fontSize of pField
			_fontStyle = fontStyle of pField
			if (_fontStyle contains "bold") then
				_fontBold = 1
			else
				_fontBold = 0
			end if

			_fontItalic = (_fontStyle contains "italic")
			if (_fontStyle contains "italic") then
				_fontItalic = 1
			else
				_fontItalic = 0
			end if

			_width = (item 1 of size of pField) - \
					(item 1 of indents of pField + item 3 of indents of pField)

			if (pFileOpt <> FALSE) then
				_fileOpt = 1
			else
				_fileOpt = 0
			end if

			if (pDirOpt <> FALSE) then
				_DirOpt = 1
			else
				_DirOpt = 0
			end if

			clear sysError

			retVal = getEllipsisByFont32(_fontName, _fontSize, _fontBold, _fontItalic, pFileName, \
					_width, _fileOpt, _dirOpt)

			if sysError = -1 then
				retVal = ASYM_ShortFileName(pFileName)
			end if

		else

			-- In 16-bit Windows, and when the file does not already exist,
			-- revert to the OpenScript-based version

			sls = syslockscreen
			if visible of pField = TRUE then
				syslockscreen = TRUE
			end if

			-- Cache the status of the field
			cache_Text = richText of pField
			cache_Scroll = scroll of pField
			cache_SelLines = selectedTextLines of pField
			cache_FldType = fieldType of pField

			clear richText of pField
			fieldType of pField = "singleLineWrap"

			retVal = pFileName
			cnt = charCount(retVal)
			text of pField = retVal
			while ((textOverFlow of pField + textUnderFlow of pField) > 0) and (cnt > 5)
				decrement cnt
				retVal = ellipsizeFileName(pFileName, cnt)
				text of pField = retVal
			end while

			-- Check to see if the return value ends in ...
			numChars = charCount(retVal)
			if (numChars > 2) and chars (numChars - 2) to (numChars) of retVal = "..." then
				-- it won't fit! Return just the filename
				retVal = ASYM_ShortFileName(pFileName)
			end if

			-- Restore the status of the field
			fieldType of pField = cache_FldType

-- 0x85170  to handle _doNeuronCheck
to handle _doNeuronCheck
	-- before we do anything else, check if we're running Neuron in secure mode, and bail out
	if sysPluginMode
		if sysSecureMode
			msgTxt = ASYM_GetString("msgErrRunningNeuronInSecureMode", \
					"You are attempting to run a click2learn.com ToolBook II course " & \
					"under Neuron in secure mode." & \
					CRLF & \
					"For the course to work, Neuron must be configured to " & \
					"run in non-secure mode." & \
					CRLF & \
					"Click OK to exit.")
			request msgTxt
			sysSuspendMessages = TRUE
			send exit to system
			break to system
		else
			if ASYM_Is32Bit() and "tb80aicc.sbk" is not in sysbooks
				ss = syssuspend
				syssuspend = FALSE
				push "tb80aicc.sbk" onto sysbooks
				syssuspend = ss
				clear sysError
			end
		end
	end
end

to handle _unLinkSysBook
	system s_ASYM_ModalState
	if s_ASYM_ModalState is TRUE
		in mainWindow
			set ASYM_ModalState of this book to FALSE
		end
	end
end

to get GetFreeDosMem maxm
	linkdll "kernel"
		DWORD GlobalDosAlloc(DWORD)
		WORD GlobalDosFree(DWORD)
	end
	if maxm is null or maxm = 0
		set maxm to 300000
	end
	set i to maxm
	set j to i div 2
	set good to 0
	while j <> 0
		get GlobalDosAlloc(i)
		if it <> 0
			selector = it mod 65536
			get globalDosFree(selector)
			set good to i
			increment i by j
		else
			set bad to i
			set j to abs(good - bad) div 2
			decrement i by j
		end
	end
	return good
end

to handle initSysBooks
end


to get SetSysBooksInOrder bkFnList
	-- Make sure that the right sysbooks are in the right order

	local WORD bkPos[]
	local STACK missing

	sysBks = sysBooks
	bkFnCnt  = itemCount(bkFnList)

	step i from 1 to bkFnCnt
		bkPos[i] = itemcontains(ASYM_ShortFileName(item i of bkFnList),\
		  sysBks)
		if bkPos[i] = 0
			push item i of bkFnList onto missing
		end
	end

	-- Add books to list as necessary and add sort tags
	step i from 1 to bkFnCnt
		format number i as "00"
		conditions
		when bkPos[i] = 0 and item i of bkFnList <> "*"
			if sysBks <> null
				put "," after sysBks
			end
			put i & space & item i of bkFnList after sysBks
		when bkPos[i] <> 0
			put i & space before item bkPos[i] of sysBks
		end
	end
	sysBkCnt = itemCount(sysBks)

	step i from 1 to itemCount(sysBks)
		if wordCount(item i of sysBks) = 1
			put "00 " before item i of sysBks
		end
	end

	sysBks = sortList(sysBks)

	step i from 1 to sysBkCnt
		clear word 1 of item i of sysBks
	end

	if sysBooks <> sysBks
		sysSuspend = false
		clear sysError
		sysBooks = sysBks
		sysSuspend = true
		if sysError <> null
			request sysError
			return false
		end
	end

	return true
end

to get shortFileName fName
	ccnt = charcount(fName)
	step i from ccnt to 1 by -1
		if char i of fName is in ":\"
			return chars i+1 to ccnt of fName
		end
	end
	return null
end

to get _ASYM_Ellipsize s, len, side
	if len = 0; return null;end
	s = ASYM_Trim(s)
	cCnt = charcount(s)
	if cCnt <= len
		return s
	end
	dotss = "...";dotCnt = 3
	p1 = offset("\", s)
	if p1 > 0
		if side is "center" and len < 18;side = "left";end
		conditions
		when side is "left"
			s = chars (cCnt - len + 1) to cCnt of s
			p = offset("\", s)
			if p > 0;s = chars p to cCnt of s;end
			dotsL = (len - charcount(s))+1
			if dotsL > 0;put chars 1 to dotsL of dotss before s;end
		when side is "center"
			s = ellipsizeFileName(s, len) -- in DLL
		else
			s = chars 1 to len - 1 of s
			step i from charcount(s) to 1 by -1
				if char i of s is in ":\"
					s = chars 1 to i of s
					break step
				end
			end
			dotsL = (len - charcount(s))+1
			if dotsL > 0;put chars 1 to dotsL of dotss after s;end
		end
	else
		conditions
		when side is "left"
			s = dotss & chars (cCnt - len + 4) to cCnt of s
		when side is "center"
			p = round((len - 3) / 2 + 0.1)
			s1 = chars 1 to p of s & dotss
			while charcount(s1) + 1 + p > len;decrement p;end
			s = s1 & chars cCnt - p to cCnt of s
		else
			s = chars 1 to len - 3 of s & dotss
		end
	end
	return s
end

to get _ASYM_ExpandString templStr
	if templStr is null or "%" is not in templStr
		return templStr
	end
	ss = sysSuspend
	sysSuspend = false
	i = 1
	while i < charcount (templStr)
		increment i
		if char (i - 1) of templStr = "%"
			if char i of templStr is "%"
				clear char i of templStr
			else
				-- check for the format %n
				n = char i of templStr & ""
				if isType(REAL,n) and n > 0
					n2 = char i + 1 of templStr
					if isType(REAL,n2)
						n = n*10 + n2
						extra = 1
					else
						extra = 0
					end
					get argument (n + 1)
					put it into chars i-1 to i + extra of templStr
					increment i by charcount(it) - 1
					clear it
				else
					-- check for the %<expression>% form
					set p to offset("%", chars i to\
					  charcount(templStr) of templStr)
					if p <> 0
						get chars i to i + p - 2 of templStr
						if ASYM_Trim(it) <> null
							get evaluate(it)
						end
						chars i-1 to i + p - 1 of templStr = it
						increment i by charcount(it) - 1
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	sysSuspend = ss
	return templStr
end

--*************************************
to get _ASYM_EllipsizeFileToField pField, pFileName, pFileOpt, pDirOpt

	retVal = NULL

	if (isObject(pField) = TRUE) and (object of pField is in "field,recordField") then

		if (ASYM_IsFile(pFileName)) and (charCount(pFileName) > 2) and \
				((chars 1 to 2 of pFileName = "\\") or (chars 2 to 3 of pFileName = ":\")) then

			linkDLL "TBFILE32.DLL"
				STRING getEllipsisByFont32(STRING, INT, INT, INT, STRING, INT, INT, INT)
			end linkDLL

			_fontName = fontFace of pField
			_fontSize = fontSize of pField
			_fontStyle = fontStyle of pField
			if (_fontStyle contains "bold") then
				_fontBold = 1
			else
				_fontBold = 0
			end if

			_fontItalic = (_fontStyle contains "italic")
			if (_fontStyle contains "italic") then
				_fontItalic = 1
			else
				_fontItalic = 0
			end if

			_width = (item 1 of size of pField) - \
					(item 1 of indents of pField + item 3 of indents of pField)

			if (pFileOpt <> FALSE) then
				_fileOpt = 1
			else
				_fileOpt = 0
			end if

			if (pDirOpt <> FALSE) then
				_DirOpt = 1
			else
				_DirOpt = 0
			end if

			clear sysError

			retVal = getEllipsisByFont32(_fontName, _fontSize, _fontBold, _fontItalic, pFileName, \
					_width, _fileOpt, _dirOpt)

			if sysError = -1 then
				retVal = ASYM_ShortFileName(pFileName)
			end if

		else

			-- In 16-bit Windows, and when the file does not already exist,
			-- revert to the OpenScript-based version

			sls = syslockscreen
			if visible of pField = TRUE then
				syslockscreen = TRUE
			end if

			-- Cache the status of the field
			cache_Text = richText of pField
			cache_Scroll = scroll of pField
			cache_SelLines = selectedTextLines of pField
			cache_FldType = fieldType of pField

			clear richText of pField
			fieldType of pField = "singleLineWrap"

			retVal = pFileName
			cnt = charCount(retVal)
			text of pField = retVal
			while ((textOverFlow of pField + textUnderFlow of pField) > 0) and (cnt > 5)
				decrement cnt
				retVal = ellipsizeFileName(pFileName, cnt)
				text of pField = retVal
			end while

			-- Check to see if the return value ends in ...
			numChars = charCount(retVal)
			if (numChars > 2) and chars (numChars - 2) to (numChars) of retVal = "..." then
				-- it won't fit! Return just the filename
				retVal = ASYM_ShortFileName(pFileName)
			end if

			-- Restore the status of the field
			fieldType of pField = cache_FldType
			richText of pField = cache_Text
			scroll of pField = cache_Scroll
			selectedTextLines of pField = cache_SelLines

			if syslockscreen <> sls then
				syslockscreen = sls
			end if

		end if

	end if

	return

	system s_ASYM_ModalState
	if s_ASYM_ModalState is TRUE
		in mainWindow
			set ASYM_ModalState of this book to FALSE
		end
	end
end

					put it into chars i-1 to i + extra of templStr
					increment i by charcount(it) - 1
					clear it
				else
					-- check for the %<expression>% form
					set p to offset("%", chars i to\
					  charcount(templStr) of templStr)
					if p <> 0
						get chars i to i + p - 2 of templStr
						if ASYM_Trim(it) <> null
							get evaluate(it)
						end
						chars i-1 to i + p - 1 of templStr = it
						increment i by charcount(it) - 1
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	sysSuspend = ss
	return templStr
end

--*************************************
to get _ASYM_EllipsizeFileToField pField, pFileName, pFileOpt, pDirOpt

	retVal = NULL

	if (isObject(pField) = TRUE) and (object of pField is in "field,recordField") then

		if (ASYM_IsFile(pFileName)) and (charCount(pFileName) > 2) and \
				((chars 1 to 2 of pFileName = "\\") or (chars 2 to 3 of pFileName = ":\")) then

			linkDLL "TBFILE32.DLL"
				STRING getEllipsisByFont32(STRING, INT, INT, INT, STRING, INT, INT, INT)
			end linkDLL

			_fontName = fontFace of pField
			_fontSize = fontSize of pField
			_fontStyle = fontStyle of pField
			if (_fontStyle contains "bold") then
				_fontBold = 1
			else
				_fontBold = 0
			end if

			_fontItalic = (_fontStyle contains "italic")
			if (_fontStyle contains "italic") then
				_fontItalic = 1
			else
				_fontItalic = 0
			end if

			_width = (item 1 of size of pField) - \
					(item 1 of indents of pField + item 3 of indents of pField)

			if (pFileOpt <> FALSE) then
				_fileOpt = 1
			else
				_fileOpt = 0
			end if

			if (pDirOpt <> FALSE) then
				_DirOpt = 1
			else
				_DirOpt = 0
			end if

			clear sysError

			retVal = getEllipsisByFont32(_fontName, _fontSize, _fontBold, _fontItalic, pFileName, \
					_width, _fileOpt, _dirOpt)

			if sysError = -1 then
				retVal = ASYM_ShortFileName(pFileName)
			end if

		else

			-- In 16-bit Windows, and when the file does not already exist,
			-- revert to the OpenScript-based version

			sls = syslockscreen
			if visible of pField = TRUE then
				syslockscreen = TRUE
			end if

			-- Cache the status of the field
			cache_Text = richText of pField
			cache_Scroll = scroll of pField
			cache_SelLines = selectedTextLines of pField
			cache_FldType = fieldType of pField

			clear richText of pField
			fieldType of pField = "singleLineWrap"

			retVal = pFileName
			cnt = charCount(retVal)
			text of pField = retVal
			while ((textOverFlow of pField + textUnderFlow of pField) > 0) and (cnt > 5)
				decrement cnt
				retVal = ellipsizeFileName(pFileName, cnt)
				text of pField = retVal
			end while

			-- Check to see if the return value ends in ...
			numChars = charCount(retVal)
			if (numChars > 2) and chars (numChars - 2) to (numChars) of retVal = "..." then
				-- it won't fit! Return just the filename
				retVal = ASYM_ShortFileName(pFileName)
			end if

			-- Restore the status of the field
			fieldType of pField = cache_FldType
			richText of pField = cache_Text
			scroll of pField = cache_Scroll
			selectedTextLines of pField = cache_SelLines

			if syslockscreen <> sls then
				syslockscreen = sls
			end if

		end if

	end if

	return retVal

end _ASYM_EllipsizeFileToField

to handle initSysBooks

to get SetSysBooksInOrder bkFnList
	-- Make sure that the right sysbooks are in the right order

	local WORD bkPos[]
	local STACK missing

	sysBks = sysBooks
	bkFnCnt  = itemCount(bkFnList)

	step i from 1 to bkFnCnt
		bkPos[i] = itemcontains(ASYM_ShortFileName(item i of bkFnList),\
		  sysBks)
		if bkPos[i] = 0
			push item i of bkFnList onto missing
		end
	end

	-- Add books to list as necessary and add sort tags
	step i from 1 to bkFnCnt
		format number i as "00"
		conditions
		when bkPos[i] = 0 and item i of bkFnList <> "*"
			if sysBks <> null
				put "," after sysBks
			end
			put i & space & item i of bkFnList after sysBks
		when bkPos[i] <> 0
			put i & space before item bkPos[i] of sysBks
		end
	end
	sysBkCnt = itemCount(sysBks)

	step i from 1 to itemCount(sysBks)
		if wordCount(item i of sysBks) = 1
			put "00 " before item i of sysBks
		end
	end

	sysBks = sortList(sysBks)

	step i from 1 to sysBkCnt
		clear word 1 of item i of sysBks
	end

	if sysBooks <> sysBks
		sysSuspend = false
		clear sysError
		sysBooks = sysBks
		sysSuspend = true
		if sysError <> null
			request sysError
			return false
		end
	end

	return true
end

to get shortFileName fName
	ccnt = charcount(fName)
	step i from ccnt to 1 by -1
		if char i of fName is in ":\"
			return chars i+1 to ccnt of fName
		end
	end
	return null
end

to get _ASYM_Ellipsize s, len, side
	if len = 0; return null;end
	s = ASYM_Trim(s)
	cCnt = charcount(s)
	if cCnt <= len
		return s
	end
	dotss = "...";dotCnt = 3
	p1 = offset("\", s)
	if p1 > 0
		if side is "center" and len < 18;side = "left";end
		conditions
		when side is "left"
			s = chars (cCnt - len + 1) to cCnt of s
			p = offset("\", s)
			if p > 0;s = chars p to cCnt of s;end
			dotsL = (len - charcount(s))+1
			if dotsL > 0;put chars 1 to dotsL of dotss before s;end
		when side is "center"
			s = ellipsizeFileName(s, len) -- in DLL
		else
			s = chars 1 to len - 1 of s
			step i from charcount(s) to 1 by -1
				if char i of s is in ":\"
					s = chars 1 to i of s
					break step
				end
			end
			dotsL = (len - charcount(s))+1
			if dotsL > 0;put chars 1 to dotsL of dotss after s;end
		end
	else
		conditions
		when side is "left"
			s = dotss & chars (cCnt - len + 4) to cCnt of s
		when side is "center"
			p = round((len - 3) / 2 + 0.1)
			s1 = chars 1 to p of s & dotss
			while charcount(s1) + 1 + p > len;decrement p;end
			s = s1 & chars cCnt - p to cCnt of s
		else
			s = chars 1 to len - 3 of s & dotss
		end
	end
	return s
end

to get _ASYM_ExpandString templStr
	if templStr is null or "%" is not in templStr
		return templStr
	end
	ss = sysSuspend
	sysSuspend = false
	i = 1
	while i < charcount (templStr)
		increment i
		if char (i - 1) of templStr = "%"
			if char i of templStr is "%"
				clear char i of templStr
			else
				-- check for the format %n
				n = char i of templStr & ""
				if isType(REAL,n) and n > 0
					n2 = char i + 1 of templStr
					if isType(REAL,n2)
						n = n*10 + n2
						extra = 1
					else
						extra = 0
					end
					get argument (n + 1)
					put it into chars i-1 to i + extra of templStr
					increment i by charcount(it) - 1
					clear it
				else
					-- check for the %<expression>% form
					set p to offset("%", chars i to\
					  charcount(templStr) of templStr)
					if p <> 0
						get chars i to i + p - 2 of templStr
						if ASYM_Trim(it) <> null
							get evaluate(it)
						end
						chars i-1 to i + p - 1 of templStr = it
						increment i by charcount(it) - 1
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	sysSuspend = ss
	return templStr
end

-- 0x85b26  to get _ASYM_ExpandString templStr
to get _ASYM_ExpandString templStr
	if templStr is null or "%" is not in templStr
		return templStr
	end
	ss = sysSuspend
	sysSuspend = false
	i = 1
	while i < charcount (templStr)
		increment i
		if char (i - 1) of templStr = "%"
			if char i of templStr is "%"
				clear char i of templStr
			else
				-- check for the format %n
				n = char i of templStr & ""
				if isType(REAL,n) and n > 0
					n2 = char i + 1 of templStr
					if isType(REAL,n2)
						n = n*10 + n2
						extra = 1
					else
						extra = 0
					end
					get argument (n + 1)
					put it into chars i-1 to i + extra of templStr
					increment i by charcount(it) - 1
					clear it
				else
					-- check for the %<expression>% form
					set p to offset("%", chars i to\
					  charcount(templStr) of templStr)
					if p <> 0
						get chars i to i + p - 2 of templStr
						if ASYM_Trim(it) <> null
							get evaluate(it)
						end
						chars i-1 to i + p - 1 of templStr = it
						increment i by charcount(it) - 1
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	sysSuspend = ss
	return templStr
end

--*************************************
to get _ASYM_EllipsizeFileToField pField, pFileName, pFileOpt, pDirOpt

	retVal = NULL

	if (isObject(pField) = TRUE) and (object of pField is in "field,recordField") then

		if (ASYM_IsFile(pFileName)) and (charCount(pFileName) > 2) and \
				((chars 1 to 2 of pFileName = "\\") or (chars 2 to 3 of pFileName = ":\")) then

			linkDLL "TBFILE32.DLL"
				STRING getEllipsisByFont32(STRING, INT, INT, INT, STRING, INT, INT, INT)
			end linkDLL

			_fontName = fontFace of pField
			_fontSize = fontSize of pField
			_fontStyle = fontStyle of pField
			if (_fontStyle contains "bold") then
				_fontBold = 1
			else
				_fontBold = 0
			end if

			_fontItalic = (_fontStyle contains "italic")
			if (_fontStyle contains "italic") then
				_fontItalic = 1
			else
				_fontItalic = 0
			end if

			_width = (item 1 of size of pField) - \
					(item 1 of indents of pField + item 3 of indents of pField)

			if (pFileOpt <> FALSE) then
				_fileOpt = 1
			else
				_fileOpt = 0
			end if

			if (pDirOpt <> FALSE) then
				_DirOpt = 1
			else
				_DirOpt = 0
			end if

			clear sysError

			retVal = getEllipsisByFont32(_fontName, _fontSize, _fontBold, _fontItalic, pFileName, \
					_width, _fileOpt, _dirOpt)

			if sysError = -1 then
				retVal = ASYM_ShortFileName(pFileName)
			end if

		else

			-- In 16-bit Windows, and when the file does not already exist,
			-- revert to the OpenScript-based version

			sls = syslockscreen
			if visible of pField = TRUE then
				syslockscreen = TRUE
			end if

			-- Cache the status of the field
			cache_Text = richText of pField
			cache_Scroll = scroll of pField
			cache_SelLines = selectedTextLines of pField
			cache_FldType = fieldType of pField

			clear richText of pField
			fieldType of pField = "singleLineWrap"

			retVal = pFileName
			cnt = charCount(retVal)
			text of pField = retVal
			while ((textOverFlow of pField + textUnderFlow of pField) > 0) and (cnt > 5)
				decrement cnt
				retVal = ellipsizeFileName(pFileName, cnt)
				text of pField = retVal
			end while

			-- Check to see if the return value ends in ...
			numChars = charCount(retVal)
			if (numChars > 2) and chars (numChars - 2) to (numChars) of retVal = "..." then
				-- it won't fit! Return just the filename
				retVal = ASYM_ShortFileName(pFileName)
			end if

			-- Restore the status of the field
			fieldType of pField = cache_FldType
			richText of pField = cache_Text
			scroll of pField = cache_Scroll
			selectedTextLines of pField = cache_SelLines

			if syslockscreen <> sls then
				syslockscreen = sls
			end if

		end if

	end if

	return retVal

end _ASYM_EllipsizeFileToField

-- 0x86417  to get _ASYM_PopupPage object pgRef, popStyle, pos, captn, curs, fx
to get _ASYM_PopupPage object pgRef, popStyle, pos, captn, curs, fx
	system s_tb80r_PopViewers
	local object oldPg
	local int oldCurs
	local v

	--sanity check
	if sysOpenWindows = 1
		clear s_tb80r_PopViewers
	end
	in ASYM_WorkWindow()
		oldCurs = _ASYM_SysCursor()
		if curs <> null
			sysCursor = curs
		end
		if pos = null
			mousePos = sysMousePosition
		end
		if true -- popStyle <> null

			maxPopups = 5 --** MAGIC NUMBER
			magicName = "Do not rename me"
			myBk = objectContainer(self,"book")

			if captn is "<glossary>"
				captn = ASYM_GetStandardString("<glossary>", "Glossary")
			end

			ss = sysSuspend;sysSuspend = false; clear sysError
			if itemCount(s_tb80r_PopViewers) >= maxPopups
				v = last item of s_tb80r_PopViewers
				clear last item of s_tb80r_PopViewers
				clear sysError
				get isOpen of v
				if sysError is null and it is true
					parentHandle of last item of s_tb80r_PopViewers\
					  = parentHandle of v
					close v
				end
			end
			sysSuspend = ss; clear sysError

			-- Find available viewer
			clear v
			step i from 1 to maxPopups
				vtemp = viewer (magicName && i) of myBk
				if not isOpen of vTemp
					v = vTemp
					break step
				end
			end
			if v is null
				msgTxt = ASYM_GetStandardString("<NoViewerAvailable>", \
						"Sorry, cannot open another window.")
				if ASYM_ProductName() = "Assistant"
					msgCaption = ASYM_GetString("Assistant")
				else
					msgCaption = ASYM_GetString("Instructor")
				end if
				get ASYM_MessageBox(msgTxt, msgCaption, "INFO", "OK")

				send ASYM_ResetCursor to this page
				return false
			end
			push v onto s_tb80r_PopViewers
			ASYM_TempViewer of v = true

			caption of v = captn
			style of v = "sysMenu"
			imageBuffers of v = 1
			alwaysReader of v = true
			autoclose of v = false
			captionBar of v = normal
			ASYM_CloseOnEsc of v = true
			conditions
			when popStyle contains "autoClose"
				autoClose of v = true
				borderStyle of v = shadowed
			when popStyle contains "shadow"
				borderStyle of v = shadowed
			when popStyle contains "thick"
				borderStyle of v = "thickFrame"
			when popStyle contains "thinCaption"
				borderStyle of v = "thinFrame"
				captionBar of v = "thin"
			when popStyle contains "thin"
				borderStyle of v = "thinFrame"
			else
				borderStyle of v = dialogFrame
			end

			ss = sysSuspend --** DEBUG

			linkdll ASYM_ProductPrefix() & "win.dll"
				STRING ScreenFromPage(WORD,STRING,INT,STRING)
				int VerticalDisplayRes()
				int HorizontalDisplayRes()
			end
			-- place as close to mouseclick as possible
			if pos = null
				pos = pageUnitsToScreen(sysMousePosition, targetWindow)
			else
				pos = ScreenFromPage(windowHandle of targetWindow,\
				  pageScroll of targetWindow, magnification of targetWindow, pos)
			end
			defaultPosition of v = pos
			defaultPage of v = pgRef
			open v
			get bounds of v
			pop it into x1; pop it into y1; pop it into x2; pop it into y2
			if x2 > HorizontalDisplayRes()
				move v by HorizontalDisplayRes() - x2,0
			end
			if y2 > VerticalDisplayRes()
				move v by 0,VerticalDisplayRes() - y2
			end
			if x1 < 0
				move v by -x1,0
			end
			if y1 < 0
				move v by 0,-y1
			end
			if curs <> null and oldCurs <> null
				send ASYM_ResetCursor
			end
			script of v = viewerScript()
			show v
		else
			if curs <> null and oldCurs <> null
				send ASYM_ResetCursor to this page
			end
		end
	end in
	return (this page <> oldPg)
end

	if parent of v = objectContainer(self,"book")
		if loc is null
			loc = mousePosition of v
		end
		get objectFromPoint(loc)
		if it <> null and object of it is in "hotword button"
--			get uniquename of it
--			send ASYM_PostMsg "buttonClick",it
			send buttonClick to it when idle
		end
	end
end

-- 0x86f2f  to handle _sized sizedObj, tbk_wid_type
to handle _sized sizedObj, tbk_wid_type
	LOCAL STRING buffer

	yp = sysPageUnitsPerPixel
	pop yp into xp
	oldLockS = lockScreen of targetWindow
	lockScreen of targetWindow = true
	Bnds = bounds of sizedObj
	conditions
		when tbk_wid_type = "ordertext"
			pg = objectContainer(sizedObj, "page,background")
			buffer = "rectangle" && QUOTE & "frame" & QUOTE && "of" && pg
			if isObject(buffer)
				oldSys = sysSuspendMessages
				b = bounds of sizedObj
				sysSuspendMessages = TRUE
				bounds of rectangle "frame" of sizedObj = b
				frame = tbk_wid_thickness of sizedObj; frameX2 = frame*2
				fx = xp*frame; fy = yp*frame
				fx2 = xp*frameX2; fy2 = yp*frameX2
				x1 = item 1 of b; y1 = item 2 of b
				x2 = item 3 of b; y2 = item 4 of b
				buffer = "field"&&QUOTE&"frame"&QUOTE&&"of"&&pg
				if isObject(buffer)
					bounds of field "frame" of sizedObj = x1+fx, y1+fy, x2-fx, y2-fy
				end
				buffer = "field"&&QUOTE&"frame2"&QUOTE&&"of"&&pg
				if isObject(buffer)
					bounds of field "frame2" of sizedObj = x1+fx2, y1+fy2, x2-fx2, y2-fy2
				end
				buffer = "field"&&QUOTE&"dragText"&QUOTE&&"of"&&pg
				if isObject(buffer)
					bounds of field "dragText" of sizedObj = x1+fx2+xp, y1+fy2+yp, x2-fx2-xp, y2-fy2-yp
				end
				sysSuspendMessages = oldSys
			end

		when tbk_wid_type = "namepart"
			set pwidth to xp * 10
			set pheight to yp * 10
			set base to  irregularPolygon "base" of sizedObj
			set topLeft to angledLine "topLeft" of sizedObj
			set mask to angledLine "mask" of sizedObj
			set topRight to line "topRight" of sizedObj
			set pnt to line "point" of sizedObj
			set bottomLine to angledLine "bottomLine" of sizedObj
			set lbl to button "label" of sizedObj
			set b to bounds of base
			set sz to size of base
			set v to vertices of base
			if item 1 of sz > pwidth and item 2 of sz > pheight
				set lockScreen of targetWindow to true
				set syssuspendmessages to true
				set distToP to (item 1 of sz - pwidth) div 2
				item 1  of v = item 1 of b + distToP
				item 2  of v = item 2 of b + pheight
				item 3  of v = item 1 of b + item 1 of sz div 2
				item 4  of v = item 2 of b
				item 5  of v = item 3 of b - distToP
				item 6  of v = item 2 of b + pheight
				item 7  of v = item 3 of b
				item 8  of v = item 2 of b + pheight
				item 9  of v = item 3 of b
				item 10 of v = item 4 of b
				item 11  of v = item 1 of b
				item 12 of v = item 4 of b
				item 13  of v = item 1 of b
				item 14  of v = item 2 of b + pheight
				set vertices of base to v

				set vertices of topLeft to \
				  item 11 of v + xp,item 12 of v - yp,\
				  item 13 of v + xp,item 14 of v + yp,\
				  item 1  of v + xp,item 2  of v+yp ,\
				  item 3  of v + xp,item 4  of v + yp
				set vertices of topRight to \
				  item 5 of v + xp,item 6 of v + yp,\
				  item 7 of v,item 8 of v + yp
				set vertices of pnt to \
				  item 3 of v - xp,item 4 of v + yp,\
				  item 5 of v - xp,item 6 of v + yp
				set vertices of mask to \
				  items 1 to 6 of v
				set vertices of bottomLine to \
				  item 7 of v - xp,item 8 of v + yp,\
				  item 9 of v - xp,item 10 of v - yp,\
				  item 11  of v + xp,item 12 of v - yp
				set bounds of lbl to item 13 of v+xp,item 14 of v+yp,items 9 to 10 of v
				set lockScreen of targetWindow to false
			end
			set resetPosition of sizedObj to position of sizedObj

		when tbk_wid_type is "3DfieldWithButton"
			set bounds of angledLine "TL" of sizedObj to Bnds
			set bounds of angledLine "BR" of sizedObj to Bnds
			fld = item 1 of objects of sizedObj
			btnW = fontsize of fld * 27
			btn = last item of objects of sizedObj
			set fontsize of btn to fontsize of fld - 3
			set bounds of fld to \
			  item 1 of Bnds + xp, item 2 of Bnds + yp,\
			  item 3 of Bnds - btnW, item 4 of Bnds - yp
			set bounds of btn to \
			  item 3 of Bnds - btnW, item 2 of Bnds + yp,\
			  item 3 of Bnds - xp, item 4 of Bnds - yp

		when tbk_wid_type is "3Dfield"
			set bounds of angledLine "TL" of sizedObj to Bnds
			set bounds of angledLine "BR" of sizedObj to Bnds
			fld = item 1 of objects of sizedObj
			set bounds of fld to \
			  item 1 of Bnds + xp, item 2 of Bnds + yp,\
			  item 3 of Bnds - xp, item 4 of Bnds - yp

		when tbk_wid_type is "3DComboBox"
			get bounds of sizedObj
			cb = item 1 of objects of sizedObj
			set bounds of cb to \
			  item 1 of Bnds + xp, item 2 of Bnds + yp,\
			  item 3 of Bnds - xp, item 4 of Bnds - yp
			item 4 of Bnds = item 4 of bounds of CB + yp
			set bounds of angledLine "TL" of sizedObj to Bnds
			set bounds of angledLine "BR" of sizedObj to Bnds

		when tbk_wid_type is "3DHLine"
			set bounds of item 1 of objects of sizedObj to \
			  item 1 of Bnds, item 2 of Bnds,\
			  item 3 of Bnds, item 2 of Bnds
			set bounds of item 2 of objects of sizedObj to \
			  item 1 of Bnds, item 2 of Bnds + yp,\
			  item 3 of Bnds, item 2 of Bnds + yp

		when tbk_wid_type is "3DVLine"
			set bounds of item 2 of objects of sizedObj to \
			  item 1 of Bnds, item 2 of Bnds,\
			  item 1 of Bnds, item 4 of Bnds
			set bounds of item 1 of objects of sizedObj to \
			  item 1 of Bnds + xp, item 2 of Bnds,\
			  item 1 of Bnds + xp, item 4 of Bnds

		when tbk_wid_type is "3DFrame"
			set bounds of item 1 of objects of sizedObj to \
			  item 1 of Bnds, item 2 of Bnds,\
			  item 3 of Bnds -xp, item 4 of Bnds - yp
			set bounds of item 2 of objects of sizedObj to\
			  item 1 of Bnds +xp, item 2 of Bnds +yp,\
			  item 3 of Bnds, item 4 of Bnds

		when tbk_wid_type is "3DGroupBox"
			sp = sysSuspendMessages
			sysSuspendMessages = true


			fld = item 3 of objects of sizedObj
			if object of fld is "field"
				fieldType of fld = "wordwrap"
			end
			bounds of fld = item 1 of Bnds + 60, item 2 of Bnds,\
			  item 1 of Bnds + 10000, item 2 of Bnds
			while textOverFlow of fld > 0
				increment item 4 of bounds of fld by yp
			end
			item 3 of bounds of fld = item 1 of bounds of fld
			while textOverFlow of fld > 0
				increment item 3 of bounds of fld by yp * 2
			end
			fillColor of fld = fillColor of objectContainer(fld,"background")
			get bounds of fld
			y = average(item 2 of it, item 4 of it)
			set bounds of item 1 of objects of sizedObj to \
			  item 1 of Bnds, y,\
			  item 3 of Bnds -xp, item 4 of Bnds - yp
			set bounds of item 2 of objects of sizedObj to\
			  item 1 of Bnds +xp, y+yp,\
			  item 3 of Bnds, item 4 of Bnds
			sysSuspendMessages = sp
	end
	lockScreen of targetWindow = oldLockS
end

-- 0x87f05  to get _ASYM_MakeBookmarkFileName
to get _ASYM_MakeBookmarkFileName
	path = ASYM_GetPath("Log")
	if path is null
		path = ASYM_WindowsDirectory()
	end
	get ASYM_ShortFileName(name of this book)
	p = offset(".", it)
	if p > 0
		clear chars p to charcount(it) of it
	end
	put ".tbm" after it
	return path & it
end

to get _readBookmarks bookmarkFn
	linkdll ASYM_ProductPrefix() & "dos.dll"
		STRING GetFileDate(STRING)
	end

	if bookmarkFn is null
		bookmarkFn = _ASYM_MakeBookmarkFileName()
	end

	if not ASYM_IsFile(bookmarkFn)
		return false
	end

	sysSuspend = false; clear sysError
	closeFile boomarkFn; clear sysError

	openFile bookmarkFn
	do
		get readNextLine(bookmarkFn)
		if offset("[", it) = 1
			clear char 1 of it
			clear last char of it
			conditions
			when it is "version"
				get ReadNextLine(bookmarkFn)
				if it <> GetFileDate(name of this book)

					if ASYM_AutoBookmarks of this book is true
						request ASYM_GetStandardString("<BookmarksOutOfDate>","")
					end

					sysError = ASYM_GetString("Bookmark file mismatch")
					break do

				end
			when it is "user"
				get readNextLine(bookmarkFn)
			when it is "page"
				get readNextLine(bookmarkFn)
				-- page info might be useful
			when it is "Been There"
				do
					seekFile bookmarkFn for 0 from current
					posMark = it
					readFile bookmarkFn to ","
					if not isType(DWORD,it)
						seekFile bookmarkFn for posMark from beginning
						get readNextLine(bookmarkFn)
						break do
					end
					if it <> null
						ASYM_BeenHere of page ID it = true
					end
				until it is null
			when it is "Done"
				do
					readFile bookmarkFn to ","
					if it <> null
						ASYM_Done of page ID it = true
					end
				until it is null
			end
		end
	until sysErrorNumber = 565
	closeFile bookmarkFn
	sysSuspend = true
	return (sysError is null or sysError is "OK" or sysErrorNumber = 565)
end

to get _writeBookmarks bookmarkFn
	system s_ASYM_UserName

	linkdll ASYM_ProductPrefix() & "dos.dll"
		STRING GetFileDate(STRING)
		INT RemoveFile(STRING)
	end

	in mainWindow

		if bookmarkFn is null
			bookmarkFn = _ASYM_MakeBookmarkFileName()
		end

		sysSuspend = false; clear sysError
		closeFile bookmarkFn
		get RemoveFile(bookmarkFn)
		clear sysError
		createFile bookmarkFn
		writeFile "[version]" & CRLF \
		  & getFileDate(name of this book) & CRLF to bookmarkFn
		writeFile "[user]" & CRLF \
		  & s_ASYM_UserName & CRLF to bookmarkFn
		writeFile "[page]" & CRLF \
		  & idNumber of this page & CRLF to bookmarkFn
		writeFile "[Been There]" & CRLF to bookmarkFn
		step i from 1 to pageCount of this book
			pg = page i of this book
			if ASYM_BeenHere of pg is true
				writeFile idNumber of pg & "," to bookmarkFn
			end
		end
		writeFile CRLF & "[Done]" & CRLF to bookmarkFn
		step i from 1 to pageCount of this book
			pg = page i of this book
			if ASYM_Done of pg is true
				writeFile idNumber of pg & "," to bookmarkFn
			end
		end
		closeFile bookmarkFn

		sysSuspend = true
		if sysError is null or sysError is "OK"
			get ASYM_CMS_StoreBookmarkFile(bookmarkFn)
		end
	end in
	if sysError is null or sysError is "OK"
		return bookmarkFn
	else
		return NULL
	end
end

to get readNextLine fN
	readFile fN to LF
	return ASYM_Trim(it)
end

-- 0x87fc8  to get _readBookmarks bookmarkFn
to get _readBookmarks bookmarkFn
	linkdll ASYM_ProductPrefix() & "dos.dll"
		STRING GetFileDate(STRING)
	end

	if bookmarkFn is null
		bookmarkFn = _ASYM_MakeBookmarkFileName()
	end

	if not ASYM_IsFile(bookmarkFn)
		return false
	end

	sysSuspend = false; clear sysError
	closeFile boomarkFn; clear sysError

	openFile bookmarkFn
	do
		get readNextLine(bookmarkFn)
		if offset("[", it) = 1
			clear char 1 of it
			clear last char of it
			conditions
			when it is "version"
				get ReadNextLine(bookmarkFn)
				if it <> GetFileDate(name of this book)

					if ASYM_AutoBookmarks of this book is true
						request ASYM_GetStandardString("<BookmarksOutOfDate>","")
					end

					sysError = ASYM_GetString("Bookmark file mismatch")
					break do

				end
			when it is "user"
				get readNextLine(bookmarkFn)
			when it is "page"
				get readNextLine(bookmarkFn)
				-- page info might be useful
			when it is "Been There"
				do
					seekFile bookmarkFn for 0 from current
					posMark = it
					readFile bookmarkFn to ","
					if not isType(DWORD,it)
						seekFile bookmarkFn for posMark from beginning
						get readNextLine(bookmarkFn)
						break do
					end
					if it <> null
						ASYM_BeenHere of page ID it = true
					end
				until it is null
			when it is "Done"
				do
					readFile bookmarkFn to ","
					if it <> null
						ASYM_Done of page ID it = true
					end
				until it is null
			end
		end
	until sysErrorNumber = 565
	closeFile bookmarkFn
	sysSuspend = true
	return (sysError is null or sysError is "OK" or sysErrorNumber = 565)
end
