-- 0x8865b  to handle _ASYM_LogDispatch LogFileName, LogDest,\
to handle _ASYM_LogDispatch LogFileName, LogDest,\
  EmailLogRecipients, bookName, courseName

	system s_ASYM_UserName

	conditions
		when LogDest is "<email>"
		when LogDest is "<fax>"
		when LogDest is "<printer>"
			get CheckDOSMemForLog()
	end

	conditions
		when LogDest is null
			break

		when LogDest is "<ask>"
		when LogDest is "<bookDir>"
		when LogDest is "<TempDir>"
		when LogDest is "<iniDir>"
		when LogDest is "<floppy>"

			break -- handled when starting log

		when LogDest is "CMS"
			if not StoreLogFileInCMS(LogFilename)
				syscursor = 1
				msgTxt = ASYM_GetStandardString("<ERRORCMSStoreLog>", \
						"Could not record session log file %1 in Course Management System.")
				msgTxt = expandString(msgTxt, lowercase(logFileName))
				msgCaption = SPACE
				get ASYM_MessageBox(msgTxt, msgCaption, "HAND", "OK")
			end

		when LogDest is "<email>"
			in ASYM_WorkWindow()
				pgw = this page
			end

			get CustomMailLogFile (LogFileName, EmailLogRecipients,\
			  bookName, courseName, s_ASYM_UserName) of pgw

			conditions
			when it is null
			when it = 0
				send ASYM_MailLogFile LogFileName, EmailLogRecipients,\
				  bookName, courseName to pgw
			end

		when LogDest is "<fax>"

			-- Here we need to find a way to print the file to fax
			faxMgrPg = page "fax" of objectContainer(self,"book")
			faxDevice = _ASYM_FindFaxDriver() of faxMgrPg
			if faxDevice <> null and \
			  SendLogAsFax(logFileName, logPrintDefaults(), faxDevice) of faxMgrPg is true
				send RequestDeleteTempFile logFileName, courseName
			else
				syscursor = 1
				msgTxt = ASYM_GetStandardString("<ErrorFaxLog>", "")
				msgTxt = expandString(msgTxt, lowercase(logFilename))
				msgCaption = SPACE
				get ASYM_MessageBox(msgTxt, msgCaption, "HAND", "OK")
			end

		when LogDest is "<printer>"

			get ASYM_FileToPrinter(logFileName, \
			  logFileName & logPrintDefaults(),sysWindowHandle,1)
			if it <> 1
				linkDLL ASYM_ProductPrefix() & "dos.dll"
					INT CopyFile(STRING,STRING)
				end
				get CopyFile(LogFileName, "PRN")
				if it <> 1
					syscursor = 1
					msgTxt = ASYM_GetStandardString("<ERRORPrintLog>", "")
					msgTxt = expandString(msgTxt, lowercase(logFileName))
					msgCaption = SPACE
					get ASYM_MessageBox(msgTxt, msgCaption, "hand", "OK")
				end
			else
				send RequestDeleteTempFile logFileName, courseName
			end
	end
end

to get _ASYM_LogDispatchComboValues
	if ASYM_ProductName() = "Assistant"
		get ASYM_GetString("<ask>,Ask at run time" & CRLF &\
			"<iniDir>,Automatic (.INI directory)" & CRLF &\
			"<bookDir>,Automatic (same as book)" & CRLF &\
			"<tempdir>,Automatic (TEMP directory)" & CRLF &\
			"<email>,E-Mail Attachment (requires MAPI)" & CRLF &\
			"<fax>,Fax (requires fax driver)" & CRLF &\
			"<floppy>,Floppy disk" & CRLF &\
			"<printer>,Printer")
	else
		get ASYM_GetString("ComboLogDestinations",\
			"<ask>,Ask at run time" & CRLF &\
			"<iniDir>,Automatic (.INI directory)" & CRLF &\
			"<bookDir>,Automatic (same as book)" & CRLF &\
			"<tempdir>,Automatic (TEMP directory)" & CRLF &\
			"<email>,E-Mail Attachment (requires MAPI)" & CRLF &\
			"<fax>,Fax (requires fax driver)" & CRLF &\
			"<floppy>,Floppy disk" & CRLF &\
			"<printer>,Printer" & CRLF &\
			"<special>,System Variable s_ASYM_LogDir")
	end

	if ASYM_CBTIniVar("Options","Log to CMS","") = TRUE
		put CRLF & ASYM_GetString("ComboLogDestinationCMS",\
		  "<CMS>,Course Management System") after it
	end
	return it

end

to handle _ASYM_MailLogFile LogFileName, EmailLogRecipients,\
  bookName, courseName

	system s_sessionHandle, s_ASYM_UserName


	sysSuspend = true

	ss = sysSuspend
	sysSuspend = false
	clear sysError
	send linkMAPI
	sysSuspend = ss
	if sysError <> null or not IsMAPIAvailable()
		send mailDriverError logFileName, EmailLogRecipients
		break
	end

	oldCurs = _ASYM_SysCursor()
	sysCursor = 4
	get SessionLogOn()
	if it is "OK" or isType(DWORD,s_sessionHandle)

		if EmailLogRecipients is not null
			-- Send directly without dialog box
			get ASYM_MAPISendMessage(EmailLogRecipients,\
			  expandString(ASYM_GetString("CBT Log X",\
			      "CBT Log %1"), ASYM_ShortFileName(bookName)),\
			  expandString(ASYM_GetString("CBT Log Mail Text",\
			    "%1" & CRLF & "%2" & CRLF &  "%3"),\
			    s_ASYM_UserName, courseName, bookName),\
			  LogFileName)
		else
			get SendFile(LogFileName)
		end

		sysCursor = 1
		if it is not "OK"
			send mailSendError LogFileName, EmailLogRecipients
		else
			send ConfirmLogMailedOK logFileName, courseName, FALSE
		end
		sysCursor = 4
		get SessionLogOff()
	else
		-- if MAPI is not available, exit
		send mailDriverError logFileName, EmailLogRecipients
	end
	if oldCurs is not null
		sysCursor = oldCurs
	end
end

to get CheckDOSMemForLog
	tag = "MinRequiredDOSMem"
	requ = ASYM_CBTIniVar("Logs",tag,"")
	if requ is null
		requ = 20000
		get SetIniVar("Logs",tag,requ,ASYM_IniFile())
	end
	mem = ASYM_FreeDOSMem(requ)
	if mem < requ
		if ASYM_CBTIniVar("Logs","LowMemWarning",true) <> false
			get ASYM_GetStandardString("<LogDosMemWarning>","")
			format number mem as "#" & sysThousand & "###"
			request ASYM_ExpandString(it, mem)
		end
		return false
	end
	return true
end

to get getMAPIErrorString nErrorNumber
	conditions
		when nErrorNumber is 0
			get "OK"
		when nErrorNumber <= 21
			get textLine nErrorNumber of ASYM_GetString("MAPIErrorsByNumber",\
			"User Aborted"&CRLF\
			&"Operation Failed"&CRLF\
			&"Login Failed"&CRLF\
			&"Disk Full"&CRLF\
			&"Insufficient Memory"&CRLF\
			&"Block Too Small"&CRLF\
			&"Too Many Sessions"&CRLF\
			&"Too Many Files"&CRLF\
			&"Too Many Recipients"&CRLF\
			&"Attachment Not Found"&CRLF\
			&"Failure Opening Attachment"&CRLF\
			&"Failure Writing Attachment"&CRLF\
			&"Unknown Recipient"&CRLF\
			&"Bad Recipient Type"&CRLF\
			&"No Messages"&CRLF\
			&"Invalid Message"&CRLF\
			&"Text is Too Large"&CRLF\
			&"Invalid Session"&CRLF\
			&"Type Not Supported"&CRLF\
			&"Ambiguous Recipient")
		else
			get nErrorNumber
	end
	return ASYM_ExpandString(ASYM_GetString("MailError","Mail Error: %1."),it)
end

to get IsMAPIAvailable
-- According to spec, the application should check for a non-zero "MAPI" entry
-- in the [MAIL] section of WIN.INI to determine if MAPI support is available.
-- Note: this does not check for a non-zero number, just a non-zero entry.

	linkDLL ASYM_ProductPrefix() & "Win.dll"
		STRING GetWinIniVar(STRING,STRING)
	end
	get GetWinIniVar("Mail","MAPI")
	if it is NULL or it = 0
		return FALSE
	else
		return TRUE
	end
end

to handle linkMAPI
	linkDLL "kernel"
		INT 	ma_hmemcpy=hmemcpy(POINTER,POINTER,LONG)
	end linkDLL
	linkdll "mapi.dll"
		DWORD MAPILogoff (DWORD, DWORD, DWORD, DWORD)
		DWORD MAPILogon (DWORD, STRING, STRING, DWORD, DWORD, POINTER)
		DWORD MAPIFindNext (DWORD, DWORD, DWORD, POINTER, DWORD, DWORD, POINTER)
		DWORD MAPIFreeBuffer (POINTER)
		DWORD MAPISendMail (DWORD, DWORD, POINTER, DWORD, DWORD)
		DWORD MAPIReadMail (DWORD, DWORD, STRING, DWORD, DWORD, POINTER)
		DWORD MAPIResolveName (DWORD, DWORD, STRING, DWORD, DWORD, POINTER)
		DWORD MAPISendDocuments (DWORD, STRING, STRING, STRING, DWORD)
		DWORD MAPIAddress (DWORD, DWORD, STRING, DWORD, STRING, DWORD, \
		                         DWORD, DWORD, DWORD, POINTER, POINTER)
		DWORD MAPIDeleteMail (DWORD,DWORD,STRING,DWORD,DWORD)
	end linkDLL
end

to get logPrintDefaults
	local string s
	iniFile = ASYM_IniFile()
	get ASYM_CBTIniVar("Logs","fontFace",null)
	if it is null
		get "Arial"
		x = SetIniVar("Logs","fontFace",it,iniFile)
	end
	textline 1 of s = it
	get ASYM_CBTIniVar("Logs","fontStyle",null)
	if it is null
		get "plain"
		x = SetIniVar("Logs","fontStyle",it,iniFile)
	end
	if it is "plain"
		get null
	end

to get logPrintDefaults
	local string s
	iniFile = ASYM_IniFile()
	get ASYM_CBTIniVar("Logs","fontFace",null)
	if it is null
		get "Arial"
		x = SetIniVar("Logs","fontFace",it,iniFile)
	end
	textline 1 of s = it
	get ASYM_CBTIniVar("Logs","fontStyle",null)
	if it is null
		get "plain"
		x = SetIniVar("Logs","fontStyle",it,iniFile)
	end
	if it is "plain"
		get null
	end
	textline 2 of s = it
	get ASYM_CBTIniVar("Logs","fontSize",null)
	if it is null
		get 8

		x = setIniVar("Logs","margins",it,iniFile)
	end
	textline 4 of s = it
	return CRLF & s

-- 0x89314  to get getMAPIErrorString nErrorNumber
to get getMAPIErrorString nErrorNumber
	conditions
		when nErrorNumber is 0
			get "OK"
		when nErrorNumber <= 21
			get textLine nErrorNumber of ASYM_GetString("MAPIErrorsByNumber",\
			"User Aborted"&CRLF\
			&"Operation Failed"&CRLF\
			&"Login Failed"&CRLF\
			&"Disk Full"&CRLF\
			&"Insufficient Memory"&CRLF\
			&"Block Too Small"&CRLF\
			&"Too Many Sessions"&CRLF\
			&"Too Many Files"&CRLF\
			&"Too Many Recipients"&CRLF\
			&"Attachment Not Found"&CRLF\
			&"Failure Opening Attachment"&CRLF\
			&"Failure Writing Attachment"&CRLF\
			&"Unknown Recipient"&CRLF\
			&"Bad Recipient Type"&CRLF\
			&"No Messages"&CRLF\
			&"Invalid Message"&CRLF\
			&"Text is Too Large"&CRLF\
			&"Invalid Session"&CRLF\
			&"Type Not Supported"&CRLF\
			&"Ambiguous Recipient")
		else
			get nErrorNumber
	end
	return ASYM_ExpandString(ASYM_GetString("MailError","Mail Error: %1."),it)
end

to get IsMAPIAvailable
-- According to spec, the application should check for a non-zero "MAPI" entry
-- in the [MAIL] section of WIN.INI to determine if MAPI support is available.
-- Note: this does not check for a non-zero number, just a non-zero entry.

	linkDLL ASYM_ProductPrefix() & "Win.dll"
		STRING GetWinIniVar(STRING,STRING)
	end
	get GetWinIniVar("Mail","MAPI")
	if it is NULL or it = 0
		return FALSE
	else
		return TRUE
	end
end

to handle linkMAPI
	linkDLL "kernel"
		INT 	ma_hmemcpy=hmemcpy(POINTER,POINTER,LONG)
	end linkDLL
	linkdll "mapi.dll"
		DWORD MAPILogoff (DWORD, DWORD, DWORD, DWORD)
		DWORD MAPILogon (DWORD, STRING, STRING, DWORD, DWORD, POINTER)
		DWORD MAPIFindNext (DWORD, DWORD, DWORD, POINTER, DWORD, DWORD, POINTER)
		DWORD MAPIFreeBuffer (POINTER)
		DWORD MAPISendMail (DWORD, DWORD, POINTER, DWORD, DWORD)
		DWORD MAPIReadMail (DWORD, DWORD, STRING, DWORD, DWORD, POINTER)
		DWORD MAPIResolveName (DWORD, DWORD, STRING, DWORD, DWORD, POINTER)
		DWORD MAPISendDocuments (DWORD, STRING, STRING, STRING, DWORD)
		DWORD MAPIAddress (DWORD, DWORD, STRING, DWORD, STRING, DWORD, \
		                         DWORD, DWORD, DWORD, POINTER, POINTER)
		DWORD MAPIDeleteMail (DWORD,DWORD,STRING,DWORD,DWORD)
	end linkDLL
end

to get logPrintDefaults
	local string s
	iniFile = ASYM_IniFile()
	get ASYM_CBTIniVar("Logs","fontFace",null)
	if it is null
		get "Arial"
		x = SetIniVar("Logs","fontFace",it,iniFile)
	end
	textline 1 of s = it
	get ASYM_CBTIniVar("Logs","fontStyle",null)
	if it is null
		get "plain"
		x = SetIniVar("Logs","fontStyle",it,iniFile)
	end
	if it is "plain"
		get null
	end
	textline 2 of s = it
	get ASYM_CBTIniVar("Logs","fontSize",null)
	if it is null
		get 8
		x = SetIniVar("Logs","fontSize",it,iniFile)
	end
	textline 3 of s = it
	get ASYM_CBTIniVar("Logs","margins",null)
	if it is null
		get "0.25,0.25,0.25,0.25"
		x = setIniVar("Logs","margins",it,iniFile)
	end
	textline 4 of s = it
	return CRLF & s
end

to get SessionLogOn
	system s_SessionHandle,s_MAPIError
	local lphSession, retVal

	clear s_MAPIError

	-- get a buffer to store the session handle
	set lphSession to ASYM_GetMemBlock(4)

	-- attempt to log on to MAPI
	get MAPILogon(sysWindowHandle,"","",1,0,lphSession)
	if it = 0
		-- extract the session handle
		s_SessionHandle = PointerDWORD(0,lphSession)
		retVal = str_OK()
	else
		-- determine what error occured
		if it <> 1 -- anything but user abort
			s_MAPIError = getMAPIErrorString(it)

			request s_MAPIError
		end

		retVal = null
	end

	-- free the buffer
	get ASYM_freeMemBlock (lphSession)
	return retVal
end

to handle showLogMailError fName, EmailLogRecipients
	system s_MAPIError
	icn = "hand"
	if EmailLogRecipients is null
		msgTxt = ASYM_GetStandardString("<ERRORMailLog>", "")
		msgTxt = expandString(msgTxt, lowercase(fName))
		msgCaption = s_MAPIError
		get ASYM_MessageBox(msgTxt, msgCaption, icn, null)
	else
		if itemCount(EmailLogRecipients) > 1
			get null
			step i from 1 to itemCount(EmailLogRecipients)
				textLine i of it = SPACE & SPACE & SPACE & item i of EmailLogRecipients
			end
			put CRLF before it
			put CRLF after it
			EmailLogRecipients = it
		end

		get ASYM_GetStandardString("<ERRORMailLogTo>",\
		 "Could not mail the log file for this session. The temporary"\
		 && "file ""%1"" that contains the log is *NOT* being deleted."\
		 && "Please mail it as an attachment to %2 as soon"\
		 && "as possible." & CRLF & CRLF & "Make a note of this information"\
		 && "before you click OK.")
		if trim(it) is not null
			msgTxt = expandString(it, lowercase(fName), EmailLogRecipients)
			msgCaption = s_MAPIError
			get ASYM_MessageBox(msgTxt, msgCaption, icn, null) -- ,hlpTag,hlpFile
		end
	end
end

to get str_OK
	return "OK"
end

to get ASYM_MAPISendMessage recips,subject,msgText,attachments
	system s_Sessionhandle,s_MAPIError
	local lpPtrRec,lpRecip
	local lpBuff,lpTmp
	local lpSub,lpText,lpMsg
	local stack recipStack
	local DWORD numRec, cntAttach
	local LONG count
	local retVal

	-- if MAPI is not available, exit
	if not isType(DWORD,s_sessionHandle)
		request str_lostMAPI()
		clear s_sessionHandle
		sysCursor = 1
		break to system
	end

	-- can be allocated
	numRec = itemcount(recips)

	cntAttach = itemCount(attachments)

	-- allocate buffers
	OK = true

	-- a buffer which will receive a pointer to a recipient structure
	lpPtrRec=ASYM_GetMemBlock(4)

	if item 1 of lpPtrRec <> 0
		-- a buffer to contain an array of recipients
		lpBuff=ASYM_GetMemBlock(24*numRec)
		if item 1 of lpBuff <> 0

			-- a pointer to the subject string
			lpSub=ASYM_GetMemBlock(charcount(subject))
			if item 1 of lpSub <> 0

				-- a pointer to the message text
				lpText=ASYM_GetMemBlock(charcount(msgText))
				if item 1 of lpText <> 0

					-- a pointer to the message structure
					lpMsg=ASYM_GetMemBlock(48)

				else
					OK = false
					get ASYM_FreeMemBlock(lpText)
					get ASYM_FreeMemBlock(lpBuff)
					get ASYM_FreeMemBlock(lpPtrRec

to get ASYM_MAPISendMessage recips,subject,msgText,attachments
	system s_Sessionhandle,s_MAPIError
	local lpPtrRec,lpRecip
	local lpBuff,lpTmp
	local lpSub,lpText,lpMsg
	local stack recipStack
	local DWORD numRec, cntAttach
	local LONG count
	local retVal

	-- if MAPI is not available, exit
	if not isType(DWORD,s_sessionHandle)
		request str_lostMAPI()
		clear s_sessionHandle
		sysCursor = 1

	end

	-- can be allocated

		-- a buffer to contain an array of recipients

		if item 1 of lpBuff <> 0

			if item 1 of lpSub <> 0

				-- a pointer to the message text

				if item 1 of lpText <> 0

					lpMsg=ASYM_GetMemBlock(48)

				else
					OK = false
					get ASYM_FreeMemBlock(lpText)
					get ASYM_FreeMemBlock(lpBuff)
					get ASYM_FreeMemBlock(lpPtrRec)
				end
			else
				OK = false
				get ASYM_FreeMemBlock(lpBuff)
				get ASYM_FreeMemBlock(lpPtrRec)
			end
		else
			OK = false
			get ASYM_FreeMemBlock(lpPtrRec)
		end
	else
		OK = false
	end

	if not OK
		return -41
	end

	-- Create buffer for the attachment descriptors

	if cntAttach > 0
		lpAttach = ASYM_GetMemBlock(24 * cntAttach)
		step i from 0 to 24 * cntAttach - 4
			get pointerDWORD(i,lpAttach,0)
		end
		if item 1 of lpAttach <> 0
			lpAttachNames = ASYM_GetMemBlock(256 * cntAttach)
			if item 1 of lpAttachNames = 0
				OK = false
				get ASYM_FreeMemBlock(lpAttach)
			end
		else
			OK = false
		end

		if not OK
			get ASYM_FreeMemBlock(lpMsg)
			get ASYM_FreeMemBlock(lpBuff)
			get ASYM_FreeMemBlock(lpPtrRec)
			get ASYM_FreeMemBlock(lpText)
			get ASYM_FreeMemBlock(lpSub)
			return -14
		end

		put CRLF after msgText
		step i from 1

to handle ConfirmLogMailedOK fN, titl, bConfirm
	if bConfirm = TRUE
		txt = ASYM_GetStandardString("<LogMailed_OKToDeleteTempFileX>", \
			"The log file for this session has been mailed." & \
			CRLF & "OK to delete the temporary file %1?")
		if trim(txt) is not null
			get ASYM_MessageBox(expandString(txt,fN), titl, "Question", "YesNo")
		end
	end if

	if it is not "No"
		linkDLL ASYM_ProductPrefix() & "DOS.dll"
			INT RemoveFile(STRING)
		end
		get RemoveFile(fN)
	end

end

to get sendFile fileName
	system s_Sessionhandle,s_MAPIError

	get MAPISendDocuments(0, ";", fileName, shortFileName(fileName), 0)
	if it <> 0
		s_MAPIError = getMAPIErrorString(it)
		if it <> 1
			request s_MAPIError
		end
		return null
	else
		s_MAPIError = null
		return str_OK()
	end
end

to get SessionLogOff
	system s_SessionHandle,s_MAPIError
	local retVal

	clear s_MAPIError

	-- attempt to log off of MAPI
	get MAPILogoff(s_SessionHandle,sysWindowHandle,0,0)
	if it = 0
		-- discard the session handle
		clear s_SessionHandle
		retVal = str_OK()
	else
		-- determine what error occured
		s_MAPIError = GetMAPIErrorString(it)
		retVal = null
	end
	return retVal

to get SessionLogOn
	system s_SessionHandle,s_MAPIError
	local lphSession, retVal

	clear s_MAPIError

	-- get a buffer to store the session handle
	set lphSession to ASYM_GetMemBlock(4)

	-- attempt to log on to MAPI
	get MAPILogon(sysWindowHandle,"","",1,0,lphSession)
	if it = 0
		-- extract the session handle
		s_SessionHandle = PointerDWORD(0,lphSession)
		retVal = str_OK()
	else
		-- determine what error occured
		if it <> 1 -- anything but user abort
			s_MAPIError = getMAPIErrorString(it)

			request s_MAPIError
		end

		retVal = null
	end

	-- free the buffer
	get ASYM_freeMemBlock (lphSession)
	return retVal
end

to handle showLogMailError fName, EmailLogRecipients
	system s_MAPIError
	icn = "hand"
	if EmailLogRecipients is null
		msgTxt = ASYM_GetStandardString("<ERRORMailLog>", "")
		msgTxt = expandString(msgTxt, lowercase(fName))
		msgCaption = s_MAPIError
		get ASYM_MessageBox(msgTxt, msgCaption, icn, null)
	else
		if itemCount(EmailLogRecipients) > 1
			get null
			step i from 1 to itemCount(EmailLogRecipients)
				textLine i of it = SPACE & SPACE & SPACE & item i of EmailLogRecipients
			end
			put CRLF before it
			put CRLF after it
			EmailLogRecipients = it
		end

		get ASYM_GetStandardString("<ERRORMailLogTo>",\
		 "Could not mail the log file for this session. The temporary"\
		 && "file ""%1"" that contains the log is *NOT* being deleted."\
		 && "Please mail it as an attachment to %2 as soon"\
		 && "as possible." & CRLF & CRLF & "Make a note of this information"\
		 && "before you click OK.")
		if trim(it) is not null
			msgTxt = expandString(it, lowercase(fName), EmailLogRecipients)
			msgCaption = s_MAPIError
			get ASYM_MessageBox(msgTxt, msgCaption, icn, null) -- ,hlpTag,hlpFile
		end
	end
end

to get str_OK
	return "OK"
end

to get ASYM_MAPISendMessage recips,subject,msgText,attachments
	system s_Sessionhandle,s_MAPIError
	local lpPtrRec,lpRecip
	local lpBuff,lpTmp
	local lpSub,lpText,lpMsg
	local stack recipStack
	local DWORD numRec, cntAttach
	local LONG count
	local retVal

	-- if MAPI is not available, exit
	if not isType(DWORD,s_sessionHandle)
		request str_lostMAPI()
		clear s_sessionHandle
		sysCursor = 1
		break to system
	end

	clear s_MAPIError

	-- find out many recipients there are so enough memory
	-- can be allocated
	numRec = itemcount(recips)

	cntAttach = itemCount(attachments)

	-- allocate buffers
	OK = true

	-- a buffer which will receive a pointer to a recipient structure
	lpPtrRec=ASYM_GetMemBlock(4)

	if item 1 of lpPtrRec <> 0
		-- a buffer to contain an array of recipients
		lpBuff=ASYM_GetMemBlock(24*numRec)
		if item 1 of lpBuff <> 0

			-- a pointer to the subject string
			lpSub=ASYM_GetMemBlock(charcount(subject))
			if item 1 of lpSub <> 0

				-- a pointer to the message text
				lpText=ASYM_GetMemBlock(charcount(msgText))
				if item 1 of lpText <> 0

					-- a pointer to the message structure
					lpMsg=ASYM_GetMemBlock(48)

				else
					OK = false
					get ASYM_FreeMemBlock(lpText)
					get ASYM_FreeMemBlock(lpBuff)
					get ASYM_FreeMemBlock(lpPtrRec)
				end
			else
				OK = false
				get ASYM_FreeMemBlock(lpBuff)
				get ASYM_FreeMemBlock(lpPtrRec)
			end
		else
			OK = false
			get ASYM_FreeMemBlock(lpPtrRec)
		end
	else
		OK = false
	end

	if not OK
		return -41
	end

	-- Create buffer for the attachment descriptors

	if cntAttach > 0
		lpAttach = ASYM_GetMemBlock(24 * cntAttach)
		step i from 0 to 24 * cntAttach - 4
			get pointerDWORD(i,lpAttach,0)
		end
		if item 1 of lpAttach <> 0
			lpAttachNames = ASYM_GetMemBlock(256 * cntAttach)
			if item 1 of lpAttachNames = 0
				OK = false
				get ASYM_FreeMemBlock(lpAttach)
			end
		else
			OK = false
		end

		if not OK
			get ASYM_FreeMemBlock(lpMsg)
			get ASYM_FreeMemBlock(lpBuff)
			get ASYM_FreeMemBlock(lpPtrRec)
			get ASYM_FreeMemBlock(lpText)
			get ASYM_FreeMemBlock(lpSub)
			return -14
		end

		put CRLF after msgText
		step i from 1 to cntAttach
			incPTmp = (i - 1) * 24
			incPNam = (i - 1) * 256

			-- Add a placeholder char to the message text
			put SPACE after msgText
			-- Set placeholder position
			get PointerDWORD(incPTmp+8,lpAttach,charcount(msgText)-1)

			-- Copy file name to names buffer
			fn = item i of Attachments
			get pointerSTRING(incPNam,lpAttachNames,fn)

			-- Set lpPathName in MAPIFILEDESC structure
			lpfN = item 1 of lpAttachNames, item 2

-- 0x89c5e  to get sendFile fileName
to get sendFile fileName
	system s_Sessionhandle,s_MAPIError

	get MAPISendDocuments(0, ";", fileName, shortFileName(fileName), 0)
	if it <> 0
		s_MAPIError = getMAPIErrorString(it)
		if it <> 1
			request s_MAPIError
		end
		return null
	else
		s_MAPIError = null
		return str_OK()
	end
end

		retVal = null
	end
	return retVal
end

		retVal = null

		if trim(it) is not null
			msgTxt = expandString(it, lowercase(fName), EmailLogRecipients)
			msgCaption = s_MAPIError
			get ASYM_MessageBox(msgTxt, msgCaption, icn, null) -- ,hlpTag,hlpFile
		end
	end

to get ASYM_MAPISendMessage recips,subject,msgText,attachments
	system s_Sessionhandle,s_MAPIError
	local lpPtrRec,lpRecip
	local lpBuff,lpTmp
	local lpSub,lpText,lpMsg
	local stack recipStack
	local DWORD numRec, cntAttach
	local LONG count
	local retVal

	-- if MAPI is not available, exit
	if not isType(DWORD,s_sessionHandle)
		request str_lostMAPI()
		clear s_sessionHandle
		sysCursor = 1
		break to system
	end

	clear s_MAPIError

	-- find out many recipients there are so enough memory
	-- can be allocated
	numRec = itemcount(recips)

	cntAttach = itemCount(attachments)

	-- allocate buffers
	OK = true

	-- a buffer which will receive a pointer to a recipient structure
	lpPtrRec=ASYM_GetMemBlock(4)

	if item 1 of lpPtrRec <> 0
		-- a buffer to contain an array of recipients
		lpBuff=ASYM_GetMemBlock(24*numRec)
		if item 1 of lpBuff <> 0

			-- a pointer to the subject string
			lpSub=ASYM_GetMemBlock(charcount(subject))
			if item 1 of lpSub <> 0

				-- a pointer to the message text
				lpText=ASYM_GetMemBlock(charcount(msgText))
				if item 1 of lpText <> 0

					-- a pointer to the message structure
					lpMsg=ASYM_GetMemBlock(48)

				else
					OK = false
					get ASYM_FreeMemBlock(lpText)
					get ASYM_FreeMemBlock(lpBuff)
					get ASYM_FreeMemBlock(lpPtrRec)
				end
			else
				OK = false
				get ASYM_FreeMemBlock(lpBuff)
				get ASYM_FreeMemBlock(lpPtrRec)
			end
		else
			OK = false
			get ASYM_FreeMemBlock(lpPtrRec)
		end
	else
		OK = false
	end

	if not OK
		return -41
	end

	-- Create buffer for the attachment descriptors

	if cntAttach > 0
		lpAttach = ASYM_GetMemBlock(24 * cntAttach)
		step i from 0 to 24 * cntAttach - 4
			get pointerDWORD(i,lpAttach,0)
		end
		if item 1 of lpAttach <> 0
			lpAttachNames = ASYM_GetMemBlock(256 * cntAttach)
			if item 1 of lpAttachNames = 0
				OK = false
				get ASYM_FreeMemBlock(lpAttach)
			end
		else
			OK = false
		end

		if not OK
			get ASYM_FreeMemBlock(lpMsg)
			get ASYM_FreeMemBlock(lpBuff)
			get ASYM_FreeMemBlock(lpPtrRec)
			get ASYM_FreeMemBlock(lpText)
			get ASYM_FreeMemBlock(lpSub)
			return -14
		end

		put CRLF after msgText
		step i from 1 to cntAttach
			incPTmp = (i - 1) * 24
			incPNam = (i - 1) * 256

			-- Add a placeholder char to the message text
			put SPACE after msgText
			-- Set placeholder position
			get PointerDWORD(incPTmp+8,lpAttach,charcount(msgText)-1)

			-- Copy file name to names buffer
			fn = item i of Attachments
			get pointerSTRING(incPNam,lpAttachNames,fn)

			-- Set lpPathName in MAPIFILEDESC structure
			lpfN = item 1 of lpAttachNames, item 2 of lpAttachNames + incPNam
			get pointerPOINTER(incPTmp+12,lpAttach,lpfN)
		end
	end

	-- Resolve names
	retVal = null
	count = 0

	-- create a temporary pointer into the recipient array
	lpTmp=lpBuff

	clear recipStack

	-- fill the recipient array:
	-- while there are recipients left
	while recips <> null
		-- get the first recipient
		pop recips into recipient

		-- get a recipient structure
		-- 0x0409 = MAPI_LOGON_UI + MAPI_DIALOG + MAPI_AB_NOMODIFY

		get MAPIResolveName(s_SessionHandle,0,recipient,0x0409,0,lpPtrRec)

		if it <> 0
			-- if the name cannot be resolved do not continue
			s_MAPIError = getMAPIerrorString(it)
			break while
		else
			-- extract a pointer to the recipient structure
			lpRecip = pointerPointer(0,lpPtrRec)

			-- copy the contents into the recipient array
			-- optimization: using this Windows API function is much faster
			-- than stepping through the buffer using pointerByte()
			get ma_hmemcpy(lpTmp,lpRecip,24)

			-- increment the counter and the pointer into the array
			increment count
			increment item 2 of lpTmp by 24

			-- keep track of the pointer for cleanup later
			push lpRecip onto recipStack
		end
	end

	-- if all of the names were resolved

	if s_MAPIError = null
		-- fill the subject and text strings
		get pointerString(0,lpSub,chars 1 to 255 of subject)
		get pointerString(0,lpText,msgText)


		-- fill the message structure
		step i from 0 to 44 by 4
			get pointerDWORD(i,lpMsg,0)
		end
		get pointerPointer(4,lpMsg,lpSub)
		get pointerPointer(8,lpMsg,lpText)
		get pointerDWORD(32,lpMsg,count)
		get pointerPointer(36,lpMsg,lpBuff)
		if cntAttach > 0
			get pointerDWORD(40,lpMsg,cntAttach)
			get pointerPointer(44,lpMsg,lpAttach)
		end

		-- send the message
		get MAPISendMail(s_SessionHandle,0,lpMsg,1,0)

		if it <> 0
			s_MAPIError = getMAPIerrorString(it)
		else
			retVal = str_OK()
		end

	end
	while recipStack <> null
		-- free all of the recipient structures
		-- pointers are stored as a 2-item list, in order to pop one of off this
		-- stack it is necessary to grab the first 2 items.
		get items 1 to 2 of recipStack
		get MAPIFreeBuffer(it)
		clear items 1 to 2 of recipStack
	end

	-- free all of the memory
	if cntAttach > 0
		get ASYM_FreeMemBlock(lpAttachNames)
		get ASYM_FreeMemBlock(lpAttach)
	end
	get ASYM_FreeMemBlock(lpMsg)
	get ASYM_FreeMemBlock(lpBuff)
	get ASYM_FreeMemBlock(lpPtrRec)
	get ASYM_FreeMemBlock(lpText)
	get ASYM_FreeMemBlock(lpSub)

	return retVal
end

end

	return retVal

-- 0x8adb1  to get _asym_IsWin31
to get _asym_IsWin31
	ss = sysSuspend; oldse = sysError; oldsen = sysErrorNumber;
	sysSuspend = false; clear sysError
	linkDLL32 "user32.dll"
		int ASYM_WinHelpByNumber = WinHelpA(WORD,STRING,WORD,DWORD)
	end
	sysSuspend = ss
	get (sysError is not NULL)
	sysError = oldse; sysErrorNumber = oldsen
	return it
end


to get _ASYM_WinHelp what, whatFile
	SYSTEM s_ASYM_ProductName, s_ASYM_ProductDirectory

	conditions
		when whatFile = "<SYSTEM>"
			linkDLL ASYM_ProductPrefix() & "win.dll"
				STRING GetIniVar(STRING,STRING,STRING)
			end

			vn = ASYM_ProductVersion()
			iniFile = ASYM_ProductPrefix() & vn & ".ini"

			conditions
			when s_ASYM_ProductName = "Assistant"
				get SetIniVar ("ToolBook","HelpFile",s_ASYM_ProductDirectory & "Assist" & vn & ".hlp", iniFile)
			when s_ASYM_ProductName = "Instructor"
				get SetIniVar ("ToolBook","HelpFile",s_ASYM_ProductDirectory & "Inst" & vn & ".hlp", iniFile)
			end

			whatFile = GetIniVar("ToolBook","HelpFile",iniFile)
			if whatFile = NULL
				whatFile = sysToolBookDirectory & ASYM_ProductPrefix() & ASYM_MTBVersion() & ".HLP"
			else
				whatFile = whatFile
			end

		when whatFile = NULL
			whatFile = name of this book
			p = revoffset(".",whatFile)
			if p = 0
				put ".HLP" after whatFile
			else
				chars p to charcount(whatFile) of whatFile = ".HLP"
			end

		else
			fN = ASYM_FindPathFile(whatFile,"")
			if fN is null
				fN = ASYM_FindPathFile(s_ASYM_ProductDirectory & whatFile,"")
				if fN is null
					fN = ASYM_FindPathFile(sysToolBookDirectory & whatFile,"")
					if fN is null
						get ASYM_GetString("CantFindFileX",\
						  "Cannot find the file %1.")
						get ASYM_MessageBox(ASYM_ExpandString(it, whatFile),null,"exclamation")
						return false
					else
						whatFile = fN
					end
				else
					whatFile = fN
				end
			else
				whatFile = fN
			end

			if ".hlp" is not in whatFile
				exe = ASYM_FindExecutableFile(fN)
				if exe is null
					msgTxt = ASYM_GetString("NoExeFileForX", \
							"There is no application associated with the file %1.")
					msgTxt = expandString(msgTxt, whatFile)
					msgCaption = SPACE
					get ASYM_MessageBox(msgTxt, msgCaption, "EXCLAMATION", "OK")
					return false
				end
				cmd = exe && fN && what
				ss = sysSuspend;sysSuspend=false;clear sysError
				run cmd
				sysSuspend = ss
				if sysError <> null
					get ASYM_MessageBox(sysError,whatFile,"exclamation")
					return false
				end
				return true
			end
	end

	whatFile = lowerCase(whatFile)

	se = sysError; clear sysError
	isWin31 = asym_IsWin31()
	if not isWin31
		ss = sysSuspend; sysSuspend = false
		linkDLL32 "user32.dll"
			int ASYM_WinHelpByNumber = WinHelpA(WORD,STRING,WORD,DWORD)
			int ASYM_WinHelpByKey = WinHelpA(WORD,STRING,WORD,STRING)
		end
		sysSuspend = ss
	end
	if isWin31 or sysError is not NULL
		linkDLL "user"
			int ASYM_WinHelpByNumber = WinHelp(WORD,STRING,WORD,DWORD)
			int ASYM_WinHelpByKey = WinHelp(WORD,STRING,WORD,STRING)
		end
	end
	sysError = se

	if isType(DWORD,what) or what is null
		if what is null
			what = 0 -- Contents
			flags = 3
		else
			flags = 1
		end
		get ASYM_WinHelpByNumber(sysWindowHandle,whatFile,flags,what)
	else
		get ASYM_WinHelpByKey(sysWindowHandle,whatFile,0x0105,what)
	end
	if it = 0
		get ASYM_MessageBox(ASYM_GetStandardString("<CannotStartHelp>"),null, "exclamation")
		return false
	end
	return true
end

-- 0x8b64f  to get _ASYM_IsObjectDirty obRef, whichBit
to get _ASYM_IsObjectDirty obRef, whichBit
	-- Checks the dirty bit of any object. Of course, at this stage dirty bits are only supported
	-- for pages, backgrounds and books. For objects on the page or background, it returns the dirty
	-- setting of that objects layer. Should also work for resources, but for viewers will return
	-- the book's dirty state -- TimB 11/00

	if not isObject(obRef)
		return false
	end

	conditions
	when whichBit = "htmlExport"
		modBit = 1
	when whichBit = "reset"
		modBit = 2
	when whichBit = "save"
		modBit = 4
	else
		return true
	end

	obType = object of obRef
	conditions
	when obType = "page"
	when obType = "background"
	when obType = "book"
		break conditions
	when obType = "viewer"
		obRef = parent of obRef
	else
		obRef = objectContainer (obRef, "page,background")
	end

	get changedBits of obRef
	return it bitAnd modBit <> 0
end

to get _ASYM_IsObjectClean obRef, whichBit
	return _ASYM_IsObjectDirty (obRef, whichBit) = false
end

to get _ASYM_IsPageDirty whichPg,whichBit,whichBk
	LOCAL tempPage

	tempPage = whichPg
	if "page" is not in tempPage
		tempPage = "page " & tempPage
		if whichBk <> null
			put " of " & whichBk after tempPage
		end if
	end if

	return _ASYM_IsObjectDirty (tempPage, whichBit)
end

to get _ASYM_IsPageClean whichPg,whichBit,whichBk
	return _ASYM_IsPageDirty(whichPg, whichBit,whichBk) = false
end

to get _ASYM_ReturnCleanPages pgList,whichBit,whichBk

	LOCAL pageList, retVal

	retVal = null
	pageList = pgList

	while pageList <> null
		pop pageList into tempPg

		--whichBit can be either "htmlexport", "reset" or "save", which are bits 1, 2 and 4 respectively
		if _ASYM_IsPageClean(tempPg,whichBit,whichBk)
			push tempPg onto retVal
		end if
	end while
	if retVal = null
		retVal = false
	end if
	return retVal

end

to get _ASYM_ReturnDirtyPages pgList,whichBit,whichBk

	LOCAL pageList, retVal

	retVal = null
	pageList = pgList

	--whichBit can be either "htmlexport", "reset" or "save", which are bits 1, 2 and 4 respectively
	while pageList <> null
		pop pageList into tempPg
		if _ASYM_IsPageDirty(tempPg,whichBit,whichBk)
			push tempPg onto retVal
		end if
	end while
	if retVal = null
		retVal = false
	end if
	return retVal

end

to get _ASYM_SetObjectClean obRef, whichBit
	if not isObject(obRef)
		return false
	end

	conditions
	when whichBit = "htmlExport"
		modBit = 1
	when whichBit = "reset"
		modBit = 2
	when whichBit = "save"
		modBit = 4
	else
		return false
	end

	obType = object of obRef
	conditions
	when obType = "page"
	when obType = "background"
	when obType = "book"
		break conditions
	when obType = "viewer"
		obRef = parent of obRef
	else
		obRef = objectContainer (obRef, "page,background")
	end

	oldBits = changedBits of obRef
	newBits = oldBits bitAnd (bitNot modBit)

	-- Ensure we only set the property if it's changing, otherwise we're actually making the
	-- book dirty.
	if newBits <> oldBits
		changedbits of obRef = newBits
	end

	return true
end

to get _ASYM_SetPageClean whichPg,whichBit,whichBk
	LOCAL tempPage
	LOCAL dword modBit

	conditions
	when whichBit = "htmlexport"
		modBit = 1
	when whichBit = "reset"
		modBit = 2
	when whichBit = "save"
		modBit = 4
	end

	while whichPg <> null
		pop whichPg into tempPage
		if "page" is not in tempPage
			tempPage = "page " & tempPage
			if whichBk <> null
				put " of " & whichBk after tempPage
			end if
		end if

		-- Ensure we only set the property if it's changing, otherwise we're actually making the
		-- book dirty.
		oldBits = changedbits of tempPage
		newBits = oldBits bitAnd (bitNot modBit)
		if newBits <> oldBits
			changedbits of tempPage = newBits
		end
	end while

	return true
end

-- 0x8bedd  to handle _ASYM_PostMsg msg, tgt
to handle _ASYM_PostMsg msg, tgt
	system s__ASYMMsgQ
	system _s_ASYM_BlockMsgQ

	if s__ASYMMsgQ <> null
		-- arbitrary queue overrun trim
		while charCount(s__ASYMMsgQ) > 32000
			p = offset(formFeed, s__ASYMMsgQ)
			if p = 0
				break while
			else
				clear chars 1 to p of s__ASYMMsgQ
			end
		end
		put formFeed after s__ASYMMsgQ
	end

	if tgt <> null and (" of book " is not in tgt)
		if object of tgt is not in "pagebackgroundbook"
			tgt = uniquename of tgt
		end
		if object of tgt is not book
			tgt = expandString("%1 of book ""%2""",tgt, name of objectContainer(tgt,"book"))
		end
	end
	put msg & ansiToChar(2) & targetWindow & ansiToChar (2) & tgt after s__ASYMMsgQ

	if (_s_ASYM_BlockMsgQ <> true) and (_s_ASYM_MsgPosted <> true) then
		-- only post the message if posted messages aren't blocked and we haven't
		-- already posted a message
		sysErrorNumber = 0
		linkdll "User"
			WORD RegisterWindowMessage(STRING)
			INT PostMessage(WORD,WORD,WORD,DWORD)
		end
		msgID = RegisterWindowMessage("ASYM_PostCO")
		hWnd = windowHandle of mainWindow
		get PostMessage(hWnd, msgID, 0, 0)
		translateWindowMessage for hWnd
			on msgID send ASYM_DoPostedMsg
		end
	end

end

to handle _ASYM_DoNextPostedMsg
	system s__ASYMMsgQ
	local OBJECT vRef

	p = offset(ansiToChar(2), s__ASYMMsgQ)
	if p = 0
		send ASYM_FlushMsgQ;break
	end
	msg = chars 1 to p-1 of s__ASYMMsgQ
	clear chars 1 to p of s__ASYMMsgQ

	p = offset(ansiToChar(2), s__ASYMMsgQ)
	tgtV = chars 1 to p-1 of s__ASYMMsgQ
	clear chars 1 to p of s__ASYMMsgQ

	p = offset(formFeed, s__ASYMMsgQ)
	conditions
	when p = 0
		tgt = s__ASYMMsgQ & ""
		clear s__ASYMMsgQ
	when p = 1
		tgt = null
		clear char 1 of s__ASYMMsgQ
	else
		tgt = chars 1 to p-1 of s__ASYMMsgQ
		clear chars 1 to p of s__ASYMMsgQ
	end

	if trim(s__ASYMMsgQ) = null
		clear s__ASYMMsgQ
	end

	bs = ASYM_BlockSuspend()
	in mainWindow
		vRef = tgtV
	end
	bs = ASYM_RestoreSuspend(bs)

	if bs <> null
		get false
	else
		get isOpen of vRef
	end

	if it
		if tgt is null
			tgt = currentPage of vRef
		end
		cmd = expandString("send %1 to %2 in vRef",msg,tgt)
	else
		if tgt is null
			tgt = this page
		end
		cmd = expandString("send %1 to %2",msg,tgt)
	end
	get ASYM_BlockSuspend()
	execute cmd
	get ASYM_RestoreSuspend (it)
end

to handle _ASYM_DoPostedMsg hWnd, msgID
	system s__ASYMMsgQ, s__ASYMMsgQHold
	system _s_ASYM_BlockMsgQ
	system _s_ASYM_MsgPosted

	-- The message has fired off, so is no longer on the queue
	clear _s_ASYM_MsgPosted

	if (s__ASYMMsgQ = null) or (_s_ASYM_BlockMsgQ = true)
		break
	end
	linkdll "User"
		INT PostMessage(WORD,WORD,WORD,DWORD)
		INT PeekMessage(POINTER,WORD,WORD,WORD,WORD)
	end
	get ASYM_Ticks()
	if it is null;send ASYM_LinkDLLs;end
	lpMsg = ASYM_GetMemBlock(64)
	if lpMsg <> null and lpMsg <> "0,0"
		-- WM_PAINT = 0x000F ; WM_TIMER = 0x0113


		busy = ((s__ASYMMsgQHold is true) or\
		  (0 <> PeekMessage(lpMsg, 0, 1, 0x000E, 0)) or\
		  (0 <> PeekMessage(lpMsg, 0, 0x0010, 0x0112, 0)) or\
		  (0 <> PeekMessage(lpMsg, 0, 0x0114, 0x01ff, 0)) or\
		  (0 <> PeekMessage(lpMsg, 0, 0x0210, msgID-1, 0)) or\
		  (0 <> PeekMessage(lpMsg, 0, msgID + 1, 65535, 0)))

		openWindows = sysOpenWindows
		while not busy and openWindows <> null
			pop openWindows into vRef
			clientHWnd = clientHandle of vRef
			busy = (PeekMessage(lpMsg, clientHWnd, 0x0200, 0x0209, 0) <> 0)
		end

		get ASYM_FreeMemBlock(lpMsg)
		if not busy
			send _ASYM_DoNextPostedMsg
		end
		if keyState(27) is up
			get PostMessage(hWnd,msgID,0,0)
		end
	end
end


to get _ASYM_IsMsgPosted msg, tgt
	-- determines if the message is already on the message queue

	system s__ASYMMsgQ

	char2 = ansiToChar(2)
	testMsg = char2 & msg & char2 & targetWindow & char2 & tgt & char2
	msgPosted = testMsg is in char2 & s__ASYMMsgQ & char2
	return msgPosted
end


to get _ASYM_SetPostMsgBlock pNewValue
	system s__ASYMMsgQ
	system _s_ASYM_BlockMsgQ
	system _s_ASYM_MsgPosted

	newValue = pNewValue

	retVal = (_s_ASYM_BlockMsgQ = true)

	conditions
		when newValue = TRUE
			_s_ASYM_BlockMsgQ = TRUE

		when newValue = FALSE
			clear _s_ASYM_BlockMsgQ
			if s__ASYMMsgQ <> NULL then
				linkDLL "USER"
					WORD RegisterWindowMessage(STRING)
					INT PostMessage(WORD, WORD, WORD, DWORD)
				end linkDLL
				msgID = RegisterWindowMessage("ASYM_PostCO")
				hWnd = windowHandle of mainWindow
				get PostMessage(hWnd, msgID, 0, 0)
				translateWindowMessage for hWnd
					on msgID send ASYM_DoPostedMsg
				end
				_s_ASYM_MsgPosted = true
			end if
	end conditions

	return retVal
end


to get _ASYM_FlushPostMsgQueue
	system s__ASYMMsgQ

	retVal = (s__ASYMMsgQ <> NULL)
	clear s__ASYMMsgQ
	return retVal
end

-- 0x8c20f  to handle _ASYM_DoNextPostedMsg
to handle _ASYM_DoNextPostedMsg
	system s__ASYMMsgQ
	local OBJECT vRef

	p = offset(ansiToChar(2), s__ASYMMsgQ)
	if p = 0
		send ASYM_FlushMsgQ;break
	end
	msg = chars 1 to p-1 of s__ASYMMsgQ
	clear chars 1 to p of s__ASYMMsgQ

	p = offset(ansiToChar(2), s__ASYMMsgQ)
	tgtV = chars 1 to p-1 of s__ASYMMsgQ
	clear chars 1 to p of s__ASYMMsgQ

	p = offset(formFeed, s__ASYMMsgQ)
	conditions
	when p = 0
		tgt = s__ASYMMsgQ & ""
		clear s__ASYMMsgQ
	when p = 1
		tgt = null
		clear char 1 of s__ASYMMsgQ
	else
		tgt = chars 1 to p-1 of s__ASYMMsgQ
		clear chars 1 to p of s__ASYMMsgQ
	end

	if trim(s__ASYMMsgQ) = null
		clear s__ASYMMsgQ
	end

	bs = ASYM_BlockSuspend()
	in mainWindow
		vRef = tgtV
	end
	bs = ASYM_RestoreSuspend(bs)

	if bs <> null
		get false
	else
		get isOpen of vRef
	end

	if it
		if tgt is null
			tgt = currentPage of vRef
		end
		cmd = expandString("send %1 to %2 in vRef",msg,tgt)
	else
		if tgt is null
			tgt = this page
		end
		cmd = expandString("send %1 to %2",msg,tgt)
	end
	get ASYM_BlockSuspend()
	execute cmd
	get ASYM_RestoreSuspend (it)
end

to handle _ASYM_DoPostedMsg hWnd, msgID
	system s__ASYMMsgQ, s__ASYMMsgQHold
	system _s_ASYM_BlockMsgQ
	system _s_ASYM_MsgPosted

	-- The message has fired off, so is no longer on the queue
	clear _s_ASYM_MsgPosted

	if (s__ASYMMsgQ = null) or (_s_ASYM_BlockMsgQ = true)
		break
	end
	linkdll "User"
		INT PostMessage(WORD,WORD,WORD,DWORD)
		INT PeekMessage(POINTER,WORD,WORD,WORD,WORD)
	end
	get ASYM_Ticks()
	if it is null;send ASYM_LinkDLLs;end
	lpMsg = ASYM_GetMemBlock(64)
	if lpMsg <> null and lpMsg <> "0,0"
		-- WM_PAINT = 0x000F ; WM_TIMER = 0x0113


		busy = ((s__ASYMMsgQHold is true) or\
		  (0 <> PeekMessage(lpMsg, 0, 1, 0x000E, 0)) or\
		  (0 <> PeekMessage(lpMsg, 0, 0x0010, 0x0112, 0)) or\
		  (0 <> PeekMessage(lpMsg, 0, 0x0114, 0x01ff, 0)) or\
		  (0 <> PeekMessage(lpMsg, 0, 0x0210, msgID-1, 0)) or\
		  (0 <> PeekMessage(lpMsg, 0, msgID + 1, 65535, 0)))

		openWindows = sysOpenWindows
		while not busy and openWindows <> null
			pop openWindows into vRef
			clientHWnd = clientHandle of vRef
			busy = (PeekMessage(lpMsg, clientHWnd, 0x0200, 0x0209, 0) <> 0)
		end

		get ASYM_FreeMemBlock(lpMsg)
		if not busy
			send _ASYM_DoNextPostedMsg
		end
		if keyState(27) is up
			get PostMessage(hWnd,msgID,0,0)
		end
	end
end


to get _ASYM_IsMsgPosted msg, tgt
	-- determines if the message is already on the message queue

	system s__ASYMMsgQ

	char2 = ansiToChar(2)
	testMsg = char2 & msg & char2 & targetWindow & char2 & tgt & char2
	msgPosted = testMsg is in char2 & s__ASYMMsgQ & char2
	return msgPosted
end


to get _ASYM_SetPostMsgBlock pNewValue
	system s__ASYMMsgQ
	system _s_ASYM_BlockMsgQ
	system _s_ASYM_MsgPosted

	newValue = pNewValue

	retVal = (_s_ASYM_BlockMsgQ = true)

	conditions
		when newValue = TRUE
			_s_ASYM_BlockMsgQ = TRUE

		when newValue = FALSE
			clear _s_ASYM_BlockMsgQ
			if s__ASYMMsgQ <> NULL then
				linkDLL "USER"
					WORD RegisterWindowMessage(STRING)
					INT PostMessage(WORD, WORD, WORD, DWORD)
				end linkDLL
				msgID = RegisterWindowMessage("ASYM_PostCO")
				hWnd = windowHandle of mainWindow
				get PostMessage(hWnd, msgID, 0, 0)
				translateWindowMessage for hWnd
					on msgID send ASYM_DoPostedMsg
				end
				_s_ASYM_MsgPosted = true
			end if
	end conditions

	return retVal
end


to get _ASYM_FlushPostMsgQueue
	system s__ASYMMsgQ

	retVal = (s__ASYMMsgQ <> NULL)
	clear s__ASYMMsgQ
	return retVal
end

-- 0x8ca33  to get _ASYM_DoGenericTextFeedback obj, tag, pos, option
to get _ASYM_DoGenericTextFeedback obj, tag, pos, option
	local STRING txtFB, txt2, fld, fldSpec

	if pos = NULL
		if obj = NULL
			pos = sysmouseposition
		else
			pos = item 4 of bounds of obj + (4*item 2 of syspageunitsperpixel)
			push truncate(item 1 of ASYM_ObjectCenter(obj)) onto pos
		end
	end

	in targetWindow
		txtFB = ASYM_GetString(tag,"") of parent of this window
		if txtFB = tag
			txtFB = ASYM_GetString(tag,"") of objectContainer(self,"book")
		end

		txtFB = ASYM_ExpandString(txtFB) of obj

		if textlinecount(txtFB) > 1
			txt2 = textLines 2 to textlinecount(txtFB) of txtFB
			txtFB = textLine 1 of txtFB
		else
			txt2 = txtFB
			txtFB = NULL
		end

		fld = ASYM_FindField ("Feedback")

		lockscreen of this window = FALSE
		conditions
			when option = "field"
				if fld <> null
					if text of fld <> NULL
						text of fld = NULL
						pause 20
					end
					if txtFB <> NULL
						text of fld = txtFB & CRLF & txt2
					else
						text of fld = txt2
					end
				else
					return FALSE
				end
			when option = "popup"
				if txt2 <> NULL
					clear sysError
					get ASYM_ModalPopText(txtFB, txt2, pos)
				end
			else
				if fld <> null
					if text of fld <> NULL
						text of fld = NULL
						pause 20
					end
					if txtFB <> NULL
						text of fld = txtFB & CRLF & txt2
					else
						text of fld = txt2
					end
				else
					if txt2 <> NULL
						clear sysError
						oldSys = sysSuspendMessages
						sysSuspendMessages = FALSE
						get ASYM_ModalPopText(txtFB, txt2, pos)
						sysSuspendMessages = oldSys
					end
				end
		end
	end
	return TRUE
end

to get _ASYM_PlayAnswerFeedback answerIndex, obj, actualObj
	local ansArray[][]
	ss = sysSuspend;sysSuspend = false; clear sysError
	ansArray = ASYM_WID_AnsArray of obj
	sysSuspend = ss
	if sysError <> null
		clear sysError
		return FALSE
	end
	if answerIndex = 0 or answerIndex is null
		get _ASYM_PlaySummaryFeedback(obj, actualObj)
	else
		get _PlayFeedbackItem (ansArray, answerIndex, obj, actualObj)
	end
	return it
end

to get _ASYM_PlaySummaryFeedback obj, actualObj, registerTry
	LOCAL fbArray[][]

	ss = sysSuspend;sysSuspend=false;clear sysError
	fbArray = ASYM_WID_SummaryFeedback of obj
	sysSuspend = ss
	if sysError <> null
 		-- This might be a 3.0 widget that has summary feedback in main array
		clear sysError
		if not _upgrade3SummaryFeedback(obj)
			return FALSE
		end
	end

	correctness = round (ASYM_WID_Correctness(obj) of obj, -2)
	conditions
	when correctness = 1
		i = 1
	when correctness <= 0
		i = 2
	else
		i = 3
	end

	_feedbackPlayed of obj = TRUE

 	if registerTry <> false
		get ASYM_RegisterAttempt (obj, null, true, correctness)
	end if

	retVal = _PlayFeedbackItem (fbArray, i, obj, NULL, false) or TRUE


	return retVal
end

to get _PlayFeedbackItem fbArray[][] by reference, num, obj, actualObj, notSummary
	system _s_ASYM_FeedbackMediaPlayer

	--fbArray is either a feedback array or an answer array

	oldSyserror = sysError
	oldMM = sysMediaSuspend
	sysMediaSuspend = FALSE
	syserror = NULL
	mmError = FALSE
	tryFlag = FALSE
	result = FALSE

	FBLoc = sysMousePosition

	while num <> NULL
		pop num into index
		if not isObject (_openClip of obj)
			clear _openClip of obj
		end

		if _openClip of obj <> NULL and mmStatus of _openClip of obj <> "CLOSED"
			mmClose _openClip of obj
			mmYield
		end
		clear _openClip of obj
		if _s_ASYM_FeedbackMediaPlayer <> null
			bs = ASYM_BlockSuspend()
			get stop() of _s_ASYM_FeedbackMediaPlayer
			get ASYM_RestoreSuspend(bs)
			clear _s_ASYM_FeedbackMediaPlayer
		end
		if fbArray[index][13] <> NULL
			oldCursor = sysCursor
			sysCursor = 4
			if ASYM_GetStructureName(fbArray[index][13],FALSE) = "object"
				mediaPlayer = ASYM_ResolveObject(fbArray[index][13],obj)
				if isObject(mediaPlayer) = true
					if ASYM_MediaPlayer of mediaPlayer = true
						bs = ASYM_BlockSuspend()
						get play() of mediaPlayer
						bs = ASYM_RestoreSuspend(bs)
						mmError = (it = false) or (bs <> NULL)
						if mmError = false
							result = TRUE
							_s_ASYM_FeedbackMediaPlayer = mediaPlayer
						end
					end
				end
			else
				clipref = item 1 of fbArray[index][13]
				played = false
				sync = item 2 of fbArray[index][13] = "TRUE"
				if wordcount(clipRef) = 1
					played = _SmartPlaySound(clipRef, sync)
				end
				if played is TRUE
					result = TRUE
				else
					ss = sysSuspend;sysSuspend = false; clear sysError
					get mmPlayable of clipref
					if sysError is null and it is TRUE
						mmYield
						clear sysError
						mmOpen clipref wait
						if sysError <> NULL
							mmClose all wait
							mmYield
							mmYield
							mmYield
							mmYield
							clear sysError
							mmOpen clipRef wait
						end
						if sysError is null
							if mmMediaType of clipRef is in "digitalvideowaveaudio"
								get PlaySound(NULL,TRUE)
								mmYield
							end
							stageRef = item 3 of fbArray[index][13]
							if sync
								if stageRef <> NULL
									mmplay clipref in stageRef wait notify self
								else
									mmplay clipref wait notify self
								end
							else
								if stageRef <> NULL
									mmplay clipref in stageRef notify self
								else
									mmplay clipref notify self
								end
							end
							_openClip of obj = clipRef
							result = TRUE
						else
							mmError = TRUE
						end
						mmYield
						mmYield
						mmYield
						mmYield
						mmYield
					else
						mmError = TRUE
					end
					sysSuspend = ss
				end
			end

			in targetWindow
				sysCursor = oldCursor
			end
		end

		if sysError <> NULL;mmError = TRUE;end
		syserror = oldSyserror

		txtFB = fbArray[index][12]
		if txtFB <> null
			showIfClipFailed = item 1 of fbArray[index][14]
			if (not showIfClipFailed)\
			  or (showIfClipFailed and mmError is TRUE)
				if actualObj = NULL
					get obj
				else
					get actualObj
				end
				if it is not NULL
					FBLoc = NULL
				end
				get _ASYM_DoGenericTextFeedback(it,\
				  txtFB, FBLoc, item 2 of fbArray[index][14])
				result = TRUE
			end
		end

		if fbArray[index][15] <> NULL
			system s__tb80r_fbcmd -- recursion trap

			cmd = fbArray[index][15]
			if cmd <> s__tb80r_fbcmd
				oldfbcmd = s__tb80r_fbcmd
				s__tb80r_fbcmd = cmd
				if wordcount(cmd) > 1
					execute ("send" && cmd && "to" && obj)
				else
					send (cmd) to obj
				end
				s__tb80r_fbcmd = oldfbcmd
			end
			result = TRUE
		end

		oldSys = sysSuspendMessages
		sysSuspendMessages = FALSE
		if fbArray[index][2] <> NULL
			if ASYM_DoAnswerHyperlink (obj, fbArray[index][1], notSummary)
				result = TRUE
			end
		end
		sysSuspendMessages = oldSys
	end

	sysMediaSuspend = oldMM
	return result
end

to get _upgrade3SummaryFeedback obj
	-- Automatically upgrade CBT Edition 3.0 widgets with "partial score"
	-- type of summary feedback when non-specific feedback is called on them

	local ansArray[][], fbArray[][]

	if ASYM_WID_PartialScore of obj is null
		return FALSE
	end

	ss=sysSuspend;sysSuspend = FALSE;clear sysError
	fbArray = ASYM_WID_SummaryFeedback of obj
	sysSuspend = ss
	if sysError is null
		return TRUE
	end

	sysSuspend = FALSE;clear sysError
	ansArray = ASYM_WID_AnsArray of obj
	sysSuspend = ss
	if sysError <> null
		return FALSE
	end

	fbArray[1][1] = "correct"
	fbArray[2][1] = "incorrect"
	fbArray[3][1] = "partially correct"
	step i from 2 to 16
		fbArray[1][i] = ansArray[1][i]
		fbArray[2][i] = ansArray[2][i]
		fbArray[3][i] = ansArray[2][i] -- there was no 3rd option in 3.0
	end
	ASYM_WID_SummaryFeedback of obj = fbArray
	ASYM_WID_DelayFeedback of obj = TRUE
	return TRUE
end

to handle mmnotify clipRef, cmd, result
	mmClose clipRef wait
	mmYield
end

			end
			result = TRUE
		end

		oldSys = sysSuspendMessages
		sysSuspendMessages = FALSE
		if fbArray[index][2] <> NULL
			if ASYM_DoAnswerHyperlink (obj, fbArray[index][1], notSummary)
				result = TRUE
			end
		end
		sysSuspendMessages = oldSys
	end

	sysMediaSuspend = oldMM
	return result
end

to get _upgrade3SummaryFeedback obj
	-- Automatically upgrade CBT Edition 3.0 widgets with "partial score"
	-- type of summary feedback when non-specific feedback is called on them

	local ansArray[][], fbArray[][]

	if ASYM_WID_PartialScore of obj is null
		return FALSE
	end

	ss=sysSuspend;sysSuspend = FALSE;clear sysError
	fbArray = ASYM_WID_SummaryFeedback of obj
	sysSuspend = ss
	if sysError is null
		return TRUE
	end

	sysSuspend = FALSE;clear sysError
	ansArray = ASYM_WID_AnsArray of obj
	sysSuspend = ss
	if sysError <> null
		return FALSE
	end

	fbArray[1][1] = "correct"
	fbArray[2][1] = "incorrect"
	fbArray[3][1] = "partially correct"
	step i from 2 to 16
		fbArray[1][i] = ansArray[1][i]
		fbArray[2][i] = ansArray[2][i]
		fbArray[3][i] = ansArray[2][i] -- there was no 3rd option in 3.0
	end
	ASYM_WID_SummaryFeedback of obj = fbArray
	ASYM_WID_DelayFeedback of obj = TRUE
	return TRUE
end

to handle mmnotify clipRef, cmd, result
	mmClose clipRef wait
	mmYield
end

to get _SmartPlaySound snd, sync
	linkdll "mmsystem"
		INT SndPlaySound(STRING,WORD)
		INT KillPlaySound = SndPlaySound(DWORD,WORD)
	end
	get KillPlaySound(0,0)
	mmYield
	if snd <> null
		flags = 0x0002 -- SND_NODEFAULT
		if sync <> true
			increment flags by 1 -- SND_ASYNC = 0x0001
		end

		--clip
		if word 1 of snd is "clip" and wordcount(snd) > 1
			clear word 1 of snd
			sms = sysMediaSuspend;sysMediaSuspend = false;clear sysError
			mmplay snd autoclose
			sysMediaSuspend = sms
			return (sysError is null)
		end

		--Windows system sound
		if "." is not in snd
			return (SndPlaySound(snd,flags) <> 0) -- Win system sound name?
		end

		--file - first try relative to this book's dir
		get ASYM_PathOfFile(name of this book) & snd
		get ASYM_GetShortFileName (it, 1)
		if it <> NULL
			get SndPlaySound(it, flags)
		else
			get 0
		end

		--that wasn't it - try media paths
		if it = 0
			get ASYM_FindPathFile(snd,HDMediaPath of this book)
			if it is null
				get ASYM_FindPathFile(snd,CDMediaPath of this book)
			end
			if it <> null
				snd = ASYM_GetShortFileName (it, 1)
			end
			get SndPlaySound(snd, flags)
		end
	end
	return (it <> 0)
end

to get _ASYM_CheckAnswerHyperlinks obj
	local links[][]
	local badlinks

	if not ASYM_checkHyperSysBook()
		return null
	end
	if ASYM_HasAnsArray(obj)
		links = ASYM_WID_AnsArray of obj
		badlinks = _ASYM_BadLinksList(links)
	end
	if ASYM_HasFBArray(obj)
		links = ASYM_WID_SummaryFeedback of obj
		if item 2 of dimensions(links) > 1
			ss= sysSuspend;sysSuspend = false
			get _ASYM_BadLinksList(links)
			sysSuspend = ss
		end
	end
	conditions

-- 0x8def7  to get _ASYM_CheckAnswerHyperlinks obj
to get _ASYM_CheckAnswerHyperlinks obj
	local links[][]
	local badlinks

	if not ASYM_checkHyperSysBook()
		return null
	end
	if ASYM_HasAnsArray(obj)
		links = ASYM_WID_AnsArray of obj
		badlinks = _ASYM_BadLinksList(links)
	end
	if ASYM_HasFBArray(obj)
		links = ASYM_WID_SummaryFeedback of obj
		if item 2 of dimensions(links) > 1
			ss= sysSuspend;sysSuspend = false
			get _ASYM_BadLinksList(links)
			sysSuspend = ss
		end
	end
	conditions
	when it is null
		get badlinks
	when badlinks <> null
		push badlinks onto it
	end

	return it
end

to handle _ASYM_PlayFeedback pTarget, index, actualObj, mode, pRegisterTry
	LOCAL STACK	responseList

	if index <> NULL
		get _ASYM_PlayAnswerFeedback (index, pTarget, actualObj)
	else
		if _ASYM_PlaySummaryFeedback(pTarget, actualObj, pRegisterTry)
			break
		end
		-- 3.0 compatibility, or detail fb possible
		if ASYM_WID_PartialScore of pTarget <> NULL
			if ASYM_WID_Score(mode, null, true) of pTarget = ASYM_WID_MaxScore of pTarget
				get 1
			else
				get 2
			end
			send ASYM_DoFeedback pTarget, it
		else
			responseIDs = ASYM_WID_ResponseIDs of pTarget
			_responseList = _responseList of pTarget
			step i from 1 to itemcount(responseIDs)
				pop responseIDs into index
				obj = item i of _responseList
				send ASYM_DoFeedback pTarget, index, obj
			end
		end
	end
end

to get _ASYM_Is32Bit
	-- This function used to return False or TRUE depending on if you were
	-- running Window 3.1x [16 bit] or Windows 95 (or higher) [32 bit]

to get _ASYM_ScreenBounds where, defaultMonitor
	-- Returns the bounds of the monitor specified by <where>. If <where> is null, returns the
	-- bounds of the primary monitor.
	--
	-- <where>		- One of the following:
	--				  * A point in pixels relative to the top left corner of the primary monitor
	--				    (that is, screen position 0,0). In <where> is a point, the function returns
	--				    the bounds of the monitor contain the specified point.
	--				  * Bounds of a rectangle, in pixels relative to the top left corner of the
	--				    primary monitor (that is, screen position 0,0). If <where> is the bounds of
	--				    a rectangle, the function returns the bounds of the monitor that has the
	--				    largest area of intersection with the specified rectangle.
	--				  * A viewer reference. If <where> is a viewer reference, the function returns
	--				    the bounds of the monitor that has the largest area of intersection with the
	--				    bounding rectangle of a specified viewer.
	--				  * NULL. If <where> is NULL, the function returns the bounds of the primary
	--				    monitor.
	-- <defaultMonitor>	- This parameter is used when the point, rectangle or viewer is not located
	--				  within the bounds of a monitor. By default, this function will return the
	--				  bounds of the nearest monitor in that case. However, if this parameter is
	--				  "defaultToPrimary", this function will return the bounds of the primary
	--				  monitor.
	--
	-- Returns the bounds of the monitor as determined by the logic described above, in pixels. If
	-- <where> is invalid, returns 0. If an error occurs that is not caused by an invalid parameter,
	-- returns the bounds of the primary monitor.

	linkDLL "user"
		INT GetSystemMetrics(INT)
	end

	linkDLL32 "kernel32.dll"
		POINTER32 GlobalAllocPointer32 = GlobalAlloc (DWORD, DWORD)
		DWORD GlobalFreePointer32 = GlobalFree (POINTER32)
	end

	if where = null
		screenBounds = 0,0,getSystemMetrics(0),getSystemMetrics(1)
	else
		-- Could we have multiple monitors?
		get sysOperatingSystem
		hasMultiMon = not (word 2 of it = "95" or (word 2 of it = "NT" and word 3 of it < 5))
		if hasMultiMon
			linkDLL32 "user32.dll"
				DWORD MonitorFromPoint (LONG, LONG, DWORD)
				DWORD MonitorFromWindow (DWORD, DWORD)
				DWORD MonitorFromRect (POINTER32, DWORD)
				INT GetMonitorInfo = GetMonitorInfoA (DWORD, POINTER32)
			end

			if defaultMonitor = "defaultToPrimary"
				MONITOR_DEFAULTTOPRIMARY = 1
				monitorDefault = MONITOR_DEFAULTTOPRIMARY
			else
				MONITOR_DEFAULTTONEAREST = 2
				monitorDefault = MONITOR_DEFAULTTONEAREST
			end

			if isType ("object", where)
				if object of where = "viewer"
					hMonitor = MonitorFromWindow (windowHandle of where, monitorDefault)
				else
					return 0
				end
			else
				if isType ("point", where)
					hMonitor = MonitorFromPoint (item 1 of where, item 2 of where, 0)
				else
					if itemCount (where) = 4 and isType ("point", items 1 to 2 of where) and isType ("point", items 3 to 4 of where)
						pRect = GlobalAllocPointer32 (0, 40)
						get pointerLong32 (0, pRect, item 1 of where)
						get pointerLong32 (4, pRect, item 2 of where)
						get pointerLong32 (8, pRect, item 3 of where)
						get pointerLong32 (12, pRect, item 4 of where)
						hMonitor = MonitorFromRect (pRect, 0)
						get GlobalFreePointer32 (pRect)
					else
						return 0
					end
				end
			end

			if hMonitor = 0
				return 0, 0, getSystemMetrics(0), getSystemMetrics(1)
			else
				pMonitorInfo = GlobalAllocPointer32 (0, 40)
				get pointerDWord32 (0, pMonitorInfo, 40)

				get GetMonitorInfo (hMonitor, pMonitorInfo)

				if it = 0
					screenBounds = 0,0,getSystemMetrics(0),getSystemMetrics(1)
				else
					left = pointerLong32 (4, pMonitorInfo)
					top = pointerLong32 (8, pMonitorInfo)
					right = pointerLong32 (12, pMonitorInfo)
					bottom = pointerLong32 (16, pMonitorInfo)

					screenBounds = left,top,right,bottom
				end

				get GlobalFreePointer32(pMonitorInfo)
			end
		else
			screenBounds = 0,0,getSystemMetrics(0),getSystemMetrics(1)
		end
	end

	return screenBounds
end

to get ScreenInfo
	linkdll ASYM_ProductPrefix() & "win.dll"
		INT HorizontalDisplayRes()
		INT VerticalDisplayRes()
		INT DisplayBitsPerPixel()
		INT DisplayColorPlanes()
	end
	get 2 ^ (DisplayBitsPerPixel() * DisplayColorPlanes())
	push VerticalDisplayRes() onto it
	push HorizontalDisplayRes() onto it
	return it
end

to get _ASYM_GetSystemColor sysColor
	linkDLL "user"
		DWORD GetSysColor (int)
	end

	if not isType ("int", sysColor)
		colorList = "Scrollbar,Background,ActiveTitle,InactiveTitle,Menu,Window,WindowFrame,MenuText,WindowText," & \
			"TitleText,ActiveBorder,InactiveBorder,AppWorkSpace,Hilight,HilightText,ButtonFace,ButtonShadow,GrayText," & \
			"ButtonText,InactiveTitleText,ButtonHilight,ButtonDkShadow,ButtonLight,InfoText,InfoWindow"
		sysColor = ASYM_ItemOffset (syscolor, colorList) - 1
	end

	if sysColor < 0
		sysError = "Not a valid Windows system color"
		return "0,0,0"
	else
		get getSysColor (sysColor)
		r = it bitAnd 0x000000ff
		g = (it bitAnd 0x0000ff00) / 0x100
		b = (it bitAnd 0x00ff0000) / 0x10000
		return r,g,b
	end
end

	linkDLL "user"
		INT getSystemMetrics(INT)
	end

	if getSystemMetrics(23) <> 0
		get keyRightButton
	else
		get keyLeftButton
	end

	return it
end

to get _ASYM_TicksToTime ms
	s = ms div 1000
	h = s div 3600
	m = s mod 3600 div 60
	s = s mod 60
	format number s as "00"
	format number m as "00"
	format number h as "00"
	return expandString("%1:%2:%3", h, m, s)
end


to get _ASYM_MouseScreenPos pReturnType
	retVal = pageUnitsToScreen(mousePosition of targetWindow, targetWindow)
	if pReturnType = "pageUnits" then
		retVal = (item 1 of retVal * item 1 of sysPageUnitsPerPixel), \
				(item 2 of retVal * item 2 of sysPageUnitsPerPixel)
	end if
	return retVal
end

to get _ASYM_FontHeight fontName, fontHeightPoints, fontInfo, units
	-- Returns the height of a fonts character cell
	-- Parameters:
	-- <fontName> = name of font face (fontFace property)
	-- <fontHeightPoints> = point size of font (fontSize property)
	-- <fontInfo> = style of font (fontStyle property)
	-- <units> = (optional) units to return ("twips" or "pageunits" or "pixels" - default is "twips" or "pageunits")

	linkDLL "gdi"
		INT GetTextMetrics (WORD, POINTER)
		WORD CreateFont (INT, INT, INT, INT, INT, BYTE, BYTE, BYTE, BYTE, BYTE, BYTE, BYTE, BYTE, STRING)
		WORD SelectObject (WORD, WORD)
		WORD GDI_DeleteObject = DeleteObject (WORD)
		INT SetMapMode (WORD, INT)
		INT GetDeviceCaps (WORD, INT)
	end

	linkDLL "user"
		WORD getDC (WORD)
		INT releaseDC (WORD, WORD)
	end

	LOGPIXELSY = 90
	MM_TEXT = 1

	-- get a window handle and a DC to select the font into
	hWnd = clientHandle of mainWindow
	hDC = getDC (hWnd)

	-- set the map mode to MM_TEXT
	oldMapMode = setMapMode (hDC, MM_TEXT)

	-- 700 is the magic number for standard bold
	if fontInfo contains "bold"
		fontBold = 700
	else
		fontBold = 0
	end
	if fontInfo contains "italic"
		fontItalic = 1
	else
		fontItalic = 0
	end

	-- create a font with the correct characteristics. Note that a negative font
	-- height indicates we're giving the height of the everything from the
	-- baseline up (which is what the point size of a font gives you).
	-- Multiplying by 20 converts points to twips.
	hFont = createFont (-fontHeightPoints * GetDeviceCaps( hDC, LOGPIXELSY )/72, 0, 0, 0, fontBold, fontItalic, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, fontName)

	if hFont = 0
		cellHeightPixels = guessFontHeight(fontHeightPoints)
	else
		-- select the font into the DC so we can get the font metrics of the DC
		hFontOld = selectObject (hDC, hFont)

		-- create the font metrics structure and get the font information
		textMetricsSize = 31
		pTextMetrics = ASYM_GetMemBlock (textMetricsSize)

		-- here's the trick - the text metrics structure gives you the full
		-- height of the font (including descenders), not just from the base
		-- line up (which is all the point size tells you).
		get GetTextMetrics (hDC, pTextMetrics)

		if it = 0
			cellHeightPixels = guessFontHeight(fontHeightPoints)
		else
			cellHeightPixels = pointerInt (0, pTextMetrics)

			get ASYM_FreeMemBlock (pTextMetrics)

			-- select the old font back into the DC and delete the font object we
			-- created
			get selectObject (hDC, hFontOld)
			get GDI_DeleteObject (hFont)

			-- restore the mapping mode of the DC, then release the DC
			get setMapMode (hDC, oldMapMode)
			get releaseDC (hWnd, hDC)
		end
	end

	if units = "pixels"
		return cellHeightPixels
	else
		return cellHeightPixels * item 2 of sysPageUnitsPerPixel
	end
end

to get guessFontHeight fontHeightPoints
	return round ((fontHeightPoints * 20 * 1.2) / yPix)
end

to get ASYM_FontWidth fontName, fontHeightPoints, fontInfo, units, what, data
	-- Returns the width of a specified character or characters using the specified units
	-- Parameters:
	-- <fontName> = name of font face (fontFace property)
	-- <fontHeightPoints> = point size of font (fontSize property)
	-- <fontInfo> = style of font (fontStyle property)
	-- <units> = (optional) units to return ("twips" or "pageunits" or "pixels" - default is "twips"
	--			 or "pageunits")
	-- <what> = (optional) "maximum", "average" (the default) or "chars". If "maximum" is specified,
	--          returns the width of the widest character. If "average" is specified, returns the
	--          average character width (typically defined as the width of the character "X"). If
	--          "chars" is specified, returns the total width of the characters in the <data> string.
	-- <data> = (required if <what> = "chars") a string of characters to calculate the total width of.

	linkDLL "gdi"
		INT GetTextMetrics (WORD, POINTER)
		WORD CreateFont (INT, INT, INT, INT, INT, BYTE, BYTE, BYTE, BYTE, BYTE, BYTE, BYTE, BYTE, STRING)
		WORD SelectObject (WORD, WORD)
		WORD GDI_DeleteObject = DeleteObject (WORD)
		INT SetMapMode (WORD, INT)
		INT GetDeviceCaps (WORD, INT)
		INT GetTextExtentPoint (WORD, STRING, INT, POINTER)
	end

	linkDLL "user"
		WORD getDC (WORD)
		INT releaseDC (WORD, WORD)
	end

	LOGPIXELSY = 90
	MM_TEXT = 1

	-- get a window handle and a DC to select the font into
	hWnd = clientHandle of mainWindow
	hDC = getDC (hWnd)

	-- set the map mode to MM_TEXT
	oldMapMode = setMapMode (hDC, MM_TEXT)

	-- 700 is the magic number for standard bold
	if fontInfo contains "bold"
		fontBold = 700
	else
		fontBold = 0
	end
	if fontInfo contains "italic"
		fontItalic = 1
	else
		fontItalic = 0
	end

	-- create a font with the correct characteristics. Note that a negative font
	-- height indicates we're giving the height of the everything from the
	-- baseline up (which is what the point size of a font gives you).
	-- Multiplying by 20 converts points to twips.
	hFont = createFont (-fontHeightPoints * GetDeviceCaps( hDC, LOGPIXELSY )/72, 0, 0, 0, fontBold, fontItalic, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, fontName)

	if hFont = 0
		cellHeightPixels = guessFontHeight(fontHeightPoints)
	else
		-- select the font into the DC so we can get the font metrics of the DC
		hFontOld = selectObject (hDC, hFont)

		if what = "chars"
			pPoint = ASYM_GetMemBlock(4)
			get GetTextExtentPoint(hDC, data, charCount(data), pPoint)
			fontWidthPixels = pointerInt(0, pPoint)
			get ASYM_FreeMemBlock(pPoint)
		else
			-- create the font metrics structure and get the font information
			textMetricsSize = 31
			pTextMetrics = ASYM_GetMemBlock (textMetricsSize)

			get GetTextMetrics (hDC, pTextMetrics

-- 0x8ed66  to get _ASYM_GetSystemColor sysColor
to get _ASYM_GetSystemColor sysColor
	linkDLL "user"
		DWORD GetSysColor (int)
	end

	if not isType ("int", sysColor)
		colorList = "Scrollbar,Background,ActiveTitle,InactiveTitle,Menu,Window,WindowFrame,MenuText,WindowText," & \
			"TitleText,ActiveBorder,InactiveBorder,AppWorkSpace,Hilight,HilightText,ButtonFace,ButtonShadow,GrayText," & \
			"ButtonText,InactiveTitleText,ButtonHilight,ButtonDkShadow,ButtonLight,InfoText,InfoWindow"
		sysColor = ASYM_ItemOffset (syscolor, colorList) - 1
	end

	if sysColor < 0
		sysError = "Not a valid Windows system color"
		return "0,0,0"
	else
		get getSysColor (sysColor)
		r = it bitAnd 0x000000ff
		g = (it bitAnd 0x0000ff00) / 0x100
		b = (it bitAnd 0x00ff0000) / 0x10000
		return r,g,b
	end
end

	end

	return it
end

	s = ms div 1000
	h = s div 3600
	m = s mod 3600 div 60
	s = s mod 60
	format number s as "00"
	format number m as "00"
	format number h as "00"
	return expandString("%1:%2:%3", h, m, s)
end


to get _ASYM_MouseScreenPos pReturnType
	retVal = pageUnitsToScreen(mousePosition of targetWindow, targetWindow)
	if pReturnType = "pageUnits" then
		retVal = (item 1 of retVal * item 1 of sysPageUnitsPerPixel), \
				(item 2 of retVal * item 2 of sysPageUnitsPerPixel)
	end if
	return retVal
end


to get _ASYM_FontHeight fontName, fontHeightPoints, fontInfo, units
	-- Returns the height of a fonts character cell
	-- Parameters:
	-- <fontName> = name of font face (fontFace property)
	-- <fontHeightPoints> = point size of font (fontSize property)
	-- <fontInfo> = style of font (fontStyle property)
	-- <units> = (optional) units to return ("twips" or "pageunits" or "pixels" - default is "twips" or "pageunits")

	linkDLL "gdi"
		INT GetTextMetrics (WORD, POINTER)
		WORD CreateFont (INT, INT, INT, INT, INT, BYTE, BYTE, BYTE, BYTE, BYTE, BYTE, BYTE, BYTE, STRING)
		WORD SelectObject (WORD, WORD)
		WORD GDI_DeleteObject = DeleteObject (WORD)
		INT SetMapMode (WORD, INT)
		INT GetDeviceCaps (WORD, INT)
	end

	linkDLL "user"
		WORD getDC (WORD)
		INT releaseDC (WORD, WORD)
	end

	LOGPIXELSY = 90
	MM_TEXT = 1

	-- get a window handle and a DC to select the font into
	hWnd = clientHandle of mainWindow
	hDC = getDC (hWnd)

	-- set the map mode to MM_TEXT
	oldMapMode = setMapMode (hDC, MM_TEXT)

	-- 700 is the magic number for standard bold
	if fontInfo contains "bold"
		fontBold = 700
	else
		fontBold = 0
	end
	if fontInfo contains "italic"
		fontItalic = 1
	else
		fontItalic = 0
	end

	-- create a font with the correct characteristics. Note that a negative font
	-- height indicates we're giving the height of the everything from the
	-- baseline up (which is what the point size of a font gives you).
	-- Multiplying by 20 converts points to twips.
	hFont = createFont (-fontHeightPoints * GetDeviceCaps( hDC, LOGPIXELSY )/72, 0, 0, 0, fontBold, fontItalic, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, fontName)

	if hFont = 0
		cellHeightPixels = guessFontHeight(fontHeightPoints)
	else
		-- select the font into the DC so we can get the font metrics of the DC
		hFontOld = selectObject (hDC, hFont)

		-- create the font metrics structure and get the font information
		textMetricsSize = 31
		pTextMetrics = ASYM_GetMemBlock (textMetricsSize)

		-- here's the trick - the text metrics structure gives you the full
		-- height of the font (including descenders), not just from the base
		-- line up (which is all the point size tells you).
		get GetTextMetrics (hDC, pTextMetrics)

		if it = 0
			cellHeightPixels = guessFontHeight(fontHeightPoints)
		else
			cellHeightPixels = pointerInt (0, pTextMetrics)

			get ASYM_FreeMemBlock (pTextMetrics)

			-- select the old font back into the DC and delete the font object we
			-- created
			get selectObject (hDC, hFontOld)
			get GDI_DeleteObject (hFont)

			-- restore the mapping mode of the DC, then release the DC
			get setMapMode (hDC, oldMapMode)
			get releaseDC (hWnd, hDC)
		end
	end

	if units = "pixels"
		return cellHeightPixels
	else
		return cellHeightPixels * item 2 of sysPageUnitsPerPixel
	end
end

to get guessFontHeight fontHeightPoints
	return round ((fontHeightPoints * 20 * 1.2) / yPix)
end

to get ASYM_FontWidth fontName, fontHeightPoints, fontInfo, units, what, data
	-- Returns the width of a specified character or characters using the specified units
	-- Parameters:
	-- <fontName> = name of font face (fontFace property)
	-- <fontHeightPoints> = point size of font (fontSize property)
	-- <fontInfo> = style of font (fontStyle property)
	-- <units> = (optional) units to return ("twips" or "pageunits" or "pixels" - default is "twips"
	--			 or "pageunits")
	-- <what> = (optional) "maximum", "average" (the default) or "chars". If "maximum" is specified,
	--          returns the width of the widest character. If "average" is specified, returns the
	--          average character width (typically defined as the width of the character "X"). If
	--          "chars" is specified, returns the total width of the characters in the <data> string.
	-- <data> = (required if <what> = "chars") a string of characters to calculate the total width of.

	linkDLL "gdi"
		INT GetTextMetrics (WORD, POINTER)
		WORD CreateFont (INT, INT, INT, INT, INT, BYTE, BYTE, BYTE, BYTE, BYTE, BYTE, BYTE, BYTE, STRING)
		WORD SelectObject (WORD, WORD)
		WORD GDI_DeleteObject = DeleteObject (WORD)
		INT SetMapMode (WORD, INT)
		INT GetDeviceCaps (WORD, INT)
		INT GetTextExtentPoint (WORD, STRING, INT, POINTER)
	end

	linkDLL "user"
		WORD getDC (WORD)
		INT releaseDC (WORD, WORD)
	end

	LOGPIXELSY = 90
	MM_TEXT = 1

	-- get a window handle and a DC to select the font into
	hWnd = clientHandle of mainWindow
	hDC = getDC (hWnd)

	-- set the map mode to MM_TEXT
	oldMapMode = setMapMode (hDC, MM_TEXT)

	-- 700 is the magic number for standard bold
	if fontInfo contains "bold"
		fontBold = 700
	else
		fontBold = 0
	end
	if fontInfo contains "italic"
		fontItalic = 1
	else
		fontItalic = 0
	end

	-- create a font with the correct characteristics. Note that a negative font
	-- height indicates we're giving the height of the everything from the
	-- baseline up (which is what the point size of a font gives you).
	-- Multiplying by 20 converts points to twips.
	hFont = createFont (-fontHeightPoints * GetDeviceCaps( hDC, LOGPIXELSY )/72, 0, 0, 0, fontBold, fontItalic, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, fontName)

	if hFont = 0
		cellHeightPixels = guessFontHeight(fontHeightPoints)
	else
		-- select the font into the DC so we can get the font metrics of the DC
		hFontOld = selectObject (hDC, hFont)

		if what = "chars"
			pPoint = ASYM_GetMemBlock(4)
			get GetTextExtentPoint(hDC, data, charCount(data), pPoint)
			fontWidthPixels = pointerInt(0, pPoint)
			get ASYM_FreeMemBlock(pPoint)
		else
			-- create the font metrics structure and get the font information
			textMetricsSize = 31
			pTextMetrics = ASYM_GetMemBlock (textMetricsSize)

			get GetTextMetrics (hDC, pTextMetrics)

			if what = "maximum"
				fontWidthPixels = pointerInt (12, pTextMetrics)
			else
				fontWidthPixels = pointerInt (10, pTextMetrics)
			end

			get ASYM_FreeMemBlock (pTextMetrics)
		end
	end

	-- select the old font back into the DC and delete the font object we
	-- created
	get selectObject (hDC, hFontOld)
	get GDI_DeleteObject (hFont)

	-- restore the mapping mode of the DC then release the DC
	get setMapMode (hDC, oldMapMode)
	get releaseDC (hWnd, hDC)

	if units = "pixels"
		return fontWidthPixels
	else
		return fontWidthPixels * item 1 of sysPageUnitsPerPixel
	end
end
