			-- created
			get selectObject (hDC, hFontOld)
			get GDI_DeleteObject (hFont)

			-- restore the mapping mode of the DC, then release the DC
			get setMapMode (hDC, oldMapMode)
			get releaseDC (hWnd, hDC)
		end
	end

	if units = "pixels"
		return cellHeightPixels
	else
		return cellHeightPixels * item 2 of sysPageUnitsPerPixel
	end
end

to get guessFontHeight fontHeightPoints
	return round ((fontHeightPoints * 20 * 1.2) / yPix)
end

to get ASYM_FontWidth fontName, fontHeightPoints, fontInfo, units, what, data
	-- Returns the width of a specified character or characters using the specified units
	-- Parameters:
	-- <fontName> = name of font face (fontFace property)
	-- <fontHeightPoints> = point size of font (fontSize property)
	-- <fontInfo> = style of font (fontStyle property)
	-- <units> = (optional) units to return ("twips" or "pageunits" or "pixels" - default is "twips"
	--			 or "pageunits")
	-- <what> = (optional) "maximum", "average" (the default) or "chars". If "maximum" is specified,
	--          returns the width of the widest character. If "average" is specified, returns the
	--          average character width (typically defined as the width of the character "X"). If
	--          "chars" is specified, returns the total width of the characters in the <data> string.
	-- <data> = (required if <what> = "chars") a string of characters to calculate the total width of.

	linkDLL "gdi"
		INT GetTextMetrics (WORD, POINTER)
		WORD CreateFont (INT, INT, INT, INT, INT, BYTE, BYTE, BYTE, BYTE, BYTE, BYTE, BYTE, BYTE, STRING)
		WORD SelectObject (WORD, WORD)
		WORD GDI_DeleteObject = DeleteObject (WORD)
		INT SetMapMode (WORD, INT)
		INT GetDeviceCaps (WORD, INT)
		INT GetTextExtentPoint (WORD, STRING, INT, POINTER)
	end

	linkDLL "user"
		WORD getDC (WORD)
		INT releaseDC (WORD, WORD)
	end

	LOGPIXELSY = 90
	MM_TEXT = 1

	-- get a window handle and a DC to select the font into
	hWnd = clientHandle of mainWindow
	hDC = getDC (hWnd)

	-- set the map mode to MM_TEXT
	oldMapMode = setMapMode (hDC, MM_TEXT)

	-- 700 is the magic number for standard bold
	if fontInfo contains "bold"
		fontBold = 700
	else
		fontBold = 0
	end
	if fontInfo contains "italic"
		fontItalic = 1
	else
		fontItalic = 0
	end

	-- create a font with the correct characteristics. Note that a negative font
	-- height indicates we're giving the height of the everything from the
	-- baseline up (which is what the point size of a font gives you).
	-- Multiplying by 20 converts points to twips.
	hFont = createFont (-fontHeightPoints * GetDeviceCaps( hDC, LOGPIXELSY )/72, 0, 0, 0, fontBold, fontItalic, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, fontName)

	if hFont = 0
		cellHeightPixels = guessFontHeight(fontHeightPoints)
	else
		-- select the font into the DC so we can get the font metrics of the DC
		hFontOld = selectObject (hDC, hFont)

		if what = "chars"
			pPoint = ASYM_GetMemBlock(4)
			get GetTextExtentPoint(hDC, data, charCount(data), pPoint)
			fontWidthPixels = pointerInt(0, pPoint)
			get ASYM_FreeMemBlock(pPoint)
		else
			-- create the font metrics structure and get the font information
			textMetricsSize = 31
			pTextMetrics = ASYM_GetMemBlock (textMetricsSize)

			get GetTextMetrics (hDC, pTextMetrics)

			if what = "maximum"
				fontWidthPixels = pointerInt (12, pTextMetrics)
			else
				fontWidthPixels = pointerInt (10, pTextMetrics)
			end

			get ASYM_FreeMemBlock (pTextMetrics)
		end
	end

	-- select the old font back into the DC and delete the font object we
	-- created
	get selectObject (hDC, hFontOld)
	get GDI_DeleteObject (hFont)

	-- restore the mapping mode of the DC then release the DC
	get setMapMode (hDC, oldMapMode)
	get releaseDC (hWnd, hDC)

	if units = "pixels"
		return fontWidthPixels
	else
		return fontWidthPixels * item 1 of sysPageUnitsPerPixel
	end
end

-- 0x905c9  to get _ASYM_INET_linkDLL
to get _ASYM_INET_linkDLL
	retVal = true
	bs = ASYM_BlockSuspend()

	linkDll32 "tbinet32.dll"
		STRING INetClose(STRING)
		STRING INetCreateDirectory(STRING, STRING)
		STRING INetDeleteFile(STRING, STRING)
		STRING INetDestroyObject(STRING, STRING)
		STRING INetGetCurrentFile(STRING, STRING, STRING)
		STRING INetGetDirectoryList(STRING, STRING, STRING)
		STRING INetGetFile(STRING, STRING, STRING, STRING)
		STRING INetGetLastErrorCode()
		STRING INetGetLastErrorText()
		STRING INetGetListDelimiter(STRING)
		STRING INetGetProperty(STRING, STRING)
		STRING INetGetRelativeUrl(STRING, STRING)
		STRING INetGetRemoteErrorCode()
		STRING INetGetSessionList()
		STRING INetGetSystemErrorCode()
		STRING INetIsFileCurrent(STRING, STRING, STRING)
		STRING INetNewObject(STRING, STRING, STRING)
		STRING INetPutFile(STRING, STRING, STRING)
		STRING INetRead(STRING, POINTER, LONG)
		STRING INetRemoveDirectory(STRING, STRING)
		STRING INetRenameFile(STRING, STRING, STRING)
		STRING INetSeek(STRING, STRING, LONG)
		STRING INetSetListDelimiter(STRING, STRING)
		STRING INetSetProperty(STRING, STRING, STRING)
		STRING INetSetRelativeUrl(STRING, STRING)
		STRING INetSetUrlFromParts(STRING)
		STRING INetWrite(STRING, POINTER, LONG)
	end linkDLL32

	bs = ASYM_RestoreSuspend(bs)
	if bs <> NULL then
		sysError = "Unable to link INET DLL"
		retVal = false
	end if
	return retVal
end


--****************************************
to get _ASYM_GetFile_URL pRemoteFile, pLocalFile, pOverWrite, pSecureSocket
	remote_File = pRemoteFile
	local_File = pLocalFile
	overWrite = (pOverWrite = TRUE)
	secureSocket = (pSecureSocket = true)

	gotRemoteFile = false
	ret = NULL
	if (remote_File <> NULL) and (local_File <> NULL) then

		if ASYM_INET_linkDLL() = true then

			INet_Alias_GetFile = "ASYM_INET_URL_GetFile"
			ret = INetNewObject(INet_Alias_GetFile, NULL, "URLConnection")
			if ret = INet_Alias_GetFile then
				ret = INetSetProperty(INet_Alias_GetFile, "URL", remote_File)

				if ret = "OK" then
					ret = INetSetProperty(INet_Alias_GetFile, "DecodeEscapeChars", true)
					ret = INetSetProperty(INet_Alias_GetFile, "EncodeUnsafeChars", true)
				end if

				if ret = "OK" then
					ret = INetSetProperty(INet_Alias_GetFile, "Secure", secureSocket)
				end if

				if ret = "OK" then
					ret = INetGetCurrentFile(INet_Alias_GetFile, local_File, overWrite)
				end if

				if ret = "OK" then
					gotRemoteFile = true
				else
					-- Errors encountered during the attempt
				end if

				get INetDestroyObject(INet_Alias_GetFile)

			else

				-- ASYM_INET_LinkDLL() failed
				gotRemoteFile = false

			end if

		else
			-- Unable to get connection
		end if
	end if

	if (ret <> "OK") AND (ret <> NULL)
		sysError = "INET Error: " & INetGetLastErrorText()
	end

	return gotRemoteFile

end


--****************************************
to get _ASYM_GetFile_FTP pRemoteServer, pRemotePort, pRemoteDir, \
		pRemoteFile, pRemoteUser, pRemotePassword, pLocalFile, pOverwrite, pTransferType

	gotRemoteFile = false

	remote_Server = pRemoteServer
	remote_Port = pRemotePort
	remote_Dir = pRemoteDir
	remote_File = pRemoteFile
	remote_User = pRemoteUser
	remote_Password = pRemotePassword

	if last char of remote_Dir <> "/" then
		put "/" after remote_Dir
	end if

	local_File = pLocalFile
	overWrite = (pOverwrite = TRUE)
	transferType = pTransferType
	if ASYM_ItemOffset(transferType, "binary,ascii") = 0 then
		transferType = "binary"
	end if

	remote_FullPath = remote_Dir & remote_File

	ret = NULL
	if ASYM_INET_linkDLL() = true then

		INet_Alias_GetFile = "ASYM_INET_FTP_GetFile"
		ret = INetNewObject(INet_Alias_GetFile, NULL, "FtpConnection")
		if ret = INet_Alias_GetFile

			ret = INetSetProperty(INet_Alias_GetFile, "ServerName", remote_Server)

			if ret = "OK" and (remote_Port <> NULL) then
				ret = INetSetProperty(INet_Alias_GetFile, "Port", remote_Port)
			end if

			if ret = "OK" and (remote_User <> NULL) then
				ret = INetSetProperty(INet_Alias_GetFile, "UserName", remote_User)
			end if

			if ret = "OK" and (remote_Password <> NULL) then
				ret = INetSetProperty(INet_Alias_GetFile, "Password", remote_User)
			end if

			if ret = "OK" then
				ret = INetSetProperty(INet_Alias_GetFile, "TransferMethod", transferType)
			end if

			if ret= "OK" then
				ret = INetSetProperty(INet_Alias_GetFile, "CurrentFile", remote_FullPath)
			end if

			if ret= "OK" then
				-- First, check to see if the local file is current
				localIsCurrent = false
				if ASYM_IsFile(local_File) = true then
					localIsCurrent = INetIsFileCurrent(INet_Alias_GetFile, remote_FullPath, local_File)
				end if
				if localIsCurrent = true then
					-- local file IS current, so we don't have to load
					-- it again
					ret = "OK"
				else
					ret = INetGetCurrentFile(INet_Alias_GetFile, local_File, overWrite)
				end if
			end if

			if ret = "OK" then
				gotRemoteFile = true
			else
				-- Errors encountered during the attempt
			end if

			get INetDestroyObject(INet_Alias_GetFile)

		else
			-- Unable to get connection
		end if

	else

		-- ASYM_INET_LinkDLL() failed
		gotRemoteFile = false

	end if

	if (ret <> "OK") AND (ret <> NULL)
		sysError = "INET Error: " & INetGetLastErrorText()
	end

	return gotRemoteFile

end

-- 0x914a9  to get _FindExecutableFile fn
to get _FindExecutableFile fn

	local testFn, f

	if fn is null
		sysError = 2
		return null
	end

	linkDll "shell.dll"
		WORD FindExecutable	(STRING,STRING,POINTER)
	end

	linkDLL "tbdos.dll"
		INT RemoveFile(STRING)
	end

	lpBuffer = ASYM_GetMemBlock(256)
	if lpBuffer = NULL or lpBuffer = "0,0"
		beep 1
		return NULL
	end

	conditions
	when fn contains "*" and fn contains "."
	when fn <> null and not ASYM_IsFile(fn)
		tempFn = null
		tempFn = ASYM_GetTempFile("tst")
		if tempFn = null
			beep 1
			return NULL
		end

		p = revOffset(".", fn)

		if p > 0
			f = ASYM_PathOfFile(tempFn)\
			   & "jg080647" & chars p to charcount(fn) of fn
			get RemoveFile(tempFn)

			ss = sysSuspend; sysSuspend = false
			closeFile f
			clear sysError
			createFile f
			writeFile "test" to f
			closeFile f
			sysSuspend = ss

			tempFn = f
		end
	else
		f = fn
	end

	status = FindExecutable(f, _ASYM_CurrentDirectory(), lpBuffer)

	if tempFn <> null
		get RemoveFile(tempFn)
	end

	if status <= 32
		sysError = status
		exe = null
	else
		exe = pointerString(0,lpBuffer)
	end
	get ASYM_FreeMemBlock(lpBuffer)

	if exe <> null and ASYM_Is32Bit()
		get ASYM_GetShortFileName(exe,1)
		if it <> null
			exe = it
		end
	end

	if (exe <> null) and ((exe is fn) or (not ASYM_IsFile(exe)))
		clear exe
	end
	return exe
end

to get _ASYM_IsDirectoryWriteable dirSpec


	conditions
		when "\\" is in chars 1 to 2 of dirSpec
		when _ASYM_IsDriveReady(char 1 of dirSpec) and _ASYM_FreeDiskSpace(char 1 of dirSpec) > 0

		  	linkdll ASYM_ProductPrefix() & "dos.dll"
		  		INT RemoveFile(STRING)
		  	end
		  	if last char of dirSpec <> "\"
		  		put "\" after dirSpec
		  	end
		  	fN = dirSpec & "~~log~~x.tmp"
		  	ss = sysSuspend
		  	sysSuspend = false
		  	clear sysError
		  	fuErr = SetErrorMode(1)
		  	createFile fN
		  	if sysError is null
		  		writeFile "test" to fN
		  		closeFile fN
		  		get RemoveFile(fN)
		  	end
		  	sysSuspend = ss
			fuErr = SetErrorMode(fuErr)
			return (sysError is null)
	end

	return (false)
end

to get _ASYM_IsDriveReady drv
	local DWORD n
	d = char 1 of drv
	linkDLL "kernel"
		WORD SetErrorMode(WORD)
	end
	linkdll ASYM_ProductPrefix() & "dos.dll"
		STRING GetVolumeName(STRING)
	end
	fuErr = SetErrorMode(1)
	clear sysError
	vn = GetVolumeName(d)
	if sysError is 18
		clear sysError
		n = _ASYM_FreeDiskSpace(d)
	end
	fuErr = SetErrorMode(fuErr)
	return (n >= 0 and (sysError is null or sysError = 0))
end

to get _ASYM_IsFileAvailable fN
	if _ASYM_IsDriveReady(char 1 of fN)
		ss = sysSuspend
		sysSuspend = false
		clear sysError
	  	fuErr = SetErrorMode(1)
	  	openFile fN
	  	if sysError is null
	  		readFile fN for 4
	  		closeFile fN
	  	end
	  	sysSuspend = ss
		fuErr = SetErrorMode(fuErr)
		return (sysError is null)
	end
	return false
end

to get _ASYM_MakeIntoRelPath rootPath,longPath
		-- as when rootPath is "c:\" and thisPath is "c:\x\"
		-- BOTH MUST END WITH "\"!!!
	local relPath
	if offset(rootPath, longPath) = 1
		relPath = longPath
		clear chars 1 to charcount(rootPath) of relPath
		p1 = 1;p2 = p1
		while p2 < charcount(relPath) and p2 > 0
			increment p2
			if char p2 of relPath is "\"
				dirlen = p2 - p1
				chars p1 to p2 - 1 of relPath = ".."
				p2 = p2 - dirlen + 3
				p1 = p2
			end
		end
		return relPath
	end
	return rootPath
end

to get _ASYM_SetCurrentDirectory pathStr
	result = -1
	ccnt = charcount (pathStr)
	if ccnt > 1 and char ccnt of pathStr is "\" and char ccnt - 1 of pathStr <> ":"
		clear last char of pathStr
	end
	linkDLL ASYM_ProductPrefix() & "DOS.dll"
		INT SetCurrentDrive(STRING)
		STRING GetCurrentDrive(STRING)
		INT SetCurrentDirectory(STRING)
	end
	d = GetCurrentDrive()
	p = offset (":", pathStr)
	if p > 1
		nd = char 1 of pathStr
		if _ASYM_IsDriveReady(nd)
			result = SetCurrentDrive (nd)
		end
	end
	if result = 1
		result = SetCurrentDirectory(pathStr)
	end
	if result <> 1
		get SetCurrentDrive(d)
	end
	return result
end

to get _ASYM_SetPath pathName, path
	system _s_ASYM_PathCache[][]
	local word i
	ss = sysSuspend;sysSuspend=false;clear sysError
	get item 1 of dimensions(_s_ASYM_PathCache)
	sysSuspend = ss
	if sysError = null and it > 0
		step i from 1 to it
			if _s_ASYM_PathCache[i][1] is pathName
				_s_ASYM_PathCache[i][2] = path
			end
		end
	else
		_s_ASYM_PathCache[1][1] = pathName
		_s_ASYM_PathCache[1][2] = path
	end
	linkDLL ASYM_ProductPrefix() & "win.dll"
		INT SetIniVar(STRING,STRING,STRING,STRING)
	end
	get SetIniVar("Paths",pathName, path, ASYM_IniFile())
	return it
end

to get _ASYM_IsValidDrive path, retry, prompt
	linkDLL ASYM_ProductPrefix() & "dos.dll"
		STRING GetCDDriveList()
		STRING GetDriveList()
	end
	d = path
	if d contains ":"
		d = char 1 of d
	end
	if d is not in GetDriveList()
		return false
	end
	if d is in GetCDDriveList()
		while _ASYM_IsDriveReady(d) is false
			if retry is false
				return false
			end
			if prompt is null
				prompt = ASYM_GetString("Check the CD", \
						"Please verify that the CD is properly installed in the CD-ROM drive.")
			end
			get ASYM_MessageBox(prompt, null, "hand", "retryCancel")
			if it is not "retry"
				return false
			end
		end
	end
	return true
end


to get _ASYM_CurrentDirectory
	linkdll "tbdos.dll"
		STRING GetCurrentDrive()
		STRING GetCurrentDirectory(STRING)
	end
	drv = GetCurrentDrive()
	dir = "\" & GetCurrentDirectory(drv)
	if last char of dir <> "\"
		put "\" after dir
	end
	return expandString("%1:%2", drv, dir)
end


to get _ASYM_FindPathFile fName, path, bkPath
	DOSPath = false
	conditions
		when fName contains ":\" or chars 1 to 2 of fName is "\\"
			if ASYM_IsFile(fName)
				return fName
			else
				return null
			end
		when path is null
			linkDLL "TBDOS.DLL"
				STRING GetDosEnvironmentString(STRING)
			end
			DOSPath = true
			path = GetDosEnvironmentString("PATH")
			p = offset("=",path)
			if p > 0
				clear chars 1 to p of path
			end
	end
	p = offset(";", path)
	while p <> 0
		char p of path = ","
		p = offset(";", path)
	end

	if bkPath = null
		bkPath = pathOfFile(name of this book)
	end

	while path <> null
		pop path
		get ASYM_trim(it)
		if last char of it <> "\"
			put "\" after it
		end
		if not DOSPath
			if chars 1 to 2 of it is ".."
				get _ASYM_ExpandRelPath(it, bkPath)
			else
				if char 2 of it <> ":" and char 1 of it is not in ".\"
					put bkPath before it
				end
			end
		end
		testName = it & fName
		if ASYM_IsFile(testName)
			return testName
		else
			if ":" is not in it
				testName = bkPath & it & fName
				if ASYM_IsFile(testName)
					return testName
				end
			end
		end
	end while
	return null
end


to get _ASYM_FreeDiskSpace drspec
	local STRING oldDir
	clear sysError
	linkdll "tbcbt.dll"
		DWORD __ASYM_FreeDiskSpace = GetFreeDiskSpace(STRING)
	end
	if _ASYM_IsDirectory(drspec)
		oldDir = _ASYM_CurrentDirectory()
		get _ASYM_SetCurrentDirectory(drspec)
	end
	clear sysError
	r = __ASYM_FreeDiskSpace(char 1 of drspec)
	if oldDir <> null
		get _ASYM_SetCurrentDirectory(oldDir)
	end
	return r
end


to get _ASYM_GetPath pathName
	system _s_ASYM_PathCache[][]
	local word i

	get ASYM_BlockSuspend()
	cacheSize = item 1 of dimensions(_s_ASYM_PathCache)
	get ASYM_RestoreSuspend (it)
	if it = null and cacheSize > 0
		step i from 1 to cacheSize
			if _s_ASYM_PathCache[i][1] is pathName
				return _s_ASYM_PathCache[i][2]
			end
		end
	end
	linkDLL "tbwin.dll"
		STRING GetIniVar(STRING, STRING, STRING)
	end
	path = GetIniVar("Paths", pathName, ASYM_IniFile())
	if path <> null
		increment cacheSize
		_s_ASYM_PathCache[cacheSize][1]	= pathName
		_s_ASYM_PathCache[cacheSize][2]	= path
	end
	return path
end

to get _ASYM_IsDirectory dirspec
	linkDLL "tbdos.dll"
		STRING GetFileAttributes(STRING)
		STRING GetDirectoryOnlyListLFN(STRING,STRING)
	end

	if dirspec = NULL
		return FALSE
	end

	while last char of dirspec is "\" and charcount(dirspec) > 3
		clear last char of dirspec
	end

	gfa = GetFileAttributes(dirspec)

	conditions
	 when "D" is in gfa
		return TRUE

	 when gfa is NULL


		gdol = GetDirectoryOnlyListLFN(dirspec & "\*.*", NULL)
		if textline 1 of gdol = "."
			return TRUE
		end

	end

	return FALSE
end


to get _ASYM_RelativePath path, bkName
	if bkName <> null
		bkPath = pathOfFile(bkName)
		if offset(bkPath, path) = 1
			clear chars 1 to charcount(bkPath) of path
		end
	end
	return path
end


to get _ASYM_WindowsDirectory
	lpBuffer = ASYM_GetMemBlock (200)

	if lpBuffer = "0,0"
		sysErrorNumber = 13
		sysError = ASYM_GetString ("Not enough memory. Close other applications or save this book and try again.")
		return NULL
	end

	linkDLL "kernel"
		INT GetWindowsDirectory(POINTER,WORD)
	end
	get GetWindowsDirectory (lpBuffer,199)
	winDir = pointerString (0,lpBuffer)
	get ASYM_FreeMemBlock (lpBuffer)
	if winDir <> null and last char of winDir <> "\"
		put "\" after winDir
	end
	return winDir
end

	if charCount(pFileName) > 2 then
		if (char 2 of pFileName = ":")

				chars p1 to p2 - 1 of relPath = ".."
				p2 = p2 - dirlen + 3
				p1 = p2
			end
		end
		return relPath
	end
	return rootPath
end

to get _ASYM_SetCurrentDirectory pathStr
	result = -1
	ccnt = charcount (pathStr)
	if ccnt > 1 and char ccnt of pathStr is "\" and char ccnt - 1 of pathStr <> ":"
		clear last char of pathStr
	end
	linkDLL ASYM_ProductPrefix() & "DOS.dll"
		INT SetCurrentDrive(STRING)
		STRING GetCurrentDrive(STRING)
		INT SetCurrentDirectory(STRING)
	end
	d = GetCurrentDrive()
	p = offset (":", pathStr)
	if p > 1
		nd = char 1 of pathStr
		if _ASYM_IsDriveReady(nd)
			result = SetCurrentDrive (nd)
		end
	end
	if result = 1
		result = SetCurrentDirectory(pathStr)
	end
	if result <> 1
		get SetCurrentDrive(d)
	end
	return result
end

to get _ASYM_SetPath pathName, path
	system _s_ASYM_PathCache[][]
	local word i
	ss = sysSuspend;sysSuspend=false;clear sysError
	get item 1 of dimensions(_s_ASYM_PathCache)
	sysSuspend = ss
	if sysError = null and it > 0
		step i from 1 to it
			if _s_ASYM_PathCache[i][1] is pathName
				_s_ASYM_PathCache[i][2] = path
			end
		end
	else
		_s_ASYM_PathCache[1][1] = pathName
		_s_ASYM_PathCache[1][2] = path
	end
	linkDLL ASYM_ProductPrefix() & "win.dll"
		INT SetIniVar(STRING,STRING,STRING,STRING)
	end
	get SetIniVar("Paths",pathName, path, ASYM_IniFile())
	return it
end

to get _ASYM_IsValidDrive path, retry, prompt
	linkDLL ASYM_ProductPrefix() & "dos.dll"
		STRING GetCDDriveList()
		STRING GetDriveList()
	end
	d = path
	if d contains ":"
		d = char 1 of d
	end
	if d is not in GetDriveList()
		return false
	end
	if d is in GetCDDriveList()
		while _ASYM_IsDriveReady(d) is false
			if retry is false
				return false
			end
			if prompt is null
				prompt = ASYM_GetString("Check the CD", \
						"Please verify that the CD is properly installed in the CD-ROM drive.")
			end
			get ASYM_MessageBox(prompt, null, "hand", "retryCancel")
			if it is not "retry"
				return false
			end
		end
	end
	return true
end


to get _ASYM_CurrentDirectory
	linkdll "tbdos.dll"
		STRING GetCurrentDrive()
		STRING GetCurrentDirectory(STRING)
	end
	drv = GetCurrentDrive()
	dir = "\" & GetCurrentDirectory(drv)
	if last char of dir <> "\"
		put "\" after dir
	end
	return expandString("%1:%2", drv, dir)
end


to get _ASYM_FindPathFile fName, path, bkPath
	DOSPath = false
	conditions
		when fName contains ":\" or chars 1 to 2 of fName is "\\"
			if ASYM_IsFile(fName)
				return fName
			else
				return null
			end
		when path is null
			linkDLL "TBDOS.DLL"
				STRING GetDosEnvironmentString(STRING)
			end
			DOSPath = true
			path = GetDosEnvironmentString("PATH")
			p = offset("=",path)
			if p > 0
				clear chars 1 to p of path
			end
	end
	p = offset(";", path)
	while p <> 0
		char p of path = ","
		p = offset(";", path)
	end

	if bkPath = null
		bkPath = pathOfFile(name of this book)
	end

	while path <> null
		pop path
		get ASYM_trim(it)
		if last char of it <> "\"
			put "\" after it
		end
		if not DOSPath
			if chars 1 to 2 of it is ".."
				get _ASYM_ExpandRelPath(it, bkPath)
			else
				if char 2 of it <> ":" and char 1 of it is not in ".\"
					put bkPath before it
				end
			end
		end
		testName = it & fName
		if ASYM_IsFile(testName)
			return testName
		else
			if ":" is not in it
				testName = bkPath & it & fName
				if ASYM_IsFile(testName)
					return testName
				end
			end
		end
	end while
	return null
end


to get _ASYM_FreeDiskSpace drspec
	local STRING oldDir
	clear sysError
	linkdll "tbcbt.dll"
		DWORD __ASYM_FreeDiskSpace = GetFreeDiskSpace(STRING)
	end
	if _ASYM_IsDirectory(drspec)
		oldDir = _ASYM_CurrentDirectory()
		get _ASYM_SetCurrentDirectory(drspec)
	end
	clear sysError
	r = __ASYM_FreeDiskSpace(char 1 of drspec)
	if oldDir <> null
		get _ASYM_SetCurrentDirectory(oldDir)
	end
	return r
end


to get _ASYM_GetPath pathName
	system _s_ASYM_PathCache[][]
	local word i

	get ASYM_BlockSuspend()
	cacheSize = item 1 of dimensions(_s_ASYM_PathCache)
	get ASYM_RestoreSuspend (it)
	if it = null and cacheSize > 0
		step i from 1 to cacheSize
			if _s_ASYM_PathCache[i][1] is pathName
				return _s_ASYM_PathCache[i][2]
			end
		end
	end
	linkDLL "tbwin.dll"
		STRING GetIniVar(STRING, STRING, STRING)
	end
	path = GetIniVar("Paths", pathName, ASYM_IniFile())
	if path <> null
		increment cacheSize
		_s_ASYM_PathCache[cacheSize][1]	= pathName
		_s_ASYM_PathCache[cacheSize][2]	= path
	end
	return path
end


to get _ASYM_IsDirectory dirspec
	linkDLL "tbdos.dll"
		STRING GetFileAttributes(STRING)
		STRING GetDirectoryOnlyListLFN(STRING,STRING)
	end

	if dirspec = NULL
		return FALSE
	end

	while last char of dirspec is "\" and charcount(dirspec) > 3
		clear last char of dirspec
	end

	gfa = GetFileAttributes(dirspec)

	conditions
	 when "D" is in gfa
		return TRUE

	 when gfa is NULL


		gdol = GetDirectoryOnlyListLFN(dirspec & "\*.*", NULL)
		if textline 1 of gdol = "."
			return TRUE
		end

	end

	return FALSE
end


to get _ASYM_RelativePath path, bkName
	if bkName <> null
		bkPath = pathOfFile(bkName)
		if offset(bkPath, path) = 1
			clear chars 1 to charcount(bkPath) of path
		end
	end
	return path
end


to get _ASYM_WindowsDirectory
	lpBuffer = ASYM_GetMemBlock (200)

	if lpBuffer = "0,0"
		sysErrorNumber = 13
		sysError = ASYM_GetString ("Not enough memory. Close other applications or save this book and try again.")
		return NULL
	end

	linkDLL "kernel"
		INT GetWindowsDirectory(POINTER,WORD)
	end
	get GetWindowsDirectory (lpBuffer,199)
	winDir = pointerString (0,lpBuffer)
	get ASYM_FreeMemBlock (lpBuffer)
	if winDir <> null and last char of winDir <> "\"
		put "\" after winDir
	end
	return winDir
end


to get _ASYM_IsAbsoluteFilePath pFileName
	retVal = FALSE
	if charCount(pFileName) > 2 then
		if (char 2 of pFileName = ":") or (chars 1 to 2 of pFileName = "\\") then
			retVal = TRUE
		end if
	end if
	return retVal
end


------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--Creates the passed directory, and any parent directories that don't
--already exist.
--Returns true if successful, false if not.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
to get _ASYM_RecurseCreateDirectory dir
	rv = false
	clear err
	if _ASYM_IsDirectory(dir) of self
		rv = true
	else
		get _ASYM_ParentDirectory(dir) of self
		if it is null
			err = ASYM_GetString("Invalid drive")
		else
			if _ASYM_RecurseCreateDirectory(it) of self
				if last char of dir is "\"
					clear last char of dir
				end
				get createDirectory(dir)
				if it = NULL
					linkDLL "tbdos.dll"
						INT createDirectory(STRING)
					end
					get createDirectory(dir)
				end
				conditions
				when it is 1	--success
					rv = true

				when it is -3	--invalid path
					err = ASYM_GetString("Invalid path")

				when it is -5	--access denied
					err = ASYM_GetString("Access denied")

				else
					err = ASYM_GetString("Unknown error")
					put " (" & it & ")" after err
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if err is not null
		sysError = expandString(ASYM_GetString("UnableToCreateDir", "Could not create directory ""%1"": %2."), \
		                        dir, err)
	end
	return rv
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--Returns the parent directory of the passed directory.  If passed directory
--is a root directory, returns null.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
to get _ASYM_ParentDirectory dir
	rv = dir
	if last char of rv is "\"
		clear last char of rv
	end
	while rv is not null and last char of rv is not "\"
		clear last char of rv
	end
	if rv is "\\"	--dir was root of a UNC drive
		clear rv
	end
	return rv
end

	if charCount(pFileName) > 2 then
		if (char 2 of pFileName = ":") or (chars 1 to 2 of pFileName = "\\") then
			retVal = TRUE
		end if
	end if
	return retVal
end


------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--Creates the passed directory, and any parent directories that don't
--already exist.
--Returns true if successful, false if not.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
to get _ASYM_RecurseCreateDirectory dir
	rv = false
	clear err
	if _ASYM_IsDirectory(dir) of self
		rv = true
	else
		get _ASYM_ParentDirectory(dir) of self
		if it is null
			err = ASYM_GetString("Invalid drive")
		else
			if _ASYM_RecurseCreateDirectory(it) of self
				if last char of dir is "\"
					clear last char of dir
				end
				get createDirectory(dir)
				if it = NULL
					linkDLL "tbdos.dll"
						INT createDirectory(STRING)
					end
					get createDirectory(dir)
				end
				conditions
				when it is 1	--success
					rv = true

				when it is -3	--invalid path
					err = ASYM_GetString("Invalid path")

				when it is -5	--access denied
					err = ASYM_GetString("Access denied")

				else
					err = ASYM_GetString("Unknown error")
					put " (" & it & ")" after err
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if err is not null
		sysError = expandString(ASYM_GetString("UnableToCreateDir", "Could not create directory ""%1"": %2."), \
		                        dir, err)
	end
	return rv
end


------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--Returns the parent directory of the passed directory.  If passed directory
--is a root directory, returns null.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
to get _ASYM_ParentDirectory dir
	rv = dir
	if last char of rv is "\"
		clear last char of rv
	end
	while rv is not null and last char of rv is not "\"
		clear last char of rv
	end
	if rv is "\\"	--dir was root of a UNC drive
		clear rv
	end
	return rv
end

--Returns desired segment of a full or partial path.

--		DISK			Returns the disk drive letter followed by a colon.
--		EXTENSION_ONLY	Returns the file extension, without the period.
--		FILENAME		Returns the filename with its file extension.
--		FILENAME_ONLY	Returns only the filename without its file extension.

-- 0x91f38  to get _ASYM_IsValidDrive path, retry, prompt
to get _ASYM_IsValidDrive path, retry, prompt
	linkDLL ASYM_ProductPrefix() & "dos.dll"
		STRING GetCDDriveList()
		STRING GetDriveList()
	end
	d = path
	if d contains ":"
		d = char 1 of d
	end
	if d is not in GetDriveList()
		return false
	end
	if d is in GetCDDriveList()
		while _ASYM_IsDriveReady(d) is false
			if retry is false
				return false
			end
			if prompt is null
				prompt = ASYM_GetString("Check the CD", \
						"Please verify that the CD is properly installed in the CD-ROM drive.")
			end
			get ASYM_MessageBox(prompt, null, "hand", "retryCancel")
			if it is not "retry"
				return false
			end
		end
	end
	return true
end


to get _ASYM_CurrentDirectory
	linkdll "tbdos.dll"
		STRING GetCurrentDrive()
		STRING GetCurrentDirectory(STRING)
	end
	drv = GetCurrentDrive()
	dir = "\" & GetCurrentDirectory(drv)
	if last char of dir <> "\"
		put "\" after dir
	end
	return expandString("%1:%2", drv, dir)
end


to get _ASYM_FindPathFile fName, path, bkPath
	DOSPath = false
	conditions
		when fName contains ":\" or chars 1 to 2 of fName is "\\"
			if ASYM_IsFile(fName)
				return fName
			else
				return null
			end
		when path is null
			linkDLL "TBDOS.DLL"
				STRING GetDosEnvironmentString(STRING)
			end
			DOSPath = true
			path = GetDosEnvironmentString("PATH")
			p = offset("=",path)
			if p > 0
				clear chars 1 to p of path
			end
	end
	p = offset(";", path)
	while p <> 0
		char p of path = ","
		p = offset(";", path)
	end

	if bkPath = null
		bkPath = pathOfFile(name of this book)
	end

	while path <> null
		pop path
		get ASYM_trim(it)
		if last char of it <> "\"
			put "\" after it
		end
		if not DOSPath
			if chars 1 to 2 of it is ".."
				get _ASYM_ExpandRelPath(it, bkPath)
			else
				if char 2 of it <> ":" and char 1 of it is not in ".\"
					put bkPath before it
				end
			end
		end
		testName = it & fName
		if ASYM_IsFile(testName)
			return testName
		else
			if ":" is not in it
				testName = bkPath & it & fName
				if ASYM_IsFile(testName)
					return testName
				end
			end
		end
	end while
	return null
end


to get _ASYM_FreeDiskSpace drspec
	local STRING oldDir
	clear sysError
	linkdll "tbcbt.dll"
		DWORD __ASYM_FreeDiskSpace = GetFreeDiskSpace(STRING)
	end
	if _ASYM_IsDirectory(drspec)
		oldDir = _ASYM_CurrentDirectory()
		get _ASYM_SetCurrentDirectory(drspec)
	end
	clear sysError
	r = __ASYM_FreeDiskSpace(char 1 of drspec)
	if oldDir <> null
		get _ASYM_SetCurrentDirectory(oldDir)
	end
	return r
end


to get _ASYM_GetPath pathName
	system _s_ASYM_PathCache[][]
	local word i

	get ASYM_BlockSuspend()
	cacheSize = item 1 of dimensions(_s_ASYM_PathCache)
	get ASYM_RestoreSuspend (it)
	if it = null and cacheSize > 0
		step i from 1 to cacheSize
			if _s_ASYM_PathCache[i][1] is pathName
				return _s_ASYM_PathCache[i][2]
			end
		end
	end
	linkDLL "tbwin.dll"
		STRING GetIniVar(STRING, STRING, STRING)
	end
	path = GetIniVar("Paths", pathName, ASYM_IniFile())
	if path <> null
		increment cacheSize
		_s_ASYM_PathCache[cacheSize][1]	= pathName
		_s_ASYM_PathCache[cacheSize][2]	= path
	end
	return path
end


to get _ASYM_IsDirectory dirspec
	linkDLL "tbdos.dll"
		STRING GetFileAttributes(STRING)
		STRING GetDirectoryOnlyListLFN(STRING,STRING)
	end

	if dirspec = NULL
		return FALSE
	end

	while last char of dirspec is "\" and charcount(dirspec) > 3
		clear last char of dirspec
	end

	gfa = GetFileAttributes(dirspec)

	conditions
	 when "D" is in gfa
		return TRUE

	 when gfa is NULL


		gdol = GetDirectoryOnlyListLFN(dirspec & "\*.*", NULL)
		if textline 1 of gdol = "."
			return TRUE
		end

	end

	return FALSE
end


to get _ASYM_RelativePath path, bkName
	if bkName <> null
		bkPath = pathOfFile(bkName)
		if offset(bkPath, path) = 1
			clear chars 1 to charcount(bkPath) of path
		end
	end
	return path
end


to get _ASYM_WindowsDirectory
	lpBuffer = ASYM_GetMemBlock (200)

	if lpBuffer = "0,0"
		sysErrorNumber = 13
		sysError = ASYM_GetString ("Not enough memory. Close other applications or save this book and try again.")
		return NULL
	end

	linkDLL "kernel"
		INT GetWindowsDirectory(POINTER,WORD)
	end
	get GetWindowsDirectory (lpBuffer,199)
	winDir = pointerString (0,lpBuffer)
	get ASYM_FreeMemBlock (lpBuffer)
	if winDir <> null and last char of winDir <> "\"
		put "\" after winDir
	end
	return winDir
end


to get _ASYM_IsAbsoluteFilePath pFileName
	retVal = FALSE
	if charCount(pFileName) > 2 then
		if (char 2 of pFileName = ":") or (chars 1 to 2 of pFileName = "\\") then
			retVal = TRUE
		end if
	end if
	return retVal
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--Returns desired segment of a full or partial path.
--	path	= path to parse
--	op		= operation:
--		DISK			Returns the disk drive letter followed by a colon.
--		EXTENSION_ONLY	Returns the file extension, without the period.
--		FILENAME		Returns the filename with its file extension.
--		FILENAME_ONLY	Returns only the filename without its file extension.
--		PATH			Returns the full disk drive and directory with no filename
--						(and with trailing backslash "\")
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
to get _ASYM_ParsePath path, op
	local STRING rv

	conditions
	when op = "DISK" or op = "DRIVE"
		if char 2 of path is ":"
			rv = chars 1 to 2 of path
		else
			clear rv
		end
	when op = "PATH"
		rv = ASYM_PathOfFile (path)
	else
		fileName = ASYM_ShortFileName (path)

		if op = "FILENAME"
			rv = fileName
		else
			dotPos = ASYM_FileDotPosition (fileName)

			conditions
			when op = "EXTENSION_ONLY"
				cc = charCount (fileName)
				if dotPos > 0 and dotPos < cc
					rv = chars dotPos + 1 to cc of fileName
				end
			when op = "FILENAME_ONLY"
				if dotPos = 0
					rv = fileName
				else
					rv = chars 1 to dotPos-1 of fileName
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return rv
end

-- Returns the position of the dot that seperates a file name from it's extension. If that dot
-- doesn't exist, returns 0.
to get ASYM_FileDotPosition fileName
	cc = charCount (fileName)
	pos = 0
	get offset (".", fileName)
	while it > 0 and it < cc
		pos = it
		get offset (".", chars it+1 to cc of fileName)
		if it > 0
			get pos + it
		end
	end

	-- It's not an extension if the dot is the first character of the file name, or the "extension"
	-- contains a space.
	if pos > 0 and (chars pos+1 to cc of fileName contains SPACE or pos = 1)
		pos = 0
	end

	return pos
end

	cc = charCount (fileName)
	pos = 0
	get offset (".", fileName)
	while it > 0 and it < cc
		pos = it
		get offset (".", chars it+1 to cc of fileName)
		if it > 0
			get pos + it
		end
	end

	-- It's not an extension if the dot is the first character of the file name, or the "extension"
	-- contains a space.
	if pos > 0 and (chars pos+1 to cc of fileName contains SPACE or pos = 1)
		pos = 0
	end

	return pos
end

	linkDLL "tbdlg.dll"
		INT itemOffset (STRING,STRING)
	end

	pos = itemOffset ("..", filePath)

		clear item pos - 1 of filePath
		pos = itemOffset ("..", filePath)

to get _ASYM_ConvertPathToList path
	-- converts a path to a list of directories for easier toolbook manipulation

	pos = offset ("\", path)
	while pos > 0
		char pos of path = ","

	end

	return path
end

to get _ASYM_ConvertListToPath pathList
	if pathList = NULL
		return NULL
	end

	pos = offset (",", pathList)
	while pos > 0
		char pos of pathList = "\"
		pos = offset (",", pathList)
	end

	return pathList
end

-- 0x92939  to get _ASYM_IsAbsoluteFilePath pFileName
to get _ASYM_IsAbsoluteFilePath pFileName
	retVal = FALSE
	if charCount(pFileName) > 2 then
		if (char 2 of pFileName = ":") or (chars 1 to 2 of pFileName = "\\") then
			retVal = TRUE
		end if
	end if
	return retVal
end


------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--Creates the passed directory, and any parent directories that don't
--already exist.
--Returns true if successful, false if not.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
to get _ASYM_RecurseCreateDirectory dir
	rv = false
	clear err
	if _ASYM_IsDirectory(dir) of self
		rv = true
	else
		get _ASYM_ParentDirectory(dir) of self
		if it is null
			err = ASYM_GetString("Invalid drive")
		else
			if _ASYM_RecurseCreateDirectory(it) of self
				if last char of dir is "\"
					clear last char of dir
				end
				get createDirectory(dir)
				if it = NULL
					linkDLL "tbdos.dll"
						INT createDirectory(STRING)
					end
					get createDirectory(dir)
				end
				conditions
				when it is 1	--success
					rv = true

				when it is -3	--invalid path
					err = ASYM_GetString("Invalid path")

				when it is -5	--access denied
					err = ASYM_GetString("Access denied")

				else
					err = ASYM_GetString("Unknown error")
					put " (" & it & ")" after err
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if err is not null
		sysError = expandString(ASYM_GetString("UnableToCreateDir", "Could not create directory ""%1"": %2."), \
		                        dir, err)
	end
	return rv
end


------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--Returns the parent directory of the passed directory.  If passed directory
--is a root directory, returns null.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
to get _ASYM_ParentDirectory dir
	rv = dir
	if last char of rv is "\"
		clear last char of rv
	end
	while rv is not null and last char of rv is not "\"
		clear last char of rv
	end
	if rv is "\\"	--dir was root of a UNC drive
		clear rv
	end
	return rv
end

------------------------------------------------------------------------------
--Returns desired segment of a full or partial path.
--	path	= path to parse
--	op		= operation:
--		DISK			Returns the disk drive letter followed by a colon.
--		EXTENSION_ONLY	Returns the file extension, without the period.
--		FILENAME		Returns the filename with its file extension.
--		FILENAME_ONLY	Returns only the filename without its file extension.
--		PATH			Returns the full disk drive and directory with no filename
--						(and with trailing backslash "\")
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
to get _ASYM_ParsePath path, op
	local STRING rv

	conditions
	when op = "DISK" or op = "DRIVE"
		if char 2 of path is ":"
			rv = chars 1 to 2 of path
		else
			clear rv
		end
	when op = "PATH"
		rv = ASYM_PathOfFile (path)
	else
		fileName = ASYM_ShortFileName (path)

		if op = "FILENAME"
			rv = fileName
		else
			dotPos = ASYM_FileDotPosition (fileName)

			conditions
			when op = "EXTENSION_ONLY"
				cc = charCount (fileName)
				if dotPos > 0 and dotPos < cc
					rv = chars dotPos + 1 to cc of fileName
				end
			when op = "FILENAME_ONLY"
				if dotPos = 0
					rv = fileName
				else
					rv = chars 1 to dotPos-1 of fileName
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return rv
end

-- Returns the position of the dot that seperates a file name from it's extension. If that dot
-- doesn't exist, returns 0.
to get ASYM_FileDotPosition fileName
	cc = charCount (fileName)
	pos = 0
	get offset (".", fileName)
	while it > 0 and it < cc
		pos = it
		get offset (".", chars it+1 to cc of fileName)
		if it > 0
			get pos + it
		end
	end

	-- It's not an extension if the dot is the first character of the file name, or the "extension"
	-- contains a space.
	if pos > 0 and (chars pos+1 to cc of fileName contains SPACE or pos = 1)
		pos = 0
	end

	return pos
end

	end
	return dir & fn
end

		end
		_s_ASYM_RRDInit = TRUE

		--do everything with short file names: faster
		get ASYM_GetShortFileName(dir,1)
		if it <> NULL
			dir = it
		end
	end

	ok = TRUE

	if not ASYM_IsDirectory(dir)
		sysError = ASYM_GetString("Directory does not exist")
		ok = FALSE
	else
		if last char of dir <> "\"
			put "\" after dir
		end

		sFiles = getFileOnlyList(dir & "*.*", NULL, NULL)
		cFiles = textlineCount(sFiles)

			sFile = dir & textline i of sFiles
			code = removeFile(sFile)
			if code <> 1
				err = ASYM_GetString("errCouldNotDeleteFile", \
					"Unable to delete file ""%1""." & \
					CRLF & CRLF & \
					"Reason: %2")

				ok = FALSE
				break step
			end
		end

			sDirs = getDirectoryOnlyList(dir & "*.*", NULL)
			cDirs = textlineCount(sDirs)

					if not ok

			clear last char of dir
			code = removeDirectory(dir)
			if code <> 1
				err = ASYM_GetString("errCouldNotDeleteDir", \
					"Unable to delete directory ""%1""." & \
					CRLF & CRLF & \

	end

			STRING getDirectoryOnlyList(STRING,STRING)
			INT removeFile(STRING)
			INT removeDirectory(STRING)
		end
		_s_ASYM_RRDInit = TRUE

		--do everything with short file names: faster
		get ASYM_GetShortFileName(dir,1)
		if it <> NULL
			dir = it
		end
	end

	ok = TRUE

	if not ASYM_IsDirectory(dir)
		sysError = ASYM_GetString("Directory does not exist")
		ok = FALSE
	else
		if last char of dir <> "\"
			put "\" after dir
		end

		sFiles = getFileOnlyList(dir & "*.*", NULL, NULL)
		cFiles = textlineCount(sFiles)
		step i from 1 to cFiles
			sFile = dir & textline i of sFiles
			code = removeFile(sFile)
			if code <> 1
				err = ASYM_GetString("errCouldNotDeleteFile", \
					"Unable to delete file ""%1""." & \
					CRLF & CRLF & \
					"Reason: %2")
				sysError = expandString(err, sFile, ASYM_TBDOSErrorString("removeFile", code))
				ok = FALSE
				break step
			end
		end

		if ok
			sDirs = getDirectoryOnlyList(dir & "*.*", NULL)
			cDirs = textlineCount(sDirs)
			step i from 1 to cDirs
				sDir = textline i of sDirs
				if (sDir is not in "..")	-- skip "." and ".."
					put dir before sDir
					ok = _ASYM_RecurseRemoveDirectory(sDir)
					if not ok
						break step
					end
				end
			end
		end

		if ok and "clearOnly" is not in options
			clear last char of dir
			code = removeDirectory(dir)
			if code <> 1
				err = ASYM_GetString("errCouldNotDeleteDir", \
					"Unable to delete directory ""%1""." & \
					CRLF & CRLF & \
					"Reason: %2")
				sysError = expandString(err, dir, ASYM_TBDOSErrorString("removeDirectory", code))
				ok = FALSE
			end
		end
	end

	if didInitHere
		sysCursor = sc
		clear _s_ASYM_RRDInit
	end

	return ok
end


to get _ASYM_FindMediaFile pFilename, pBook, pSearchHD, pSearchCD, pSearchHyperPath

	retVal = NULL

	if pFilename <> NULL

		refBook = pBook
		if (isObject(refBook) = false) or (object of refBook <> "book") then
			if object of target = "book" then
				refBook = target
			else
				refBook = objectContainer(target, "book")
			end if
		end if

		searchPath = NULL

		if pSearchHD = TRUE then
			put HDMediaPath of refBook & "," after searchPath
		end if

		if pSearchCD = TRUE then
			put CDMediaPath of refBook & "," after searchPath
		end if

		if pSearchHyperPath = TRUE then
			put ASYM_HyperPath(refBook) of refBook after searchPath
		end if

		while last char of searchPath = ","
			clear last char of searchPath
		end while

		searchPath = ASYM_ExpandMediaPath(searchPath, refBook)

		retVal = ASYM_FindPathFile(pFilename, searchPath)

	end if

	return retVal
end


to get _ASYM_ExpandMediaPath pPaths, pBook

	pathList = pPaths

	refBook = pBook
	if (isObject(refBook) = false) or (object of refBook <> "book") then
		if object of target = "book" then
			refBook = target
		else
			refBook = objectContainer(target, "book")
		end if
	end if

	bookPath = ASYM_PathOfFile(name of refBook)

	linkDLL "TBDOS.DLL"
		STRING getCDDriveList()
	end linkDLL
	CDDriveLetters = getCDDriveList()
	numDrives = textlineCount(CDDriveLetters)

	newPathList = NULL
	while pathList <> NULL
		pop pathList into mediaPath
		conditions
			when chars 1 to 10 of mediaPath = "<BookPath>"
				newPath = mediaPath
				clear chars 1 to 10 of newPath
				if first char of newPath = "\" then
					clear first char of newPath
				end if
				newPath = bookPath & newPath
				if last char of newPath <> "\" then
					put "\" after newPath
				end if
				if ASYM_ItemInList(newPath, newPathList) = false then
					put newPath & "," after newPathList
				end if

			when chars 1 to 7 of mediaPath = "<CDROM>"
				clear chars 1 to 7 of mediaPath
				if first char of mediaPath = "\" then
					clear first char of mediaPath
				end if

				clear newPath
				step i from 1 to numDrives
					thisCDDrive = first char of textline i of CDDriveLetters
					if mediaPath = NULL then
						newPath = thisCDDrive & ":\"
					else
						newPath = thisCDDrive & ":\" & mediaPath
						if last char of newPath <> "\" then
							put "\" after newPath
						end if
					end if
					if ASYM_ItemInList(newPath, newPathList) = false then
						put newPath & "," after newPathList
					end if
				end step

			else
				newPath = mediaPath
				if last char of newPath <> "\" then
					put "\" after newPath
				end if
				if ASYM_ItemInList(newPath, newPathList) = false then
					put newPath & "," after newPathList
				end if

		end conditions

	end while

	while last char of newPathList = ","

-- 0x9324a  to get _ASYM_AppendFileToPath dir, fn
to get _ASYM_AppendFileToPath dir, fn
	left = (last char of dir = "\")
	right = (first char of fn = "\")
	conditions
	when left and right
		clear first char of fn
	when not left and not right
		put "\" after dir
	end
	return dir & fn
end


to get _ASYM_ExpandRelPath otherPath, rootPath
	if last char of rootPath <> "\"
		put "\" after rootPath
	end
	while first char of otherPath = "\"
		clear first char of otherPath
	end

	return ASYM_ResolvePath (rootPath & otherPath)
end


to get _ASYM_ResolvePath filePath
	filePath = ASYM_ConvertPathToList (filePath)

	linkDLL "tbdlg.dll"
		INT itemOffset (STRING,STRING)
	end

	pos = itemOffset ("..", filePath)
	while pos > 1
		clear item pos of filePath
		clear item pos - 1 of filePath
		pos = itemOffset ("..", filePath)
	end

	return ASYM_ConvertListToPath (filePath)
end

to get _ASYM_ConvertPathToList path
	-- converts a path to a list of directories for easier toolbook manipulation
	-- first item is drive letter, or null if no drive letter

	pos = offset ("\", path)
	while pos > 0
		char pos of path = ","
		pos = offset ("\", path)
	end

	return path
end

to get _ASYM_ConvertListToPath pathList
	if pathList = NULL
		return NULL
	end

	pos = offset (",", pathList)
	while pos > 0
		char pos of pathList = "\"
		pos = offset (",", pathList)
	end

	return pathList
end


to get _ASYM_RecurseRemoveDirectory dir, options
	system _s_ASYM_RRDInit
	local LOGICAL didInitHere

	--initialize if we haven't already
	if _s_ASYM_RRDInit <> TRUE
		sc = sysCursor
		sysCursor = 4

		didInitHere = TRUE
		linkDLL "tbdos.dll"
			STRING getFileOnlyList(STRING,STRING,STRING)
			STRING getDirectoryOnlyList(STRING,STRING)
			INT removeFile(STRING)
			INT removeDirectory(STRING)
		end
		_s_ASYM_RRDInit = TRUE

		--do everything with short file names: faster
		get ASYM_GetShortFileName(dir,1)
		if it <> NULL
			dir = it
		end
	end

	ok = TRUE

	if not ASYM_IsDirectory(dir)
		sysError = ASYM_GetString("Directory does not exist")
		ok = FALSE
	else
		if last char of dir <> "\"
			put "\" after dir
		end

		sFiles = getFileOnlyList(dir & "*.*", NULL, NULL)
		cFiles = textlineCount(sFiles)
		step i from 1 to cFiles
			sFile = dir & textline i of sFiles
			code = removeFile(sFile)
			if code <> 1
				err = ASYM_GetString("errCouldNotDeleteFile", \
					"Unable to delete file ""%1""." & \
					CRLF & CRLF & \
					"Reason: %2")
				sysError = expandString(err, sFile, ASYM_TBDOSErrorString("removeFile", code))
				ok = FALSE
				break step
			end
		end

		if ok
			sDirs = getDirectoryOnlyList(dir & "*.*", NULL)
			cDirs = textlineCount(sDirs)
			step i from 1 to cDirs
				sDir = textline i of sDirs
				if (sDir is not in "..")	-- skip "." and ".."
					put dir before sDir
					ok = _ASYM_RecurseRemoveDirectory(sDir)
					if not ok
						break step
					end
				end
			end
		end

		if ok and "clearOnly" is not in options
			clear last char of dir
			code = removeDirectory(dir)
			if code <> 1
				err = ASYM_GetString("errCouldNotDeleteDir", \
					"Unable to delete directory ""%1""." & \
					CRLF & CRLF & \
					"Reason: %2")
				sysError = expandString(err, dir, ASYM_TBDOSErrorString("removeDirectory", code))
				ok = FALSE
			end
		end
	end

	if didInitHere
		sysCursor = sc
		clear _s_ASYM_RRDInit
	end

	return ok
end

					"Unable to delete file ""%1""." & \
					CRLF & CRLF & \
					"Reason: %2")
				sysError = expandString(err, sFile, ASYM_TBDOSErrorString("removeFile", code))
				ok = FALSE
				break step
			end
		end

		if ok
			sDirs = getDirectoryOnlyList(dir & "*.*", NULL)
			cDirs = textlineCount(sDirs)
			step i from 1 to cDirs
				sDir = textline i of sDirs
				if (sDir is not in "..")	-- skip "." and ".."
					put dir before sDir
					ok = _ASYM_RecurseRemoveDirectory(sDir)
					if not ok
						break step
					end
				end
			end
		end

		if ok and "clearOnly" is not in options
			clear last char of dir
			code = removeDirectory(dir)
			if code <> 1
				err = ASYM_GetString("errCouldNotDeleteDir", \
					"Unable to delete directory ""%1""." & \
					CRLF & CRLF & \
					"Reason: %2")
				sysError = expandString(err, dir, ASYM_TBDOSErrorString("removeDirectory", code))
				ok = FALSE
			end
		end
	end

	if didInitHere
		sysCursor = sc
		clear _s_ASYM_RRDInit
	end

	return ok
end


to get _ASYM_FindMediaFile pFilename, pBook, pSearchHD, pSearchCD, pSearchHyperPath

	retVal = NULL

	if pFilename <> NULL

		refBook = pBook
		if (isObject(refBook) = false) or (object of refBook <> "book") then
			if object of target = "book" then
				refBook = target
			else
				refBook = objectContainer(target, "book")
			end if
		end if

		searchPath = NULL

		if pSearchHD = TRUE then
			put HDMediaPath of refBook & "," after searchPath
		end if

		if pSearchCD = TRUE then
			put CDMediaPath of refBook & "," after searchPath
		end if

		if pSearchHyperPath = TRUE then
			put ASYM_HyperPath(refBook) of refBook after searchPath
		end if

		while last char of searchPath = ","
			clear last char of searchPath
		end while

		searchPath = ASYM_ExpandMediaPath(searchPath, refBook)

		retVal = ASYM_FindPathFile(pFilename, searchPath)

	end if

	return retVal
end


to get _ASYM_ExpandMediaPath pPaths, pBook

	pathList = pPaths

	refBook = pBook
	if (isObject(refBook) = false) or (object of refBook <> "book") then
		if object of target = "book" then
			refBook = target
		else
			refBook = objectContainer(target, "book")
		end if
	end if

	bookPath = ASYM_PathOfFile(name of refBook)

	linkDLL "TBDOS.DLL"
		STRING getCDDriveList()
	end linkDLL
	CDDriveLetters = getCDDriveList()
	numDrives = textlineCount(CDDriveLetters)

	newPathList = NULL
	while pathList <> NULL
		pop pathList into mediaPath
		conditions
			when chars 1 to 10 of mediaPath = "<BookPath>"
				newPath = mediaPath
				clear chars 1 to 10 of newPath
				if first char of newPath = "\" then
					clear first char of newPath
				end if
				newPath = bookPath & newPath
				if last char of newPath <> "\" then
					put "\" after newPath
				end if
				if ASYM_ItemInList(newPath, newPathList) = false then
					put newPath & "," after newPathList
				end if

			when chars 1 to 7 of mediaPath = "<CDROM>"
				clear chars 1 to 7 of mediaPath
				if first char of mediaPath = "\" then
					clear first char of mediaPath
				end if

				clear newPath
				step i from 1 to numDrives
					thisCDDrive = first char of textline i of CDDriveLetters
					if mediaPath = NULL then
						newPath = thisCDDrive & ":\"
					else
						newPath = thisCDDrive & ":\" & mediaPath
						if last char of newPath <> "\" then
							put "\" after newPath
						end if
					end if
					if ASYM_ItemInList(newPath, newPathList) = false then
						put newPath & "," after newPathList
					end if
				end step

			else
				newPath = mediaPath
				if last char of newPath <> "\" then
					put "\" after newPath
				end if
				if ASYM_ItemInList(newPath, newPathList) = false then
					put newPath & "," after newPathList
				end if

		end conditions

	end while

	while last char of newPathList = ","
		clear last char of newPathList
	end while

	return newPathList
end


to get _ASYM_FileRelativeToMedia pFilename, pBook, pSearchHD, pSearchCD, pSearchHyperPath

	retVal = pFilename

	if pFilename <> NULL

		filename = pFilename

		refBook = pBook
		if (isObject(refBook) = false) or (object of refBook <> "book") then
			if object of target = "book" then
				refBook = target
			else
				refBook = objectContainer(target, "book")
			end if
		end if

		searchPath = NULL

		if pSearchHD = TRUE then
			put HDMediaPath of refBook & "," after searchPath
		end if

		if pSearchCD = TRUE then
			put CDMediaPath of refBook & "," after searchPath
		end if

		if pSearchHyperPath = TRUE then
			put ASYM_HyperPath(refBook) of refBook after searchPath
		end if

		while last char of searchPath = ","
			clear last char of searchPath
		end while

		searchPath = ASYM_ExpandMediaPath(searchPath, refBook)

		while searchPath <> NULL
			pop searchPath into thisPath
			pathLen = charCount(thisPath)
			if chars 1 to pathLen of filename = thisPath then
				clear chars 1 to pathLen of filename
				retVal = filename
				break while
			end if
		end while

	end if

	return retVal
end

to get _ASYM_PromptForCDROM pFilename, pMessage, pCaption
	retVal = NULL
	if pFilename <> NULL

		continueCheck = TRUE
		while continueCheck

			retVal = ASYM_FindFileOnCDROM(pFilename)

			if retVal <> NULL
				-- We found a CD with the file
				continueCheck = FALSE

			else
				-- Keep looking
				msgTxt = pMessage
				if msgTxt = NULL
					msgTxt = ASYM_GetString("msgPromptForCDROM", \
							"ToolBook was unable to locate a CDROM containing the file:" & \
							CRLF & CRLF & \
							"%1" & \
							CRLF & CRLF & \
							"Insert the appropriate CDROM and press Retry, or press Cancel.")
					msgTxt = expandString(msgTxt, pFilename)
				end if

				msgCaption = pCaption
				if pCaption = NULL then
					msgCaption = ASYM_GetString("msgCapPromptForCDROM", \
							"Insert CDROM")
				end if

				ret = ASYM_MessageBox(msgTxt, msgCaption, "INFO", "RetryCancel")

				if ret = "retry"
					get ASYM_Wait(3000)
				else
					continueCheck = FALSE
				end if

			end if

		end while

	end if

	return retVal
end

to get _ASYM_FindFileOnCDROM pFilename
	retVal = NULL
	if pFilename <> NULL

		linkDLL "TBDOS.DLL"
			STRING getCDDriveList()
		end linkDLL
		CDList = getCDDriveList()
		numDrives = textlineCount(CDList)

		step i from 1 to numDrives
			filename = first char of textline i of CDList & ":\" & pFilename
			if ASYM_IsFile(filename) = TRUE
				retVal = filename
				break step
			end if
		end step

	end if
	return retVal
end

-- ASYM_PathOfFile version to handle URLs
to get

-- 0x93577  to get _ASYM_RecurseRemoveDirectory dir, options
to get _ASYM_RecurseRemoveDirectory dir, options
	system _s_ASYM_RRDInit
	local LOGICAL didInitHere

	--initialize if we haven't already
	if _s_ASYM_RRDInit <> TRUE
		sc = sysCursor
		sysCursor = 4

		didInitHere = TRUE
		linkDLL "tbdos.dll"
			STRING getFileOnlyList(STRING,STRING,STRING)
			STRING getDirectoryOnlyList(STRING,STRING)
			INT removeFile(STRING)
			INT removeDirectory(STRING)
		end
		_s_ASYM_RRDInit = TRUE

		--do everything with short file names: faster
		get ASYM_GetShortFileName(dir,1)
		if it <> NULL
			dir = it
		end
	end

	ok = TRUE

	if not ASYM_IsDirectory(dir)
		sysError = ASYM_GetString("Directory does not exist")
		ok = FALSE
	else
		if last char of dir <> "\"
			put "\" after dir
		end

		sFiles = getFileOnlyList(dir & "*.*", NULL, NULL)
		cFiles = textlineCount(sFiles)
		step i from 1 to cFiles
			sFile = dir & textline i of sFiles
			code = removeFile(sFile)
			if code <> 1
				err = ASYM_GetString("errCouldNotDeleteFile", \
					"Unable to delete file ""%1""." & \
					CRLF & CRLF & \
					"Reason: %2")
				sysError = expandString(err, sFile, ASYM_TBDOSErrorString("removeFile", code))
				ok = FALSE
				break step
			end
		end

		if ok
			sDirs = getDirectoryOnlyList(dir & "*.*", NULL)
			cDirs = textlineCount(sDirs)
			step i from 1 to cDirs
				sDir = textline i of sDirs
				if (sDir is not in "..")	-- skip "." and ".."
					put dir before sDir
					ok = _ASYM_RecurseRemoveDirectory(sDir)
					if not ok
						break step
					end
				end
			end
		end

		if ok and "clearOnly" is not in options
			clear last char of dir
			code = removeDirectory(dir)
			if code <> 1
				err = ASYM_GetString("errCouldNotDeleteDir", \
					"Unable to delete directory ""%1""." & \
					CRLF & CRLF & \
					"Reason: %2")
				sysError = expandString(err, dir, ASYM_TBDOSErrorString("removeDirectory", code))
				ok = FALSE
			end
		end
	end

	if didInitHere
		sysCursor = sc
		clear _s_ASYM_RRDInit
	end

	return ok
end

to get _ASYM_TempDir
	linkDLL32 "kernel32.dll"
		DWORD GetTempPathA(INT,POINTER32)
		POINTER32 GlobalAllocPointer32 = GlobalAlloc(DWORD,DWORD)
		DWORD GlobalFreePointer32 = GlobalFree(POINTER32)
	end

	lpBuffer32 = GlobalAllocPointer32(0,1024)

	if lpBuffer32 = "0,0"
		sysErrorNumber = 13
		sysError = ASYM_GetString ("Not enough memory. Close other applications or save this book and try again.")
		return NULL
	end

	get GetTempPathA(1023,lpBuffer32)

	tmpDir = pointerString32(0,lpBuffer32)

	get GlobalFreePointer32(lpBuffer32)

	if tmpDir <> null and last char of tmpDir <> "\"
		put "\" after tmpDir
	end

	return tmpDir
end

	CDDriveLetters = getCDDriveList()
	numDrives = textlineCount(CDDriveLetters)

	newPathList = NULL
	while pathList <> NULL
		pop pathList into mediaPath
		conditions
			when chars 1 to 10 of mediaPath = "<BookPath>"
				newPath = mediaPath
				clear chars 1 to 10 of newPath
				if first char of newPath = "\" then
					clear first char of newPath
				end if
				newPath = bookPath & newPath
				if last char of newPath <> "\" then
					put "\" after newPath
				end if
				if ASYM_ItemInList(newPath, newPathList) = false then
					put newPath & "," after newPathList
				end if

			when chars 1 to 7 of mediaPath = "<CDROM>"
				clear chars 1 to 7 of mediaPath
				if first char of mediaPath = "\" then
					clear first char of mediaPath
				end if

				clear newPath
				step i from 1 to numDrives
					thisCDDrive = first char of textline i of CDDriveLetters
					if mediaPath = NULL then
						newPath = thisCDDrive & ":\"
					else
						newPath = thisCDDrive & ":\" & mediaPath
						if last char of newPath <> "\" then
							put "\" after newPath
						end if
					end if
					if ASYM_ItemInList(newPath, newPathList) = false then
						put newPath & "," after newPathList
					end if
				end step

			else
				newPath = mediaPath
				if last char of newPath <> "\" then
					put "\" after newPath
				end if
				if ASYM_ItemInList(newPath, newPathList) = false then
					put newPath & "," after newPathList
				end if

		end conditions

	end while

	while last char of newPathList = ","
		clear last char of newPathList
	end while

	return newPathList
end


to get _ASYM_FileRelativeToMedia pFilename, pBook, pSearchHD, pSearchCD, pSearchHyperPath

	retVal = pFilename

	if pFilename <> NULL

		filename = pFilename

		refBook = pBook
		if (isObject(refBook) = false) or (object of refBook <> "book") then
			if object of target = "book" then
				refBook = target
			else
				refBook = objectContainer(target, "book")
			end if
		end if

		searchPath = NULL

		if pSearchHD = TRUE then
			put HDMediaPath of refBook & "," after searchPath
		end if

		if pSearchCD = TRUE then
			put CDMediaPath of refBook & "," after searchPath
		end if

		if pSearchHyperPath = TRUE then
			put ASYM_HyperPath(refBook) of refBook after searchPath
		end if

		while last char of searchPath = ","
			clear last char of searchPath
		end while

		searchPath = ASYM_ExpandMediaPath(searchPath, refBook)

		while searchPath <> NULL
			pop searchPath into thisPath
			pathLen = charCount(thisPath)
			if chars 1 to pathLen of filename = thisPath then
				clear chars 1 to pathLen of filename
				retVal = filename
				break while
			end if
		end while

	end if

	return retVal
end

to get _ASYM_PromptForCDROM pFilename, pMessage, pCaption
	retVal = NULL
	if pFilename <> NULL

		continueCheck = TRUE
		while continueCheck

			retVal = ASYM_FindFileOnCDROM(pFilename)

			if retVal <> NULL
				-- We found a CD with the file
				continueCheck = FALSE

			else
				-- Keep looking
				msgTxt = pMessage
				if msgTxt = NULL
					msgTxt = ASYM_GetString("msgPromptForCDROM", \
							"ToolBook was unable to locate a CDROM containing the file:" & \
							CRLF & CRLF & \
							"%1" & \
							CRLF & CRLF & \
							"Insert the appropriate CDROM and press Retry, or press Cancel.")
					msgTxt = expandString(msgTxt, pFilename)
				end if

				msgCaption = pCaption
				if pCaption = NULL then
					msgCaption = ASYM_GetString("msgCapPromptForCDROM", \
							"Insert CDROM")
				end if

				ret = ASYM_MessageBox(msgTxt, msgCaption, "INFO", "RetryCancel")

				if ret = "retry"
					get ASYM_Wait(3000)
				else
					continueCheck = FALSE
				end if

			end if

		end while

	end if

	return retVal
end

to get _ASYM_FindFileOnCDROM pFilename
	retVal = NULL
	if pFilename <> NULL

		linkDLL "TBDOS.DLL"
			STRING getCDDriveList()
		end linkDLL
		CDList = getCDDriveList()
		numDrives = textlineCount(CDList)

		step i from 1 to numDrives
			filename = first char of textline i of CDList & ":\" & pFilename
			if ASYM_IsFile(filename) = TRUE
				retVal = filename
				break step
			end if
		end step

	end if
	return retVal
end

-- ASYM_PathOfFile version to handle URLs
to get _ASYM_PathOfFile pPath
	retVal = pPath
	while (retVal <> NULL) and not (last char of retVal is in "\/:")
		clear last char of retVal
	end while
	return retVal
end


-- ASYM_ShortFileName version to handle URLs
to get _ASYM_ShortFileName pPath
	tmp = pPath
	retVal = NULL
	while (tmp <> NULL) and not (last char of tmp is in "\/:")
		put last char of tmp before retVal
		clear last char of tmp
	end while
	return retVal
end

to get _ASYM_TempDir
	linkDLL32 "kernel32.dll"
		DWORD GetTempPathA(INT,POINTER32)
		POINTER32 GlobalAllocPointer32 = GlobalAlloc(DWORD,DWORD)
		DWORD GlobalFreePointer32 = GlobalFree(POINTER32)
	end

	lpBuffer32 = GlobalAllocPointer32(0,1024)

	if lpBuffer32 = "0,0"
		sysErrorNumber = 13
		sysError = ASYM_GetString ("Not enough memory. Close other applications or save this book and try again.")
		return NULL
	end

	get GetTempPathA(1023,lpBuffer32)

	tmpDir = pointerString32(0,lpBuffer32)

	get GlobalFreePointer32(lpBuffer32)

	if tmpDir <> null and last char of tmpDir <> "\"
		put "\" after tmpDir
	end

	return tmpDir
end

-- 0x9487f  to get _AskStudentName prompt
to get _AskStudentName prompt
	local nam
	if prompt is null
		prompt = ASYM_GetStandardString("<askStudentName>","")
	end
	do
		cap = ASYM_GetString("Application Login")
		retVal = ASYM_Ask(cap,prompt,"question",null,null,300)
		get textline 2 of retVal

		nam = ASYM_Trim(it)
		if nam is null
			get ASYM_GetStandardString("<NameRequiredToContinue>","")
			if it is not in prompt
				put it & crlf before prompt
			end
		else
			break do
		end
	until false

	return nam
end

to handle _ASYM_CollectLogResponseData sep

	local LOGICAL passSkip

	totalScore = 0
	totalMax = 0
	passSkip = (includeSkip <> true)
	if sep is null
		sep = tab
	end

	colNames = ASYM_GetString("LogColNames", \
			"Question%1Score%1Max Score%1Locked%1Tries used%1Max Tries%1" & \
			"Time used%1Max Time%1Last response")
	colNames = expandString(colNames, sep)
	get ASYM_LogWriteEntry(colNames & CRLF)

	step i from 1 to pageCount of this book
		pg = page i of this book
		if passSkip and skipNavigation of pg
			continue step
		end
		widList = ASYM_CollectWidgets(pg)
		while widList <> null
			pop widList into obj
			if ASYM_WID_IsScored of obj = true

				s = ASYM_WID_Score(null ,TRUE) of obj
				m = ASYM_WID_MaxScore of obj

				if isType(REAL,s) and isType(REAL,m)
					increment totalScore by s
					increment totalMax by m
				end
			end
			if ASYM_WID_IsScored of obj = true
				noUpdate = TRUE
				QStatus = ASYM_QuestionStatus(obj, null, null, true) of obj
				push ASYM_NameOrID(obj) onto QStatus

				LastThing = items 9 to itemcount(QStatus) of QStatus
				clear items 9 to itemcount(QStatus) of QStatus

				if sep <> ","
					p = offset(",",Qstatus)
					while p > 0
						char p of QStatus = sep
						p = offset(",",Qstatus)
					end
				end
				put sep & LastThing & CRLF after Qstatus

				get ASYM_LogWriteEntry(QStatus)
			end
		end
	end

	if sep = TAB
		logTxt = ASYM_GetString("Total_Score_<totalScore>_<totalMax>", \
				"Total%1Score%1%2%1%3" & CRLF)
		logTxt = expandString(logTxt, sep, totalScore, totalMax)
		get ASYM_LogWriteEntry(logTxt)
	end

end

to get _ASYM_LogDispatchDirectory LogDest

	conditions
	when LogDest is null
		return null

	when LogDest is "<ask>"
		prompt = ASYM_GetStandardString("<LogFileDirPrompt>", "Log File Directory:")
		path = ASYM_GetPath("Ask Logs")
		while last char of path is "\"
			clear last char of path
		end
		do
			temp = ASYM_CurrentDirectory()
			path = lowerCase (ASYM_ChooseDirectoryDlg (prompt,path))
			get ASYM_SetCurrentDirectory(temp)
			if path is null
				cancelStr = ASYM_GetStandardString("<CancelSession>","")
				request ASYM_GetStandardString("<MustSpecifyLogDirectory>","") \
				  	with "&OK" or "&" & cancelStr
				if cancelStr is in it
					return "<exit>"
				end
			else
				if (not ASYM_isdirectorywriteable(path)) or (not isRoomOnDisk(char 1 of path))
						msgTxt = ASYM_GetStandardString("<CannotWriteLogToThisDirectory>", "")
						msgTxt = expandString(msgTxt, path)
						msgCaption = ASYM_GetString("Logging")
						get ASYM_MessageBox(msgTxt, msgCaption, "WARNING", "OK")
				else
					if last char of path <> "\"
						put "\" after path
					end
					get ASYM_SetPath("Ask Logs", path)
					break do
				end
			end
		until false -- or path is null
		result = path

	when LogDest is "<sameDir>"
	when LogDest is "<bookDir>"

		return ASYM_PathOfFile(name of this book)

	when LogDest is "<iniDir>"

		result = ASYM_WindowsDirectory()

	when LogDest is "<email>"
		ss= sysSuspend;sysSuspend = false;clear sysError
		linkdll "mapi.dll"
			DWORD MAPILogoff (DWORD, DWORD, DWORD, DWORD)
		end
		sysSuspend = ss
		if sysError <> null or GetIniVar("mail","mapi","win.ini") <> 1
			msgTxt = ASYM_GetStandardString("<MAPINotFound>", "")
			msgTxt = expandString(msgTxt, ASYM_TempDir())
			msgCaption = SPACE
			get ASYM_MessageBox(msgTxt, msgCaption, "WARNING", "OK")
		end
		result = ASYM_TempDir()

	when LogDest is "<TempDir>"
		result = ASYM_TempDir()

	when LogDest is "<CMS>"
		result = ASYM_TempDir()

	when LogDest is "<fax>"
		get _ASYM_FindFax() of page "Fax" of objectContainer(self,"book")
		result = ASYM_TempDir()

	when LogDest is "<floppy>"
		linkDLL "TBDOS.dll"
			STRING GetDriveList()
			STRING GetDriveKind(STRING)
		end
		Drives = GetDriveList()
		okStr = ASYM_GetStandardString("<OK>", "OK")
		escStr = ASYM_GetStandardString("<CancelLog>", "Cancel Log")
		conditions
		when drives contains "A" and drives contains "B"
			do
				request ASYM_GetStandardString("<ChooseFloppy>","") \
				  with "&A:" or "&B:"
				if "A:" is in it or "B:" is in it
					c = char 1 of it
					result = c & ":"
					tryStr = ASYM_GetStandardString("<TryDrive>","")
					while not (ASYM_isdirectorywriteable(result) and isRoomOnDisk(c))
						get ASYM_GetStandardString("<CheckFloppyDrive>","")
						request ASYM_ExpandString(it, c & ":")\
				  		  with okStr or tryStr or escStr
						conditions
						when it contains okStr
							mmyield
							continue while
						when it contains tryStr
							mmyield
							continue do
						else
							result = null
							break while
						end
					end
					break do
				end
			until result = null
		when drives contains "A"
			result = "A:\"
		when drives contains "B"
			result = "B:\"
		else
			result = null
		end
		if result <> null
			c = upperCase(char 1 of result)
			while not (ASYM_isdirectorywriteable(c & ":\") and isRoomOnDisk(c))
				get ASYM_GetStandardString("<CheckFloppyDrive>","")

				mmYield

				request ASYM_ExpandString(it, c & ":")\
				  with okStr or escStr
				if okStr is not in it
					clear result
					break while
				end
				mmyield
			end
		end
	else
		system s_ASYM_LogDir
		result = s_ASYM_LogDir
	end
	if result <> null and (not isRoomOnDisk(char 1 of result))
		clear result
	end

	if result is not null and dest is in "<email>,<fax>,<printer>"
		get CheckDOSMemForLog() of page "log dispatch" of objectContainer(self,"book")
	end

	if result <> null and last char of result <> "\"
		put "\" after result
	end
	return result
end

to get _ASYM_LogStart bk, fName, logAppend, encryptIt, dest, typ, CMSLogFileName, CMSLogFileType

  	system s_ASYM_LogFileName, s_ASYM_LogHeading, \
  	  s_ASYM_LogEncrypt, s_ASYM_LogDest, s_ASYM_LogStartTime,\
  	  s_ASYM_LogType, s_ASYM_UserName, s_ASYM_BookIsScored,\
  	  s_ASYM_LogEncryptKey,_s_CMS_ModuleLogInfo

  	if bk is null
  		in ASYM_WorkWindow()
  			bk = this book
  		end
  	end
  	if fName <> null
  		if ":" is not in fName
  			fName = _ASYM_MakeLogFileName(dest, fName)
  			if fName is "<exit>"
  				return fName
  			end
  		end
  		logAppend = (logAppend is true or logAppend is "append")
  	end

  	if fName is null
  		fName = _ASYM_MakeLogFileName(dest)
  		logAppend = false
  	end

  	pwVerString = "[version4]"

  	s_ASYM_LogEncrypt = (encryptIt = true)
  	if s_ASYM_LogEncrypt
  		s_ASYM_LogEncryptKey = ASYM_LogEncryptKey of bk
  	end

  	if s_ASYM_LogEncryptKey is null
  		s_ASYM_LogEncryptKey = pwVerString & \
  			MakeKeyedPasswordEX("Sesame", 0x07000001)
  	end

  	sysSuspend = false; clear sysError
  	if logAppend and ASYM_IsFile(fName)
  		if not s_ASYM_LogEncrypt
		 	openFile fName
		 	writeFile (CRLF & "===========================================" & CRLF) to fName
		 	closeFile fName
		 end
  	else
  		if s_ASYM_LogEncrypt
  			get s_ASYM_LogEncryptKey

  			p = offset(pwVerString, it)
  			if p = 1
  				clear chars 1 to charCount(pwVerString) of it
  				get ASYM_CreateEncryptedFileEx(fName, it, 0x07000001)
  			else
	  			get ASYM_CreateEncryptedFile(fName, s_ASYM_LogEncryptKey)
	  		end
	  	else
  			createFile fName
	  		closeFile fName
	  	end
  	end
  	sysSuspend = true
  	if

						request ASYM_ExpandString(it, c & ":")\
				  		  with okStr or tryStr or escStr
						conditions
						when it contains okStr
							mmyield
							continue while
						when it contains tryStr
							mmyield
							continue do
						else
							result = null
							break while
						end
					end
					break do
				end
			until result = null
		when drives contains "A"
			result = "A:\"
		when drives contains "B"
			result = "B:\"
		else
			result = null
		end
		if result <> null
			c = upperCase(char 1 of result)
			while not (ASYM_isdirectorywriteable(c & ":\") and isRoomOnDisk(c))
				get ASYM_GetStandardString("<CheckFloppyDrive>","")

				mmYield

				request ASYM_ExpandString(it, c & ":")\
				  with okStr or escStr
				if okStr is not in it
					clear result
					break while
				end
				mmyield
			end
		end
	else
		system s_ASYM_LogDir
		result = s_ASYM_LogDir
	end
	if result <> null and (not isRoomOnDisk(char 1 of result))
		clear result
	end

	if result is not null and dest is in "<email>,<fax>,<printer>"
		get CheckDOSMemForLog() of page "log dispatch" of objectContainer(self,"book")
	end

	if result <> null and last char of result <> "\"
		put "\" after result
	end
	return result
end

to get _ASYM_LogDispatchDirectory LogDest

	conditions
	when LogDest is null
		return null

	when LogDest is "<ask>"
		prompt = ASYM_GetStandardString("<LogFileDirPrompt>", "Log File Directory:")
		path = ASYM_GetPath("Ask Logs")
		while last char of path is "\"
			clear last char of path
		end
		do
			temp = ASYM_CurrentDirectory()
			path = lowerCase (ASYM_ChooseDirectoryDlg (prompt,path))
			get ASYM_SetCurrentDirectory(temp)
			if path is null
				cancelStr = ASYM_GetStandardString("<CancelSession>","")
				request ASYM_GetStandardString("<MustSpecifyLogDirectory>","") \
				  	with "&OK" or "&" & cancelStr
				if cancelStr is in it
					return "<exit>"
				end
			else
				if (not ASYM_isdirectorywriteable(path)) or (not isRoomOnDisk(char 1 of path))
						msgTxt = ASYM_GetStandardString("<CannotWriteLogToThisDirectory>", "")
						msgTxt = expandString(msgTxt, path)
						msgCaption = ASYM_GetString("Logging")
						get ASYM_MessageBox(msgTxt, msgCaption, "WARNING", "OK")
				else
					if last char of path <> "\"
						put "\" after path
					end
					get ASYM_SetPath("Ask Logs", path)
					break do
				end
			end
		until false -- or path is null
		result = path

	when LogDest is "<sameDir>"
	when LogDest is "<bookDir>"

		return ASYM_PathOfFile(name of this book)

	when LogDest is "<iniDir>"

		result = ASYM_WindowsDirectory()

	when LogDest is "<email>"
		ss= sysSuspend;sysSuspend = false;clear sysError
		linkdll "mapi.dll"
			DWORD MAPILogoff (DWORD, DWORD, DWORD, DWORD)
		end
		sysSuspend = ss
		if sysError <> null or GetIniVar("mail","mapi","win.ini") <> 1
			msgTxt = ASYM_GetStandardString("<MAPINotFound>", "")
			msgTxt = expandString(msgTxt, ASYM_TempDir())
			msgCaption = SPACE
			get ASYM_MessageBox(msgTxt, msgCaption, "WARNING", "OK")
		end
		result = ASYM_TempDir()

	when LogDest is "<TempDir>"
		result = ASYM_TempDir()

	when LogDest is "<CMS>"
		result = ASYM_TempDir()

	when LogDest is "<fax>"
		get _ASYM_FindFax() of page "Fax" of objectContainer(self,"book")
		result = ASYM_TempDir()

	when LogDest is "<floppy>"
		linkDLL "TBDOS.dll"
			STRING GetDriveList()
			STRING GetDriveKind(STRING)
		end
		Drives = GetDriveList()
		okStr = ASYM_GetStandardString("<OK>", "OK")
		escStr = ASYM_GetStandardString("<CancelLog>", "Cancel Log")
		conditions
		when drives contains "A" and drives contains "B"
			do
				request ASYM_GetStandardString("<ChooseFloppy>","") \
				  with "&A:" or "&B:"
				if "A:" is in it or "B:" is in it
					c = char 1 of it
					result = c & ":"
					tryStr = ASYM_GetStandardString("<TryDrive>","")
					while not (ASYM_isdirectorywriteable(result) and isRoomOnDisk(c))
						get ASYM_GetStandardString("<CheckFloppyDrive>","")
						request ASYM_ExpandString(it, c & ":")\
				  		  with okStr or tryStr or escStr
						conditions
						when it contains okStr
							mmyield
							continue while
						when it contains tryStr
							mmyield
							continue do
						else
							result = null
							break while
						end
					end
					break do
				end
			until result = null
		when drives contains "A"
			result = "A:\"
		when drives contains "B"
			result = "B:\"
		else
			result = null
		end
		if result <> null
			c = upperCase(char 1 of result)
			while not (ASYM_isdirectorywriteable(c & ":\") and isRoomOnDisk(c))
				get ASYM_GetStandardString("<CheckFloppyDrive>","")

				mmYield

				request ASYM_ExpandString(it, c & ":")\
				  with okStr or escStr
				if okStr is not in it
					clear result
					break while
				end
				mmyield
			end
		end
	else
		system s_ASYM_LogDir
		result = s_ASYM_LogDir
	end
	if result <> null and (not isRoomOnDisk(char 1 of result))
		clear result
	end

		get CheckDOSMemForLog() of page "log dispatch" of objectContainer(self,"book")
	end

to get _ASYM_LogStop

  	system s_ASYM_LogFileName, s_ASYM_LogDest, s_ASYM_LogTimes,\
  	  s_ASYM_LogStats, s_ASYM_LogStartTime, s_ASYM_LogType, s_ASYM_BookIsScored

  	local ElapsedTime
	oldCursor = _ASYM_SysCursor()
	sysCursor = 4
	result = false

  	if s_ASYM_LogFileName <> null

		logTimes = s_ASYM_LogTimes
		s_ASYM_LogTimes = null

		if isType(DWORD,s_ASYM_LogStartTime)
			ElapsedTime = ASYM_TicksToTime(ASYM_Ticks() - s_ASYM_LogStartTime)
		end

		in ASYM_WorkWindow()
			bookName = ASYM_CMS_BookName()
			if bookName is null
				bookName = name of this book
			end
			courseName = ASYM_CMS_CourseName()
			if courseName is null
				courseName = Info_Title of this book
			end
		end

		conditions
		when s_ASYM_LogType is "ResponseData"

  			-- Trigger the call that will collect all scores
  			if elapsedTime is null
  				timeStamp = 0 & tab & 0 & tab & 0
  			else
  				timeStamp = elapsedTime
  				p = offset(":", timeStamp)
  				while p > 0
  					char p of timeStamp = tab
	  				p = offset(":", timeStamp)
  				end
  			end
  			get ASYM_LogWriteEntry(\
  		      ASYM_GetString("SESSION END") & tab\
  		      & ASYM_GetString("SUMMARY") & tab & timestamp & CRLF)

  			send _ASYM_CollectLogResponseData

  		else

	  		get ASYM_LogWriteEntry(\
  		      CRLF & ASYM_GetString("LogSessionEnd","---- SESSION END ----")\
  		      && sysTime & CRLF)

  			if isType(DWORD,s_ASYM_LogStartTime)
  				get ASYM_LogWriteEntry(ASYM_GetString("Total session time:")\
  				  && ElapsedTime & CRLF)
  			end

	  		if s_ASYM_BookIsScored is true
	  			score = ASYM_CollectTotalScore() of this book
	  			if itemCount(score) = 2 and item 2 of score > 0
	  				score = item 1 of score & "/" & item 2 of score
	  			else
	  				score = ASYM_GetString("No scored objects found")
	  			end

	  			get ASYM_LogWriteEntry(ASYM_GetString("Final Score:") && score & CRLF)
	  		end

	  		if s_ASYM_LogStats is true
		  		get ASYM_LogWriteEntry(\
  		      	CRLF & ASYM_GetString("LogFinalQStatus",\
  		      	"---- FINAL TEST ITEM STATUS ----") & CRLF)

	  			send _ASYM_CollectLogResponseData ","
	  		end

	  		get ASYM_LogWriteEntry(CRLF & ASYM_GetString("LogEnd",\
	  		  "---- LOG END ----") & CRLF)
	  	end

		s_ASYM_LogTimes = logTimes

  		if s_ASYM_LogDest is null
  			s_ASYM_LogDest = ASYM_LogDestination of this book
  		end

  		send _ASYM_LogDispatch s_ASYM_LogFileName, s_ASYM_LogDest,\
  		  ASYMI_EmailLogList of this book, bookName, courseName \
  		  to page "Log Dispatch" of objectContainer(self,"book")

		clear s_ASYM_LogFileName

		result = true

  	end
	if oldCursor <> null
		sysCursor = oldCursor
	else
		sysCursor = 1
	end
	return result

end

to get _ASYM_LogTypeComboValues
	return ASYM_GetString("ComboLogTypes",\
		"<none>,None" & CRLF &\
		"transcript,Full session transcript" & CRLF &\
		"responseData,Tab-separated response data")

to get _ASYM_MakeLogFileName dest, logFn

	if char 1 of dest is "<"
		dest = _ASYM_LogDispatchDirectory(dest)
		if dest is "<exit>"
			return dest
		end
	end

	if ASYM_IsDirectory(dest) or \
	  (charcount(dest) = 3 and (chars 2 to 3 of dest is ":\" or chars 1 to 2 of dest is "\\"))
		path = dest
	else
		path = ASYM_GetPath("Log")
	end

	if ASYM_Is32Bit()
		path = ASYM_GetShortFileName(path, 1)
	end

	if path is null
		path = ASYM_WindowsDirectory()
	end
	if logFn is null or logFn is "auto" or logFn is "<auto>"
		logFn = "LOG00000.LOG"
		n = 0
		do
			increment n
			format number n as "00000"
			chars 4 to 8 of logFn = n
		until not ASYM_IsFile(path & logFn)
	end
	return path & logFn
end

	linkDLL ASYM_ProductPrefix() &
