	system s_ASYM_LogHeading, s_ASYM_LogPages, s_ASYM_LogTimes, s_ASYM_LogAnswers, s_ASYM_LogOnLock, s_ASYM_LogStats

	s_ASYM_LogHeading = heading
	s_ASYM_LogPages = (logPages = true)
	if logTimes <> null
		ltf = logTimes & ""
		get sysTime
		sysSuspend = false
		clear sysError

		format time it as ltf

		sysSuspend = true
		if sysError is null
			s_ASYM_LogTimes = ltf
		else
			s_ASYM_LogTimes = sysTimeFormat
		end
	else
		clear s_ASYM_LogTimes
	end
	s_ASYM_LogAnswers = (logAnswers = true)
	s_ASYM_LogOnLock = (logOnLock = true)
	s_ASYM_LogStats = (logStats = true)
  	return true
end


to get _ASYM_LogStatus
 	system s_ASYM_LogFileName

  	if s_ASYM_LogFileName <> null
  		linkDLL "tbdos.dll"
  			LONG GetFileSize(STRING)
  		end
  		if ASYM_IsFile(s_ASYM_LogFileName)
  			get GetFileSize(s_ASYM_LogFileName)
  			push s_ASYM_LogFileName onto it
  			return it
  		else
  			clear s_ASYM_LogFileName
  		end
  	end
	return null
end

to get _ASYM_decode source, password, ver
	if "_ASYM_decrypt" is not in linkedFunctions("tbcbt.dll")
		linkDLL "tbcbt.dll"
			STRING _ASYM_decrypt = decrypt(STRING,STRING)
			STRING _ASYM_decryptEX = decryptEX(STRING,STRING,DWORD)
		end
	end
	if ver is NULL
		ver = 0x07000001
	end
	return _ASYM_decryptEX(source, password,ver)
end

-- 0x96e23  to get _ASYM_decode source, password, ver

to handle _ASYM_Reset targetRef, mode, pResetTargetPage
	SYSTEM s_ASYM_ResetOnSave
	LOCAL LOGICAL oldLock
	LOCAL STACK objList, fld

	oldLock = lockscreen of this window
	lockscreen of this window = TRUE
	oType = object of targetRef
	qType = ASYM_WID_QType of targetRef
	oldError = sysError

	in ASYM_WorkWindow()
		c = syscursor
		syscursor = 4

		if oType = "button"
			if ASYMI_AutoSize of targetRef = true and (caption of targetRef = NULL or captionPosition of targetRef = "center")
				send sizeButtonToGraphic targetRef
			end
			if ASYMI_UseRollover of targetRef = true and _swapped of targetRef = true and objectFromPoint (mousePosition of targetWindow, targetWindow) <> targetRef
				get normalGraphic of targetRef
				normalGraphic of targetRef = checkedGraphic of targetRef
				checkedGraphic of targetRef = it
				clear _swapped of targetRef
			end
		end

		conditions
		when oType is "page"
			push ASYM_FindField("Feedback", targetRef) onto fld
			push ASYM_FindField("Score", targetRef) onto fld
		when qType <> null
			pg = objectContainer(targetRef, "page")
			push ASYM_FindField("Feedback", pg) onto fld
			push ASYM_FindField("Score", pg) onto fld
		end
		while fld is not null
			pop fld
			if it is not null
				if text of it <> null
					clear text of it
				end
			end
		end

		conditions
		when oType = page
			pgClean = not ASYM_IsObjectDirty (targetRef, "htmlExport")
			bgClean = not ASYM_IsObjectDirty (parent of targetRef, "htmlExport")

			clear ASYM_BeenHere of targetRef
			clear ASYM_Done of targetRef
			clear ASYM_TimingStarted of targetRef
			objList = ASYM_CollectWidgets(targetRef)
			step i from 1 to itemcount(objList)
				pop objList into obj
				if ASYM_WID_QType of obj is in "MATCHOBJ,MATCHITEM,MULTIOBJ,SELTEXT"
					if targetRef <> this page
						go to targetRef
					end
				end

				if mode = "READER" and ASYM_WID_ReadyToRun of obj = TRUE
					send ASYM_Reset null, targetRef to obj
				else
					send ASYM_Reset mode, targetRef to obj
				end

			end
			if sysOpenMedia <> NULL
				mmClose all
			end

			-- meant page was being reset for author level.
			if mode = "reader" or (mode = null and sysLevel = "reader")
				get ASYM_SetObjectClean (targetRef, "reset")
				get ASYM_SetObjectClean (parent of targetRef, "reset")
			end

			if pgClean
				get ASYM_SetObjectClean(targetRef, "htmlExport")
			end
			if bgClean
				get ASYM_SetObjectClean(parent of targetRef, "htmlExport")
			end

		when qType <> NULL
			send _ASYM_ResetTestItem qType, mode, targetRef
			send _ASYM_ResetResponseData to targetRef

		when tbk_wid_name of targetRef = "BeenHere"
		when tbk_wid_type of targetRef = "BeenHere"
			ASYM_BeenHere of targetRef = false
			checked of targetRef = false
			invert of targetRef = false

		when tbk_wid_name of targetRef = "BeenThere"
		when tbk_wid_type of targetRef = "BeenThere"
			checked of targetRef = false
			invert of targetRef = false

		when oType = "book" or oType = "background"
			s_ASYM_ResetOnSave =(sysLevel is AUTHOR and mode is "reader")
			lockscreen of this window = TRUE
			pg = this page
			oldSys = syssuspendmessages
			syssuspendmessages = TRUE
			step i from 1 to pageCount of targetRef
				caption of statusBar = expandString(ASYM_GetString("Resetting page x","Resetting page %1"),i)
				if isObject(page i of targetRef)
					tPage = page i of targetRef
					-- If we're resetting to reader level, only reset if the page has changed since
					-- the last time it was reset for reader level.
					readerReset = ((mode = "reader") or (mode = null and sysLevel = "reader"))
					if not readerReset or ASYM_IsPageDirty (tPage, "reset")
						send ASYM_Reset mode, tPage to tPage
					end
				end
			end
			clear caption of statusBar
			if pg <> this page
				go to pg
			end
			lockscreen of this window = FALSE
			syssuspendmessages = oldSys
			if oType is background
				if parent of this page = targetRef
					tPage = this page
				else
					tPage = first page of targetRef
				end
				objList = ASYM_CollectWidgets(targetRef)
				step i from 1 to itemcount(objList)
					pop objList into obj
					send ASYM_Reset mode, tPage to obj
				end
			end
			clear s_ASYM_ResetOnSave
		end
		syscursor = c
	end
	lockscreen of this window = oldLock
	sysError = oldError
end

to handle _ASYM_ResetPgWidgets msg
	system s__tb80r_fbcmd
	SYSTEM s_cbtr_LastQ
	LOCAL LOGICAL resetFlag
	local fbArray[][]
	local STACK widList, QList, OtherList

	clear s__tb80r_fbcmd -- Feedback recursion trap

	clear s_cbtr_LastQ

	if "tb80a.sbk" is not in parent of targetWindow
  		widList = ASYM_CollectWidgets()

		while widList <> null
			pop widList into obj
			if ASYM_WID_QType of obj <> null
				push obj onto QList
			else
				push obj onto OtherList
			end
		end

		resetFlag = FALSE

		-- reset questions first

		while QList <> null

			pop QList into obj

			if syslevel is author
				-- auto upgrade of version 3.0 widgets

				ss = sysSuspend;sysSuspend=false;clear sysError
				fbArray = ASYM_WID_SummaryFeedback of obj
				sysSuspend = ss
				if sysError <> null
					-- This might be a 3.0 widget that has summary feedback in main array
					clear sysError
					get _upgrade3SummaryFeedback(obj) of page\
					  "test item feedback" of parent of parent of self
				end
			end

			get ASYM_WID_AutoReset of obj

			conditions
			when it is TRUE
			when it is not null and it is msg
			when it is "always"
			when sysLevel = "author"

				if msg = "enterPage" and sysLevel = "author"
					send ASYM_Reset "author" to obj
				else
					if sysLevel = "reader"
						send ASYM_Reset msg to obj
					else
						send ASYM_Reset "check" to obj
					end
				end
				resetFlag = TRUE
			end

			if sysLevel is reader\
			  and msg = "enterPage"\
			  and ASYM_WID_QType of obj <> null\
			  and ASYM_WID_TimeMax of obj <> NULL \
			  and ASYM_WID_TimeMax of obj <> 0

			  	pg = objectContainer(obj,"page,background")
				if ASYM_BeenHere of pg = TRUE and ASYM_TimingStarted of pg = TRUE
					get ASYM_WID_TimeStart of obj
					if it is null or it = -1
						get ASYM_Ticks()
						ASYM_WID_TimeStart of obj = it
					end
					ASYM_WID_TimeUsed of obj = ASYM_Ticks() - it
					if ASYM_WID_TimeUsed of obj >= ASYM_WID_TimeMax of obj
						ASYM_WID_AnswerLocked of obj = TRUE
						if ASYM_WID_TimeLocked of obj = NULL
							ASYM_WID_TimeLocked of obj = TRUE
							in ASYM_WorkWindow()
	 							send ASYM_QLocked obj,"enter page" to this page
	 						end
						end
					end

				else

					ASYM_TimingStarted of pg = TRUE
					ASYM_WID_TimeUsed of obj = 0
					clear ASYM_WID_TimeLocked of obj
					ASYM_WID_TimeStart of obj = ASYM_Ticks()
					resetFlag = TRUE
				end
			end
		end

		-- now other stuff like timers that watch questions

		while OtherList <> null
			pop OtherList into obj
			get ASYM_WID_AutoReset of obj

			conditions
			when it is TRUE
			when it is not null and it is msg
			when it is "always"
			when sysLevel = "author"
				if msg = "enterPage" and sysLevel = "author"
					send ASYM_Reset "author" to obj
				else
					if sysLevel is "reader"
						send ASYM_Reset msg to obj
					else
						send ASYM_Reset "check" to obj
					end
				end
				resetFlag = TRUE
			end
		end

		if resetFlag
			oldSys = sysError
			fld = ASYM_FindField ("Feedback")
			if fld <> NULL
				clear text of fld
			end
			fld = ASYM_FindField ("Score")
			if fld <> NULL
				clear text of fld
			end
			sysError = oldSys
		end

 		-- reset buttons with special properties
		obList = getObjectList (this page, "button", false)
		get getObjectList (this background, "button", false)
		push it onto obList
		while obList <> NULL
			pop obList into obj
			if ASYMI_UseRollover

to handle sizeButtonToGraphic obj
	get normalGraphic of obj
	if it <> NULL
		get resourceInfo of it
		bs = borderStyle of obj
		conditions
		when bs = "commandButton" or bs = "pushButton" or bs = "shadowed"
			get item 2 of it + 5, item 3 of it + 5
		when bs = "none"
			get item 2 of it - 1, item 3 of it - 1
		when bs = "rectangle"
			get item 2 of it + 1, item 3 of it + 1
		else
			get item 2 of it, item 3 of it
		end
		ssm = sysSuspendMessages
		sysSuspendMessages = true
		size of obj = clientToPageUnits (it)
		sysSuspendMessages = ssm
	end
end

to handle _ASYM_Locked _target
	LOCAL ansArray[][]

	if ASYM_WID_AnswerLocked of _target = FALSE
		send ASYM_QLocked _target, ASYM_WID_Responses() of _target to target
	end

	ASYM_WID_AnswerLocked of _target = TRUE
	QType = ASYM_WID_QType of _target
	conditions
	when QType = "TRUEFALSE"
	when QType = "MULTICHOICE"
	when QType = "MATCHITEM"
		_locked of objects of _target = TRUE

	when QType = "MULTIDROP"
	when QType = "MATCHOBJ"
	when QType = "MULTIOBJ"
		_locked of _responseList of _target = TRUE

	when QType = "TYPEIN"
	when QType = "NAMEPART"
		_locked of _target = TRUE

	when QType = "ORDEROBJ"
		ansArray = ASYM_WID_AnsArray of _target
		step i from 1 to item 1 of dimensions(ansArray)
			if isObject(ansArray[i][1])
				_locked of ansArray[i][1] = TRUE
			end
		end
	end
end


to handle _ASYM_ResetRespData _target

	ASYM_WID_AnswerLocked of _target = FALSE
	ASYM_WID_ResponseIDs of _target = NULL
	ASYM_WID_TimeStart of _target = ASYM_Ticks()
	ASYM_WID_TimeUsed of _target = 0
	ASYM_WID_TriesUsed of _target = 0
	ASYM_WID_TimeChosen of _target = 0
	clear ASYM_WID_LastScore of _target
	clear ASYM_WID_HintsUsed of _target
	clear ASYM_WID_TimeLocked of _target
	if not isType(REAL,ASYM_WID_TriesMax of _target)
		ASYM_WID_TriesMax of _target = 0
	end
	if not isType(REAL,ASYM_WID_TimeMax of _target)
		ASYM_WID_TimeMax of _target = 0
	end
	if _openClip of _target <> NULL and isObject(_openClip of _target) and mmStatus of _openClip of _target <> "CLOSED"
		mmClose _openClip of _target
		clear _openClip of _target
	end
	clear _responseText of _target
end

					clear _lineRef of obj

			end

		when QType = "MULTIDROP"
			sBuffer = _responseList of _target
			step i from 1 to itemcount(sBuffer)

				get _position of obj
				if it <> NULL
					move obj to it
					clear _position of obj
				end
				get _layer of obj
				if it <> NULL
					layer of obj = it
					clear _layer of obj
				end
				clear _locked of obj
			end

			targetObj = ASYM_WID_TargetObject of _target
			if targetObj = "<self>"
				targetObj = _target
			else
				tBuffer = targetObj && "of" && objParent
				if isObject(tBuffer)
					targetObj = tBuffer
				else
					targetObj = NULL
				end
			end

			if targetObj <> NULL
				objList = getObjectList(_target,"",FALSE)
				if objList = NULL

to handle _ASYM_ResetTestItem QType, mode, _target
	SYSTEM s_ASYM_ResetOnSave
	LOCAL ARRAY	ansArray[][]
	LOCAL STACK sBuffer
	LOCAL STRING tBuffer
	LOCAL OBJECT objParent

	if not ASYM_HasAnsArray(_target)
		send _fixAnsArray _target

		if sysLevel = "author" and s_ASYM_ResetOnSave <> TRUE

		end
	end

	conditions
		when QType = "TRUEFALSE"
		when QType is "MULTICHOICE"
			send ASYM_QuestionLoad mode, 1, _target
			send ASYM_WID_Chosen (objects of _target), FALSE to _target
			clear _locked of objects of _target

		when QType is "MULTIOBJ"
			sBuffer = _responseList of _target
			step i from 1 to itemcount(sBuffer)
				pop sBuffer into obj
				if _lineRef of obj <> NULL
					tBuffer = _lineRef of obj
					if isObject(tBuffer)
						select tBuffer
						send clear
					end
					clear _lineRef of obj
				end
				clear _locked of obj
			end

		when QType = "MULTIDROP"
			sBuffer = _responseList of _target
			step i from 1 to itemcount(sBuffer)
				pop sBuffer into obj
				get _position of obj
				if it <> NULL
					move obj to it
					clear _position of obj
				end
				get _layer of obj
				if it <> NULL
					layer of obj = it
					clear _layer of obj
				end
				clear _locked of obj
			end

			targetObj = ASYM_WID_TargetObject of _target
			if targetObj = "<self>"
				targetObj = _target
			else
				tBuffer = targetObj && "of" && objParent
				if isObject(tBuffer)
					targetObj = tBuffer
				else
					targetObj = NULL
				end
			end

			if targetObj <> NULL
				objList = getObjectList(_target,"",FALSE)
				if objList = NULL
					objList = _target
				end
				if targetObj = _target
					defaultAllowDrop of objList = TRUE
				else
					defaultAllowDrop of objList = FALSE
					defaultAllowDrop of targetObj = TRUE
				end
			end

			if false -- make draggable automatically may interfere with other objects

				ansArray = ASYM_WID_AnsArray of _target

				step i from 1 to item 1 of dimensions(ansArray)
					nam = ansArray[i][1]
					if nam is "<else>"
						break step
					end
					if quote is not in nam
						objs = ASYM_ObjectsWhere(this page,null,\
						  "name of it is" && quote & nam & quote)
						if objs <> null
							ASYM_Draggable of objs = true
							_position of objs = null
							step j from 1 to itemCount(objs)
								obj = item j of objs

								if ASYM_WID_ResetPosition of obj <> NULL and \
								  mode <> "check" and mode <> "afterEdit"
									position of obj = ASYM_WID_ResetPosition of obj
								else

									ASYM_WID_ResetPosition of obj = position of obj
								end
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end

		when QType = "ORDERTEXT"
			ansArray = ASYM_WID_AnsArray of _target
			if itemcount(objects of _target) > 1
				_dragField of _target = last item of objects of _target
			else
				_dragField of _target = _target
			end
			_dragField = _dragField of _target

			conditions
				when mode = "check"
				when mode = "reader"
					-- Only do this if we're really switching from author state
					if _ASYM_Randomized of _target <> true

						tBuffer = text of _dragField
						ASYM_WID_SortByWord of _target = not (textlinecount(tBuffer) > 1)

						ansArray[1][1] = tBuffer
						ASYM_WID_AnsArray of _target = ansArray
					end

					_ASYM_Randomized of _target = true

				when mode = "author"
				when mode = "afterEdit"
					clear text of _dragField
					text of _dragField = ansArray[1][1]
					_ASYM_Randomized of _target = false
			end

			if textlinecount(text of _dragField) > 1
				fieldType of _dragField = singleSelect
			else
				fieldType of _dragField = wordWrap
			end


			resetMode = ASYM_WID_AutoReset of _target

			conditions
				when mode = "author"
				when mode = "check"
				when mode = "afterEdit"
					resetQ = FALSE

				when mode = "reader"
				when mode = null

					resetQ = TRUE

				when resetMode = NULL
					resetQ = FALSE

				when resetMode = "always"
				when resetMode = "leavePage" and mode = "leavePage"
				when resetMode = "enterPage" and mode = "enterPage"
					resetQ = TRUE

				else
					resetQ = FALSE
			end conditions

			if resetQ = FALSE
				break conditions
			end

			clear tBuffer
			clear sBuffer
			clear text of _dragField
			if ASYM_WID_SortByWord of _target <> "TRUE"
				maxCount = textlinecount(ansArray[1][1])
				answerList = ASYM_RandomList(maxCount)
				step i from 1 to maxCount
					whatItem = item i of answerList
					put textline whatItem of ansArray[1][1]&CRLF after tBuffer
				end
				clear last char of tBuffer;  clear last char of tBuffer
			else
				maxCount = wordCount(ansArray[1][1])
				answerList = ASYM_RandomList(maxCount)
				step i from 1 to maxCount
					whatItem = item i of answerList
					put word whatItem of ansArray[1][1]&SPACE after tBuffer
				end
				clear last char of tBuffer
			end
			text of _dragField = tBuffer

		when QType = "SLIDER"
			ASYM_WID_AnswerLocked of _target = FALSE
			if ASYM_WID_Randomize of _target is TRUE
				a = sliderMin of _target
				b = sliderMax of _target
				get ((random(10000) / 10000) * (b - a)) + a
				sliderPos of _target = it
				_lastPos of _target = it
			else
				if resetPosition of _target <> NULL
					sliderPos of _target = resetPosition of _target
					_lastPos of _target = resetPosition of _target
				end
			end

		when QType = "TYPEIN"
			if object of _target = hotword
				NBS = ansiToChar(160)
				myText = NULL
				step i from 1 to min(32000,ASYM_WID_MaxChars of _target)
					put NBS after myText
				end
				text of _target = myText
				spot = textOffset of _target
				fontStyle of chars spot to spot+(charcount(myText))-1 of text of parent of _target = underline,bold
			else
				clear text of _target
			end
			clear _locked of _target
			clear _responseText of _target

		when QType = "NAMEPART"
			if (ASYM_ResetPosition of _target = NULL or mode = "reader" or mode = "check") and s_ASYM_ResetOnSave <> "TRUE"
				ASYM_ResetPosition of _target = position of _target
			end
			move _target

-- 0x9a334  to get _ASYM_ShortReference obj
to get _ASYM_ShortReference obj
	get offset(" of book",obj)
	if it > 0
		get chars 1 to it-1 of obj
		if isObject(obj) and not isObject(it)
			return obj
		end
		return it
	else
		return obj
	end
end

to get _ASYM_ShowDialog whatViewer, whatPage, whatCaption, whatMode
	ss = sysSuspend; sysSuspend = false; clear sysError
	v = viewer whatViewer
	sysSuspend = ss
	if sysError = null
		if isOpen of v

			request ASYM_ExpandString(ASYM_GetString("ViewerInUse",\
			  "Viewer %1 is already in use."),whatViewer)\
			  with ASYM_GetStandardString("<Continue>","") \
			  or ASYM_GetStandardString("<Cancel>","")
			if IT <> ASYM_GetStandardString("<Continue>","")
				return FALSE
			else
				if isOpen of v
					close v
				end
			end
		end
		if isObject("page" && whatPage)
			whatPage = page whatPage
			defaultPage of v = whatPage
			caption of v = whatCaption
			conditions
				when whatMode = "modal"
					show v as modal
				when whatMode = "notActive"
					show v as notActive
				else
					show v
			end
			clear defaultPage of v
			return TRUE
		end
	end
	return FALSE
end

to handle _fixAnsArray obj
	LOCAL ARRAY ansArray[][]

	conditions
		when QType = "TRUEFALSE"
		when QType = "MULTICHOICE"
		when QType = "MULTIOBJ"
		when QType = "MATCHITEM"
			objList = objects of obj
			maxCount = itemCount(objList)
		when QType = "MATCHOBJ"
		when QType = "MULTIDROP"
		when QType = "ORDERTEXT"
		when QType = "ORDEROBJ"
		when QType = "SLIDER"
		when QType = "TYPEIN"
		when QType = "NAMEPART"
			maxCount = 1
	end

	step i from 1 to maxCount
		ansArray[i][1] = NULL
	end
	ASYM_WID_AnsArray of obj = ansArray
end

to handle ASYM_QuestionLoad mode, index, _target
	LOCAL STACK	objList, answerList, distractorList
	LOCAL WORD 	maxCount, numCorrect, numAnswers, howMany, i
	LOCAL ARRAY	ansArray[][], temp[][]

	objList = objects of _target
	if objList = NULL
		break ASYM_QuestionLoad
	end

	ansArray = ASYM_WID_AnsArray of _target
	answerList = NULL
	clear _locked of objList
	maxCount = itemCount(objList)
	maxIndex = item 1 of dimensions(ansArray)
	numCorrect = 0
	if index = NULL; index = 1;end

	conditions
		when  maxIndex > maxCount
			step i from 1 to maxIndex
				if ansArray[i][10] = TRUE
					increment numCorrect
				else
					push i onto answerList
				end
			end

			howMany = max(0,maxCount - numCorrect)
			distractorList = ASYM_RandomList(howMany, answerList)
			answerList = NULL
			step i from maxIndex to 1 by -1
				if ansArray[i][10] = TRUE
					push i onto answerList
				else
					if distractorList <> NULL
						pop distractorList
						push IT onto answerList
					end
				end
			end

		when maxIndex < maxCount
			if mode = "afterEdit"
				NoStr = ASYM_GetStandardString("<No>","")
				request ASYM_GetString("RemoveExtraQObjects",\
				  "There are more objects in the question than defined answers."\
				  && "Do you want the extra objects removed?") \
				  with "&" & ASYM_GetStandardString("<Yes>","") or "&" & NoStr
				if NoStr is not in it
					step i from item 1 of dimensions(ansArray)+1 to maxCount
						select item i of objList
						send clear
					end
					selection = NULL
					selection = _target
				else
					step i from maxIndex+1 to maxCount
						ansArray[i][1] = NULL
					end
				end
			else
				step i from maxIndex+1 to maxCount
					ansArray[i][1] = NULL
				end
			end
			objList = objects of _target
			maxCount = itemCount(objList)
			maxIndex = item 1 of dimensions(ansArray)
			step i from maxCount to 1 by -1
				push i onto answerList
			end
		else
			step i from maxCount to 1 by -1
				push i onto answerList
			end
	end

	conditions

		when mode = "check" and ansArray[1][16] is null
		when mode = "reader" and ansArray[1][16] is null

			step i from 1 to maxCount
				whatObj = item i of objList
				whatItem = layer of whatObj
				name of whatObj = whatItem
				isChangedText = FALSE

				conditions

					when object of whatObj = button\
					  and ansArray[whatItem][index] <> caption of whatObj

						newText = caption of whatObj
						isChangedText = TRUE

					when object of whatObj = field\
					  and ansArray[whatItem][index] <> text of whatObj

						newText = text of whatObj
						isChangedText = TRUE

				end conditions

				if isChangedText
					if mode is "check" and debug of this page is true
						get nothing
					end

					if newText = NULL
						newText = ASYM_GetString("Empty item tag","<empty>")
					end
					ansArray[whatItem][index] = newText

				end
			end

		when mode = "author"
		when mode = "check"
		when mode = "afterEdit"

			step i from 1 to maxCount

				ansArray[i][16] = null

				whatObj = item i of objList
				name of whatObj = i
				clear _locked of whatObj

				conditions

					when object of whatObj = button
						caption of whatObj = ansArray[i][index]

					when object of whatObj = field

						text of whatObj = ansArray[i][index]
						_caption of whatObj = ansArray[i][index]

					else

						_caption of whatObj = ansArray[i][index]

				end

			end
	end

	if itemOffset(mode,"author,check,afterEdit") = 0

		if ASYM_WID_Randomize of _target = TRUE
			answerList = ASYM_RandomList(maxCount, answerList)
		end

		step i from 1 to maxCount

			whatItem = item i of answerList

			ansArray[i][16] = whatItem
			whatObj = item i of objList
			name of whatObj = whatItem

			conditions

				when object of whatObj = button
					caption of whatObj = ansArray[whatItem][index]

				when object of whatObj = field
					text of whatObj = ansArray[whatItem][index]
					_caption of whatObj = ansArray[whatItem][index]

				else
					_caption of whatObj = ansArray[whatItem][index]
			end

		end

	end
	ASYM_WID_AnsArray of _target = ansArray

end

				push i onto answerList
			end

			end

		end

-- 0x9af2b  to handle ASYM_Reset
to handle ASYM_Reset
	myBook = objectContainer(self,"book")

	-- ensure if reset, that we delete all duplicate pages
	vRef = viewer "askReqDialog" of myBook
	defaultPage of vRef = "page askRequest"
	if isOpen of vRef
		close vRef
	end

	pageList = pages of self

	-- we need to keep one copy of this page
	pop pageList

	-- but remember to clear the icon from that button first
	normalGraphic of button "icon" of it = null

	-- delete all copies of this page
	while pageList <> NULL
		pop pageList
		get deleteObject(it)
	end

	-- also delete all icons in this book named "ASYM_AskRequest_tmpIcon"
	resList = resourceList(icon,myBook)
	while resList <> null
		pop resList
		if name of IT = "ASYM_AskRequest_tmpIcon"
			remove resource IT
		end
	end
	forward
end

to get _asym_ask_request _caption, _text, _icon, _buttons, _type, _defText, _width, _position, _frame, _check, _radio, _help
	system _s_ASYM_AskRequestButtonSizes, _s_ASYM_AskRequestCmdButtonResponse, _s_ASYM_AskRequest_mnemonicList

	oldSysCursor = sysCursor
	sysCursor = 4

	-- set up some default values
	myBook = objectContainer(self,"book")
	myPage = myPage()

	marginWithIcon			   = 945
	marginWithoutIcon		   = 150
	askFieldHeight 			   = 270
	textRightMargin			   = 150
	textTopMargin			   = 120
	radioCheckButtonHeight	   = 255
	cmdButtonBetweenPadding    = 105
	cmdButtonGroupMargin 	   = 330
	cmdButtonStandardHeight    = 345
	cmdButtonStandardWidth     = 1110
	bottomViewerPadding		   = 165
	bottomFrameExtraPadding	   = 60
	verticalObjectPadding	   = 120
	betweenRadioAndCheckboxPad = 240
	frameHeightPadding		   = 90
	frameMinimumHeightWithIcon = 700
	standardCmdButtonsWidth    = 1125
	minViewerWidth 			   = 3000

	clear asym_ask_requestReply

	-- IF NO TEXT PASSED USE A SINGLE SPACE INSTEAD
	if _text = null
		_text = space
	end

	-- IF NO BUTTONS PASSED TO FUNCTION, JUST USE "OK"
	if _buttons = null or _buttons = "OK"
		_buttons = "+OK"
	end

	-- TRUNCATE MORE THAN 10 BUTTON SPECIFICATIONS
	_buttons = textlines 1 to 10 of _buttons
	_radio   = textlines 1 to 10 of _radio
	_check   = textlines 1 to 10 of _check

	-- ENSURE WIDTH IS A NUMBER
	if _width = null OR isNumber(_width) = false
		_width = 0
	end
	_width = XpixelToPU(_width)

	-- MAKE IT EASY ON MYSELF, VARIABLE-IZE THE OBJECT NAMES
	dialogViewer = viewer "askReqDialog"   of myBook
	dialogText   = field  "dialogText"     of myPage
	buttonGroup  = group  "buttons"        of myPage
	buttonFrame  = button "messageBox"     of myPage
	fieldAsk     = field  "fieldask"       of myPage
	radioGroup   = group  "radio"          of myPage
	checkGroup   = group  "checkbox"       of myPage
	buttonIcon   = button "icon"           of myPage

	-- OPEN THE VIEWER
	if isOpen of dialogViewer
		if visible of dialogViewer
			hide dialogViewer
		end
		currentPage of dialogViewer = myPage
	else
		defaultPage of dialogViewer = myPage
		open dialogViewer
	end

	-- CLEAR ANY PREVIOUS HELP BUTTON SETTINGS - from hook in DefCmdButton
	help of objects of buttonGroup = null

	-- CLEAR ANY DEFAULT BUTTON SETTINGS - from hook in DefCmdButton
	default of objects of buttonGroup = null

	-- CLEAR ANY CANCEL BUTTON SETTINGS - from hook in DefCmdButton
	escape of objects of buttonGroup = null

	-- ENSURE ALL RADIO BUTTONS ARE INITIALLY DISABLED
	asym_enabled of objects of radioGroup = false

	-- SET CAPTION
	caption of dialogViewer = ASYM_Ellipsize(_caption,78,"right")

	-- ICON MUST BE A VALUE BETWEEN ONE OF 4 DEFAULTS
	-- ICON CAN ALSO BE A REFERENCE TO AN ICON RESOURCE
	leftMargin = marginWithoutIcon
	if _icon <> NULL
		if ASYM_ItemInList(_icon,"stop,question,exclamation,information")
			-- USING ONE OF STANDARD SET OF ICONS, SET IT...
			show buttonIcon
			normalGraphic of buttonIcon = icon ("ASYM_AskRequest_" & _icon) of myBook
			leftMargin = marginWithIcon
		else
			-- must be a reference to an icon. Attempt to set it and on error use no icon.
			if word 1 of _icon = "icon"
				bs = ASYM_BlockSuspend()
				normalGraphic of buttonIcon = _icon
				error = ASYM_RestoreSuspend(bs)
			else
				-- can't use it as it is not an Icon resource
				error = TRUE
			end

			-- were we able to successfully set the icon?
			if error = null
				show buttonIcon
				-- NAME THIS ICON SO WE CAN LATER CLEAR IT OUT WITH A RESET
				name of normalGraphic of buttonIcon = "ASYM_AskRequest_tmpIcon"
				-- POSITION TEXT FIELD AWAY FROM BUTTON
				leftMargin = marginWithIcon
			else
				-- HIDE ICON AS WE AREN'T USING IT
				hide buttonIcon
			end
		end
	else
		-- Icon is NULL, hide button.
		hide buttonIcon
	end

	item 1 of position of dialogText = leftMargin

	-- SET TEXT
	if chars 1 to 5 of _text = "{\rtf"
		richtext of dialogText = _text
	else
		text of dialogText = _text
	end

	-- CONFIGURE RADIO BUTTONS and CHECKBOX BUTTONS
	widestButtons = 0

	checkedObjRef = null

	step i from 1 to 2
		if i = 1
			bGroup = checkGroup
			val    = _check
		else
			bGroup = radioGroup
			val    = _radio
		end

		if val is not null
			-- show button group
			visible of bGroup = true

			-- hide all 10 buttons in this group
			hide objects of bGroup

			-- stack all buttons on top of each other
			pos = 0
			position of objects of bGroup = leftMargin,pos

			numButtons = textLineCount(val)

			-- SHOW NEEDED BUTTONS AND SET CAPTIONS
			step k from 1 to numButtons
				curObj = group ("b" & k) of bGroup

				show curObj

				curLine = textline k of val
				specialButton = findSpecial(curLine,"*(/")

				asym_caption of curObj = stripSpecial(curLine,"*(/")

				-- force button to resize itself
				send autoSize to curObj

				if "checked" is in specialButton
					asym_checked of curObj = true
					if i = 2
						checkedObjRef = button ("b" & k) of curObj
					end
				else
					asym_checked of curObj = false
				end

				asym_enabled of curObj = "disabled" is not in specialButton

				-- position button
				item 2 of position of curObj = pos
				increment pos by radioCheckButtonHeight
				widestButtons = max(widestButtons,item 3 of bounds of curObj)
			end

			-- if no radio buttons were checked, check the first one by default
			if i = 2 AND checkedObjRef = null
				curRef = group "b1" of bGroup
				asym_checked of curRef = true
				checkedObjRef = button "b1" of curRef
			end
		else
			-- we are not using this button group, hide it
			hide bGroup
		end
	end

	-- CONFIGURE COMMAND BUTTONS
	hide objects of buttonGroup
	position of objects of buttonGroup = position of button ("b" & 1) of buttonGroup

-- 0x9b13a  to get _asym_ask_request _caption, _text, _icon, _buttons, _type, _defText, _width, _position, _fram
to get _asym_ask_request _caption, _text, _icon, _buttons, _type, _defText, _width, _position, _frame, _check, _radio, _help
	system _s_ASYM_AskRequestButtonSizes, _s_ASYM_AskRequestCmdButtonResponse, _s_ASYM_AskRequest_mnemonicList

	oldSysCursor = sysCursor
	sysCursor = 4

	-- set up some default values
	myBook = objectContainer(self,"book")
	myPage = myPage()

	marginWithIcon			   = 945
	marginWithoutIcon		   = 150
	askFieldHeight 			   = 270
	textRightMargin			   = 150
	textTopMargin			   = 120
	radioCheckButtonHeight	   = 255
	cmdButtonBetweenPadding    = 105
	cmdButtonGroupMargin 	   = 330
	cmdButtonStandardHeight    = 345
	cmdButtonStandardWidth     = 1110
	bottomViewerPadding		   = 165
	bottomFrameExtraPadding	   = 60
	verticalObjectPadding	   = 120
	betweenRadioAndCheckboxPad = 240
	frameHeightPadding		   = 90
	frameMinimumHeightWithIcon = 700
	standardCmdButtonsWidth    = 1125
	minViewerWidth 			   = 3000

	clear asym_ask_requestReply

	-- IF NO TEXT PASSED USE A SINGLE SPACE INSTEAD
	if _text = null
		_text = space
	end

	-- IF NO BUTTONS PASSED TO FUNCTION, JUST USE "OK"
	if _buttons = null or _buttons = "OK"
		_buttons = "+OK"
	end

	-- TRUNCATE MORE THAN 10 BUTTON SPECIFICATIONS
	_buttons = textlines 1 to 10 of _buttons
	_radio   = textlines 1 to 10 of _radio
	_check   = textlines 1 to 10 of _check

	-- ENSURE WIDTH IS A NUMBER
	if _width = null OR isNumber(_width) = false
		_width = 0
	end
	_width = XpixelToPU(_width)

	-- MAKE IT EASY ON MYSELF, VARIABLE-IZE THE OBJECT NAMES
	dialogViewer = viewer "askReqDialog"   of myBook
	dialogText   = field  "dialogText"     of myPage
	buttonGroup  = group  "buttons"        of myPage
	buttonFrame  = button "messageBox"     of myPage
	fieldAsk     = field  "fieldask"       of myPage
	radioGroup   = group  "radio"          of myPage
	checkGroup   = group  "checkbox"       of myPage
	buttonIcon   = button "icon"           of myPage

	-- OPEN THE VIEWER
	if isOpen of dialogViewer
		if visible of dialogViewer
			hide dialogViewer
		end
		currentPage of dialogViewer = myPage
	else
		defaultPage of dialogViewer = myPage
		open dialogViewer
	end

	-- CLEAR ANY PREVIOUS HELP BUTTON SETTINGS - from hook in DefCmdButton
	help of objects of buttonGroup = null

	-- CLEAR ANY DEFAULT BUTTON SETTINGS - from hook in DefCmdButton
	default of objects of buttonGroup = null

	-- CLEAR ANY CANCEL BUTTON SETTINGS - from hook in DefCmdButton
	escape of objects of buttonGroup = null

	-- ENSURE ALL RADIO BUTTONS ARE INITIALLY DISABLED
	asym_enabled of objects of radioGroup = false

	-- SET CAPTION
	caption of dialogViewer = ASYM_Ellipsize(_caption,78,"right")

	-- ICON MUST BE A VALUE BETWEEN ONE OF 4 DEFAULTS
	-- ICON CAN ALSO BE A REFERENCE TO AN ICON RESOURCE
	leftMargin = marginWithoutIcon
	if _icon <> NULL
		if ASYM_ItemInList(_icon,"stop,question,exclamation,information")
			-- USING ONE OF STANDARD SET OF ICONS, SET IT...
			show buttonIcon
			normalGraphic of buttonIcon = icon ("ASYM_AskRequest_" & _icon) of myBook
			leftMargin = marginWithIcon
		else
			-- must be a reference to an icon. Attempt to set it and on error use no icon.
			if word 1 of _icon = "icon"
				bs = ASYM_BlockSuspend()
				normalGraphic of buttonIcon = _icon
				error = ASYM_RestoreSuspend(bs)
			else
				-- can't use it as it is not an Icon resource
				error = TRUE
			end

			-- were we able to successfully set the icon?
			if error = null
				show buttonIcon
				-- NAME THIS ICON SO WE CAN LATER CLEAR IT OUT WITH A RESET
				name of normalGraphic of buttonIcon = "ASYM_AskRequest_tmpIcon"
				-- POSITION TEXT FIELD AWAY FROM BUTTON
				leftMargin = marginWithIcon
			else
				-- HIDE ICON AS WE AREN'T USING IT
				hide buttonIcon
			end
		end
	else
		-- Icon is NULL, hide button.
		hide buttonIcon
	end

	item 1 of position of dialogText = leftMargin

	-- SET TEXT
	if chars 1 to 5 of _text = "{\rtf"
		richtext of dialogText = _text
	else
		text of dialogText = _text
	end

	-- CONFIGURE RADIO BUTTONS and CHECKBOX BUTTONS
	widestButtons = 0

	checkedObjRef = null

	step i from 1 to 2
		if i = 1
			bGroup = checkGroup
			val    = _check
		else
			bGroup = radioGroup
			val    = _radio
		end

		if val is not null
			-- show button group
			visible of bGroup = true

			-- hide all 10 buttons in this group
			hide objects of bGroup

			-- stack all buttons on top of each other
			pos = 0
			position of objects of bGroup = leftMargin,pos

			numButtons = textLineCount(val)

			-- SHOW NEEDED BUTTONS AND SET CAPTIONS
			step k from 1 to numButtons
				curObj = group ("b" & k) of bGroup

				show curObj

				curLine = textline k of val
				specialButton = findSpecial(curLine,"*(/")

				asym_caption of curObj = stripSpecial(curLine,"*(/")

				-- force button to resize itself
				send autoSize to curObj

				if "checked" is in specialButton
					asym_checked of curObj = true
					if i = 2
						checkedObjRef = button ("b" & k) of curObj
					end
				else
					asym_checked of curObj = false
				end

				asym_enabled of curObj = "disabled" is not in specialButton

				-- position button
				item 2 of position of curObj = pos
				increment pos by radioCheckButtonHeight
				widestButtons = max(widestButtons,item 3 of bounds of curObj)
			end

			-- if no radio buttons were checked, check the first one by default
			if i = 2 AND checkedObjRef = null
				curRef = group "b1" of bGroup
				asym_checked of curRef = true
				checkedObjRef = button "b1" of curRef
			end
		else
			-- we are not using this button group, hide it
			hide bGroup
		end
	end

	-- CONFIGURE COMMAND BUTTONS
	hide objects of buttonGroup
	position of objects of buttonGroup = position of button ("b" & 1) of buttonGroup

	-- IS A CRLF LIST OF BUTTONS BEING PASSED OR JUST A SINGLE LINE?
	_standardButtons = ASYM_ItemInList(_buttons,"OK,OKCancel,RetryCancel,AbortRetryIgnore,YesNo,YesNoCancel")
	if _standardButtons = true
		-- User is passing a standard set of buttons, convert to crlf list
		_buttons = parseButtons(_buttons)
	end
	numButtons = textlineCount(_buttons)

	defCmdButton = null
	showCloseButton = false
	_s_ASYM_AskRequest_mnemonicList = null

	-- SHOW NEEDED CMD BUTTONS AND SET CAPTIONS
	cmdButtonSpecialChars = "+?x(/"
	step k from 1 to numButtons
		curButton = button ("b" & k) of buttonGroup
		show curButton
		curLine = textline k of _buttons
		specialButton = findSpecial(curLine,cmdButtonSpecialChars)

		captionText = stripSpecial(curLine,cmdButtonSpecialChars)
		caption of curButton = captionText

		-- build a list of mnemonic characters
		push mnemonicChar(captionText) onto _s_ASYM_AskRequest_mnemonicList

		enabled of curButton = true

		while specialButton <> null
			pop specialButton into curItem
			conditions
				when curItem = "help"
					help of curButton = true

				when curItem = "cancel"
					escape of curButton = true
					showCloseButton = true

				when curItem = "default"
					default of curButton = true
					defCmdButton = curButton

				when curItem = "disabled"
					enabled of curButton = false
			end
		end
	end

	if showCloseButton <> true
		linkDLL "user"
			WORD GetSystemMenu (WORD, INT)
			INT  RemoveMenu    (WORD, WORD, WORD)
		end
		MF_BYCOMMAND = 0x0000
		SC_CLOSE = 0xF060
		hMenu = getSystemMenu (windowHandle of dialogViewer, 0)
		get removeMenu (hMenu, 0xF060, MF_BYCOMMAND)
	end

	-- If no Default CMD button set, use 1st CMD button
	if defCmdButton = null
		defCmdButton = button "b1" of buttonGroup
		default of defCmdButton = true
	end
	defCmdButton of myPage = defCmdButton

	-- RESIZE ALL BUTTONS TO FIT
	-- SHAREDSCRIPT ON BUTTONS CONTROL RESIZING
	_s_ASYM_AskRequestB

-- 0x9d159  to get stripSpecial str, lst
to get stripSpecial str, lst
	get char 1 of str
	while it is in lst
		clear char 1 of str
		if it = "/"
			break while
		end
		get char 1 of str
	end
	return str
end

to get findSpecial str, lst
	retVal = null

	if str is not null
		step k from 1 to charCount(str)
			chr = char k of str

			conditions
				when chr = "?" and chr is in lst
					push "help" onto retVal

				when chr = "x" and chr is in lst
					push "cancel" onto retVal

				when chr = "+" and chr is in lst
					push "default" onto retVal

				when chr = "*" and chr is in lst
					push "checked" onto retVal

				when chr = "(" and chr is in lst
					push "disabled" onto retVal

				else
					break step
			end
		end
	end

	return retVal
end

to handle resizeButtons
	-- NOTIFYBEFORE HANDLERS WILL TAKE CARE OF THIS
end

to get XpixelToPU val
	return val * item 1 of sysPageUnitsPerPixel
end

to get YpixelToPU val
	return val * item 2 of sysPageUnitsPerPixel
end

to handle resizeField obj, fixedWidth, minWidth, maxWidth, textRightMargin
	scroll of obj = 0

	if fixedWidth <> NULL
		-- user specified a size
		item 3 of bounds of obj = fixedWidth - textRightMargin
		get repairFieldHeight(obj,screenHeight() * YpixelToPU(1))
	else
		-- height to width ratio for dialog
		cnt = charCount (text of obj)
		ratio = max (8, round (20 - cnt / 20))

		xPix = XpixelToPU(1)
		totalMargin = item 1 of position of obj + textRightMargin
		h = maxWidth - totalMargin
		decrement minWidth by totalMargin
		l = minWidth

		while h-l >= xPix
			m = (h+l) bitShiftRight 1
			size of obj = m, m/ratio
			if textoverflow of obj = 0
				-- Too High
				h = m
			else
				-- Too Low
				l = m
			end
		end

		if m = l
			increment m by xPix
			size of obj = m, m/ratio
		end

		get repairFieldHeight(obj,m/ratio)
		get repairFieldWidth(obj,minWidth,m)
	end
end

to get repairFieldWidth obj, min, max
	h = max
	l = min
	xPix = XpixelToPU(1)

	while h-l >= xPix
		m = (h + l) bitShiftRight 1

		item 1 of size of obj = m

		if textoverflow of obj = 0
			-- Too High
			h = m
		else
			-- Too Low
			l = m
		end
	end
	if m = l
		increment m by xPix
		item 1 of size of obj = m
	end
	return TRUE
end

to get repairFieldHeight obj, maxHeight
	scroll of obj = 0

	h = maxHeight
	l = 0
	yPix = YpixelToPU(1)
	while h-l >= yPix
		m = (h + l) bitShiftRight 1

		item 2 of size of obj = m

		if textoverflow of obj = 0
			h = m
		else
			l = m
		end
	end
	if m = l
		increment m by yPix
		item 2 of size of obj = m
	end
	return TRUE
end

	return _s_ASYM_RequestPageRef

to get parseButtons _buttons
	btns = "OK,OKCancel,RetryCancel,AbortRetryIgnore,YesNo,YesNoCancel"

	-- if invalid set of buttons passed, use OK as default
	if ASYM_ItemInList(_buttons,btns) = false
		return null
	end

	myBook = this book

	_cancel  = asym_getString("<cancel>","xCancel") of myBook
	_retry   = asym_getString("<retry>","&Retry")   of myBook
	_abort   = asym_getString("<abort>","&Abort")   of myBook
	_ignore  = asym_getString("<ignore>","&Ignore") of myBook
	_yes     = asym_getString("<yes>","&Yes")       of myBook
	_no      = asym_getString("<no>","&No")         of myBook

	conditions
		when _buttons = "OK"
			_buttons = _ok

		when _buttons = "OKCancel"
			_buttons = _ok & CRLF & _cancel

		when _buttons = "RetryCancel"
			_buttons = _retry & CRLF & _cancel

		when _buttons = "AbortRetryIgnore"
			_buttons = _abort & CRLF & _retry & CRLF & _ignore

		when _buttons = "YesNo"
			_buttons = _yes & CRLF & _no

		when _buttons = "YesNoCancel"
			_buttons = _yes & CRLF & _no & CRLF & _cancel
	end

	return _buttons
end

-- return mnemonic character for caption
to get mnemonicChar str
	retVal = null

	if "&" is in str
		-- found one, now remove all &&
		pos = offset("&&",str)
		while pos > 0
			clear chars pos to pos + 1 of str
			pos = offset("&&",str)
		end

		-- now find first occurance of &
		pos = offset("&",str)
		if pos > 0
			retVal = char pos + 1 of STR
		end
	end

	return retVal
end

to handle keyChar key
	SYSTEM _s_ASYM_AskRequest_mnemonicList
	forward
	if object of target is not "field"
		chr = ansiToChar(key)
		pos = offset(chr,_s_ASYM_AskRequest_mnemonicList)
		if pos > 0
			linkdll "TBWIN.DLL"
				INT  sendKeys(STRING,INT)
			end linkDLL
			get sendKeys("%" & chr,0)
		end
	end
end

			pos = offset("&&",str)
		end

		-- now find first occurance of &
		pos = offset("&",str)
		if pos > 0
			retVal = char pos + 1 of STR
		end
	end

	return retVal
end

to handle keyChar key
	SYSTEM _s_ASYM_AskRequest_mnemonicList
	forward
	if object of target is not "field"
		chr = ansiToChar(key)
		pos = offset(chr,_s_ASYM_AskRequest_mnemonicList)
		if pos > 0
			linkdll "TBWIN.DLL"
				INT  sendKeys(STRING,INT)
			end linkDLL
			get sendKeys("%" & chr,0)
		end
	end
end

-- 0x9daad  to get mnemonicChar str
to get mnemonicChar str
	retVal = null

	if "&" is in str
		-- found one, now remove all &&
		pos = offset("&&",str)
		while pos > 0
			clear chars pos to pos + 1 of str
			pos = offset("&&",str)
		end

		-- now find first occurance of &
		pos = offset("&",str)
		if pos > 0
			retVal = char pos + 1 of STR
		end
	end

	return retVal
end

	forward

		if pos > 0
			linkdll "TBWIN.DLL"
				INT  sendKeys(STRING,INT)
			end linkDLL
			get sendKeys("%" & chr,0)
		end
	end
end

-- 0x9dc75  to get _ASYM_FindField fldName, pg
to get _ASYM_FindField fldName, pg
	if pg is null
		pg = this page
	end
	si = ASYM_BlockSuspend()
	fld = recordfield fldName of pg
	if sysError <> null
		clear sysError
		fld = field fldName of parent of pg
		if sysError <> null
			clear sysError
			fld = field fldName of pg
		end
	end
	get ASYM_RestoreSuspend (si)
	if it = null
		return fld
	end
	return null
end


to get _ASYM_FindPage pgN
	si = ASYM_BlockSuspend()
	get page pgN
	si = ASYM_RestoreSuspend (si)
	return it
end


to get _ASYM_GetObjectListByName oContainer, otype, hasScript, nam
	local stack oList
	get GetObjectList(oContainer, otype, hasScript)
	while it <> null
		pop it into obj
		if name of obj is nam
			push obj onto oList
		end
	end
	return oList
end


to get _ASYM_NameOrID obj
	if obj is null
		return null
	end
	get name of obj
	if it is null
		get "ID" && idNumber of obj
	end
	return it
end


to get _ASYM_ObjectCenter pTarget, obj
	if obj is null
		obj = pTarget
	end
	get object of obj
	if it is in "pagebackgroundbookviewer"
		conditions
			when it is "page"
				get size of parent of obj
			when it is "background"
			when it is "book"
				get size of obj
			when it is "viewer"
				get clientSize of obj
		end
		if it is null or it is "0,0"
			get size of objectContainer(obj,"book")
		end
		result = item 1 of it div 2, item 2 of it div 2
	else
		get bounds of obj
		result = round(average(item 1 of it, item 3 of it)- 0.0001), round(average (item 2 of it, item 4 of it) - 0.0001)
	end
	return result
end


to handle _ASYM_SetObjectCenter pTarget, loc
	if isType(point,loc)
		get bounds of pTarget
		move pTarget to item 1 of loc - (item 3 of it - item 1 of it) / 2, item 2 of loc - (item 4 of it - item 2 of it) / 2
	end
end


to get _ASYM_OppositePos pos
	get ClientSize of targetWindow
	pop it into maxX
	pop it into maxY
	maxX = maxX / 2
	maxY = maxY / 2
	pop pos into x
	pop pos into y
	if x >= maxX
		x = 1200
	else
		x = maxX + 300
	end
	if y >= maxY
		y = 1200
	else
		y = maxY + 300
	end
	return x, y
end


to handle _ASYM_ScrollListBoxToSelection pTarget
	get item 1 of selectedTextLines of pTarget
	if it <> null and it > 0
		n = itemCount(textRightOverflow of pTarget)
		if it < scroll of pTarget or it > scroll of pTarget + n
			scroll of pTarget = max(0, it - (1 + n div 2))
		end
	end
end


to get _ASYM_WordFromPoint loc
	LOCAL wordNum

	obj = objectFromPoint(loc)
	if obj <> NULL and object of obj is in "recordfield"
		spot = textFromPoint(loc) of obj
		if item 1 of spot < 1
			return NULL
		end
		whatText = textline abs(item 1 of spot) of text of obj
		whatChar = item 2 of spot
		oldFocus = focus
		oldWord = selectedTextState
		oldLock = lockscreen of this window
		lockscreen of this window = true

		step i from 1 to wordcount(whatText)
			select word i of text of obj
			if item 1 of selectedTextState <= whatChar and item 2 of selectedTextState >= whatChar
				wordNum = i
				break step
			end
		end

		if oldWord = NULL
			focus = NULL
			focus = oldFocus
		else
			select chars item 1 of oldWord to item 2 of oldWord of text of obj
		end

		lockscreen of this window = oldLock
	end

	return wordNum
end


to handle _ASYMA_CopyUserProperties obj1, obj2
	propList = userProperties of obj1
	while propList <> NULL
		pop propList into prop
		cmd = expandString("%1 of %2 = %1 of %3",prop, obj2, obj1)
		execute cmd
	end
end


to handle _ASYM_FixFieldScrollBar pTarget, fld
	if fld is null
		fld = pTarget
	end
	if (textOverflow of fld) + (textUnderflow of fld) > 0
		borderStyle of fld = scrolling
	else
		borderStyle of fld = rectangle
	end
end


to get _ASYM_CopyProperty pSourceObj, pDestObj, pSourceProp, pDestProp

	if (isObject(pSourceObj) = TRUE) and (isObject(pDestObj) = TRUE) and (pSourceProp <> NULL)

		if pDestProp = NULL
			pDestProp = pSourceProp
		end if
		execString = pDestProp & " of " & pDestObj & " = " & \
				pSourceProp & " of " & pSourceObj

		execute (execString)
	end if
	return NULL
end


to get _ASYM_ObjectParentList pObj, pCutOffLevel

	retVal = NULL

	if (isObject(pObj) = TRUE) and (object of pObj <> "book")

		if not (pCutOffLevel is in "page,background,book")
			pCutOffLevel = NULL
		end if

		parentObj = pObj

		do
			put parentObj & "," after retVal
			parentObj = parent of parentObj
			objType = object of parentObj
		until (objType = "book") or (objType = pCutOffLevel)

		if (objType = "book") and (pCutOffLevel <> "book")
			put parentObj & "," after retVal
		end if

		if retVal <> NULL
			clear last char of retVal
		end if

	end if

	return retVal

end

to get ASYM_ConstructObjectIdentifier objectRef, targetRef, noSelf, thisPage
	-- <objectRef> is the object we're constructing an identifier for.
	-- <targetRef> is the object that will be storing the object reference.
	-- <noSelf> means don't return "<self>" for the object (but still will use self for parents of
	--   the object)
	-- <thisPage> forces a "this page" type reference when actions in the book or a background, or
	--   objects on a background, refer to a page or objects on a page (not used yet).

	local STRING objectIdentifier

	objectIdentifier = "object"

	if not isObject (targetRef)
		return null
	end

	targetType = object of targetRef

	if objectRef = "target"
		return ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "id", "<target>")
	end

	if objectRef = "self" or (objectRef = targetRef and noSelf <> true)
		return ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "id", "<self>")
	end

	if not isObject (objectRef) or not isObject (targetRef)
		return null
	end

	objectType = object of objectRef
	objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "type", objectType)

	if targetType = "book"
		targetBook = targetRef
	else
		targetBook = objectContainer (targetRef, "book")
	end

	if objectType = "book"
		objectBook = objectRef
	else
		objectBook = objectContainer (objectRef, "book")
	end

	if objectBook = targetBook and not (objectType = "book" and noSelf = true)
		objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "bookName", "<self>")
	else
		objectBookName = name of objectBook
		objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "bookName", ASYM_ShortFileName (objectBookName))
		send ASYM_RegisterPath ASYM_PathOfFile (objectBookName), targetRef
	end

	if objectType = "book"
		return objectIdentifier
	end

	if objectType = "page"
		if targetType = "page"
			targetPage = targetRef
		else
			targetPage = objectContainer (targetRef, "page")
		end
		if (objectRef = targetPage or (targetPage = null and thisPage = true)) and noSelf <> true
			objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "id", "<self>")
			return objectIdentifier
		end
	else
		if objectType = "background"
			if targetType = "background"
				targetBackground = targetRef
			else
				targetBackground = objectContainer (targetRef, "background")
			end
			if objectRef = targetBackground and noSelf <> true
				objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "id", "<self>")
				return objectIdentifier
			end
		end
	end

	objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "id", idNumber of objectRef)
	get name of objectRef
	if it <> null
		objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "name", it)
	end

	if ASYM_ItemInList (objectType, "page,background,viewer")
		return objectIdentifier
	end

	objectLayerRef = objectContainer (objectRef, "page,background")

	if ASYM_ItemInList (targetType, "page,background")

-- 0x9dd9a  to get _ASYM_GetObjectListByName oContainer, otype, hasScript, nam

	return oList
end

			objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "id", "<self>")

				objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "id", "<self>")

-- 0x9de8e  to get _ASYM_ObjectCenter pTarget, obj
to get _ASYM_ObjectCenter pTarget, obj
	if obj is null
		obj = pTarget
	end
	get object of obj
	if it is in "pagebackgroundbookviewer"
		conditions
			when it is "page"
				get size of parent of obj
			when it is "background"
			when it is "book"
				get size of obj
			when it is "viewer"
				get clientSize of obj
		end
		if it is null or it is "0,0"
			get size of objectContainer(obj,"book")
		end
		result = item 1 of it div 2, item 2 of it div 2
	else
		get bounds of obj
		result = round(average(item 1 of it, item 3 of it)- 0.0001), round(average (item 2 of it, item 4 of it) - 0.0001)
	end
	return result
end


to handle _ASYM_SetObjectCenter pTarget, loc
	if isType(point,loc)
		get bounds of pTarget
		move pTarget to item 1 of loc - (item 3 of it - item 1 of it) / 2, item 2 of loc - (item 4 of it - item 2 of it) / 2
	end
end


to get _ASYM_OppositePos pos
	get ClientSize of targetWindow
	pop it into maxX
	pop it into maxY
	maxX = maxX / 2
	maxY = maxY / 2
	pop pos into x
	pop pos into y
	if x >= maxX
		x = 1200
	else
		x = maxX + 300
	end
	if y >= maxY
		y = 1200
	else
		y = maxY + 300
	end
	return x, y
end


to handle _ASYM_ScrollListBoxToSelection pTarget
	get item 1 of selectedTextLines of pTarget
	if it <> null and it > 0
		n = itemCount(textRightOverflow of pTarget)
		if it < scroll of pTarget or it > scroll of pTarget + n
			scroll of pTarget = max(0, it - (1 + n div 2))
		end
	end
end


to get _ASYM_WordFromPoint loc
	LOCAL wordNum

	obj = objectFromPoint(loc)
	if obj <> NULL and object of obj is in "recordfield"
		spot = textFromPoint(loc) of obj
		if item 1 of spot < 1
			return NULL
		end
		whatText = textline abs(item 1 of spot) of text of obj
		whatChar = item 2 of spot
		oldFocus = focus
		oldWord = selectedTextState
		oldLock = lockscreen of this window
		lockscreen of this window = true

		step i from 1 to wordcount(whatText)
			select word i of text of obj
			if item 1 of selectedTextState <= whatChar and item 2 of selectedTextState >= whatChar
				wordNum = i
				break step
			end
		end

		if oldWord = NULL
			focus = NULL
			focus = oldFocus
		else
			select chars item 1 of oldWord to item 2 of oldWord of text of obj
		end

		lockscreen of this window = oldLock
	end

	return wordNum
end


to handle _ASYMA_CopyUserProperties obj1, obj2
	propList = userProperties of obj1
	while propList <> NULL
		pop propList into prop
		cmd = expandString("%1 of %2 = %1 of %3",prop, obj2, obj1)
		execute cmd
	end
end


to handle _ASYM_FixFieldScrollBar pTarget, fld
	if fld is null
		fld = pTarget
	end
	if (textOverflow of fld) + (textUnderflow of fld) > 0
		borderStyle of fld = scrolling
	else
		borderStyle of fld = rectangle
	end
end


to get _ASYM_CopyProperty pSourceObj, pDestObj, pSourceProp, pDestProp

	if (isObject(pSourceObj) = TRUE) and (isObject(pDestObj) = TRUE) and (pSourceProp <> NULL)

		if pDestProp = NULL
			pDestProp = pSourceProp
		end if
		execString = pDestProp & " of " & pDestObj & " = " & \
				pSourceProp & " of " & pSourceObj

		execute (execString)
	end if
	return NULL
end


to get _ASYM_ObjectParentList pObj, pCutOffLevel

	retVal = NULL

	if (isObject(pObj) = TRUE) and (object of pObj <> "book")

		if not (pCutOffLevel is in "page,background,book")
			pCutOffLevel = NULL
		end if

		parentObj = pObj

		do
			put parentObj & "," after retVal
			parentObj = parent of parentObj
			objType = object of parentObj
		until (objType = "book") or (objType = pCutOffLevel)

		if (objType = "book") and (pCutOffLevel <> "book")
			put parentObj & "," after retVal
		end if

		if retVal <> NULL
			clear last char of retVal
		end if

	end if

	return retVal

end

to get ASYM_ConstructObjectIdentifier objectRef, targetRef, noSelf, thisPage
	-- <objectRef> is the object we're constructing an identifier for.
	-- <targetRef> is the object that will be storing the object reference.
	-- <noSelf> means don't return "<self>" for the object (but still will use self for parents of
	--   the object)
	-- <thisPage> forces a "this page" type reference when actions in the book or a background, or
	--   objects on a background, refer to a page or objects on a page (not used yet).

	local STRING objectIdentifier

	objectIdentifier = "object"

	if not isObject (targetRef)
		return null
	end

	targetType = object of targetRef

	if objectRef = "target"
		return ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "id", "<target>")
	end

	if objectRef = "self" or (objectRef = targetRef and noSelf <> true)
		return ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "id", "<self>")
	end

	if not isObject (objectRef) or not isObject (targetRef)
		return null
	end

	objectType = object of objectRef
	objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "type", objectType)

	if targetType = "book"
		targetBook = targetRef
	else
		targetBook = objectContainer (targetRef, "book")
	end

	if objectType = "book"
		objectBook = objectRef
	else
		objectBook = objectContainer (objectRef, "book")
	end

	if objectBook = targetBook and not (objectType = "book" and noSelf = true)
		objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "bookName", "<self>")
	else
		objectBookName = name of objectBook
		objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "bookName", ASYM_ShortFileName (objectBookName))
		send ASYM_RegisterPath ASYM_PathOfFile (objectBookName), targetRef
	end

	if objectType = "book"
		return objectIdentifier
	end

	if objectType = "page"
		if targetType = "page"
			targetPage = targetRef
		else
			targetPage = objectContainer (targetRef, "page")
		end
		if (objectRef = targetPage or (targetPage = null and thisPage = true)) and noSelf <> true
			objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "id", "<self>")
			return objectIdentifier
		end
	else
		if objectType = "background"
			if targetType = "background"
				targetBackground = targetRef
			else
				targetBackground = objectContainer (targetRef, "background")
			end
			if objectRef = targetBackground and noSelf <> true
				objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "id", "<self>")
				return objectIdentifier
			end
		end
	end

	objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "id", idNumber of objectRef)
	get name of objectRef
	if it <> null
		objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "name", it)
	end

	if ASYM_ItemInList (objectType, "page,background,viewer")
		return objectIdentifier
	end

	objectLayerRef = objectContainer (objectRef, "page,background")

	if ASYM_ItemInList (targetType, "page,background")
		targetLayerRef = targetRef
	else
		targetLayerRef = objectContainer (targetRef, "page,background")
	end

	objectLayerType = object of objectLayerRef
	objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "layerType", objectLayerType)

	if targetLayerRef = null
		targetLayerType = null
	else
		targetLayerType = object of targetLayerRef
	end

	if objectLayerRef = targetLayerRef or \
			(targetLayerRef <> null and objectLayerRef = parent of targetLayerRef) or \
			(targetLayerType <> "page" and objectLayerType = "page" and thisPage = true)
		objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "layerID", "<self>")
	else
		objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "layerID", idNumber of objectLayerRef)
		get name of objectLayerRef
		if it <> null
			objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "layerName", it)
		end
	end

	return objectIdentifier
end

to get ASYM_ObjectDescriptionFromObjectInfo obInfo, selfRef, event, initCaps, obRef
	-- we can construct a suitable unique, displayable object description from
	-- just the object info structure even if we don't know the source object,
	-- because the object info structure is all relative anyway.

	-- if obRef is passed, we use it to get a wid name if we can

	initCaps = (initCaps = true)

	if obInfo = null
		if initCaps
			return "Self"
		else
			return "self"
		end
	end

	obType = ASYM_GetDataElement (obInfo, "type")
	if initCaps = true
		char 1 of obType = uppercase(char 1 of obType)
	else
		char 1 of obType = lowercase

			end
		end
	end

	objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "id", idNumber of objectRef)
	get name of objectRef
	if it <> null
		objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "name", it)
	end

	if ASYM_ItemInList (objectType, "page,background,viewer")
		return objectIdentifier
	end

	objectLayerRef = objectContainer (objectRef, "page,background")

	if ASYM_ItemInList (targetType, "page,background")
		targetLayerRef = targetRef
	else
		targetLayerRef = objectContainer (targetRef, "page,background")
	end

	objectLayerType = object of objectLayerRef
	objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "layerType", objectLayerType)

	if targetLayerRef = null
		targetLayerType = null
	else
		targetLayerType = object of targetLayerRef
	end

	if objectLayerRef = targetLayerRef or \
			(targetLayerRef <> null and objectLayerRef = parent of targetLayerRef) or \
			(targetLayerType <> "page" and objectLayerType = "page" and thisPage = true)
		objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "layerID", "<self>")
	else
		objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "layerID", idNumber of objectLayerRef)
		get name of objectLayerRef
		if it <> null
			objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "layerName", it)
		end
	end

	return objectIdentifier
end

to get ASYM_ObjectDescriptionFromObjectInfo obInfo, selfRef, event, initCaps, obRef
	-- we can construct a suitable unique, displayable object description from
	-- just the object info structure even if we don't know the source object,
	-- because the object info structure is all relative anyway.

	-- if obRef is passed, we use it to get a wid name if we can

	initCaps = (initCaps = true)

	if obInfo = null
		if initCaps
			return "Self"
		else
			return "self"
		end
	end

	obType = ASYM_GetDataElement (obInfo, "type")
	if initCaps = true
		char 1 of obType = uppercase(char 1 of obType)
	else
		char 1 of obType = lowercase(char 1 of obType)
	end

	-- Note that using an expression for an object's name is only supported by the Actions system,
	-- and only passed to this function at design time, so we're safe calling into an Actions system

-- 0x9e17d  to handle _ASYM_ScrollListBoxToSelection pTarget
to handle _ASYM_ScrollListBoxToSelection pTarget
	get item 1 of selectedTextLines of pTarget
	if it <> null and it > 0
		n = itemCount(textRightOverflow of pTarget)
		if it < scroll of pTarget or it > scroll of pTarget + n
			scroll of pTarget = max(0, it - (1 + n div 2))
		end
	end
end


to get _ASYM_WordFromPoint loc
	LOCAL wordNum

	obj = objectFromPoint(loc)
	if obj <> NULL and object of obj is in "recordfield"
		spot = textFromPoint(loc) of obj
		if item 1 of spot < 1
			return NULL
		end
		whatText = textline abs(item 1 of spot) of text of obj
		whatChar = item 2 of spot
		oldFocus = focus
		oldWord = selectedTextState
		oldLock = lockscreen of this window
		lockscreen of this window = true

		step i from 1 to wordcount(whatText)
			select word i of text of obj
			if item 1 of selectedTextState <= whatChar and item 2 of selectedTextState >= whatChar
				wordNum = i
				break step
			end
		end

		if oldWord = NULL
			focus = NULL
			focus = oldFocus
		else
			select chars item 1 of oldWord to item 2 of oldWord of text of obj
		end

		lockscreen of this window = oldLock
	end

	return wordNum
end


to handle _ASYMA_CopyUserProperties obj1, obj2
	propList = userProperties of obj1
	while propList <> NULL
		pop propList into prop
		cmd = expandString("%1 of %2 = %1 of %3",prop, obj2, obj1)
		execute cmd
	end
end


to handle _ASYM_FixFieldScrollBar pTarget, fld
	if fld is null
		fld = pTarget
	end
	if (textOverflow of fld) + (textUnderflow of fld) > 0
		borderStyle of fld = scrolling
	else
		borderStyle of fld = rectangle
	end
end


to get _ASYM_CopyProperty pSourceObj, pDestObj, pSourceProp, pDestProp

	if (isObject(pSourceObj) = TRUE) and (isObject(pDestObj) = TRUE) and (pSourceProp <> NULL)

		if pDestProp = NULL
			pDestProp = pSourceProp
		end if
		execString = pDestProp & " of " & pDestObj & " = " & \
				pSourceProp & " of " & pSourceObj

		execute (execString)
	end if
	return NULL
end


to get _ASYM_ObjectParentList pObj, pCutOffLevel

	retVal = NULL

	if (isObject(pObj) = TRUE) and (object of pObj <> "book")

		if not (pCutOffLevel is in "page,background,book")
			pCutOffLevel = NULL
		end if

		parentObj = pObj

		do
			put parentObj & "," after retVal
			parentObj = parent of parentObj
			objType = object of parentObj
		until (objType = "book") or (objType = pCutOffLevel)

		if (objType = "book") and (pCutOffLevel <> "book")
			put parentObj & "," after retVal
		end if

		if retVal <> NULL
			clear last char of retVal
		end if

	end if

	return retVal

end

to get ASYM_ConstructObjectIdentifier objectRef, targetRef, noSelf, thisPage
	-- <objectRef> is the object we're constructing an identifier for.
	-- <targetRef> is the object that will be storing the object reference.
	-- <noSelf> means don't return "<self>" for the object (but still will use self for parents of
	--   the object)
	-- <thisPage> forces a "this page" type reference when actions in the book or a background, or
	--   objects on a background, refer to a page or objects on a page (not used yet).

	local STRING objectIdentifier

	objectIdentifier = "object"

	if not isObject (targetRef)
		return null
	end

	targetType = object of targetRef

	if objectRef = "target"
		return ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "id", "<target>")
	end

	if objectRef = "self" or (objectRef = targetRef and noSelf <> true)
		return ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "id", "<self>")
	end

	if not isObject (objectRef) or not isObject (targetRef)
		return null
	end

	objectType = object of objectRef
	objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "type", objectType)

	if targetType = "book"
		targetBook = targetRef
	else
		targetBook = objectContainer (targetRef, "book")
	end

	if objectType = "book"
		objectBook = objectRef
	else
		objectBook = objectContainer (objectRef, "book")
	end

	if objectBook = targetBook and not (objectType = "book" and noSelf = true)
		objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "bookName", "<self>")
	else
		objectBookName = name of objectBook
		objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "bookName", ASYM_ShortFileName (objectBookName))
		send ASYM_RegisterPath ASYM_PathOfFile (objectBookName), targetRef
	end

	if objectType = "book"
		return objectIdentifier
	end

	if objectType = "page"
		if targetType = "page"
			targetPage = targetRef
		else
			targetPage = objectContainer (targetRef, "page")
		end
		if (objectRef = targetPage or (targetPage = null and thisPage = true)) and noSelf <> true
			objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "id", "<self>")
			return objectIdentifier
		end
	else
		if objectType = "background"
			if targetType = "background"
				targetBackground = targetRef
			else
				targetBackground = objectContainer (targetRef, "background")
			end
			if objectRef = targetBackground and noSelf <> true
				objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "id", "<self>")
				return objectIdentifier
			end
		end
	end

	objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "id", idNumber of objectRef)
	get name of objectRef
	if it <> null
		objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "name", it)
	end

	if ASYM_ItemInList (objectType, "page,background,viewer")
		return objectIdentifier
	end

	objectLayerRef = objectContainer (objectRef, "page,background")

	if ASYM_ItemInList (targetType, "page,background")
		targetLayerRef = targetRef
	else
		targetLayerRef = objectContainer (targetRef, "page,background")
	end

	objectLayerType = object of objectLayerRef
	objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "layerType", objectLayerType)

	if targetLayerRef = null
		targetLayerType = null
	else
		targetLayerType = object of targetLayerRef
	end

	if objectLayerRef = targetLayerRef or \
			(targetLayerRef <> null and objectLayerRef = parent of targetLayerRef) or \
			(targetLayerType <> "page" and objectLayerType = "page" and thisPage = true)
		objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "layerID", "<self>")
	else
		objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "layerID", idNumber of objectLayerRef)
		get name of objectLayerRef
		if it <> null
			objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "layerName", it)
		end
	end

	return objectIdentifier
end

to get ASYM_ObjectDescriptionFromObjectInfo obInfo, selfRef, event, initCaps, obRef
	-- we can construct a suitable unique, displayable object description from
	-- just the object info structure even if we don't know the source object,
	-- because the object info structure is all relative anyway.

	-- if obRef is passed, we use it to get a wid name if we can

	initCaps = (initCaps = true)

	if obInfo = null
		if initCaps
			return "Self"
		else
			return "self"
		end
	end

	obType = ASYM_GetDataElement (obInfo, "type")
	if initCaps = true
		char 1 of obType = uppercase(char 1 of obType)
	else
		char 1 of obType = lowercase(char 1 of obType)
	end

	-- Note that using an expression for an object's name is only supported by the Actions system,
	-- and only passed to this function at design time, so we're safe calling into an Actions system
	-- authoring function.
	nameExp = ASYM_GetDataElement(obInfo, "nameExp")
	if nameExp <> null
		return obType && ASYM_EA_ExpressionDisplayStringFromExpressionInfo(nameExp, selfRef, event, true)
	end

	bookName = ASYM_GetDataElement (obInfo, "bookName")
	if bookName = "<self>"
		bookName = null
	end

				return "Self"

to handle _ASYM_FixFieldScrollBar pTarget, fld
	if fld is null
		fld = pTarget
	end

		borderStyle of fld = scrolling
	else

	end

to get _ASYM_CopyProperty pSourceObj, pDestObj, pSourceProp, pDestProp

	if (isObject(pSourceObj) = TRUE) and (isObject(pDestObj) = TRUE) and (pSourceProp <> NULL)

		if pDestProp = NULL
			pDestProp = pSourceProp
		end if
		execString = pDestProp & " of " & pDestObj & " = " & \
				pSourceProp & " of " & pSourceObj

		execute (execString)
	end if
	return NULL
end


to get _ASYM_ObjectParentList pObj, pCutOffLevel

	retVal = NULL

	if (isObject(pObj) = TRUE) and (object of pObj <> "book")

		if not (pCutOffLevel is in "page,background,book")
			pCutOffLevel = NULL
		end if

		parentObj = pObj

		do
			put parentObj & "," after retVal
			parentObj = parent of parentObj
			objType = object of parentObj
		until (objType = "book") or (objType = pCutOffLevel)

		if (objType = "book") and (pCutOffLevel <> "book")
			put parentObj & "," after retVal
		end if

		if retVal <> NULL
			clear last char of retVal
		end if

	end if

	return retVal

end

to get ASYM_ConstructObjectIdentifier objectRef, targetRef, noSelf, thisPage
	-- <objectRef> is the object we're constructing an identifier for.
	-- <targetRef> is the object that will be storing the object reference.
	-- <noSelf> means don't return "<self>" for the object (but still will use self for parents of
	--   the object)
	-- <thisPage> forces a "this page" type reference when actions in the book or a background, or
	--   objects on a background, refer to a page or objects on a page (not used yet).

	local STRING objectIdentifier

	objectIdentifier = "object"

	if not isObject (targetRef)
		return null
	end

	targetType = object of targetRef

	if objectRef = "target"
		return ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "id", "<target>")
	end

	if objectRef = "self" or (objectRef = targetRef and noSelf <> true)
		return ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "id", "<self>")
	end

	if not isObject (objectRef) or not isObject (targetRef)
		return null
	end

	objectType = object of objectRef
	objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "type", objectType)

	if targetType = "book"
		targetBook = targetRef
	else
		targetBook = objectContainer (targetRef, "book")
	end

	if objectType = "book"
		objectBook = objectRef
	else
		objectBook = objectContainer (objectRef, "book")
	end

	if objectBook = targetBook and not (objectType = "book" and noSelf = true)
		objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "bookName", "<self>")
	else
		objectBookName = name of objectBook
		objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "bookName", ASYM_ShortFileName (objectBookName))
		send ASYM_RegisterPath ASYM_PathOfFile (objectBookName), targetRef
	end

	if objectType = "book"
		return objectIdentifier
	end

	if objectType = "page"
		if targetType = "page"
			targetPage = targetRef
		else
			targetPage = objectContainer (targetRef, "page")
		end
		if (objectRef = targetPage or (targetPage = null and thisPage = true)) and noSelf <> true
			objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "id", "<self>")
			return objectIdentifier
		end
	else
		if objectType = "background"
			if targetType = "background"
				targetBackground = targetRef
			else
				targetBackground = objectContainer (targetRef, "background")
			end
			if objectRef = targetBackground and noSelf <> true
				objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "id", "<self>")
				return objectIdentifier
			end
		end
	end

	objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "id", idNumber of objectRef)
	get name of objectRef
	if it <> null
		objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "name", it)
	end

	if ASYM_ItemInList (objectType, "page,background,viewer")
		return objectIdentifier
	end

	objectLayerRef = objectContainer (objectRef, "page,background")

	if ASYM_ItemInList (targetType, "page,background")
		targetLayerRef = targetRef
	else
		targetLayerRef = objectContainer (targetRef, "page,background")
	end

	objectLayerType = object of objectLayerRef
	objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "layerType", objectLayerType)

	if targetLayerRef = null
		targetLayerType = null
	else
		targetLayerType = object of targetLayerRef
	end

	if objectLayerRef = targetLayerRef or \
			(targetLayerRef <> null and objectLayerRef = parent of targetLayerRef) or \
			(targetLayerType <> "page" and objectLayerType = "page" and thisPage = true)
		objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "layerID", "<self>")
	else
		objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "layerID", idNumber of objectLayerRef)
		get name of objectLayerRef
		if it <> null
			objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "layerName", it)
		end
	end

	return objectIdentifier
end

to get ASYM_ObjectDescriptionFromObjectInfo obInfo, selfRef, event, initCaps, obRef
	-- we can construct a suitable unique, displayable object description from
	-- just the object info structure even if we don't know the source object,
	-- because the object info structure is all relative anyway.

	-- if obRef is passed, we use it to get a wid name if we can

	initCaps = (initCaps = true)

	if obInfo = null
		if initCaps
			return "Self"
		else
			return "self"
		end
	end

	obType = ASYM_GetDataElement (obInfo, "type")
	if initCaps = true
		char 1 of obType = uppercase(char 1 of obType)
	else
		char 1 of obType = lowercase(char 1 of obType)
	end

	-- Note that using an expression for an object's name is only supported by the Actions system,
	-- and only passed to this function at design time, so we're safe calling into an Actions system
	-- authoring function.
	nameExp = ASYM_GetDataElement(obInfo, "nameExp")
	if nameExp <> null
		return obType && ASYM_EA_ExpressionDisplayStringFromExpressionInfo(nameExp, selfRef, event, true)
	end

	bookName = ASYM_GetDataElement (obInfo, "bookName")
	if bookName = "<self>"
		bookName = null
	end

	if obType = "book"
		if bookName = null
			if initCaps
				return "This Book"
			else
				return "this book"
			end
		else
			if initCaps
				return "Book" && quote & bookName & quote
			else
				return "book" && quote & bookName & quote
			end
		end
	end

	obID = ASYM_GetDataElement (obInfo, "id")
	if obID = null or obID = "<self>"
		conditions
		when obType = "page"
			if initCaps
				return "This Page"
			else
				return "this page"
			end
		when obType = "background"
			if initCaps
				return "This Background"
			else
				return "this background"
			end
		else
			if initCaps
				return "Self"
			else
				return "self"
			end
		end
	end

	if obID = "<target>"
		if initCaps
			return "Target"
		else
			return "target"
		end
	end

	if obType = null
		return null
	end

	isGraphicObject = not ASYM_ItemInList (obType, "page,background,viewer,bitmap,icon,cursor,font,sharedScript,menuBar")

	if isGraphicObject and isObject(obRef)
		get ASYM_WID_Name of obRef
		if it <> null
			obType = it

			if initCaps
				step i from 1 to wordCount(obType)
					char 1 of word i of obType = uppercase(char 1 of word i of obType)
				end
			else
				step i from 1 to wordCount(obType)
					char 1 of word i of obType = lowercase(char 1 of word i of obType)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	obName = ASYM_GetDataElement (obInfo,

-- 0x9e79c  to get ASYM_ConstructObjectIdentifier objectRef, targetRef, noSelf, thisPage
to get ASYM_ConstructObjectIdentifier objectRef, targetRef, noSelf, thisPage
	-- <objectRef> is the object we're constructing an identifier for.
	-- <targetRef> is the object that will be storing the object reference.
	-- <noSelf> means don't return "<self>" for the object (but still will use self for parents of
	--   the object)
	-- <thisPage> forces a "this page" type reference when actions in the book or a background, or
	--   objects on a background, refer to a page or objects on a page (not used yet).

	local STRING objectIdentifier

	objectIdentifier = "object"

	if not isObject (targetRef)
		return null
	end

	targetType = object of targetRef

	if objectRef = "target"
		return ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "id", "<target>")
	end

	if objectRef = "self" or (objectRef = targetRef and noSelf <> true)
		return ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "id", "<self>")
	end

	if not isObject (objectRef) or not isObject (targetRef)
		return null
	end

	objectType = object of objectRef
	objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "type", objectType)

	if targetType = "book"
		targetBook = targetRef
	else
		targetBook = objectContainer (targetRef, "book")
	end

	if objectType = "book"
		objectBook = objectRef
	else
		objectBook = objectContainer (objectRef, "book")
	end

	if objectBook = targetBook and not (objectType = "book" and noSelf = true)
		objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "bookName", "<self>")
	else
		objectBookName = name of objectBook
		objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "bookName", ASYM_ShortFileName (objectBookName))
		send ASYM_RegisterPath ASYM_PathOfFile (objectBookName), targetRef
	end

	if objectType = "book"
		return objectIdentifier
	end

	if objectType = "page"
		if targetType = "page"
			targetPage = targetRef
		else
			targetPage = objectContainer (targetRef, "page")
		end
		if (objectRef = targetPage or (targetPage = null and thisPage = true)) and noSelf <> true
			objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "id", "<self>")
			return objectIdentifier
		end
	else
		if objectType = "background"
			if targetType = "background"
				targetBackground = targetRef
			else
				targetBackground = objectContainer (targetRef, "background")
			end
			if objectRef = targetBackground and noSelf <> true
				objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "id", "<self>")
				return objectIdentifier
			end
		end
	end

	objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "id", idNumber of objectRef)
	get name of objectRef
	if it <> null
		objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "name", it)
	end

	if ASYM_ItemInList (objectType, "page,background,viewer")
		return objectIdentifier
	end

	objectLayerRef = objectContainer (objectRef, "page,background")

	if ASYM_ItemInList (targetType, "page,background")
		targetLayerRef = targetRef
	else
		targetLayerRef = objectContainer (targetRef, "page,background")
	end

	objectLayerType = object of objectLayerRef
	objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "layerType", objectLayerType)

	if targetLayerRef = null
		targetLayerType = null
	else
		targetLayerType = object of targetLayerRef
	end

	if objectLayerRef = targetLayerRef or \
			(targetLayerRef <> null and objectLayerRef = parent of targetLayerRef) or \
			(targetLayerType <> "page" and objectLayerType = "page" and thisPage = true)
		objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "layerID", "<self>")
	else
		objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "layerID", idNumber of objectLayerRef)
		get name of objectLayerRef
		if it <> null
			objectIdentifier = ASYM_SetDataElement (objectIdentifier, "layerName", it)
		end
	end

	return objectIdentifier
end

	else

		layerType = ASYM_GetDataElement (obInfo, "layerType")

		if layerId = "<self>" or layerId = null
			-- Determine the layer type of the source object. If it's different to the layer type of

					if selfLayer = null
