					else
						selfLayerType = object of selfLayer
					end
				end
			end

			if initCaps
				char 1 of layerType = uppercase(char 1 of layerType)
			else
				char 1 of layerType = lowercase(char 1 of layerType)
			end

			if selfLayerType <> layerType
				if initCaps

			end
			return obDesc
		end

		if layerType = null
			return null
		end

		layerName = ASYM_GetDataElement (obInfo, "layerName")
		if layerName = null
			obDesc = obDesc && "of" && layerType && "id" && layerID
		else
			obDesc = obDesc && "of" && layerType && quote & layerName & quote
		end

to get ASYM_ResolveObject objectInfo, selfRef, targetRef, validate
	-- <objectInfo> defines a single object, and must be of the form:
	--     "object type=<type> id=<id number> name=<name> layerType=<layer type> layerID=<layer id> layerName=<layer name> bookName=<book name>"
	-- <selfRef> - the object that the <objectInfo> structure is relative to (self)
	-- <targetRef> - the target object (only passed by the Actions system runtime)
	-- <validate> - if true, validate that all the items in <objectInfo> are up-to-date, and if not
	--     return an up-to-date object info as the second textline of the return value.

	-- this handler clears sysError if successful. It sets sysError if the
	-- object could not be successfully resolved.

	sysError = null
	validate = (validate = true)

	if objectInfo = null
		if validate
			objectInfo = ASYM_SetDataElement ("object", "id", "<self>")
			return selfRef & CRLF & objectInfo
		else
			return selfRef
		end
	end

	objectType = ASYM_GetDataElement (objectInfo, "type")

	-- Added support for object name as expression. The expression is stored in the Actions system
	-- expression format. This functionality is only supported by the Actions system. Note that we
	-- never need to resolve the object here - at design time, the object isn't resolvable, and at
	-- runtime the object is resolved through other means. Therefore, we just return the structure
	-- passed to us, with "<exp>" appended to indicate that this object's name is specified as an
	-- expression.
	nameExp = ASYM_GetDataElement(objectInfo, "nameExp")
	if nameExp <> null
		push "<exp>" onto objectInfo
		return objectInfo
	end

	targetType = object of selfRef

	objectID = ASYM_GetDataElement (objectInfo, "id")
	if (objectID = "<self>" or objectID = null) and (objectType = null or objectType = targetType)
		if validate
			newObjectInfo = ASYM_SetDataElement ("object", "id", "<self>")
			if newObjectInfo <> objectInfo
				return selfRef & CRLF & newObjectInfo
			else
				return selfRef
			end
		else
			return selfRef
		end
	end

	if objectID = "<target>"
		if targetRef = null
			retVal = "<target>",selfRef
		else
			retVal = targetRef
		end

		if validate
			newObjectInfo = ASYM_SetDataElement ("object", "id", "<target>")
			if newObjectInfo <> objectInfo
				return retVal & CRLF & newObjectInfo
			else
				return retVal
			end
		else
			return retVal
		end
	end

	if objectType = null
		sysError = ASYM_GetString ("ResolveObjectNoObjectType", "No object type defined.")
		return null
	end

	bookName = ASYM_GetDataElement (objectInfo, "bookName")
	bookName = ASYM_ResolveBookName (bookName, selfRef)
	if sysError <> null
		return null
	end

	bs = ASYM_BlockSuspend()
	bookRef = book bookName
	get ASYM_RestoreSuspend (bs)

	if it <> null
		sysError = expandString (ASYM_GetString ("ResolveObjectNotABook", "Not a book: Book ""%1""."), bookName)
		return null
	end

	if objectType = "book"
		if validate
			newObjectInfo = ASYM_ConstructObjectIdentifier (bookRef, selfRef)
			if newObjectInfo <> objectInfo
				return bookRef & CRLF & newObjectInfo
			else
				return bookRef
			end
		else
			return bookRef
		end
	end

	objectName = ASYM_GetDataElement (objectInfo, "name")

	conditions
	when objectType = "page"
		retVal = ASYM_ResolvePage (objectName, objectID, bookRef, selfRef)
	when objectType = "background"
		retVal = ASYM_ResolveBackground (objectName, objectID, bookRef, selfRef)
	when objectType = "viewer"
		retVal = ASYM_FindViewer (objectName, objectID, bookRef, selfRef)
	else
		layerType = ASYM_GetDataElement (objectInfo, "

-- 0xa14de  to get _ASYM_ObjectsWhere ownerObj, objTypes, express

-- 0xa19ed  to get ASYM_SetDataElement stack dataStructure, string elementName, stack elementValue, validate
to get ASYM_SetDataElement stack dataStructure, string elementName, stack elementValue, validate
	local STACK tempStack
	local STACK elementValueStack

	chr1 = ansiToChar(1)

	if dataStructure <> null
		pop dataStructure into nameString

		-- If the nameString doesn't start with chr(1), then this data structure is in the old data format, unless it's
		-- only one element in which case just the structure name that's been passed to initialize the structure.

		if char 1 of nameString <> chr1
			-- if validate is true, we only accept valid arrays and this isn't a valid array
			if validate = true
				sysError = ASYM_GetString ("InvalidDataStructure", "Not a valid array.")
				return null
			end

			if dataStructure = null
				nameString = chr1 & nameString
			else
				push nameString onto dataStructure
				return ASYM_SetDataElement_Old (dataStructure, elementName, elementValue)
			end
		end
	else
		-- if validate is true, we only accept valid arrays and this isn't a valid array
		if validate = true
			sysError = ASYM_GetString ("InvalidDataStructure", "Not a valid array.")
			return null
		end

		-- If no name is specified for the data structure, we use chr4 for the name so the internal
		-- structure is still what we expect (otherwise we get ambiguities in the structure with no
		-- name specified).
		nameString = chr1 & ansiToChar(4)
	end

	-- We now have a bare data structure, without the name string (which is stored in nameString)

	chr2 = ansiToChar(2)

	while dataStructure <> null
		pop dataStructure into nm

		if nm contains SPACE -- we have data in the form "<element name> <element data>"
			-- Only want to include it if it's not the element we're about to add.
			if word 1 of nm <> elementName
				push nm onto tempStack
			else
				break while
			end
		else
			-- Will either be a bare element name, or will be of the form "<element name>,<chr1>,<element data>,<chr2>",
			-- where <element data> could be a data structure itself.
			if dataStructure <> null
				pop dataStructure

				if char 1 of it = chr1
					if nm = elementName
						-- this element will be replaced, so just skip to the end
						depth = 1
						do
							pop dataStructure
							if last char of it = chr2
								while last char of it = chr2 and depth > 0
									clear last char of it
									decrement depth
								end
							else
								if char 1 of it = chr1
									increment depth
								end
							end
						until depth = 0 or dataStructure = null
						break while
					else
						push nm onto tempStack
						push it onto tempStack
						depth = 1
						do
							pop dataStructure
							push it onto tempStack
							if last char of it = chr2
								while last char of it = chr2 and depth > 0
									clear last char of it
									decrement depth
								end
							else
								if char 1 of it = chr1
									increment depth
								end
							end
						until depth = 0 or dataStructure = null
					end
				else
					if nm <> elementName
						push nm onto tempStack
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- We've now removed any existing element of that name. We have the following variables set up:

	-- tempStack - contains all of the data structure up to the point where we found the element, in reverse order.
	-- dataStructure - contains what was left after than point, in correct order.
	-- elementValue - a potential stack, in the correct order
	-- nameString - name string to go on the front

	-- We need to pop off the items in elementValue onto a temporary stack, to determine how many
	-- items it has. If only 1, then we push "<element name> <element data>" onto dataStructure.
	-- Otherwise we push chr2 onto data structure, followed by the items that were in elementValue
	-- (which are now in reverse order, so they end up in correct order), followed by chr1, followed
	-- by the element name.

	if elementValue <> null
		elementItemCount = 0

		-- Note that quotes can cause problems within the data structure, so we replace them with
		-- chr(3) and restore then when extracting data. However, we don't need to replace quotes if
		-- <elementValue> is a data structure, as quotes would already have been replaced when the
		-- data structure was created.
		quoteChar = ansiToChar(3)

		-- Quick peek to see if we're looking at a data structure. Note that if elementValue is a
		-- stack (which it will be if it's a data structure), it's faster to pop the first item off,
		-- look at it's first char, then push it back on than it is to get the first char of
		-- elementValue, which would result in a stack to string conversion.
		pop elementValue
		replaceQuotes = (char 1 of it <> chr1)
		push it onto elementValue

		-- Replace quotes if necessary
		if replaceQuotes
			get offset (quote, elementValue)
			while it > 0
				char it of elementValue = quoteChar
				get offset (quote, elementValue)
			end
		end

		while elementValue <> null
			pop elementValue into elementItem
			push elementItem onto elementValueStack
			increment elementItemCount
		end

		if elementItemCount = 1
			push elementName && elementValueStack onto dataStructure
		else
			if elementValueStack <> null
				pop elementValueStack
				put chr2 after it
				push it onto dataStructure
			end

			while elementValueStack <> null
				pop elementValueStack
				push it onto dataStructure
			end

			if char 1 of it <> chr1
				push chr1 onto dataStructure
			end
			push elementName onto dataStructure
		end
	end

	while tempStack <> null
		pop tempStack
		push it onto dataStructure
	end

	push nameString onto dataStructure

	return dataStructure
end

to get ASYM_GetDataElement stack dataStructure, string elementName, defaultValue, validate
	local STACK tempStack, retVal

	chr1 = ansiToChar(1)

	if dataStructure <> null
		pop dataStructure into nameString

		-- If the nameString doesn't start with chr(1), then this data structure is in the old data format, unless it's
		-- only one element in which case just the structure name that's been passed to initialize the structure.

		if char 1 of nameString <> chr1
			-- if validate is true, we only accept valid arrays and this isn't a valid array
			if validate = true
				sysError = ASYM_GetString ("InvalidDataStructure", "Not a valid array.")
				return null
			end

			push nameString onto dataStructure
			return ASYM_GetDataElement_Old (dataStructure, elementName, defaultValue)
		end
	else
		-- if validate is true, we only accept valid arrays and this isn't a valid array
		if validate = true
			sysError = ASYM_GetString ("InvalidDataStructure", "Not a valid array.")
			return null
		end
	end

	-- We now have a bare data structure, without the name string
	chr2 = ansiToChar(2)
	quoteChar = ansiToChar(3)
	while dataStructure <> null
		pop dataStructure into nm

		if nm contains SPACE -- we have data in the form "<element name> <element data>"
			-- Is it the element we're after?
			if word 1 of nm = elementName
				clear chars 1 to charCount (elementName) + 1 of nm

				-- Restore quotes that have been escaped
				get offset (quoteChar, nm)
				while it > 0
					char it of nm = quote
					get offset (quoteChar, nm)
				end

				retVal = nm
				break while
			end
		else
			-- Will either be a bare element name, or will be of the form "<element name>,<chr1>,<element data>,<chr2>",
			-- where <element data> could be a data structure itself.
			if dataStructure <> null
				pop dataStructure into dataElement

				if char 1 of dataElement = chr1
					if nm = elementName
						-- gather the data to return
						if dataElement = chr1
							-- This is just a bare marker, which means we're not looking at a nested
							-- data structure. Therefore we need to replace the escape character for
							-- quotes with real quotes.
							restoreQu

-- 0xa3ef5  to get ASYM_Offset str, src, pos
to get ASYM_Offset str, src, pos
	get charCount (src)
	if pos > it
		return 0
	else
		get offset (str, chars pos to it of src)
		if it = 0
			return 0
		else
			return it + pos - 1
		end
	end
end

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Support for "for each" type loops
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------

to get ASYM_ForEachInit STACK dataStructure, validate
	-- initializes a "for each" loop on a data structure

	system STACK _s_ASYM_ForEachData[][]

	-- _s_ASYM_ForEachData[n][1] - the actual data structure
	-- _s_ASYM_ForEachData[n][2] - true if this ID is in use
	-- _s_ASYM_ForEachData[n][3] - structure version

	-- first we need to find an empty structureID to use
	structureID = 1
	while _s_ASYM_ForEachData[structureID][2] <> null
		increment structureID
	end

	_s_ASYM_ForEachData[structureID][2] = true

	-- process the data structure to remove the name, and determine the version
	if dataStructure <> null
		pop dataStructure into nameString

		-- If it doesn't have a version string, then it's in the old data format.
		if char 1 of nameString <> ansiToChar(1)
			-- if validate is true, we only accept valid arrays and this isn't a valid array
			if validate = true and (wordCount(nameString) <> 1 or dataStructure <> null)
				sysError = ASYM_GetString ("InvalidDataStructure", "Not a valid array.")
				return null
			end

			if wordCount (nameString) <> 1 -- it's not the structure name, so we put it back
				push nameString onto dataStructure
			end

			_s_ASYM_ForEachData[structureID][1] = dataStructure
			_s_ASYM_ForEachData[structureID][3] = null -- no version number

			return structureID
		end
	end

	_s_ASYM_ForEachData[structureID][3] = 0
	_s_ASYM_ForEachData[structureID][1] = dataStructure

	return structureID
end

to get ASYM_ForEachNext structureID
	-- returns the next structureID in a data structure

	system STACK _s_ASYM_ForEachData[][]
	local STACK dataStructure, tempStack, retVal

	dataStructure = _s_ASYM_ForEachData[structureID][1]

	-- Once the user calls and gets an empty data structure, we no longer consider this id to be in
	-- use, so we clear the second element.
	if dataStructure = null
		_s_ASYM_ForEachData[structureID][2] = null
		_s_ASYM_ForEachData[structureID][3] = null
		return null
	end

	if _s_ASYM_ForEachData[structureID][3] = null -- it's in the old format
		pop dataStructure into bit

		elementName = word 1 of bit
		clear chars 1 to charCount (elementName) + 1 of bit
		retVal = bit
		retVal = ASYM_ExpandSpecialChars (retVal)

		push elementName onto retVal

		_s_ASYM_ForEachData[structureID][1] = dataStructure

		return retVal
	end

	pop dataStructure into nm

	if nm contains SPACE -- we have data in the form "<element name> <element data>"
		elementName = word 1 of nm
		clear chars 1 to charCount (elementName) + 1 of nm
		retVal = nm
		push elementName onto retVal
	else
		-- Will either be a bare element name, or will be of the form "<element name>,<chr1>,<element data>,<chr2>",
		-- where <element data> could be a data structure itself.
		if dataStructure = null
			retVal = nm
		else
			pop dataStructure

			chr1 = ansiToChar(1)

			if char 1 of it <> chr1
				-- it's not data, so we push it back on
				push it onto dataStructure
				retVal = nm
			else
				-- gather the data to return
				if it <> chr1 -- this is the first item of data, not just a marker
					push it onto tempStack
				end

				depth = 1
				chr2 = ansiToChar(2)
				do
					pop dataStructure
					if last char of it = chr2
						while last char of it = chr2 and depth > 0
							decrement depth
							clear last char of it
						end
					else
						if char 1 of it = chr1
							increment depth
						end
					end
					push it onto tempStack
				until depth = 0 or dataStructure = null

				while tempStack <> null
					pop tempStack
					push it onto retVal
				end

				push nm onto retVal
			end
		end
	end

	_s_ASYM_ForEachData[structureID][1] = dataStructure

	return retVal
end

to get ASYM_ForEachRelease structureID
	system STACK _s_ASYM_ForEachData[][]

	clear _s_ASYM_ForEachData[structureID][1]
	clear _s_ASYM_ForEachData[structureID][2]
	clear _s_ASYM_ForEachData[structureID][3]

	return true
end

-- Converts a list (comma seperated string) to a stack faster than the system does (believe it!)
to get ASYM_ListToStack STRING pList
	local STACK tempStack, retVal

	while pList <> null
		pos = offset (",", pList)
		if pos = 0
			get pList
			clear pList
		else
			get chars 1 to pos-1 of pList
			clear chars 1 to pos of pList
		end

		push it onto tempStack
	end

	while tempStack <> null
		pop tempStack
		push it onto retVal
	end

	return retVal
end

-- return data type of an array user property
to get _asym_ArrayPropertyDataType obj, prop
	local STACK dTypes

	bs = ASYM_BlockSuspend()
	dimValues = getPropertyDimensions(obj,prop)
	error = ASYM_RestoreSuspend(bs)

	if dimValues <> NULL
		-- this is a valid array, we are okay to continue
		dTypes = ",int,long,real,word,dword,string,logical,point,color,stack," & \
		         "date,time,page,background,layer,graphic,field,object,book"

		dTypesCopy = dTypes

		dims = ASYM_StringOf("[]",itemCount(dimValues))

		while dTypes <> null
			pop dTypes into curType
			error = typeDataCheck(obj, prop, curType, dims)
			if error = null
				-- data type has been identified
				return (ASYM_itemOffset(curType,dTypesCopy) - 1)
			end
		end
	end

	return -1
end

to get typeDataCheck obj, prop, curType, dims
	bs = ASYM_BlockSuspend()
	cmd = "local" && curType && "temp" & dims
	execute cmd

	clear sysError
	cmd = "temp =" && prop && "of" && obj
	execute cmd

	error = sysError

	get ASYM_RestoreSuspend(bs)
	return error
end

-- 0xaaa46  to get writeMemToFile iFileHandle, lpBuffer, dwBytes
to get writeMemToFile iFileHandle, lpBuffer, dwBytes
	startAddress = getSelectorBase(item 1 of lpBuffer)

	--Write out the data in 65334 byte chunks.
	dwBytesTmp = dwBytes

   	while (dwBytes > 65334)
      	if (_lwrite(iFileHandle, lpBuffer, 65334) <> 65334)
         	return 0
         end
      	dwBytes = dwBytes - 65334
      	address = getSelectorBase(item 1 of lpBuffer)
      	get SetSelectorBase(item 1 of lpBuffer,address + 65334)
	end

	-- Write out the last chunk (which is < 65334 bytes)

	if (_lwrite(iFileHandle, lpBuffer, dwBytes) <> dwBytes)
		get SetSelectorBase(item 1 of lpBuffer, startAddress)
 		return 0
 	else
		get SetSelectorBase(item 1 of lpBuffer, startAddress)
 		return dwBytesTmp
 	end
end writeMemToFile


-- **************************************************************************

to get DIBError ErrNo
	if ((ErrNo < 0) or (ErrNo >= 29))
		-- The decimal equivalent of MB_OK | MB_ICONSTOP is 16.
		get MessageBox(0, "Undefined Error!", "", 16)
		return -1
	else
   		conditions
   			when ErrNo = 0
   				return ErrNo
   			when ErrNo = 1
   				ErrString = "Not a Windows DIB file!"
   			when ErrNo = 2
   				ErrString = "Couldn't allocate memory!"
   			when ErrNo = 3
  				ErrString = "Error reading file!"
   			when ErrNo = 4
   				ErrString = "Error locking memory!"
   			when ErrNo = 5
   				ErrString = "Error opening file!"
   			when ErrNo = 6
   				ErrString = "Error creating palette!"
   			when ErrNo = 7
   				ErrString = "Error getting a DC!"
   			when ErrNo = 8
   				ErrString = "Error creating Device Dependent Bitmap"
   			when ErrNo = 9
   				ErrString = "StretchBlt() failed!"
   			when ErrNo = 10
   				ErrString = "StretchDIBits() failed!"
   			when ErrNo = 11
   				ErrString = "SetDIBitsToDevice() failed!"
   			when ErrNo = 12
   				ErrString = "Printer: StartDoc failed!"
   			when ErrNo = 13
   				ErrString = "Printing: GetModuleHandle() couldn't find GDI!"
   			when ErrNo = 14
   				ErrString = "Printer: SetAbortProc failed!"
   			when ErrNo = 15
   				ErrString = "Printer: StartPage failed!"
   			when ErrNo = 16
   				ErrString = "Printer: NEWFRAME failed!"
   			when ErrNo = 17
   				ErrString = "Printer: EndPage failed!"
   			when ErrNo = 18
   				ErrString = "Printer: EndDoc failed!"
	   		when ErrNo = 19
	   			ErrString = "SetDIBits() failed!"
   			when ErrNo = 20
   				ErrString = "File Not Found!"
   			when ErrNo = 21
   				ErrString = "Invalid Window Handle"
   			when ErrNo = 22
   				ErrString = "General Error on call to DIB function"
   			when ErrNo = 23
   				ErrString = "Error creating DIB from specified window."
   			when ErrNo = 24
   				ErrString = "Error getting number of colors, check the device you are using."
   			when ErrNo = 25
   				ErrString = "Error creating printer DC!  Could not get Printer Information"
   			when ErrNo = 26
   				ErrString = "Error: Invalid Print Area!"
   			when ErrNo = 27
   				ErrString = "Error: Invalid Print Option!"
   			when ErrNo = 28
   				ErrString = "Error:  Could not create DIB file"
   			when ErrNo = 29
   				ErrString = "Error:  Could not write DIB to file"
   		end conditions

		get MessageBox(0, ErrString, "Print/Save Error", 16)
		return ErrNo
	end if
end DIBError

to get getViewerName whatViewer
	if name of whatViewer <> NULL
		return "viewer" && QUOTE & name of whatViewer & QUOTE
	else
		return words 1 to 3 of whatViewer
	end if
end getViewerName

-- **************************************************************************
to handle saveWindowToFile hWnd, wPrintArea, FileName, bitCount, compress, toTop, update, statusB
	LOCAL winList, nameList, palettes, handleList, parentWin
	local WORD hszJobName, currentlyActiveWnd, hWnd1
	local REAL status
	local LOGICAL sbVis

	send linkDlls

	tmp = ""
	currentlyActiveWnd = activeWindowHandle

	if Hwnd <> NULL
		oldSys = sysSuspendMessages
		sysSuspendMessages = TRUE

		in mainWindow
			prnWindow = windowRefFromHandle(hwnd)
			if prnWindow <> NULL
				in prnWindow
					oldStatus = visible of statusbar
					if  NOT (sysRuntime = TRUE)
						if (statusB <> NULL)
							visible of statusbar = statusB
						else
							statusB = NULL
						end if
					end if
				end
			end if
		end

		sysSuspendMessages = FALSE

		if toTop = NULL
			toTop = TRUE
		end

		-- hide pallettes
		if (toTop = TRUE)
			if NOT sysRuntime  AND (prnWindow <> NULL)
				push visible of commandWindow onto palettes
				push visible of colorTray onto palettes
				push visible of lineEndsPalette onto palettes
				push visible of linePalette onto palettes
				push visible of patternPalette onto palettes
				push visible of polygonPalette onto palettes
				push visible of statusBar onto palettes
				push visible of toolbar onto palettes
				push visible of toolPalette onto palettes

				hide commandWindow
				hide colorTray
				hide lineEndsPalette
				hide linePalette
				hide patternPalette
				hide polygonPalette
				hide toolbar
				hide toolPalette
			end


			get bringWindowToTop(hWnd)
		end

		-- get open media if running multimedia toolbook
		tmp = sysOpenMedia
		if (tmp <> "" AND tmp <> "sysOpenMedia")
			mediaList = tmp
			in mainwindow
				step i from 1 to itemcount(mediaList)
					whatClip = item i of mediaList
					if mmDeviceHandle of whatClip <> NULL
						push mmDeviceHandle of whatClip onto handleList
					end
				end
			end
		end

		if update = NULL
			update = TRUE
		end

		if update
			step i from 1 to itemcount(handleList)
				hWnd1 = item i of handleList
				get InvalidateRect(hWnd1,0,0)
				get updateWindow(hWnd1)
				mmYield
				get yield()
				mmYield
			end
		end

		if (fileName = NULL)
			vwrRef = windowRefFromHandle( hWnd )
			if (vwrRef = NULL)
				fileName = "printwnd.dib"
			else
				fileName = name of parent of vwrRef
				while (fileName <> NULL) AND ("." is not last char of fileName)
					clear last char of fileName
				end while
				fileName = fileName & "dib"
			end if
		end if

		if ("," & bitCount & "," is not in ",1,4,8,24,")
			bitCount = 8
		end if

		if (compress <> "RLE4") AND (compress <> "RLE8")
			compress = ""
		end if

		if wPrintArea = NULL
			wPrintArea = 1
		end

		status = doSaveWindow(hWnd, wPrintArea, FileName, bitCount, compress)

		if (toTop = TRUE) and NOT sysRuntime and (Palettes <> NULL)
			pop palettes into visible of toolPalette
			pop palettes into visible of toolbar
			pop palettes into visible of statusBar
			pop palettes into visible of polygonPalette
			pop palettes into visible of patternPalette
			pop palettes into visible of linePalette
			pop palettes into visible of lineEndsPalette
			pop palettes into visible of colorTray
			pop palettes into visible of commandWindow
		end

		if NOT sysRuntime
			in mainWindow
				if prnWindow <> NULL AND (statusB <> NULL)
					in prnWindow
						visible of statusbar = oldStatus
					end
				end
			end
		end

		sysSuspendMessages = oldSys
	end

	get BringWindowToTop(currentlyActiveWnd)
end saveWindowtoFile


-- **************************************************************************
-- *
-- * doSaveWindow()
-- *
-- * Description:
-- *
-- * This function saves the specified window to the specified file
-- *
-- * Parameters:
-- *
-- * WORD hWnd       - Specifies the window to print.  The window must
-- *                   not be iconic and must be topmost on the display.
-- *
-- * WORD fPrintArea - Specifies the area of the window to print.  Must be
-- *             	   one of:		1 (corresponds to PW_ALL)

-- 0xac52b  to get _ASYM_WID_Responses obj
to get _ASYM_WID_Responses obj
	LOCAL ARRAY ansArray[][]
	LOCAL STACK buffer, retVal

	if ASYM_HasAnsArray(obj)
		ansArray = ASYM_WID_AnsArray of obj

		QType = ASYM_WID_QType of obj

		if QType is "ORDERTEXT"
			get text of (_dragField of obj)

			p = offset(CRLF,it)
			while p > 0
				chars p to p+1 of it = ""
				p = offset(CRLF,it)
			end
			return it
		end

		retVal = ASYM_WID_ResponseIDs of obj
		while retVal <> NULL
			pop retVal
			push it onto buffer
		end
		clear retVal
		matchQ = "MATCH" is in QType
		typeIn = (QType = "TYPEIN") and (_logResponse of obj <> FALSE)
		multiField = (QType = "MULTICHOICE" or QType = "TRUEFALSE") and object of item 1 of objects of obj = "Field"

		while buffer <> NULL
			pop buffer into respID
			if respID <> NULL
				if respID = "<else>" or ITrespID = 99
					respID = item 1 of dimensions(ansArray)
				end

				val = ansArray[respID][1]

				conditions
					when multiField
						push "<" & respID & ">" onto retVal
					when typeIn and char 1 of val <> "<"
						push "<" & val & ">" onto retVal
					else
						push val onto retVal
				end

				conditions
					when matchQ
						put ansArray[respID][17] & " -> " before item 1 of retVal
					when typeIn
						txt = _cleanUp(_responseText of obj)
						cnt = charcount(txt)
						maxCnt = ASYM_WID_logResponseLimit of obj
						if maxCnt is NULL or (not isType("real",maxCnt)) or maxCnt < 1
							maxCnt = 256
						end
						if cnt > maxCnt
							txt = chars 1 to (maxCnt-5) of txt & "[...]"
						end
						put SPACE & QUOTE & txt & QUOTE after retVal
					when multiField
						put SPACE & QUOTE & _cleanUp(ansArray[respID][1]) & QUOTE after retVal

				end
			end
		end
	end
	return retval
end

to get _ASYM_BeginResponse actualObj, respName, _target, resetToOld
	SYSTEM s_cbtr_CurrentQ,s_cbtr_CurrentQObj

	LOCAL ARRAY	ansArray[][]
	LOCAL STACK buffer
	LOCAL DWORD oldTimeChosen, newTimeChosen, TimeUsed

  	ansArray = ASYM_WID_AnsArray of _target
	maxIndex = item 1 of dimensions(ansArray)
	if maxIndex = 0
		return FALSE
	end

	s_cbtr_CurrentQ = _target
	s_cbtr_CurrentQObj = actualObj

	whatIndex = NULL
	QType = ASYM_WID_QType of _target
	newTimeChosen = ASYM_Ticks()
	answerLocked = ASYM_WID_AnswerLocked of _target

	oldLock = lockScreen of this window
	lockScreen of this window = false -- TRUE

	if answerLocked = TRUE
		get ASYM_DoGenericTextFeedback (actualObj, "<questionLocked>")
		_locked of _responseList of _target = TRUE
		if object of _target <> "hotword"
			_locked of objects of _target = TRUE
		end
		conditions
			when QType = "ORDEROBJ"
				position of actualObj = _startLoc of actualObj
			when QType = "MULTICHOICE"
			when QType = "TRUEFALSE"
				if object of actualObj = "button"
					checked of actualObj = not checked of actualObj
				end
		end
		lockScreen of this window = oldLock
		return FALSE
	end

	if _locked of actualObj = TRUE
		get ASYM_DoGenericTextFeedback (actualObj, "<responseItemLocked>")
		lockScreen of this window = oldLock
		return FALSE
	end

	if (ASYM_WID_TimeMax of _target <> 0) and\
	  (not SetElapsedTime(_target, newTimeChosen))
		sysError = "Elapsed time reset"
		lockScreen of this window = oldLock
		return FALSE
	end

	timeMax = ASYM_WID_TimeMax of _target
	timeUsed = ASYM_WID_TimeUsed of _target
	triesMax = ASYM_WID_TriesMax of _target
	triesUsed = ASYM_WID_TriesUsed of _target

	conditions
		when timeMax <> 0 and timeUsed >= timeMax
			errStr = "<outOfTime>"
		when triesMax <> 0 and triesUsed >= triesMax
			errStr = "<outOfTries>"
		when ASYM_WID_AutoLockAnswer of _target = TRUE \
		  and ASYM_WID_MultipleAnswers of _target <> "TRUE"\
		  and triesUsed > 0
			errStr = "<questionLocked>"
		else
			errStr = NULL
	end

	if errStr <> null
		send idle to this page
		ASYM_WID_TimeLocked of _target = newTimeChosen

		get ASYM_DoGenericTextFeedback (actualObj, errStr)
		if errStr is "<outOfTime>" or resetToOld is TRUE
			send LockAndAdjustTestItem _target, actualObj, \
			  respName, QType
		else
			ASYM_WID_AnswerLocked of _target = TRUE
			_locked of _responseList of _target = TRUE
			send ASYM_QLocked _target, respName to _target
		end
		lockScreen of this window = oldLock

		return FALSE
	end

	lockScreen of this window = oldLock
	return TRUE
end

to get _ASYM_CheckPoint obj, loc, _target
	SYSTEM s_asym_dragObj, s_asym_dropObj
	LOCAL STACK objList
	LOCAL STRING onam

	objName = obj & ""
	if isObject(objName)
		obj = uniquename of obj
		objName = name of obj
	end

	testObj = objectfrompoint(loc)
	s_asym_dropObj = testObj
	if testObj <> NULL and name of testObj = objName
		send _moveObj obj, _target
		return TRUE
	end

	oldLock = lockscreen of this window
	lockscreen of this window = TRUE
	while testObj <> NULL and object of testObj is not in "pagebackground"
		while testObj <> NULL and name of testObj <> objName and object of parent of testObj is not in "pagebackground"
			testObj = parent of testObj
		end
		push testObj onto objList
		if testObj <> NULL and name of testObj is objName
			s_asym_dropObj = testObj
			visible of objList = TRUE
			send _moveObj obj, _target
			return TRUE
		end
		hide testObj
		testObj = objectfrompoint(loc)
		s_asym_dropObj = testObj
	end
	if objList <> NULL
		visible of objList = TRUE
	end
	lockscreen of this window = oldLock

	return FALSE
end

to handle _ASYM_GetTypeInData _target
	if _locked of _target = TRUE
		get ASYM_DoGenericTextFeedback (_target, "<questionLocked>")
		break _ASYM_GetTypeInData
	end

	hwTxt = text of _target
	spot = textOffset of _target
	myParent = parent of _target
	_lastText of _target = text of _target


	IsBlank = TRUE
	NBS = ansiToChar(160)
	step i from 1 to charcount(hwTxt)
		if char i of hwTxt <> NBS
			IsBlank = FALSE
			break step
		end
	end
	maxChars = ASYM_WID_MaxChars of _target
	step i from charcount(hwTxt) to maxChars-1
		put NBS after hwTxt
	end
	text of _target = hwTxt
	fontStyle of chars spot to spot+(charcount(text of _target))-1 of text of myParent = bold,underline

	oldSys = sysSuspendMessages; sysSuspendMessages = TRUE

	if not isBlank
		myText = NULL
		step i from 1 to maxChars
			put NBS after myText
		end
		text of _target = myText
		fontStyle of chars spot to spot+(charcount(myText))-1 of text of myParent = underline,bold
	end

	ls = lockScreen of targetWindow
	lockScreen of targetWindow = TRUE
	if _inputField of _target = NULL or not isObject(_inputField of _target)
		bnds = bounds of _target
		pop bnds into x1; pop bnds into y1; pop bnds into x2; pop bnds into y2
		draw field from x1,y1 to x2 + 2 * item 1 of sysPageUnitsPerPixel, y2 + 2 * item 2 of sysPageUnitsPerPixel
		entryField = selection
		if not isBlank
			text of entryField = hwTxt
		end
		get parent of _target
		activated of entryField = false
		indents of entryField = 0,0,0
		borderStyle of entryField = none
		fieldType of entryField = noWrap
		ASYM_WID_MaxChars of entryField = ASYM_WID_MaxChars of _target
		_targetHotword of entryField = _target
		_inputField of _target = entryField
	else
		entryField = _inputField of _target

		bnds = bounds of _target
		pop bnds into x1; pop bnds into y1; pop bnds into x2; pop bnds into y2
		bounds of entryField = x1,y1,x2 + 2 * item 1 of sysPageUnitsPerPixel, y2 + 2 * item 2 of sysPageUnitsPerPixel
		if not isBlank
			text of entryField = hwTxt
		else
			text of entryField = NULL
		end
	end
	ASYM_WID_MaxChars of entryField = ASYM_WID_MaxChars of _target

	get parent of _target
	transparent of entryField = transparent of it
	fillcolor of entryField = fillColor of it
	useWindowsColors of entryField = useWindowsColors of it
	fontface of entryField = fontface of text of _target
	fontsize of entryField = fontsize of text of _target
	fontstyle of entryField =

-- 0xac999  to get _ASYM_BeginResponse actualObj, respName, _target, resetToOld

			errStr = "<outOfTries>"
		when ASYM_WID_AutoLockAnswer of _target = TRUE \
		  and ASYM_WID_MultipleAnswers of _target <> "TRUE"\
		  and triesUsed > 0
			errStr = "<questionLocked>"
		else
			errStr = NULL
	end

	if errStr <> null
		send idle to this page
		ASYM_WID_TimeLocked of _target = newTimeChosen

		get ASYM_DoGenericTextFeedback (actualObj, errStr)
		if errStr is "<outOfTime>" or resetToOld is TRUE
			send LockAndAdjustTestItem _target, actualObj, \
			  respName, QType
		else
			ASYM_WID_AnswerLocked of _target = TRUE
			_locked of _responseList of _target = TRUE
			send ASYM_QLocked _target, respName to _target
		end
		lockScreen of this window = oldLock

		return FALSE
	end

	lockScreen of this window = oldLock
	return TRUE
end

to get _ASYM_CheckPoint obj, loc, _target
	SYSTEM s_asym_dragObj, s_asym_dropObj
	LOCAL STACK objList
	LOCAL STRING onam

	objName = obj & ""
	if isObject(objName)
		obj = uniquename of obj
		objName = name of obj
	end

	testObj = objectfrompoint(loc)
	s_asym_dropObj = testObj
	if testObj <> NULL and name of testObj = objName
		send _moveObj obj, _target
		return TRUE
	end

	oldLock = lockscreen of this window
	lockscreen of this window = TRUE
	while testObj <> NULL and object of testObj is not in "pagebackground"
		while testObj <> NULL and name of testObj <> objName and object of parent of testObj is not in "pagebackground"
			testObj = parent of testObj
		end
		push testObj onto objList
		if testObj <> NULL and name of testObj is objName
			s_asym_dropObj = testObj
			visible of objList = TRUE
			send _moveObj obj, _target
			return TRUE
		end
		hide testObj
		testObj = objectfrompoint(loc)
		s_asym_dropObj = testObj
	end
	if objList <> NULL
		visible of objList = TRUE
	end
	lockscreen of this window = oldLock

	return FALSE
end

to handle _ASYM_GetTypeInData _target
	if _locked of _target = TRUE
		get ASYM_DoGenericTextFeedback (_target, "<questionLocked>")
		break _ASYM_GetTypeInData
	end

	hwTxt = text of _target
	spot = textOffset of _target
	myParent = parent of _target
	_lastText of _target = text of _target


	IsBlank = TRUE
	NBS = ansiToChar(160)
	step i from 1 to charcount(hwTxt)
		if char i of hwTxt <> NBS
			IsBlank = FALSE
			break step
		end
	end
	maxChars = ASYM_WID_MaxChars of _target
	step i from charcount(hwTxt) to maxChars-1
		put NBS after hwTxt
	end
	text of _target = hwTxt
	fontStyle of chars spot to spot+(charcount(text of _target))-1 of text of myParent = bold,underline

	oldSys = sysSuspendMessages; sysSuspendMessages = TRUE

	if not isBlank
		myText = NULL
		step i from 1 to maxChars
			put NBS after myText
		end
		text of _target = myText
		fontStyle of chars spot to spot+(charcount(myText))-1 of text of myParent = underline,bold
	end

	ls = lockScreen of targetWindow
	lockScreen of targetWindow = TRUE
	if _inputField of _target = NULL or not isObject(_inputField of _target)
		bnds = bounds of _target
		pop bnds into x1; pop bnds into y1; pop bnds into x2; pop bnds into y2
		draw field from x1,y1 to x2 + 2 * item 1 of sysPageUnitsPerPixel, y2 + 2 * item 2 of sysPageUnitsPerPixel
		entryField = selection
		if not isBlank
			text of entryField = hwTxt
		end
		get parent of _target
		activated of entryField = false
		indents of entryField = 0,0,0
		borderStyle of entryField = none
		fieldType of entryField = noWrap
		ASYM_WID_MaxChars of entryField = ASYM_WID_MaxChars of _target
		_targetHotword of entryField = _target
		_inputField of _target = entryField
	else
		entryField = _inputField of _target

		bnds = bounds of _target
		pop bnds into x1; pop bnds into y1; pop bnds into x2; pop bnds into y2
		bounds of entryField = x1,y1,x2 + 2 * item 1 of sysPageUnitsPerPixel, y2 + 2 * item 2 of sysPageUnitsPerPixel
		if not isBlank
			text of entryField = hwTxt
		else
			text of entryField = NULL
		end
	end
	ASYM_WID_MaxChars of entryField = ASYM_WID_MaxChars of _target

	get parent of _target
	transparent of entryField = transparent of it
	fillcolor of entryField = fillColor of it
	useWindowsColors of entryField = useWindowsColors of it
	fontface of entryField = fontface of text of _target
	fontsize of entryField = fontsize of text of _target
	fontstyle of entryField = fontstyle of text of _target
	strokeColor of entryField = strokeColor of text of _target
	lockScreen of targetWindow = ls

	show entryField

	sysSuspendMessages = oldSys
	script of entryField = _script of _target
	focus = entryField
	select text of entryField
end


to handle _ASYM_RegisterResponse actualObj, respName, _target

	SYSTEM s_cbtr_CurrentQ, s_cbtr_CurrentQObj, s_cbtr_lastQ, s_asym_dropObj

	LOCAL ARRAY	ansArray[][]
	LOCAL STACK buffer
	LOCAL DWORD oldTimeChosen, newTimeChosen, TimeUsed

	loc = sysMousePosition

  	ansArray = ASYM_WID_AnsArray of _target

	if maxIndex = 0
		break _ASYM_RegisterResponse
	end
	whatIndex = NULL
	FBIndex = NULL

	newTimeChosen = ASYM_Ticks()

	clear sysError
	OK = TRUE
	if s_cbtr_CurrentQ <> _target or s_cbtr_CurrentQObj <> actualObj

		-- BeginResponse checks not performed yet. Check for locks and
		-- reset object positions if necessary

		OK = _ASYM_BeginResponse(actualObj, respName, _target, TRUE)
	end
	clear s_cbtr_CurrentQ
	clear s_cbtr_CurrentQObj

	if not OK
		break
	end

	answerLocked = (ASYM_WID_AnswerLocked of _target is TRUE)
	if answerLocked
		break
	end

	oldLock = lockScreen of this window
	lockScreen of this window = TRUE

	clear ASYM_WID_ReadyToRun of _target --** NEW

	rejectIfWrong = (ASYM_WID_RejectWrong of _target is TRUE)

	lockWidget = FALSE
	rejectFlag = TRUE
	OK = TRUE
	conditions
		when QType = "MULTICHOICE"
		when QType = "TRUEFALSE"
			whatIndex = respName
			FBIndex = whatIndex
			if ASYM_WID_MultipleAnswers of _target = TRUE
				prevResponse = itemOffset(whatIndex, ASYM_WID_ResponseIDs of _target)
				if prevResponse > 0

-- 0xacf5b  to get _ASYM_CheckPoint obj, loc, _target

to handle _ASYM_RegisterResponse actualObj, respName, _target

	SYSTEM s_cbtr_CurrentQ, s_cbtr_CurrentQObj, s_cbtr_lastQ, s_asym_dropObj

	LOCAL ARRAY	ansArray[][]
	LOCAL STACK buffer
	LOCAL DWORD oldTimeChosen, newTimeChosen, TimeUsed

	loc = sysMousePosition

  	ansArray = ASYM_WID_AnsArray of _target
	maxIndex = item 1 of dimensions(ansArray)
	if maxIndex = 0
		break _ASYM_RegisterResponse
	end
	whatIndex = NULL
	FBIndex = NULL

	QType = ASYM_WID_QType of _target
	newTimeChosen = ASYM_Ticks()

	clear sysError
	OK = TRUE
	if s_cbtr_CurrentQ <> _target or s_cbtr_CurrentQObj <> actualObj

		-- BeginResponse checks not performed yet. Check for locks and
		-- reset object positions if necessary

		OK = _ASYM_BeginResponse(actualObj, respName, _target, TRUE)
	end
	clear s_cbtr_CurrentQ
	clear s_cbtr_CurrentQObj

	if not OK
		break
	end

	answerLocked = (ASYM_WID_AnswerLocked of _target is TRUE)
	if answerLocked
		break
	end

	oldLock = lockScreen of this window
	lockScreen of this window = TRUE

	clear ASYM_WID_ReadyToRun of _target --** NEW

	rejectIfWrong = (ASYM_WID_RejectWrong of _target is TRUE)

	lockWidget = FALSE
	rejectFlag = TRUE
	OK = TRUE
	conditions
		when QType = "MULTICHOICE"
		when QType = "TRUEFALSE"
			whatIndex = respName
			FBIndex = whatIndex
			if ASYM_WID_MultipleAnswers of _target = TRUE
				prevResponse = itemOffset(whatIndex, ASYM_WID_ResponseIDs of _target)
				if prevResponse > 0
					clear item prevResponse of ASYM_WID_ResponseIDs of _target
					clear item prevResponse of _responseList of _target
					rejectFlag = FALSE
					whatIndex = NULL
					value = FALSE
				else
					push whatIndex onto ASYM_WID_ResponseIDs of _target
					push actualObj onto _responseList of _target
					value = TRUE
				end
				send ASYM_WID_Chosen actualObj, value to _target
			else
				objs = objects of _target
				step i from 1 to itemcount(objs)
					pop objs into obj
					send ASYM_WID_Chosen obj, (obj = actualObj) to _target
				end
				ASYM_WID_ResponseIDs of _target = whatIndex
				_responseList of _target = actualObj
			end

		when QType = "MULTIOBJ"
		when QType = "MULTIDROP"
			byObjRef = (ansArray[1][1] contains quote)
			if byObjRef
				respName = object of actualObj &&QUOTE&respName&QUOTE
			end
			whatIndex = ASYM_FindAnswerIndex(respName) of _target


			if whatIndex = NULL
				whatIndex = maxIndex
			end

			FBIndex = whatIndex

			syslockscreen = false
			lockscreen of this window = false


			dontRegisterResponse = false
			if rejectIfWrong
				if whatIndex is null or ansArray[whatIndex][10] is false
					get _position of actualObj
					if it <> NULL
						move actualObj to it
						clear _position of actualObj
					end
					get _layer of actualObj
					if it <> NULL
						layer of actualObj = it
						clear _layer of actualObj
					end

					dontRegisterResponse = true
				end
			end


			if dontRegisterResponse <> true
				if ASYM_WID_MultipleAnswers of _target = TRUE
					prevResponse = itemOffset(actualObj, _responseList of _target)
					if prevResponse > 0
						clear item prevResponse of ASYM_WID_ResponseIDs of _target
						clear item prevResponse of _responseList of _target
						if QType = "MULTIOBJ"
							send ASYM_WID_Chosen actualObj, FALSE to _target
						end
						clear whatIndex
						rejectFlag = FALSE
					else
						send ASYM_WID_Chosen actualObj, TRUE to _target
						push whatIndex onto ASYM_WID_ResponseIDs of _target
						push actualObj onto _responseList of _target
					end
				else
					objs = _responseList of _target
					flag = FALSE
					step i from 1 to itemcount(objs)
						pop objs into obj
						if obj = actualObj
							flag = TRUE
						else
							send ASYM_WID_Chosen obj, FALSE to _target
						end
					end
					if flag
						clear ASYM_WID_ResponseIDs of _target
						clear _responseList of _target
						FBIndex = NULL
					else
						dragSnap = ASYM_WID_DragSnap of _target
						-- snap here rather than in widget
						if dragSnap is TRUE

-- 0xb1426  to get ASYM_SoundsLike s1, s2
to get ASYM_SoundsLike s1, s2
	s1 = ASYM_cepr(s1)
	s2 = ASYM_cepr(s2)
	return s1 = s2
end

to get ASYM_stripPunctuation whatText
	LOCAL INT maxCount,counter
	LOCAL STRING spaceString, deleteString

	counter = charcount(whatText)
	deleteString = "!'-`,.:;"&QUOTE

	while counter > 0
		if char counter of whatText is in deleteString
			clear char counter of whatText
		end
		decrement counter
	end
	return whatText
end

to get defaultPhRules
	-- Table of substitution rules changes with language
	get sysVersion
	conditions
	when it contains "French"
	when it contains "France"
		get "PH,F,CK,K,Y,I,SCI,SI,SCE,SE,CA,KA,CO,KO,CU,KU,"\
		  & "CI,SI,CE,SE,GE,JE,GI,JI,Ç,S,OUX,OUS,OMT,ONT,"\
		  & "NB,MB,NP,MP,MPT,NT,CHU,SHU,CH,K,SH,CH,TH,T,C,K,PS,S,SC,S,SS,S,"\
		  & "QU,Q,Q,K,EZ,É,WH,W,WR,R,NGT,NT,OFT,OF,RH,R,TIO,SIO"\
		  & "Ê,È,Ë,È"

	when it contains "Deutsch"
	when it contains "German"
		get ""
	else
		get null
	end
	get ASYM_CBTIniVar("Phonetic","Rules",it)
	if itemCount(it) mod 2 <> 0
		msgTxt = ASYM_GetString("errPhoneticRules", "Error in phonetic rules: %1")
		msgTxt = expandString(msgTxt, it)
		msgCaption = SPACE
		get ASYM_MessageBox(msgTxt, msgCaption, "WARNING", "OK")
	end
	return it
end

to get defaultPhVowels
	get sysVersion
	conditions
	when it contains "French"
	when it contains "France"
		get "AEIOUYÉÀÂÎÏÔÙÛ" -- keep other accented
	when it contains "Deutsch"
	when it contains "German"
		get "AEIOUY"
	else
		get "AEIOUY"
	end
	get ASYM_CBTIniVar("Phonetic","Vowels",it)
	return it
end

to handle LockAndAdjustTestItem _target, actualObj, respName, QType
	_locked of _responseList of _target = TRUE
	conditions
		when QType = "MULTIDROP" and actualObj \
		  is not in _responseList of _target
			ASYM_WID_AnswerLocked of _target = TRUE
			send _moveObj actualObj, _target
		when QType = "SLIDER"
			while keyState(keyLeftButton) = DOWN
			end
			sliderPos of _target = _lastPos of _target
		when QType = "ORDEROBJ"
			if _locked of actualObj <> TRUE
				position of actualObj = _position of actualObj
			end
		when QType = "NAMEPART"
			position of _target = _lastSpot of _target
		when QType = "MULTICHOICE"
		when QType = "TRUEFALSE"
			if object of actualObj = "button"
				checked of actualObj = not checked of actualObj
			end
		when QType = "TYPEIN"
			text of _target = _lastText of _target
			_locked of actualObj = TRUE
		when QType contains "MATCH"
			_locked of actualObj = TRUE
		when QType <> NULL
			if object of actualObj = button
				_locked of actualObj = TRUE
			end
	end
	ASYM_WID_AnswerLocked of _target = TRUE
	send ASYM_QLocked _target, respName to _target
end

to get matchJumbledWords STRING testString, ARRAY wrdList[],LOGICAL byCase
	matchCount = 0
	n = dimensions(wrdList)
	step i from 1 to n
		wrd = wrdList[i]
		p = offset(wrd, testString)
		get (p > 0)
		if byCase
			temp = testString
			ccnt = charcount(wrd)
			while p > 0
			 	if ASYM_CompareByCase(wrd, chars p to p + ccnt - 1 of temp)
			 		break while
			 	end
			 	clear chars p to p + ccnt - 1 of temp
				p = offset(wrd, temp)
			end
			get (p > 0)
		end
		if it is TRUE
			increment matchCount
		end
	end
	return (matchCount = n)
end

to get SetElapsedTime _target, newTimeChosen
	get ASYM_WID_TimeStart of _target
	if not isType(REAL,it)
		get ASYM_Ticks()
		ASYM_WID_TimeStart of _target = it
	end
	get newTimeChosen - it
	if it < 0
		resetStr = ASYM_GetString("Reset")
		request ASYM_GetString("NeedPgResetForTimer", \
		  "The current question has invalid data for the elapsed time." \
		   && "This page should be reset.") \
		  with "&" & ResetStr or "&" & ASYMGetStandardString("<Cancel>", "")
		if it contains resetStr
			send ASYM_Reset to this page
			return FALSE
		end
		ASYM_WID_TimeStart of _target = NULL
		ASYM_WID_TimeUsed of _target = 0
	else
		ASYM_WID_TimeUsed of _target = IT
	end
	ASYM_WID_TimeChosen of _target = newTimeChosen
 	return TRUE
end

to get _cleanUp txt

	if txt = NULL
		return txt
	end

	spot = 1
	max = charcount(txt)

	step i from charcount(txt) to 1 by -1
		if char i of txt = "|"
			char i of txt = "||"
		end
	end

	while CRLF is in txt
		spot = offset(CRLF,txt)
		chars spot to spot+1 of txt = "|n"
	end

	while CR is in txt
		char offset(CR,txt) of txt = "|n"
	end

	while LF is in txt
		char offset(LF,txt) of txt = "|l"
	end

	while QUOTE is in txt
		char offset(QUOTE,txt) of txt = "|q"
	end

	while TAB is in txt
		char offset(TAB,txt) of txt = "|t"
	end

	step i from charcount(txt) to 1 by -1
		if charToAnsi(char i of txt) < 32
			clear char i of txt
		end
	end

	return txt
end


to handle _ASYM_CheckDropObj pTarget, obj, loc
	SYSTEM s_asym_dragObj, s_asym_dropObj

	if ASYM_WID_QType of pTarget = ORDEROBJ
		send ASYM_RegisterResponse obj, name of obj to pTarget
	else
		if ASYM_WID_TargetObject of pTarget = "<self>"
			_target = pTarget
		else
			_target = ASYM_WID_TargetObject of pTarget
		end
		if _target <> NULL and ASYM_CheckPoint(_target, loc, pTarget)
			send ASYM_RegisterResponse obj, name of obj to pTarget
			clear s_asym_dragObj
		end
	end
	clear s_asym_dropObj
end

to get _ASYM_RegisterAttempt pTarget, _target, mode, showFeedback, correctness, score
	-- Registers an attempt at a question by calling ASYM_CheckTries. Also sends ASYM_Scored message
	-- ("Question scored" event for Actions system) and updates the ASYM_WID_LastScore property (the
	-- Actions system lastScore property). Note that we shouldn't be calling ASYM_CheckTries
	-- directly any more. This function returns the questions current score.

	send _ASYM_CheckTries pTarget, _target

	-- If the value for the score parameter hasn't been given to us, we work it out here
	if correctness = null
		-- ASYM_WID_Correctness() gives us a value between 0 (totally incorrect) and 1 (totally correct) inclusive
		correctness = round (ASYM_WID_Correctness(_target) of _target, -2)
	end

	conditions
	when correctness = 1
		scoreText = "correct"
	when correctness <= 0
		scoreText = "incorrect"
	else
		scoreText = "mixed"
	end

	-- We must update the ASYM_WID_LastScore property before we send the ASYM_Scored event.
	if score = null
		score = ASYM_WID_Score (mode, true) of _target
	end
	ASYM_WID_LastScore of _target = score

	-- Generate the "Question scored" event (aka ASYM_Scored message) for the actions system. Any
	-- time an attempt at a question is registered, it should go through this code (rather than
	-- ASYM_CheckTries, which we call above).
	send ASYM_Scored (showFeedback = true), scoreText to _target

	return score
end

to handle _ASYM_CheckTries pTarget, _target
	-- This handler should no longer be called directly. Rather, the _ASYM_RegisterAttempt()
	-- function should be used.

	if not isType(real, ASYM_WID_TriesUsed of _target)
 		ASYM_WID_TriesUsed of _target = 0
 	end
	increment ASYM_WID_TriesUsed of _target

	-- for EA system
	send ASYM_Changed "tryCount" to _target

 	if ASYM_WID_AnswerLocked of _target <> TRUE \
 	  and ASYM_WID_TriesMax of _target <> 0 \
 	  and ASYM_WID_TriesUsed of _target >= ASYM_WID_TriesMax of _target
 		ASYM_WID_TimeLocked of _target = ASYM_Ticks()
		ASYM_WID_AnswerLocked of _target = TRUE
		send ASYM_QLocked _target, ASYM_WID_Responses() of _target to pTarget
		send ASYM_Locked to _target

		-- for EA system
		send ASYM_Changed "locked" to _target
	end
end

to get _ASYM_FindAnswerIndex pTarget, whatItem, col, all
	LOCAL ARRAY	ansArray[][]
	LOCAL STACK retVal

	if col = NULL

	if all = NULL

-- 0xb151b  to get defaultPhRules
to get defaultPhRules
	-- Table of substitution rules changes with language
	get sysVersion
	conditions
	when it contains "French"
	when it contains "France"
		get "PH,F,CK,K,Y,I,SCI,SI,SCE,SE,CA,KA,CO,KO,CU,KU,"\
		  & "CI,SI,CE,SE,GE,JE,GI,JI,Ç,S,OUX,OUS,OMT,ONT,"\
		  & "NB,MB,NP,MP,MPT,NT,CHU,SHU,CH,K,SH,CH,TH,T,C,K,PS,S,SC,S,SS,S,"\
		  & "QU,Q,Q,K,EZ,É,WH,W,WR,R,NGT,NT,OFT,OF,RH,R,TIO,SIO"\
		  & "Ê,È,Ë,È"

	when it contains "Deutsch"
	when it contains "German"
		get ""
	else
		get null
	end
	get ASYM_CBTIniVar("Phonetic","Rules",it)
	if itemCount(it) mod 2 <> 0
		msgTxt = ASYM_GetString("errPhoneticRules", "Error in phonetic rules: %1")
		msgTxt = expandString(msgTxt, it)
		msgCaption = SPACE
		get ASYM_MessageBox(msgTxt, msgCaption, "WARNING", "OK")
	end
	return it
end

to get defaultPhVowels
	get sysVersion
	conditions
	when it contains "French"
	when it contains "France"
		get "AEIOUYÉÀÂÎÏÔÙÛ" -- keep other accented
	when it contains "Deutsch"
	when it contains "German"
		get "AEIOUY"
	else
		get "AEIOUY"
	end
	get ASYM_CBTIniVar("Phonetic","Vowels",it)
	return it
end

to handle LockAndAdjustTestItem _target, actualObj, respName, QType
	_locked of _responseList of _target = TRUE
	conditions
		when QType = "MULTIDROP" and actualObj \
		  is not in _responseList of _target
			ASYM_WID_AnswerLocked of _target = TRUE
			send _moveObj actualObj, _target
		when QType = "SLIDER"
			while keyState(keyLeftButton) = DOWN
			end
			sliderPos of _target = _lastPos of _target
		when QType = "ORDEROBJ"
			if _locked of actualObj <> TRUE
				position of actualObj = _position of actualObj
			end
		when QType = "NAMEPART"
			position of _target = _lastSpot of _target
		when QType = "MULTICHOICE"
		when QType = "TRUEFALSE"
			if object of actualObj = "button"
				checked of actualObj = not checked of actualObj
			end
		when QType = "TYPEIN"
			text of _target = _lastText of _target
			_locked of actualObj = TRUE
		when QType contains "MATCH"
			_locked of actualObj = TRUE
		when QType <> NULL
			if object of actualObj = button
				_locked of actualObj = TRUE
			end
	end
	ASYM_WID_AnswerLocked of _target = TRUE
	send ASYM_QLocked _target, respName to _target
end

to get matchJumbledWords STRING testString, ARRAY wrdList[],LOGICAL byCase
	matchCount = 0
	n = dimensions(wrdList)
	step i from 1 to n
		wrd = wrdList[i]
		p = offset(wrd, testString)
		get (p > 0)
		if byCase
			temp = testString
			ccnt = charcount(wrd)
			while p > 0
			 	if ASYM_CompareByCase(wrd, chars p to p + ccnt - 1 of temp)
			 		break while
			 	end
			 	clear chars p to p + ccnt - 1 of temp
				p = offset(wrd, temp)
			end
			get (p > 0)
		end
		if it is TRUE
			increment matchCount
		end
	end
	return (matchCount = n)
end

to get SetElapsedTime _target, newTimeChosen
	get ASYM_WID_TimeStart of _target
	if not isType(REAL,it)
		get ASYM_Ticks()
		ASYM_WID_TimeStart of _target = it
	end
	get newTimeChosen - it
	if it < 0
		resetStr = ASYM_GetString("Reset")
		request ASYM_GetString("NeedPgResetForTimer", \
		  "The current question has invalid data for the elapsed time." \
		   && "This page should be reset.") \
		  with "&" & ResetStr or "&" & ASYMGetStandardString("<Cancel>", "")
		if it contains resetStr
			send ASYM_Reset to this page
			return FALSE
		end
		ASYM_WID_TimeStart of _target = NULL
		ASYM_WID_TimeUsed of _target = 0
	else
		ASYM_WID_TimeUsed of _target = IT
	end
	ASYM_WID_TimeChosen of _target = newTimeChosen
 	return TRUE
end

to get _cleanUp txt

	if txt = NULL
		return txt
	end

	spot = 1
	max = charcount(txt)

	step i from charcount(txt) to 1 by -1
		if char i of txt = "|"
			char i of txt = "||"
		end
	end

	while CRLF is in txt
		spot = offset(CRLF,txt)
		chars spot to spot+1 of txt = "|n"
	end

	while CR is in txt
		char offset(CR,txt) of txt = "|n"
	end

	while LF is in txt
		char offset(LF,txt) of txt = "|l"
	end

	while QUOTE is in txt
		char offset(QUOTE,txt) of txt = "|q"
	end

	while TAB is in txt
		char offset(TAB,txt) of txt = "|t"
	end

	step i from charcount(txt) to 1 by -1
		if charToAnsi(char i of txt) < 32
			clear char i of txt
		end
	end

	return txt
end


to handle _ASYM_CheckDropObj pTarget, obj, loc
	SYSTEM s_asym_dragObj, s_asym_dropObj

	if ASYM_WID_QType of pTarget = ORDEROBJ
		send ASYM_RegisterResponse obj, name of obj to pTarget
	else
		if ASYM_WID_TargetObject of pTarget = "<self>"
			_target = pTarget
		else
			_target = ASYM_WID_TargetObject of pTarget
		end
		if _target <> NULL and ASYM_CheckPoint(_target, loc, pTarget)
			send ASYM_RegisterResponse obj, name of obj to pTarget
			clear s_asym_dragObj
		end
	end
	clear s_asym_dropObj
end

to get _ASYM_RegisterAttempt pTarget, _target, mode, showFeedback, correctness, score
	-- Registers an attempt at a question by calling ASYM_CheckTries. Also sends ASYM_Scored message
	-- ("Question scored" event for Actions system) and updates the ASYM_WID_LastScore property (the
	-- Actions system lastScore property). Note that we shouldn't be calling ASYM_CheckTries
	-- directly any more. This function returns the questions current score.

	send _ASYM_CheckTries pTarget, _target

	-- If the value for the score parameter hasn't been given to us, we work it out here
	if correctness = null
		-- ASYM_WID_Correctness() gives us a value between 0 (totally incorrect) and 1 (totally correct) inclusive
		correctness = round (ASYM_WID_Correctness(_target) of _target, -2)
	end

	conditions
	when correctness = 1
		scoreText = "correct"
	when correctness <= 0
		scoreText = "incorrect"
	else
		scoreText = "mixed"
	end

	-- We must update the ASYM_WID_LastScore property before we send the ASYM_Scored event.
	if score = null
		score = ASYM_WID_Score (mode, true) of _target
	end
	ASYM_WID_LastScore of _target = score

	-- Generate the "Question scored" event (aka ASYM_Scored message) for the actions system. Any
	-- time an attempt at a question is registered, it should go through this code (rather than
	-- ASYM_CheckTries, which we call above).
	send ASYM_Scored (showFeedback = true), scoreText to _target

	return score
end

to handle _ASYM_CheckTries pTarget, _target
	-- This handler should no longer be called directly. Rather, the _ASYM_RegisterAttempt()
	-- function should be used.

	if not isType(real, ASYM_WID_TriesUsed of _target)
 		ASYM_WID_TriesUsed of _target = 0
 	end
	increment ASYM_WID_TriesUsed of _target

	-- for EA system
	send ASYM_Changed "tryCount" to _target

 	if ASYM_WID_AnswerLocked of _target <> TRUE \
 	  and ASYM_WID_TriesMax of _target <> 0 \
 	  and ASYM_WID_TriesUsed of _target >= ASYM_WID_TriesMax of _target
 		ASYM_WID_TimeLocked of _target = ASYM_Ticks()
		ASYM_WID_AnswerLocked of _target = TRUE
		send ASYM_QLocked _target, ASYM_WID_Responses() of _target to pTarget
		send ASYM_Locked to _target

		-- for EA system
		send ASYM_Changed "locked" to _target
	end
end

to get _ASYM_FindAnswerIndex pTarget, whatItem, col, all

	LOCAL STACK retVal

	if col = NULL

	end
	if all = NULL
		all = FALSE
	end

	if ASYM_HasAnsArray(pTarget)
		ansArray = ASYM_WID_AnsArray of pTarget
		step i from 1 to item 1 of dimensions(ansArray)
			if ansArray[i][col] = whatItem
				push i onto retVal
				if not all
					return retVal
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return retVal
end

			txt = name of obj & tab & "Locked!" & tab & quote & ASYM_WID_Responses() of obj & quote
		else
			txt = expandString(ASYM_GetString("LogLockedQ", "Q=%1 : E=Locked! : R=%2"), name of obj, ASYM_WID_Responses() of obj)
		end
		get ASYM_LogWriteEntry(txt

		get ASYM_LogWriteEntry(txt & CRLF) of this page
	end

to get _ASYM_QuestionStatus pTarget, obj, _score, mode, noUpdate, showFeedback

		obj = pTarget
	end

	if TriesUsed = 0 and ASYM_WID_ResponseIDs of obj <> NULL and noUpdate <> true
		TriesUsed = 1

	push ASYM_WID_AnswerLocked of obj onto stat
	push ASYM_WID_MaxScore of obj onto stat

	else
		push _score onto stat
	end

	return stat

-- 0xb1e7e  to handle _ASYM_CheckDropObj pTarget, obj, loc
to handle _ASYM_CheckDropObj pTarget, obj, loc
	SYSTEM s_asym_dragObj, s_asym_dropObj

	if ASYM_WID_QType of pTarget = ORDEROBJ
		send ASYM_RegisterResponse obj, name of obj to pTarget
	else
		if ASYM_WID_TargetObject of pTarget = "<self>"
			_target = pTarget
		else
			_target = ASYM_WID_TargetObject of pTarget
		end
		if _target <> NULL and ASYM_CheckPoint(_target, loc, pTarget)
			send ASYM_RegisterResponse obj, name of obj to pTarget
			clear s_asym_dragObj
		end
	end
	clear s_asym_dropObj
end

to get _ASYM_RegisterAttempt pTarget, _target, mode, showFeedback, correctness, score
	-- Registers an attempt at a question by calling ASYM_CheckTries. Also sends ASYM_Scored message
	-- ("Question scored" event for Actions system) and updates the ASYM_WID_LastScore property (the
	-- Actions system lastScore property). Note that we shouldn't be calling ASYM_CheckTries
	-- directly any more. This function returns the questions current score.

	send _ASYM_CheckTries pTarget, _target

	-- If the value for the score parameter hasn't been given to us, we work it out here
	if correctness = null
		-- ASYM_WID_Correctness() gives us a value between 0 (totally incorrect) and 1 (totally correct) inclusive
		correctness = round (ASYM_WID_Correctness(_target) of _target, -2)
	end

	conditions
	when correctness = 1
		scoreText = "correct"
	when correctness <= 0
		scoreText = "incorrect"
	else
		scoreText = "mixed"
	end

	-- We must update the ASYM_WID_LastScore property before we send the ASYM_Scored event.
	if score = null
		score = ASYM_WID_Score (mode, true) of _target
	end
	ASYM_WID_LastScore of _target = score

	-- Generate the "Question scored" event (aka ASYM_Scored message) for the actions system. Any
	-- time an attempt at a question is registered, it should go through this code (rather than
	-- ASYM_CheckTries, which we call above).
	send ASYM_Scored (showFeedback = true), scoreText to _target

	return score
end

to handle _ASYM_CheckTries pTarget, _target
	-- This handler should no longer be called directly. Rather, the _ASYM_RegisterAttempt()
	-- function should be used.

	if not isType(real, ASYM_WID_TriesUsed of _target)
 		ASYM_WID_TriesUsed of _target = 0
 	end
	increment ASYM_WID_TriesUsed of _target

	-- for EA system
	send ASYM_Changed "tryCount" to _target

 	if ASYM_WID_AnswerLocked of _target <> TRUE \
 	  and ASYM_WID_TriesMax of _target <> 0 \
 	  and ASYM_WID_TriesUsed of _target >= ASYM_WID_TriesMax of _target
 		ASYM_WID_TimeLocked of _target = ASYM_Ticks()
		ASYM_WID_AnswerLocked of _target = TRUE
		send ASYM_QLocked _target, ASYM_WID_Responses() of _target to pTarget
		send ASYM_Locked to _target

		-- for EA system
		send ASYM_Changed "locked" to _target
	end
end

to get _ASYM_FindAnswerIndex pTarget, whatItem, col, all
	LOCAL ARRAY	ansArray[][]
	LOCAL STACK retVal

	if col = NULL
		col = 1
	end
	if all = NULL
		all = FALSE
	end

	if ASYM_HasAnsArray(pTarget)
		ansArray = ASYM_WID_AnsArray of pTarget
		step i from 1 to item 1 of dimensions(ansArray)
			if ansArray[i][col] = whatItem
				push i onto retVal
				if not all
					return retVal
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return retVal
end

to get ASYM_ProductVersion dotFlag, options
	if (dotFlag <> NULL) and (dotFlag <> FALSE)
		if "minorVersion" is in options
			return "8.1"
		else
			return "8.0"
		end
	else
		if "minorVersion" is in options
			return "81"
		else
			return "80"
		end
	end
end

--**** SYSTEM MESSAGE HANDLERS
to handle author
	-- redirect to mainWindow
	if parent of mainWindow <> self and ((object of target = "book" and target = self) or (objectContainer (target, "book") = self))
		send author to currentPage of mainWindow in mainWindow
		break
	end

	send killUserTooltipTimers
	forward
end

to handle buttonClick loc
	system s_cbtrhypexterr

	obj = target

	forward
	if object of obj is hotword
		if ASYM_AutoGlossary of this book is true
			send AutoGlossary obj to page AutoGlossary of self
		end
		break
	else
		if "field" is in object of obj and ASYM_AutoHotwords of this book is true
			send AutoHotword obj, loc to page AutoGlossary of self
			break
		end
	end
end

to handle buttonDown loc
	SYSTEM s_asym_dragObj

	bs = ASYM_BlockSuspend()
	if ASYM_ToolTip of target <> null
		send hideTooltip target to page "tooltip" of self
	end
	get ASYM_RestoreSuspend(bs)

	forward

	obj = target
	whatButton = ASYM_PrimaryMouseButton()
	while object of obj is not in "pagebackgroundbook"
		conditions
			when _locked of obj = TRUE and ASYM_WID_AnswerLocked of parent of obj <> TRUE
				get _ASYM_DoGenericTextFeedback(obj, "<responseItemLocked>") of page "Test Item Feedback" of self
				break buttonDown

			when ASYM_WID_QType of obj <> NULL and  ASYM_WID_AnswerLocked of obj = TRUE
				send ASYM_ObjectDropped obj, loc to objectContainer(target,"page,background")
				break buttonDown

			when ASYM_Draggable of obj = TRUE
				s_asym_dragObj = obj
				send DoDragObject target, obj, loc, whatButton to page "Test item behaviors" of self
				clear s_asym_dragObj
				break while

			when ASYM_WID_QType of parent of obj = "MATCHITEM"
				send DoMatchItemDrag target, obj, loc, whatButton to page "Test Item Behaviors" of self
				break while
			else
				obj = parent of obj
		end
	end
end

to handle clear
	if targetWindow is mainwindow or focus is null or objectContainer(targetWindow, "book") <> self
	  	forward
	end
end

to handle closeWindow
	system s_tb80r_PopViewers
	forward
	get ASYM_itemOffset(target,s_tb80r_PopViewers)
	if it <> null and it > 0
		clear item it of s_tb80r_PopViewers
	end
end

to handle destroy
	LOCAL ansArray[][], temp[][]
	myParent = parent of target
	qType = ASYM_WID_QType of myParent
	conditions
		when "MATCH" is in qType
		when "MULTWID" = qType
		when "MULTIOBJ" = qType
			ansArray = ASYM_WID_AnsArray of myParent
			objList = objects of myParent
			maxCount = item 1 of dimensions(ansArray)
			step i from 1 to itemcount(objList)
				pop objlist into obj
				if obj = target
					counter = 0
					step j from 1 to maxCount
						if j <> i
							increment counter
							step k from 1 to item 2 of dimensions(ansArray)
								temp[counter][k] = ansArray[j][k]
							end
						end
					end
					ASYM_WID_AnsArray of myParent = temp
					forward
					break destroy
				end
			end
	end
	forward
end

to handle enterApplication
	system s_cbtrhypexterr, s_ASYM_LogStartTime, s_ASYM_SessionElapsedTime
	local bookmarkFn, logFn, preferredLogFn

	clear s_cbtrhypexterr
	s_ASYM_SessionElapsedTime = 0

	forward

	if object of target <> book
		bk = this book
	else
		bk = target
	end

	CMS = ASYM_CMS_CourseID() <> NULL

	s_ASYM_LogStartTime = ASYM_Ticks()

	if ASYM_AutoBookMarks of bk is true
		bookmarkFn = _ASYM_MakeBookmarkFileName() of page "bookmarking" of self
	end

	if CMS
		send _CMS_EnterApplication bk, bookmarkFn to page "CMS EnterApplication" of self
	end

	if sysLevel = "reader"
		-- in case wasn't set when book saved
		if caption of mainWindow = NULL
			conditions
			when ASYM_Caption of bk <> NULL
				caption of mainWindow = ASYM_Caption of bk
			when INFO_Title of bk <> NULL
				caption of mainWindow = INFO_Title of bk
			end
		end

		if ASYM_FullScreen of bk is true
			captionBar of mainWindow = none
			borderStyle of mainWindow = none
			state of mainWindow = maximized
		else
			if ASYM_BorderStyle of bk <> NULL
				borderStyle of mainWindow = ASYM_BorderStyle of bk
			end
			if ASYM_CaptionBar of bk <> NULL
				captionBar of mainWindow = ASYM_CaptionBar of bk
			end
		end

		if ASYM_Modal of bk is true
			set ASYM_ModalState of this book to true
		end
	end

	if ASYM_AutoBookMarks of bk is true
		get _readBookmarks(bookmarkFn) of page "bookmarking" of self
	end

	s_ASYM_LogStartTime = ASYM_Ticks()

	if ASYM_LogStatus() is null
		get ASYM_LogType of bk
		if it <> null and it <> "none"
			get ASYM_LogStart(bk, ASYM_LogName of bk, ASYM_LogAppend of bk,ASYM_LogEncrypt of bk, ASYM_LogDestination of bk, it)
			if it is "<exit>"
				send _ASYM_ReaderExit
			end
		end
	end

	matColor of mainWindow = matColor of mainWindow
end

to handle enterBook
	forward
	get ASYM_BookSysBooks of target
	if it <> null
		bs = ASYM_BlockSuspend()
		while it <> null
			pop it into sb
			if sb is not in sysBooks
				push sb onto sysBooks
			end
		end
		get ASYM_RestoreSuspend(bs)
		if sysError <> null
			request sysError
		end
	end
end

to handle enterPage
	system s_ASYM_LogPages
	local logical resetFlag
	local sbkArr [][]
	local iList
	local WORD i,j,n

	pageCleanForExport = not ASYM_IsObjectDirty (target, "htmlExport")
	bgCleanForExport = not ASYM_IsObjectDirty (parent of target, "htmlExport")

	bk = self
	if name of page 23 of bk = "Test Item Reset"
		obj = page 23 of bk
	else
		obj = page "Test Item Reset" of self
	end
	send _ASYM_ResetPgWidgets "enterpage" to obj

	-- resetting should have no effect on export process
	if pageCleanForExport
		get ASYM_SetObjectClean (target, "htmlExport")
	end
	if bgCleanForExport
		get ASYM_SetObjectClean (parent of target, "htmlExport")
	end

	if s_ASYM_LogPages is true
		logTxt = ASYM_GetString("logPageEntry", "Page %1" & CRLF)
		logTxt = expandString(logTxt, ASYM_NameOrID(this page))
		get ASYM_LogWriteEntry(logTxt)
	end

	forward

	-- Clean up duplicate sysbooks, except myself
	myShortName = ASYM_ShortFileName(my name)
	sbks = sysbooks
	n = 0
	reset sbkArr
	step i from 1 to itemcount(sbks)
		get ASYM_ShortFileName(item i of sbks)
		if it is myShortName
			continue step
		end
		there = false
		step j from 1 to n
			if sbkArr[j][1] is it
				there = true
				increment sbkArr[j][2]
				break step
			end
		end
		if not there
			increment n
			sbkArr[n][1] = it
			sbkArr[n][2] = 1
		end
	end

	step i from 1 to n
		escapeCnt = 10
		while sbkArr[i][2] > 1 and escapeCnt > 0
			decrement escapeCnt
			step j from 1 to itemCount(sysBooks)
				get item j of sysBooks
				if it <> NULL
					get ASYM_ShortFileName (item j of sysBooks)
					clear sysError
					if it is sbkArr[i][1]
						get sysbooks
						mmyield
						clear item j of sysBooks
						mmYield
						if it <> sysbooks -- we successfully cleared the item
							decrement sbkArr[i][2]
							if sbkArr[i][2] = 1
								break step
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
			sbkArr[i][2] = 0
			step j from 1 to itemCount(sysBooks)
				get ASYM_ShortFileName (item j of sysBooks)

-- 0xb2b68  to get ASYM_ProductName
to get ASYM_ProductName
	SYSTEM s_ASYM_ProductName

	return s_ASYM_ProductName
end

	get ASYM_RestoreSuspend(bs)

	forward

	obj = target
	whatButton = ASYM_PrimaryMouseButton()
	while object of obj is not in "pagebackgroundbook"
		conditions
			when _locked of obj = TRUE and ASYM_WID_AnswerLocked of parent of obj <> TRUE
				get _ASYM_DoGenericTextFeedback(obj, "<responseItemLocked>") of page "Test Item Feedback" of self
				break buttonDown

			when ASYM_WID_QType of obj <> NULL and  ASYM_WID_AnswerLocked of obj = TRUE
				send ASYM_ObjectDropped obj, loc to objectContainer(target,"page,background")
				break buttonDown

			when ASYM_Draggable of obj = TRUE
				s_asym_dragObj = obj
				send DoDragObject target, obj, loc, whatButton to page "Test item behaviors" of self
				clear s_asym_dragObj
				break while

			when ASYM_WID_QType of parent of obj = "MATCHITEM"
				send DoMatchItemDrag target, obj, loc, whatButton to page "Test Item Behaviors" of self
				break while
			else
				obj = parent of obj
		end
	end
end

to handle clear
	if targetWindow is mainwindow or focus is null or objectContainer(targetWindow, "book") <> self
	  	forward
	end
end

to handle closeWindow
	system s_tb80r_PopViewers
	forward
	get ASYM_itemOffset(target,s_tb80r_PopViewers)
	if it <> null and it > 0
		clear item it of s_tb80r_PopViewers
	end

to handle destroy
	LOCAL ansArray[][], temp[][]
	myParent = parent of target
	qType = ASYM_WID_QType of myParent
	conditions
		when "MATCH" is in qType
		when "MULTWID" = qType
		when "MULTIOBJ" = qType
			ansArray = ASYM_WID_AnsArray of myParent
			objList = objects of myParent
			maxCount = item 1 of dimensions(ansArray)
			step i from 1 to itemcount(objList)
				pop objlist into obj
				if obj = target
					counter = 0
					step j from 1 to maxCount
						if j <> i
							increment counter
							step k from 1 to item 2 of dimensions(ansArray)
								temp[counter][k] = ansArray[j][k]
							end
						end
					end
					ASYM_WID_AnsArray of myParent = temp
					forward
					break destroy
				end
			end
	end
	forward
end

to handle enterApplication
	system s_cbtrhypexterr, s_ASYM_LogStartTime, s_ASYM_SessionElapsedTime
	local bookmarkFn, logFn, preferredLogFn

	clear s_cbtrhypexterr
	s_ASYM_SessionElapsedTime = 0

	forward

	if object of target <> book
		bk = this book
	else
		bk = target
	end

	CMS = ASYM_CMS_CourseID() <> NULL

	s_ASYM_LogStartTime = ASYM_Ticks()

	if ASYM_AutoBookMarks of bk is true
		bookmarkFn = _ASYM_MakeBookmarkFileName() of page "bookmarking" of self
	end

	if CMS
		send _CMS_EnterApplication bk, bookmarkFn to page "CMS EnterApplication" of self
	end

	if sysLevel = "reader"
		-- in case wasn't set when book saved
		if caption of mainWindow = NULL
			conditions
			when ASYM_Caption of bk <> NULL
				caption of mainWindow = ASYM_Caption of bk
			when INFO_Title of bk <> NULL
				caption of mainWindow = INFO_Title of bk
			end
		end

		if ASYM_FullScreen of bk is true
			captionBar of mainWindow = none
			borderStyle of mainWindow = none
			state of mainWindow = maximized
		else
			if ASYM_BorderStyle of bk <> NULL
				borderStyle of mainWindow = ASYM_BorderStyle of bk
			end
			if ASYM_CaptionBar of bk <> NULL
				captionBar of mainWindow = ASYM_CaptionBar of bk
			end
		end

		if ASYM_Modal of bk is true
			set ASYM_ModalState of this book to true
		end
	end

	if ASYM_AutoBookMarks of bk is true
		get _readBookmarks(bookmarkFn) of page "bookmarking" of self
	end

	s_ASYM_LogStartTime = ASYM_Ticks()

	if ASYM_LogStatus() is null
		get ASYM_LogType of bk
		if it <> null and it <> "none"
			get ASYM_LogStart(bk, ASYM_LogName of bk, ASYM_LogAppend of bk,ASYM_LogEncrypt of bk, ASYM_LogDestination of bk, it)
			if it is "<exit>"
				send _ASYM_ReaderExit
			end
		end
	end

	matColor of mainWindow = matColor of mainWindow
end

to handle enterBook
	forward
	get ASYM_BookSysBooks of target
	if it <> null
		bs = ASYM_BlockSuspend()
		while it <> null
			pop it into sb
			if sb is not in sysBooks
				push sb onto sysBooks
			end
		end
		get ASYM_RestoreSuspend(bs)
		if sysError <> null
			request sysError
		end
	end
end

to handle enterPage
	system s_ASYM_LogPages
	local logical resetFlag
	local sbkArr [][]
	local iList
	local WORD i,j,n

	pageCleanForExport = not ASYM_IsObjectDirty (target, "htmlExport")
	bgCleanForExport = not ASYM_IsObjectDirty (parent of target, "htmlExport")

	bk = self
	if name of page 23 of bk = "Test Item Reset"
		obj = page 23 of bk
	else
		obj = page "Test Item Reset" of self
	end
	send _ASYM_ResetPgWidgets "enterpage" to obj

	-- resetting should have no effect on export process
	if pageCleanForExport
		get ASYM_SetObjectClean (target, "htmlExport")
	end
	if bgCleanForExport
		get ASYM_SetObjectClean (parent of target, "htmlExport")
	end

	if s_ASYM_LogPages is true
		logTxt = ASYM_GetString("logPageEntry", "Page %1" & CRLF)
		logTxt = expandString(logTxt, ASYM_NameOrID(this page))
		get ASYM_LogWriteEntry(logTxt)
	end

	forward

	-- Clean up duplicate sysbooks, except myself
	myShortName = ASYM_ShortFileName(my name)
	sbks = sysbooks
	n = 0
	reset sbkArr
	step i from 1 to itemcount(sbks)
		get ASYM_ShortFileName(item i of sbks)
		if it is myShortName
			continue step
		end
		there = false
		step j from 1 to n
			if sbkArr[j][1] is it
				there = true
				increment sbkArr[j][2]
				break step
			end
		end
		if not there
			increment n
			sbkArr[n][1] = it
			sbkArr[n][2] = 1
		end
	end

	step i from 1 to n
		escapeCnt = 10
		while sbkArr[i][2] > 1 and escapeCnt > 0
			decrement escapeCnt
			step j from 1 to itemCount(sysBooks)
				get item j of sysBooks
				if it <> NULL
					get ASYM_ShortFileName (item j of sysBooks)
					clear sysError
					if it is sbkArr[i][1]
						get sysbooks
						mmyield
						clear item j of sysBooks
						mmYield
						if it <> sysbooks -- we successfully cleared the item
							decrement sbkArr[i][2]
							if sbkArr[i][2] = 1
								break step
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
			sbkArr[i][2] = 0
			step j from 1 to itemCount(sysBooks)
				get ASYM_ShortFileName (item j of sysBooks)
				if it is sbkArr[i][1]
					increment sbkArr[i][2]
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if ASYM_WorkWindow() = targetWindow
		vList = sysOpenWindows
		while itemCount(vList) > 0
			pop vList into v
			if v <> targetWindow
				send ASYM_PageEntered targetWindow to currentPage of v
			end
		end
	end
end

to handle enterSystem
	forward
	send _doNeuronCheck to page "Initialization" of self
	if ASYM_Ticks() = null
		send _linkSysBook to page "Initialization" of self
	end
end

to handle enterWindow vRef
	system s_ASYMWorkWindow

	send killUserTooltipTimers

-- 0xb2bc5  to get ASYMR
to get ASYMR
	return "TB" & ASYM_MTBVersion() & "R.SBK"
end

		send author to currentPage of mainWindow in mainWindow
		break
	end

	send killUserTooltipTimers
	forward
end

	end
