				increment sbkArr[j][2]
				break step
			end
		end
		if not there
			increment n
			sbkArr[n][1] = it
			sbkArr[n][2] = 1
		end
	end

	step i from 1 to n
		escapeCnt = 10
		while sbkArr[i][2] > 1 and escapeCnt > 0
			decrement escapeCnt
			step j from 1 to itemCount(sysBooks)
				get item j of sysBooks
				if it <> NULL
					get ASYM_ShortFileName (item j of sysBooks)
					clear sysError
					if it is sbkArr[i][1]
						get sysbooks
						mmyield
						clear item j of sysBooks
						mmYield
						if it <> sysbooks -- we successfully cleared the item
							decrement sbkArr[i][2]
							if sbkArr[i][2] = 1
								break step
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
			sbkArr[i][2] = 0
			step j from 1 to itemCount(sysBooks)
				get ASYM_ShortFileName (item j of sysBooks)
				if it is sbkArr[i][1]
					increment sbkArr[i][2]
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if ASYM_WorkWindow() = targetWindow
		vList = sysOpenWindows
		while itemCount(vList) > 0
			pop vList into v
			if v <> targetWindow
				send ASYM_PageEntered targetWindow to currentPage of v
			end
		end
	end
end

to handle enterSystem
	forward
	send _doNeuronCheck to page "Initialization" of self
	if ASYM_Ticks() = null
		send _linkSysBook to page "Initialization" of self
	end
end

to handle enterWindow vRef
	system s_ASYMWorkWindow

	send killUserTooltipTimers

	forward
	conditions
	when target is mainWindow
		s_ASYMWorkWindow = mainWindow
	when object of target is "viewer"
		if revertFocus of target and vRef <> null
		  	if isOpen of vRef and (not revertFocus of vRef)
				v = vRef
			else
				s_ASYMWorkWindow

-- 0xb2ca7  to handle buttonClick loc
to handle buttonClick loc
	system s_cbtrhypexterr

	obj = target

	forward
	if object of obj is hotword
		if ASYM_AutoGlossary of this book is true
			send AutoGlossary obj to page AutoGlossary of self
		end
		break
	else
		if "field" is in object of obj and ASYM_AutoHotwords of this book is true
			send AutoHotword obj, loc to page AutoGlossary of self
			break
		end
	end
end

to handle buttonDown loc
	SYSTEM s_asym_dragObj

	bs = ASYM_BlockSuspend()
	if ASYM_ToolTip of target <> null
		send hideTooltip target to page "tooltip" of self
	end
	get ASYM_RestoreSuspend(bs)

	forward

	obj = target
	whatButton = ASYM_PrimaryMouseButton()
	while object of obj is not in "pagebackgroundbook"
		conditions
			when _locked of obj = TRUE and ASYM_WID_AnswerLocked of parent of obj <> TRUE
				get _ASYM_DoGenericTextFeedback(obj, "<responseItemLocked>") of page "Test Item Feedback" of self
				break buttonDown

			when ASYM_WID_QType of obj <> NULL and  ASYM_WID_AnswerLocked of obj = TRUE
				send ASYM_ObjectDropped obj, loc to objectContainer(target,"page,background")
				break buttonDown

			when ASYM_Draggable of obj = TRUE
				s_asym_dragObj = obj
				send DoDragObject target, obj, loc, whatButton to page "Test item behaviors" of self
				clear s_asym_dragObj
				break while

			when ASYM_WID_QType of parent of obj = "MATCHITEM"
				send DoMatchItemDrag target, obj, loc, whatButton to page "Test Item Behaviors" of self
				break while
			else
				obj = parent of obj
		end
	end
end

to handle clear
	if targetWindow is mainwindow or focus is null or objectContainer(targetWindow, "book") <> self
	  	forward
	end
end

to handle closeWindow
	system s_tb80r_PopViewers
	forward
	get ASYM_itemOffset(target,s_tb80r_PopViewers)
	if it <> null and it > 0
		clear item it of s_tb80r_PopViewers
	end
end

to handle destroy
	LOCAL ansArray[][], temp[][]
	myParent = parent of target
	qType = ASYM_WID_QType of myParent
	conditions
		when "MATCH" is in qType
		when "MULTWID" = qType
		when "MULTIOBJ" = qType
			ansArray = ASYM_WID_AnsArray of myParent
			objList = objects of myParent
			maxCount = item 1 of dimensions(ansArray)
			step i from 1 to itemcount(objList)
				pop objlist into obj
				if obj = target
					counter = 0
					step j from 1 to maxCount
						if j <> i
							increment counter
							step k from 1 to item 2 of dimensions(ansArray)
								temp[counter][k] = ansArray[j][k]
							end
						end
					end
					ASYM_WID_AnsArray of myParent = temp
					forward
					break destroy
				end
			end
	end
	forward
end

to handle enterApplication
	system s_cbtrhypexterr, s_ASYM_LogStartTime, s_ASYM_SessionElapsedTime
	local bookmarkFn, logFn, preferredLogFn

	clear s_cbtrhypexterr
	s_ASYM_SessionElapsedTime = 0

	forward

	if object of target <> book
		bk = this book
	else
		bk = target
	end

	CMS = ASYM_CMS_CourseID() <> NULL

	s_ASYM_LogStartTime = ASYM_Ticks()

	if ASYM_AutoBookMarks of bk is true
		bookmarkFn = _ASYM_MakeBookmarkFileName() of page "bookmarking" of self
	end

	if CMS
		send _CMS_EnterApplication bk, bookmarkFn to page "CMS EnterApplication" of self
	end

	if sysLevel = "reader"
		-- in case wasn't set when book saved
		if caption of mainWindow = NULL
			conditions
			when ASYM_Caption of bk <> NULL
				caption of mainWindow = ASYM_Caption of bk
			when INFO_Title of bk <> NULL
				caption of mainWindow = INFO_Title of bk
			end
		end

		if ASYM_FullScreen of bk is true
			captionBar of mainWindow = none
			borderStyle of mainWindow = none
			state of mainWindow = maximized
		else
			if ASYM_BorderStyle of bk <> NULL
				borderStyle of mainWindow = ASYM_BorderStyle of bk
			end
			if ASYM_CaptionBar of bk <> NULL
				captionBar of mainWindow = ASYM_CaptionBar of bk
			end
		end

		if ASYM_Modal of bk is true
			set ASYM_ModalState of this book to true
		end
	end

	if ASYM_AutoBookMarks of bk is true
		get _readBookmarks(bookmarkFn) of page "bookmarking" of self
	end

	s_ASYM_LogStartTime = ASYM_Ticks()

	if ASYM_LogStatus() is null
		get ASYM_LogType of bk
		if it <> null and it <> "none"
			get ASYM_LogStart(bk, ASYM_LogName of bk, ASYM_LogAppend of bk,ASYM_LogEncrypt of bk, ASYM_LogDestination of bk, it)
			if it is "<exit>"
				send _ASYM_ReaderExit
			end
		end
	end

	matColor of mainWindow = matColor of mainWindow
end

to handle enterBook
	forward
	get ASYM_BookSysBooks of target
	if it <> null
		bs = ASYM_BlockSuspend()
		while it <> null
			pop it into sb
			if sb is not in sysBooks
				push sb onto sysBooks
			end
		end
		get ASYM_RestoreSuspend(bs)
		if sysError <> null
			request sysError
		end
	end
end

to handle enterPage
	system s_ASYM_LogPages
	local logical resetFlag
	local sbkArr [][]
	local iList
	local WORD i,j,n

	pageCleanForExport = not ASYM_IsObjectDirty (target, "htmlExport")
	bgCleanForExport = not ASYM_IsObjectDirty (parent of target, "htmlExport")

	bk = self
	if name of page 23 of bk = "Test Item Reset"
		obj = page 23 of bk
	else
		obj = page "Test Item Reset" of self
	end
	send _ASYM_ResetPgWidgets "enterpage" to obj

	-- resetting should have no effect on export process
	if pageCleanForExport
		get ASYM_SetObjectClean (target, "htmlExport")
	end
	if bgCleanForExport
		get ASYM_SetObjectClean (parent of target, "htmlExport")
	end

	if s_ASYM_LogPages is true
		logTxt = ASYM_GetString("logPageEntry", "Page %1" & CRLF)
		logTxt = expandString(logTxt, ASYM_NameOrID(this page))
		get ASYM_LogWriteEntry(logTxt)
	end

	forward

	-- Clean up duplicate sysbooks, except myself
	myShortName = ASYM_ShortFileName(my name)
	sbks = sysbooks
	n = 0
	reset sbkArr
	step i from 1 to itemcount(sbks)
		get ASYM_ShortFileName(item i of sbks)
		if it is myShortName
			continue step
		end
		there = false
		step j from 1 to n
			if sbkArr[j][1] is it
				there = true
				increment sbkArr[j][2]
				break step
			end
		end
		if not there
			increment n
			sbkArr[n][1] = it
			sbkArr[n][2] = 1
		end
	end

	step i from 1 to n
		escapeCnt = 10
		while sbkArr[i][2] > 1 and escapeCnt > 0
			decrement escapeCnt
			step j from 1 to itemCount(sysBooks)
				get item j of sysBooks
				if it <> NULL
					get ASYM_ShortFileName (item j of sysBooks)
					clear sysError
					if it is sbkArr[i][1]
						get sysbooks
						mmyield
						clear item j of sysBooks
						mmYield
						if it <> sysbooks -- we successfully cleared the item
							decrement sbkArr[i][2]
							if sbkArr[i][2] = 1
								break step
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
			sbkArr[i][2] = 0
			step j from 1 to itemCount(sysBooks)
				get ASYM_ShortFileName (item j of sysBooks)
				if it is sbkArr[i][1]
					increment sbkArr[i][2]
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if ASYM_WorkWindow() = targetWindow
		vList = sysOpenWindows
		while itemCount(vList) > 0
			pop vList into v
			if v <> targetWindow
				send ASYM_PageEntered targetWindow to currentPage of v
			end
		end
	end
end

to handle enterSystem
	forward
	send _doNeuronCheck to page "Initialization" of self
	if ASYM_Ticks() = null
		send _linkSysBook to page "Initialization" of self
	end
end

	send killUserTooltipTimers

	forward
	conditions
	when target is mainWindow

	when object of target is "viewer"

			else
				s_ASYMWorkWindow = mainWindow
				break conditions
			end

			v = target
		end
		if not alwaysReader of v
	 		s_ASYMWorkWindow = v
		end
	end

		s_ASYMWorkWindow = mainWindow
	end
end

			request sysError
		end
	end
end

to handle enterPage
	system s_ASYM_LogPages
	local logical resetFlag
	local sbkArr [][]
	local iList
	local WORD i,j,n

	pageCleanForExport = not ASYM_IsObjectDirty (target, "htmlExport")
	bgCleanForExport = not ASYM_IsObjectDirty (parent of target, "htmlExport")

	bk = self
	if name of page 23 of bk = "Test Item Reset"
		obj = page 23 of bk
	else
		obj = page "Test Item Reset" of self
	end
	send _ASYM_ResetPgWidgets "enterpage" to obj

	-- resetting should have no effect on export process
	if pageCleanForExport
		get ASYM_SetObjectClean (target, "htmlExport")
	end
	if bgCleanForExport
		get ASYM_SetObjectClean (parent of target, "htmlExport")
	end

	if s_ASYM_LogPages is true
		logTxt = ASYM_GetString("logPageEntry", "Page %1" & CRLF)
		logTxt = expandString(logTxt, ASYM_NameOrID(this page))
		get ASYM_LogWriteEntry(logTxt)
	end

	forward

	-- Clean up duplicate sysbooks, except myself
	myShortName = ASYM_ShortFileName(my name)
	sbks = sysbooks
	n = 0
	reset sbkArr
	step i from 1 to itemcount(sbks)
		get ASYM_ShortFileName(item i of sbks)
		if it is myShortName
			continue step
		end
		there = false
		step j from 1 to n
			if sbkArr[j][1] is it
				there = true
				increment sbkArr[j][2]
				break step
			end
		end
		if not there
			increment n
			sbkArr[n][1] = it
			sbkArr[n][2] = 1
		end
	end

	step i from 1 to n
		escapeCnt = 10
		while sbkArr[i][2] > 1 and escapeCnt > 0
			decrement escapeCnt
			step j from 1 to itemCount(sysBooks)
				get item j of sysBooks
				if it <> NULL
					get ASYM_ShortFileName (item j of sysBooks)
					clear sysError
					if it is sbkArr[i][1]
						get sysbooks
						mmyield
						clear item j of sysBooks
						mmYield
						if it <> sysbooks -- we successfully cleared the item
							decrement sbkArr[i][2]
							if sbkArr[i][2] = 1
								break step
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
			sbkArr[i][2] = 0
			step j from 1 to itemCount(sysBooks)
				get ASYM_ShortFileName (item j of sysBooks)
				if it is sbkArr[i][1]
					increment sbkArr[i][2]
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if ASYM_WorkWindow() = targetWindow
		vList = sysOpenWindows
		while itemCount(vList) > 0
			pop vList into v
			if v <> targetWindow
				send ASYM_PageEntered targetWindow to currentPage of v
			end
		end
	end
end

to handle enterSystem
	forward
	send _doNeuronCheck to page "Initialization" of self
	if ASYM_Ticks() = null
		send _linkSysBook to page "Initialization" of self
	end
end

	system s_ASYMWorkWindow

	send killUserTooltipTimers

	forward
	conditions
	when target is mainWindow
		s_ASYMWorkWindow = mainWindow
	when object of target is "viewer"
		if revertFocus of target and vRef <> null
		  	if isOpen of vRef and (not revertFocus of vRef)
				v = vRef
			else
				s_ASYMWorkWindow = mainWindow
				break conditions
			end
		else
			v = target
		end
		if not alwaysReader of v

		end
	end
	if s_ASYMWorkWindow is null or not isObject(s_ASYMWorkWindow) or not isOpen of s_ASYMWorkWindow
		s_ASYMWorkWindow = mainWindow
	end
end

			get ASYM_CollectTotalScore() of this book
		else
			get ","
		end
		logToCMS = ASYM_LogDestination of this

-- 0xb3091  to handle closeWindow
to handle closeWindow
	system s_tb80r_PopViewers
	forward
	get ASYM_itemOffset(target,s_tb80r_PopViewers)
	if it <> null and it > 0
		clear item it of s_tb80r_PopViewers
	end

to handle destroy
	LOCAL ansArray[][], temp[][]
	myParent = parent of target
	qType = ASYM_WID_QType of myParent
	conditions
		when "MATCH" is in qType
		when "MULTWID" = qType
		when "MULTIOBJ" = qType
			ansArray = ASYM_WID_AnsArray of myParent
			objList = objects of myParent
			maxCount = item 1 of dimensions(ansArray)
			step i from 1 to itemcount(objList)
				pop objlist into obj
				if obj = target
					counter = 0
					step j from 1 to maxCount
						if j <> i
							increment counter
							step k from 1 to item 2 of dimensions(ansArray)
								temp[counter][k] = ansArray[j][k]
							end
						end
					end
					ASYM_WID_AnsArray of myParent = temp
					forward
					break destroy
				end
			end
	end
	forward
end

to handle enterApplication
	system s_cbtrhypexterr, s_ASYM_LogStartTime, s_ASYM_SessionElapsedTime
	local bookmarkFn, logFn, preferredLogFn

	clear s_cbtrhypexterr
	s_ASYM_SessionElapsedTime = 0

	forward

	if object of target <> book
		bk = this book
	else
		bk = target
	end

	CMS = ASYM_CMS_CourseID() <> NULL

	s_ASYM_LogStartTime = ASYM_Ticks()

	if ASYM_AutoBookMarks of bk is true
		bookmarkFn = _ASYM_MakeBookmarkFileName() of page "bookmarking" of self
	end

	if CMS
		send _CMS_EnterApplication bk, bookmarkFn to page "CMS EnterApplication" of self
	end

	if sysLevel = "reader"
		-- in case wasn't set when book saved
		if caption of mainWindow = NULL
			conditions
			when ASYM_Caption of bk <> NULL
				caption of mainWindow = ASYM_Caption of bk
			when INFO_Title of bk <> NULL
				caption of mainWindow = INFO_Title of bk
			end
		end

		if ASYM_FullScreen of bk is true
			captionBar of mainWindow = none
			borderStyle of mainWindow = none
			state of mainWindow = maximized
		else
			if ASYM_BorderStyle of bk <> NULL
				borderStyle of mainWindow = ASYM_BorderStyle of bk
			end
			if ASYM_CaptionBar of bk <> NULL
				captionBar of mainWindow = ASYM_CaptionBar of bk
			end
		end

		if ASYM_Modal of bk is true
			set ASYM_ModalState of this book to true
		end
	end

	if ASYM_AutoBookMarks of bk is true
		get _readBookmarks(bookmarkFn) of page "bookmarking" of self
	end

	s_ASYM_LogStartTime = ASYM_Ticks()

	if ASYM_LogStatus() is null
		get ASYM_LogType of bk
		if it <> null and it <> "none"
			get ASYM_LogStart(bk, ASYM_LogName of bk, ASYM_LogAppend of bk,ASYM_LogEncrypt of bk, ASYM_LogDestination of bk, it)
			if it is "<exit>"
				send _ASYM_ReaderExit
			end
		end
	end

	matColor of mainWindow = matColor of mainWindow
end

to handle enterBook
	forward
	get ASYM_BookSysBooks of target
	if it <> null
		bs = ASYM_BlockSuspend()
		while it <> null
			pop it into sb
			if sb is not in sysBooks
				push sb onto sysBooks
			end
		end
		get ASYM_RestoreSuspend(bs)
		if sysError <> null
			request sysError
		end
	end
end

			end

to handle enterBook
	forward
	get ASYM_BookSysBooks of target
	if it <> null
		bs = ASYM_BlockSuspend()
		while it <> null
			pop it into sb
			if sb is not in sysBooks
				push sb onto sysBooks
			end
		end
		get ASYM_RestoreSuspend(bs)
		if sysError <> null
			request sysError
		end
	end
end

to handle enterPage
	system s_ASYM_LogPages
	local logical resetFlag
	local sbkArr [][]
	local iList
	local WORD i,j,n

	pageCleanForExport = not ASYM_IsObjectDirty (target, "htmlExport")
	bgCleanForExport = not ASYM_IsObjectDirty (parent of target, "htmlExport")

	bk = self
	if name of page 23 of bk = "Test Item Reset"
		obj = page 23 of bk
	else
		obj = page "Test Item Reset" of self
	end
	send _ASYM_ResetPgWidgets "enterpage" to obj

	-- resetting should have no effect on export process
	if pageCleanForExport
		get ASYM_SetObjectClean (target, "htmlExport")
	end
	if bgCleanForExport
		get ASYM_SetObjectClean (parent of target, "htmlExport")
	end

	if s_ASYM_LogPages is true
		logTxt = ASYM_GetString("logPageEntry", "Page %1" & CRLF)
		logTxt = expandString(logTxt, ASYM_NameOrID(this page))
		get ASYM_LogWriteEntry(logTxt)
	end

	forward

	-- Clean up duplicate sysbooks, except myself
	myShortName = ASYM_ShortFileName(my name)
	sbks = sysbooks
	n = 0
	reset sbkArr
	step i from 1 to itemcount(sbks)
		get ASYM_ShortFileName(item i of sbks)
		if it is myShortName
			continue step
		end
		there = false
		step j from 1 to n
			if sbkArr[j][1] is it
				there = true
				increment sbkArr[j][2]
				break step
			end
		end
		if not there
			increment n
			sbkArr[n][1] = it
			sbkArr[n][2] = 1
		end
	end

	step i from 1 to n
		escapeCnt = 10
		while sbkArr[i][2] > 1 and escapeCnt > 0
			decrement escapeCnt
			step j from 1 to itemCount(sysBooks)
				get item j of sysBooks
				if it <> NULL
					get ASYM_ShortFileName (item j of sysBooks)
					clear sysError
					if it is sbkArr[i][1]
						get sysbooks
						mmyield
						clear item j of sysBooks
						mmYield
						if it <> sysbooks -- we successfully cleared the item
							decrement sbkArr[i][2]
							if sbkArr[i][2] = 1
								break step
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
			sbkArr[i][2] = 0
			step j from 1 to itemCount(sysBooks)
				get ASYM_ShortFileName (item j of sysBooks)
				if it is sbkArr[i][1]
					increment sbkArr[i][2]
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if ASYM_WorkWindow() = targetWindow
		vList = sysOpenWindows
		while itemCount(vList) > 0
			pop vList into v
			if v <> targetWindow
				send ASYM_PageEntered targetWindow to currentPage of v
			end
		end
	end
end

to handle enterSystem
	forward
	send _doNeuronCheck to page "Initialization" of self
	if ASYM_Ticks() = null
		send _linkSysBook to page "Initialization" of self
	end
end

to handle enterWindow vRef
	system s_ASYMWorkWindow

	send killUserTooltipTimers

	forward
	conditions
	when target is mainWindow
		s_ASYMWorkWindow = mainWindow
	when object of target is "viewer"
		if revertFocus of target and vRef <> null
		  	if isOpen of vRef and (not revertFocus of vRef)
				v = vRef
			else
				s_ASYMWorkWindow = mainWindow
				break conditions
			end
		else
			v = target
		end
		if not alwaysReader of v
	 		s_ASYMWorkWindow = v
		end
	end
	if s_ASYMWorkWindow is null or not isObject(s_ASYMWorkWindow) or not isOpen of s_ASYMWorkWindow
		s_ASYMWorkWindow = mainWindow
	end
end

to handle leaveApplication
	system s__ASYM_TempTotalScore, s_ASYM_LogStartTime, s_ASYM_LogFileName, s_ASYM_SessionElapsedTime, s_ASYM_ModalState

	local bookmarkFn

	clear s__ASYM_TempTotalScore

	if isType(REAL,s_ASYM_LogStartTime )
		s_ASYM_SessionElapsedTime = (ASYM_Ticks() - s_ASYM_LogStartTime)
	else
		s_ASYM_SessionElapsedTime = 0
	end

	if targetWindow is mainwindow or objectContainer(targetWindow, "book") <> self
	  	forward
	end

	if s_ASYM_ModalState is TRUE
		set ASYM_ModalState of this book to FALSE
	end

	get ASYM_LogStatus()
	if it <> null
		logFn = s_ASYM_LogFileName
		get ASYM_LogStop(it)
	end

	if ASYM_AutoBookMarks of this book is true
		bookmarkFn = _WriteBookmarks() of page "bookmarking" of self
	end

	if ASYM_CMS_CourseID() <> NULL and name of this book is not asym_CMS_CMSApplicationName()
		if ASYM_IsScored of this book <> false
			get ASYM_CollectTotalScore() of this book
		else
			get ","
		end
		logToCMS = ASYM_LogDestination of this book is "<CMS>"
		if not logToCMS
			clear logFn
		end
		if ASYM_CMS_LeaveApplication(item 1 of it, item 2 of it, s_ASYM_SessionElapsedTime div 1000, bookmarkFn, logFn) of this book
		  	get FlushMessageQueue()
			get removeFile(bookmarkFn)
			if logToCMS
				get removeFile(logFn)
			end
		end
	end
	clear s__ASYM_TempTotalScore
end

		conditions
			when not isObject(s_ASYMWorkWindow)
			when s_ASYMWorkWindow & "" is "viewer id 0 of book """""
			when parent of s_ASYMWorkWindow is this book
				clear s_ASYMWorkWindow
		end
		get ASYM_RestoreSuspend(bs)
	end
	forward
end

			_swapped of target <> true

		_swapped of target = true
	end
	forward

		if ASYM_CMS_LeaveApplication(item 1 of it, item 2 of it, s_ASYM_SessionElapsedTime div 1000, bookmarkFn, logFn) of this book
		  	get FlushMessageQueue()
			get removeFile(bookmarkFn)
			if logToCMS
				get removeFile(logFn)
			end
		end
	end
	clear s__ASYM_TempTotalScore
end

to handle leaveBook
	system s_ASYMWorkWindow
	if s_ASYMWorkWindow <> null
		bs = ASYM_BlockSuspend()
		conditions
			when not isObject(s_ASYMWorkWindow)
			when s_ASYMWorkWindow & "" is "viewer id 0 of book """""
			when parent of s_ASYMWorkWindow is this book
				clear s_ASYMWorkWindow
		end
		get ASYM_RestoreSuspend(bs)
	end
	forward
end

to handle leavePage
	pageCleanForExport = not ASYM_IsObjectDirty (target, "htmlExport")
	bgCleanForExport = not ASYM_IsObjectDirty (parent of target, "htmlExport")

	send _ASYM_ResetPgWidgets "leavepage" to page "Test Item Reset" of self

	-- only set if its changing, to prevent setting changed bits unnecessarily
	if ASYM_BeenHere of this page <> true
		ASYM_BeenHere of this page = true
	end

	-- resetting and ASYM_BeenHere should have no effect on export process
	if pageCleanForExport
		get ASYM_SetObjectClean (target, "htmlExport")
	end
	if bgCleanForExport
		get ASYM_SetObjectClean (parent of target, "htmlExport")

	forward
end

		ASYM_ModalState = FALSE

	loc = mousePosition of this window
	if autoClose of this window
		send _AutoCloseCheck loc to page "Popup Page Mgr" of self
	end

to handle linkSysBook
	if target is self and ASYM_Ticks() = NULL
		send _linkSysBook to page "Initialization" of self
	end

	if target = self
		send _unlinkSysBook to page "Initialization" of self

to handle mouseEnter
	bRef = objectContainer (target, "book")
	if bRef <> NULL
		if (ASYM_ShowToolTips of bRef <> FALSE)
			bs = ASYM_BlockSuspend()
			if ASYM_Tooltip of target <> null
				send doToolTip target to page "tooltip" of self
			end
			get ASYM_RestoreSuspend(bs)
		end
	end
	if object of target = "button" and borderStyle of target is not in "checkbox3d,radiobutton3d" and \
			enabled of target = true and \
			ASYMI_UseRollover of target = true and \
			checkedGraphic of target <> NULL and \
			_swapped of target <> true
		lastGraphic = normalGraphic of target
		normalGraphic of target = checkedGraphic of target
		checkedGraphic of target = lastGraphic
		_swapped of target = true
	end
	forward
end

to handle mouseLeave
	-- tooltip
	bs = ASYM_BlockSuspend()
	if ASYM_ToolTip of target <> null
		send hideTooltip target to page "tooltip" of self
	end
	get ASYM_RestoreSuspend(bs)

	-- rollover
	if object of target = "button" and borderStyle of target is not in "checkbox3d,radiobutton3d" and \
			ASYMI_UseRollover of target = true and _swapped of target = true
		lastGraphic = normalGraphic of target
		normalGraphic of target = checkedGraphic of target
		checkedGraphic of target = lastGraphic
		clear _swapped

to handle enterSystem
	forward
	send _doNeuronCheck to page "Initialization" of self
	if ASYM_Ticks() = null
		send _linkSysBook to page "Initialization" of self
	end
end

to handle enterWindow vRef
	system s_ASYMWorkWindow

	send killUserTooltipTimers

	forward
	conditions
	when target is mainWindow
		s_ASYMWorkWindow = mainWindow
	when object of target is "viewer"
		if revertFocus of target and vRef <> null
		  	if isOpen of vRef and (not revertFocus of vRef)
				v = vRef
			else
				s_ASYMWorkWindow = mainWindow
				break conditions
			end
		else
			v = target
		end
		if not alwaysReader of v
	 		s_ASYMWorkWindow = v
		end
	end
	if s_ASYMWorkWindow is null or not isObject(s_ASYMWorkWindow) or not isOpen of s_ASYMWorkWindow
		s_ASYMWorkWindow = mainWindow
	end
end

to handle openWindow
	system s_ASYM_ModalState
	forward
	if this window <> mainWindow and s_ASYM_ModalState <> null
		send disableTaskSwitching s_ASYM_ModalState to page "Task switch manager" of self
	end
end

to handle keyDown key
	bs = ASYM_BlockSuspend()
	if ASYM_ToolTip of target <> null
		send hideTooltip target to page "tooltip" of self
	end
	get ASYM_RestoreSuspend(bs)
	forward
end

to handle keyChar x
	if x is keyEscape and ASYM_CloseOnEsc of this window is true
		close this window
	else
		forward
	end
end

to handle leaveApplication
	system s__ASYM_TempTotalScore, s_ASYM_LogStartTime, s_ASYM_LogFileName, s_ASYM_SessionElapsedTime, s_ASYM_ModalState

	local bookmarkFn

	clear s__ASYM_TempTotalScore

	if isType(REAL,s_ASYM_LogStartTime )
		s_ASYM_SessionElapsedTime = (ASYM_Ticks() - s_ASYM_LogStartTime)
	else
		s_ASYM_SessionElapsedTime = 0
	end

	if targetWindow is mainwindow or objectContainer(targetWindow, "book") <> self
	  	forward
	end

	if s_ASYM_ModalState is TRUE
		set ASYM_ModalState of this book to FALSE
	end

	get ASYM_LogStatus()
	if it <> null
		logFn = s_ASYM_LogFileName
		get ASYM_LogStop(it)
	end

	if ASYM_AutoBookMarks of this book is true
		bookmarkFn = _WriteBookmarks() of page "bookmarking" of self
	end

	if ASYM_CMS_CourseID() <> NULL and name of this book is not asym_CMS_CMSApplicationName()
		if ASYM_IsScored of this book <> false
			get ASYM_CollectTotalScore() of this book
		else
			get ","
		end
		logToCMS = ASYM_LogDestination of this book is "<CMS>"
		if not logToCMS
			clear logFn
		end
		if ASYM_CMS_LeaveApplication(item 1 of it, item 2 of it, s_ASYM_SessionElapsedTime div 1000, bookmarkFn, logFn) of this book
		  	get FlushMessageQueue()
			get removeFile(bookmarkFn)
			if logToCMS
				get removeFile(logFn)
			end
		end
	end
	clear s__ASYM_TempTotalScore
end

to handle rightButtonDown loc, sh, ct
	bs = ASYM_BlockSuspend()
	if ASYM_ToolTip of target <> null
		send hideTooltip target to page "tooltip" of self
	end
	get ASYM_RestoreSuspend(bs)
	if (object of target = "background") or ((object of objectContainer(target, "page,background") = "background") \
			and (object of target <> "page"))
		send ASYM_BackgroundRightButtonDown loc, sh, ct to (currentPage of targetWindow)
	end
	forward
end

to handle rightButtonUp loc
	local hyperlinks[][]
	forward
	obj = target
	do
		if "ASYM_Hyperlinks" is in userProperties of obj
			if ASYM_DoHyperlink(obj, "rightButtonUp")
				break
			end
		end
		obj = parent of obj
	until obj is null
end

to handle sized
	get tbk_wid_type of target
	if it <> null
		send _sized target,it to page "Object resizing and arranging" of self
	end
	if ASYM_WID_QType of target = "SLIDER"
		send ASYM_Reset to target
	end
	if object of target = "button" and ASYMI_AutoSize of target = true and (caption of target = NULL or captionPosition of target = "center")
		send sizeButtonToGraphic target to page "Test Item Reset" of self
	end
	forward
end

to handle menuItemSelected
	bs = ASYM_BlockSuspend()
	if ASYM_ToolTip of target <> null
		send hideTooltip target to page "tooltip" of self
	end
	get ASYM_RestoreSuspend(bs)
	forward
end

	if pos = null
		return textlineOffset (x, txt)
	else
		get textlineCount (txt)
		if pos > it
			return 0
		else
			get textlineOffset (x, textlines pos to it of txt)

to get ASYM_TextlineOffset x, txt, pos
	if pos = null
		return textlineOffset (x, txt)
	else
		get textlineCount (txt)
		if pos > it
			return 0
		else
			get textlineOffset (x, textlines pos to it of txt)
			if it = 0
				return 0
			else
				return it + pos - 1
			end
		end
	end
end

		ASYM_ModalState = FALSE
	end

to handle mouseEnter
	bRef = objectContainer (target, "book")
	if bRef <> NULL
		if (ASYM_ShowToolTips of bRef <> FALSE)
			bs = ASYM_BlockSuspend()
			if ASYM_Tooltip of target <> null
				send doToolTip target to page "tooltip" of self
			end
			get ASYM_RestoreSuspend(bs)
		end
	end
	if object of target = "button" and borderStyle of target is not in "checkbox3d,radiobutton3d" and \
			enabled of target = true and \
			ASYMI_UseRollover of target = true and \
			checkedGraphic of target <> NULL and \
			_swapped of target <> true
		lastGraphic = normalGraphic of target
		normalGraphic of target = checkedGraphic of target
		checkedGraphic of target = lastGraphic
		_swapped of target = true
	end
	forward
end

to handle mouseLeave
	-- tooltip
	bs = ASYM_BlockSuspend()
	if ASYM_ToolTip of target <> null
		send hideTooltip target to page "tooltip" of self
	end
	get ASYM_RestoreSuspend(bs)

	-- rollover
	if object of target = "button" and borderStyle of target is not in "checkbox3d,radiobutton3d" and \
			ASYMI_UseRollover of target = true and _swapped of target = true
		lastGraphic = normalGraphic of target
		normalGraphic of target = checkedGraphic of target
		checkedGraphic of target = lastGraphic
		clear _swapped of target
	end
	forward
end

to handle newBackground
	if targetWindow is mainwindow or objectContainer(targetWindow, "book") <> self
	  	forward
	end
end

to handle newPage
	if targetWindow is mainwindow or objectContainer(targetWindow, "book") <> self
	  	forward
	end
end

	if targetWindow is mainwindow or objectContainer(targetWindow,"book") <> self
	  	forward
	else
		in mainWindow
			send reader to this page
		end
	end
end

	bs = ASYM_BlockSuspend()

		send hideTooltip target to page "tooltip" of self
	end
	get ASYM_RestoreSuspend(bs)
	if (object of target = "background") or ((object of objectContainer(target, "page,background") = "background") \
			and (object of target <> "page"))

	end
	forward
end

				break
			end
		end
		obj = parent of obj
	until obj is null

	return isType(REAL,x)

	return ASYM_ItemOffset(x,txt)

to get ASYM_TextlineOffset x, txt, pos
	if pos = null
		return textlineOffset (x, txt)
	else
		get textlineCount (txt)
		if pos > it
			return 0
		else
			get textlineOffset (x, textlines pos to it of txt)
			if it = 0
				return 0
			else
				return it + pos - 1
			end
		end
	end
end

to get ASYM_BlockSuspend handleStackFull
	retVal = sysSuspend

	if handleStackFull = true
		put CRLF & sysSuspendStackFull after retVal
		sysSuspendStackFull = false
		sysErrorStackFull = false
	else
		put CRLF after retVal
	end

	put CRLF & sysErrorNumber & CRLF & sysError after retVal

	sysSuspend = FALSE
	clear sysError
	sysErrorNumber = 0
	return retVal

-- 0xb3f31  to handle keyChar x
to handle keyChar x
	if x is keyEscape and ASYM_CloseOnEsc of this window is true
		close this window
	else
		forward
	end
end

to handle leaveApplication
	system s__ASYM_TempTotalScore, s_ASYM_LogStartTime, s_ASYM_LogFileName, s_ASYM_SessionElapsedTime, s_ASYM_ModalState

	local bookmarkFn

	clear s__ASYM_TempTotalScore

	if isType(REAL,s_ASYM_LogStartTime )
		s_ASYM_SessionElapsedTime = (ASYM_Ticks() - s_ASYM_LogStartTime)
	else
		s_ASYM_SessionElapsedTime = 0
	end

	if targetWindow is mainwindow or objectContainer(targetWindow, "book") <> self
	  	forward
	end

	if s_ASYM_ModalState is TRUE
		set ASYM_ModalState of this book to FALSE
	end

	get ASYM_LogStatus()
	if it <> null
		logFn = s_ASYM_LogFileName
		get ASYM_LogStop(it)
	end

	if ASYM_AutoBookMarks of this book is true
		bookmarkFn = _WriteBookmarks() of page "bookmarking" of self
	end

	if ASYM_CMS_CourseID() <> NULL and name of this book is not asym_CMS_CMSApplicationName()
		if ASYM_IsScored of this book <> false
			get ASYM_CollectTotalScore() of this book
		else
			get ","
		end
		logToCMS = ASYM_LogDestination of this book is "<CMS>"
		if not logToCMS
			clear logFn
		end
		if ASYM_CMS_LeaveApplication(item 1 of it, item 2 of it, s_ASYM_SessionElapsedTime div 1000, bookmarkFn, logFn) of this book
		  	get FlushMessageQueue()
			get removeFile(bookmarkFn)
			if logToCMS
				get removeFile(logFn)
			end
		end
	end
	clear s__ASYM_TempTotalScore
end

to handle leaveBook
	system s_ASYMWorkWindow
	if s_ASYMWorkWindow <> null
		bs = ASYM_BlockSuspend()
		conditions
			when not isObject(s_ASYMWorkWindow)
			when s_ASYMWorkWindow & "" is "viewer id 0 of book """""
			when parent of s_ASYMWorkWindow is this book
				clear s_ASYMWorkWindow
		end
		get ASYM_RestoreSuspend(bs)
	end
	forward
end

to handle leavePage
	pageCleanForExport = not ASYM_IsObjectDirty (target, "htmlExport")
	bgCleanForExport = not ASYM_IsObjectDirty (parent of target, "htmlExport")

	send _ASYM_ResetPgWidgets "leavepage" to page "Test Item Reset" of self

	-- only set if its changing, to prevent setting changed bits unnecessarily
	if ASYM_BeenHere of this page <> true
		ASYM_BeenHere of this page = true
	end

	-- resetting and ASYM_BeenHere should have no effect on export process
	if pageCleanForExport
		get ASYM_SetObjectClean (target, "htmlExport")
	end
	if bgCleanForExport
		get ASYM_SetObjectClean (parent of target, "htmlExport")
	end

	forward
end

to handle leaveSystem
	system s_ASYM_ModalState
	if s_ASYM_ModalState is TRUE
		ASYM_ModalState = FALSE
	end
	forward
end

to get ASYM_BlockSuspend handleStackFull
	retVal = sysSuspend

	if handleStackFull = true
		put CRLF & sysSuspendStackFull after retVal
		sysSuspendStackFull = false

to get ASYM_RestoreSuspend options
	retVal = sysError

	sysSuspend = (textline 1 of options <> false)

	get textline 2 of options
	if isType("logical", it)
		sysSuspendStackFull = it
		-- If handling stack full errors, and a stack full error occurred,
		-- that over-rides any other possible setting of sysError.
		if sysErrorStackFull = true
			-- No localization, as ASYM_GetString() will probably fail
			retVal = "Calls to handlers are nested too deeply. Try making fewer nested calls."
		end
	end

	get textline 3 of options
	if isType ("word", it)
		sysErrorNumber = it
	end

	clear textlines 1 to 3 of options
	sysError = options

	return retVal
end

to get ASYM_CollectWidgets pg
	system STACK _s_AsymWidgetCollection
	_s_AsymWidgetCollection = null
	if pg is null
		pg = this page
	end
	send ASYM_SummonWidgets to pg
	get _s_AsymWidgetCollection	& ""
	_s_AsymWidgetCollection = null
	return it
end

end

	system STACK _s_AsymWidgetCollection
	push target onto _s_AsymWidgetCollection
end

to get ASYM_Container STRING testObj, objTypeList
	local OBJECT obj

	if not isObject (testObj)
		return NULL
	end

	obj = testObj

	if ASYM_ItemInList (object of obj, objTypeList)
		return obj
	else
		return objectContainer (obj, objTypeList)
	end
end

to handle ASYM_Trigger
	mousePos = mousePosition of targetWindow
	send buttonclick mousePos, FALSE, FALSE to target

	-- trigger checked property of check-boxes and radio-buttons
	if object of target = "button"
		buttonType = borderStyle of target
		conditions
		when buttonType contains "checkbox"
			checked of target = not checked of target
			send ASYM_Changed "checked" to target
		when buttonType contains "radiobutton"
			if object of parent of target = "group"
				checked of target = true
			else
				checked of target = not checked of target
			end
			send ASYM_Changed "checked" to target
		end
	end
end

to handle ASYM_Reset mode, pResetTargetPage
	send _ASYM_Reset target, mode, pResetTargetPage to page "test item reset" of self
end

to set trackPosition to v
	_trackPosition of target = v
	b = bounds of line "track" of target
	conditions
		when v = "vertical" and item 1 of b <> item 3 of b
			h = (item 3 of b - item 1 of b)/2
			c = h + item 1 of b
			bnds = c,item 2 of b - h,c,item 2 of b + h
		when v = "horizontal" and item 2 of b <> item 4 of b
			h = (item 4 of b - item 2 of b)/2
			c = h + item 2 of b
			b = item 1 of b - h,c,item 1 of b + h,c
	end
	bounds of line "track" of target = b
	sliderPos of target = _sliderPos of target
end

			else
				return it + pos - 1
			end
		end
	end
end

to get onLine
	return (_onLine of target <> "FALSE")
end

to set onLine to val
	_online of target = val
	sliderPos of target = _sliderPos of target
end

to get ASYM_ItemInList itm,lst
	return ("," & itm & ",") is in ("," & lst & ",")
end

to get ASYM_TextlineInText tl, txt
	return (CRLF & tl & CRLF) is in (CRLF & txt & CRLF)
end

to get ASYM_BlockSuspend handleStackFull
	retVal = sysSuspend

	if handleStackFull = true
		put CRLF & sysSuspendStackFull after retVal
		sysSuspendStackFull = false
		sysErrorStackFull = false
	else
		put CRLF after retVal
	end

	put CRLF & sysErrorNumber & CRLF & sysError after retVal

	sysSuspend = FALSE
	clear sysError
	sysErrorNumber = 0
	return retVal
end

to get ASYM_RestoreSuspend options
	retVal = sysError

	sysSuspend = (textline 1 of options <> false)

	get textline 2 of options
	if isType("logical", it)
		sysSuspendStackFull = it
		-- If handling stack full errors, and a stack full error occurred,
		-- that over-rides any other possible setting of sysError.
		if sysErrorStackFull = true
			-- No localization, as ASYM_GetString() will probably fail
			retVal = "Calls to handlers are nested too deeply. Try making fewer nested calls."
		end
	end

	get textline 3 of options
	if isType ("word", it)
		sysErrorNumber = it
	end

	clear textlines 1 to 3 of options
	sysError = options

	return retVal
end

to get ASYM_CollectWidgets pg
	system STACK _s_AsymWidgetCollection
	_s_AsymWidgetCollection = null
	if pg is null
		pg = this page
	end
	send ASYM_SummonWidgets to pg
	get _s_AsymWidgetCollection	& ""
	_s_AsymWidgetCollection = null
	return it
end

to get INFO_CreatedBy
	forward
	if (it = NULL) and (object of target = "book")
		get INFO_AuthorName of target
	end
	return it
end

to handle ASYM_IAmWidget
	system STACK _s_AsymWidgetCollection
	push target onto _s_AsymWidgetCollection
end

to get ASYM_Container STRING testObj, objTypeList
	local OBJECT obj

	if not isObject (testObj)
		return NULL
	end

	obj = testObj

	if ASYM_ItemInList (object of obj, objTypeList)
		return obj
	else
		return objectContainer (obj, objTypeList)
	end
end

to handle ASYM_Trigger
	mousePos = mousePosition of targetWindow
	send buttonclick mousePos, FALSE, FALSE to target

	-- trigger checked property of check-boxes and radio-buttons
	if object of target = "button"
		buttonType = borderStyle of target
		conditions
		when buttonType contains "checkbox"
			checked of target = not checked of target
			send ASYM_Changed "checked" to target
		when buttonType contains "radiobutton"
			if object of parent of target = "group"
				checked of target = true
			else
				checked of target = not checked of target
			end
			send ASYM_Changed "checked" to target
		end
	end
end

to handle ASYM_Reset mode, pResetTargetPage
	send _ASYM_Reset target, mode, pResetTargetPage to page "test item reset" of self
end

	return GetIniVar("User Info","Company","asym.ini")

	send updateElements to target

to get trackPosition
	return _trackPosition of target
end

to set trackPosition to v
	_trackPosition of target = v
	b = bounds of line "track" of target
	conditions
		when v = "vertical" and item 1 of b <> item 3 of b
			h = (item 3 of b - item 1 of b)/2
			c = h + item 1 of b
			bnds = c,item 2 of b - h,c,item 2 of b + h
		when v = "horizontal" and item 2 of b <> item 4 of b
			h = (item 4 of b - item 2 of b)/2
			c = h + item 2 of b
			b = item 1 of b - h,c,item 1 of b + h,c
	end
	bounds of line "track" of target = b
	sliderPos of target = _sliderPos of target
end

-- 0xb4ae8  to get isNumber x
to get isNumber x
	return isType(REAL,x)
end

end

	return ASYM_ItemOffset(x,txt)
end

to get ASYM_TextlineOffset x, txt, pos
	if pos = null
		return textlineOffset (x, txt)
	else
		get textlineCount (txt)
		if pos > it
			return 0
		else
			get textlineOffset (x, textlines pos to it of txt)
			if it = 0
				return 0
			else
				return it + pos - 1
			end
		end
	end
end

to get ASYM_BlockSuspend handleStackFull
	retVal = sysSuspend

	if handleStackFull = true
		put CRLF & sysSuspendStackFull after retVal
		sysSuspendStackFull = false
		sysErrorStackFull = false
	else
		put CRLF after retVal
	end

	put CRLF & sysErrorNumber & CRLF & sysError after retVal

	sysSuspend = FALSE
	clear sysError
	sysErrorNumber = 0
	return retVal
end

to get ASYM_RestoreSuspend options
	retVal = sysError

	sysSuspend = (textline 1 of options <> false)

	get textline 2 of options
	if isType("logical", it)
		sysSuspendStackFull = it
		-- If handling stack full errors, and a stack full error occurred,
		-- that over-rides any other possible setting of sysError.
		if sysErrorStackFull = true
			-- No localization, as ASYM_GetString() will probably fail
			retVal = "Calls to handlers are nested too deeply. Try making fewer nested calls."
		end
	end

	get textline 3 of options
	if isType ("word", it)
		sysErrorNumber = it
	end

	clear textlines 1 to 3 of options
	sysError = options

	return retVal
end

to get ASYM_CollectWidgets pg
	system STACK _s_AsymWidgetCollection
	_s_AsymWidgetCollection = null
	if pg is null
		pg = this page
	end
	send ASYM_SummonWidgets to pg
	get _s_AsymWidgetCollection	& ""
	_s_AsymWidgetCollection = null
	return it
end

to get INFO_CreatedBy
	forward
	if (it = NULL) and (object of target = "book")
		get INFO_AuthorName of target
	end
	return it
end

to handle ASYM_IAmWidget
	system STACK _s_AsymWidgetCollection
	push target onto _s_AsymWidgetCollection
end

to get ASYM_Container STRING testObj, objTypeList
	local OBJECT obj

	if not isObject (testObj)
		return NULL
	end

	obj = testObj

	if ASYM_ItemInList (object of obj, objTypeList)
		return obj
	else
		return objectContainer (obj, objTypeList)
	end
end

to handle ASYM_Trigger
	mousePos = mousePosition of targetWindow
	send buttonclick mousePos, FALSE, FALSE to target

	-- trigger checked property of check-boxes and radio-buttons
	if object of target = "button"
		buttonType = borderStyle of target
		conditions
		when buttonType contains "checkbox"
			checked of target = not checked of target
			send ASYM_Changed "checked" to target
		when buttonType contains "radiobutton"
			if object of parent of target = "group"
				checked of target = true
			else
				checked of target = not checked of target
			end
			send ASYM_Changed "checked" to target
		end
	end
end

to handle ASYM_Reset mode, pResetTargetPage
	send _ASYM_Reset target, mode, pResetTargetPage to page "test item reset" of self
end

to set trackPosition to v
	_trackPosition of target = v
	b = bounds of line "track" of target
	conditions
		when v = "vertical" and item 1 of b <> item 3 of b
			h = (item 3 of b - item 1 of b)/2
			c = h + item 1 of b
			bnds = c,item 2 of b - h,c,item 2 of b + h
		when v = "horizontal" and item 2 of b <> item 4 of b
			h = (item 4 of b - item 2 of b)/2
			c = h + item 2 of b
			b = item 1 of b - h,c,item 1 of b + h,c
	end
	bounds of line "track" of target = b
	sliderPos of target = _sliderPos of target
end

to get ASYM_ExpandString
	execString = "retVal = expandString("
	step i from 1 to argCount
		put "argument (" & i & ")," after execString
	end
	if last char of execString = ","
		clear last char of execString
	end if
	put ")" after execString
	execute execString
	return retVal
end

to get revOf

-- 0xb500c  to get INFO_CreatedBy
to get INFO_CreatedBy
	forward
	if (it = NULL) and (object of target = "book")
		get INFO_AuthorName of target
	end
	return it
end

to handle ASYM_IAmWidget
	system STACK _s_AsymWidgetCollection
	push target onto _s_AsymWidgetCollection
end

to get ASYM_Container STRING testObj, objTypeList
	local OBJECT obj

	if not isObject (testObj)
		return NULL
	end

	obj = testObj

	if ASYM_ItemInList (object of obj, objTypeList)
		return obj
	else
		return objectContainer (obj, objTypeList)
	end
end

to handle ASYM_Trigger
	mousePos = mousePosition of targetWindow
	send buttonclick mousePos, FALSE, FALSE to target

	-- trigger checked property of check-boxes and radio-buttons
	if object of target = "button"
		buttonType = borderStyle of target
		conditions
		when buttonType contains "checkbox"
			checked of target = not checked of target
			send ASYM_Changed "checked" to target
		when buttonType contains "radiobutton"
			if object of parent of target = "group"
				checked of target = true
			else
				checked of target = not checked of target
			end
			send ASYM_Changed "checked" to target
		end
	end
end

to handle ASYM_Reset mode, pResetTargetPage
	send _ASYM_Reset target, mode, pResetTargetPage to page "test item reset" of self
end

to get trackPosition
	return _trackPosition of target
end

to set trackPosition to v
	_trackPosition of target = v
	b = bounds of line "track" of target
	conditions
		when v = "vertical" and item 1 of b <> item 3 of b
			h = (item 3 of b - item 1 of b)/2
			c = h + item 1 of b
			bnds = c,item 2 of b - h,c,item 2 of b + h
		when v = "horizontal" and item 2 of b <> item 4 of b
			h = (item 4 of b - item 2 of b)/2
			c = h + item 2 of b
			b = item 1 of b - h,c,item 1 of b + h,c
	end
	bounds of line "track" of target = b
	sliderPos of target = _sliderPos of target
end

	sliderPos of target = _sliderPos of target

	return _thumbWidth of target
end

to set thumbWidth to value
	_thumbWidth of target = value
	send updateElements to target
end

to get trackPosition
	return _trackPosition of target
end

to set trackPosition to v
	_trackPosition of target = v
	b = bounds of line "track" of target
	conditions
		when v = "vertical" and item 1 of b <> item 3 of b
			h = (item 3 of b - item 1 of b)/2
			c = h + item 1 of b
			bnds = c,item 2 of b - h,c,item 2 of b + h
		when v = "horizontal" and item 2 of b <> item 4 of b
			h = (item 4 of b - item 2 of b)/2
			c = h + item 2 of b
			b = item 1 of b - h,c,item 1 of b + h,c
	end
	bounds of line "track" of target = b
	sliderPos of target = _sliderPos of target
end

to get ASYM_ExpandString
	execString = "retVal = expandString("
	step i from 1 to argCount
		put "argument (" & i & ")," after execString
	end
	if last char of execString = ","
		clear last char of execString
	end if
	put ")" after execString
	execute execString
	return retVal
end

		else
			return pathOfFile(pPath)
	end conditions

to get sliderMax
	return _sliderMax of target
end

to set sliderMax to value
	_sliderMax of target = value
end

to get sliderMin
	return _sliderMin of target
end

to set sliderMin to value
	_sliderMin of target = value
end

to handle sliderMove
end

to get sliderPos
	return _sliderPos of target
end

to get sliderRatio
	return _sliderRatio of target
end

to set sliderRatio to value
	_sliderRatio of target = value
end

to get thumbPosition
	return _thumbPosition of target
end

to set thumbPosition to val
	_thumbPosition of target = val
	sliderPos of target = _sliderPos of target
end

to get thumbWidth
	return _thumbWidth of target
end

to set thumbWidth to value
	_thumbWidth of target = value
	send updateElements to target
end

to get trackPosition
	return _trackPosition of target
end

to set trackPosition to v
	_trackPosition of target = v
	b = bounds of line "track" of target
	conditions
		when v = "vertical" and item 1 of b <> item 3 of b
			h = (item 3 of b - item 1 of b)/2
			c = h + item 1 of b
			bnds = c,item 2 of b - h,c,item 2 of b + h
		when v = "horizontal" and item 2 of b <> item 4 of b
			h = (item 4 of b - item 2 of b)/2
			c = h + item 2 of b
			b = item 1 of b - h,c,item 1 of b + h,c
	end
	bounds of line "track" of target = b
	sliderPos of target = _sliderPos of target
end

to get sliderPos
	return _sliderPos of target
end

to get sliderRatio
	return _sliderRatio of target
end

to set sliderRatio to value
	_sliderRatio of target = value
end

to get thumbPosition
	return _thumbPosition of target
end

to set thumbPosition to val
	_thumbPosition of target = val
	sliderPos of target = _sliderPos of target
end

to get thumbWidth
	return _thumbWidth of target
end

to set thumbWidth to value
	_thumbWidth of target = value
	send updateElements to target
end

to get trackPosition
	return _trackPosition of target
end

to set trackPosition to v
	_trackPosition of target = v
	b = bounds of line "track" of target
	conditions
		when v = "vertical" and item 1 of b <> item 3 of b
			h = (item 3 of b - item 1 of b)/2
			c = h + item 1 of b
			bnds = c,item 2 of b - h,c,item 2 of b + h
		when v = "horizontal" and item 2 of b <> item 4 of b
			h = (item 4 of b - item 2 of b)/2
			c = h + item 2 of b
			b = item 1 of b - h,c,item 1 of b + h,c
	end
	bounds of line "track" of target = b
	sliderPos of target = _sliderPos of target
end

to get ASYM_ExpandString
	execString = "retVal = expandString("
	step i from 1 to argCount
		put "argument (" & i & ")," after execString
	end
	if last char of execString = ","
		clear last char of execString
	end if
	put ")" after execString
	execute execString
	return retVal
end

to get ASYM_PathOfFile pPath
	conditions
		when pPath = NULL
			return NULL
		when pPath contains "/"
			return _ASYM_PathOfFile(pPath) of page "Path Manager" of self
		else
			return pathOfFile(pPath)
	end conditions
end

to get trackPosition
	return _trackPosition of target
end

to set trackPosition to v
	_trackPosition of target = v
	b = bounds of line "track" of target
	conditions
		when v = "vertical" and item 1 of b <> item 3 of b
			h = (item 3 of b - item 1 of b)/2
			c = h + item 1 of b
			bnds = c,item 2 of b - h,c,item 2 of b + h
		when v = "horizontal" and item 2 of b <> item 4 of b
			h = (item 4 of b - item 2 of b)/2
			c = h + item 2 of b
			b = item 1 of b - h,c,item 1 of b + h,c
	end
	bounds of line "track" of target = b
	sliderPos of target = _sliderPos of target
end

	put ")" after execString

		put "argument (" & i & ")," after execString
	end
	if last char of execString = ","
		clear last char of execString
	end if
	put ")" after execString
	execute execString
	return retVal

to get ASYM_ExpandString
	execString = "retVal = expandString("
	step i from 1 to argCount
		put "argument (" & i & ")," after execString
	end
	if last char of execString = ","
		clear last char of execString
	end if
	put ")" after execString
	execute execString
	return retVal
end

to get ASYM_ExpandString
	execString = "retVal = expandString("
	step i from 1 to argCount
		put "argument (" & i & ")," after execString
	end
	if last char of execString = ","
		clear last char of execString
	end if
	put ")" after execString
	execute execString
	return retVal
end

to get ASYM_PathOfFile pPath
	conditions
		when pPath = NULL
			return NULL
		when pPath contains "/"
			return _ASYM_PathOfFile(pPath) of page "Path Manager" of self
		else
			return pathOfFile(pPath)
	end conditions
end

to get ASYM_ExpandString
	execString = "retVal = expandString("
	step i from 1 to argCount
		put "argument (" & i & ")," after execString
	end
	if last char of execString = ","
		clear last char of execString
	end if
	put ")" after execString
	execute execString
	return retVal
end

to get ASYM_WID_Score mode, noUpdate, showFeedback
	local _score

	if ASYM_WID_QType of target <> NULL
		if noUpdate <> TRUE
			_score = ASYM_RegisterAttempt (target, mode, showFeedback) of target
		else
		  	_score = _ASYM_WID_Score(target, mode) of page "Test Item Score" of self
		end
	end

	return _score
end

		if noUpdate <> TRUE
			_score = ASYM_RegisterAttempt (target, mode, showFeedback) of target
		else

		end
	end

	return _score

to get ASYM_WID_Score mode, noUpdate, showFeedback
	local _score

	if ASYM_WID_QType of target <> NULL
		if noUpdate <> TRUE
			_score = ASYM_RegisterAttempt (target, mode, showFeedback) of target
		else
		  	_score = _ASYM_WID_Score(target, mode) of page "Test Item Score" of self
		end
	end

	return _score
end

	return _ASYM_CollectTotalScore(includeSkip) of page "Test Item Score" of self

	end
	return _ASYM_WID_Correctness(obj) of page "Test item score" of self

	local _score

	if ASYM_WID_QType of target <> NULL
		if noUpdate <> TRUE
			_score = ASYM_RegisterAttempt (target, mode, showFeedback) of target
		else
		  	_score = _ASYM_WID_Score(target, mode) of page "Test Item Score" of self
		end
	end

	return _score

--**** TEST ITEM SCORE
to handle ASYM_ShowYourScore obj, score, mode, playFB
	if obj = NULL
		obj = target
	end
	send ASYM_ShowYourScore obj, score, mode, playFB, target to page "test item score" of self
end

to get ASYM_WID_Score mode, noUpdate, showFeedback
	local _score

	if ASYM_WID_QType of target <> NULL
		if noUpdate <> TRUE
			_score = ASYM_RegisterAttempt (target, mode, showFeedback) of target
		else
		  	_score = _ASYM_WID_Score(target, mode) of page "Test Item Score" of self
		end
	end

	return _score
end

to get ASYM_CollectTotalScore includeSkip
	return _ASYM_CollectTotalScore(includeSkip) of page "Test Item Score" of self
end

to get ASYM_WID_Correctness obj
	if obj is null
		obj = target
	end
	return _ASYM_WID_Correctness(obj) of page "Test item score" of self
end

to get ASYM_WID_Score mode, noUpdate, showFeedback
	local _score

	if ASYM_WID_QType of target <> NULL
		if noUpdate <> TRUE
			_score = ASYM_RegisterAttempt (target, mode, showFeedback) of target
		else
		  	_score = _ASYM_WID_Score(target, mode) of page "Test Item Score" of self
		end
	end

	return _score
end

	if ASYM_WID_QType of target <> NULL
		if noUpdate <> TRUE
			_score = ASYM_RegisterAttempt (target, mode, showFeedback) of target
		else

		end
	end

	return _score

to get ASYM_WID_Score mode, noUpdate, showFeedback
	local _score

	if ASYM_WID_QType of target <> NULL
		if noUpdate <> TRUE
			_score = ASYM_RegisterAttempt (target, mode, showFeedback) of target
		else
		  	_score = _ASYM_WID_Score(target, mode) of page "Test Item Score" of self
		end
	end

	return _score
end

to get ASYM_WID_Score mode, noUpdate, showFeedback
	local _score

	if ASYM_WID_QType of target <> NULL
		if noUpdate <> TRUE
			_score = ASYM_RegisterAttempt (target, mode, showFeedback) of target
		else
		  	_score = _ASYM_WID_Score(target, mode) of page "Test Item Score" of self
		end
	end

	return _score
end

to get ASYM_WID_Score mode, noUpdate, showFeedback
	local _score

	if ASYM_WID_QType of target <> NULL
		if noUpdate <> TRUE
			_score = ASYM_RegisterAttempt (target, mode, showFeedback) of target
		else
		  	_score = _ASYM_WID_Score(target, mode) of page "Test Item Score" of self
		end
	end

	return _score
end

--
--**** MESSAGE BOX
--

to get ASYM_MessageBox txt,captn,icn,btns,hlpTag,hlpFile
	oldFocusWindow = focusWindow
	get ASYM_DisableWindows()
	retVal = _ASYM_MessageBox(txt,captn,icn,btns,hlpTag,hlpFile) of page "Message Box" of self
	get ASYM_EnableWindows(it)
	if focusWindow <> oldFocusWindow and isObject(oldFocusWindow) and visible of oldFocusWindow
		focusWindow = oldFocusWindow
	end
	return retVal
end

	if pgRef <> null
		if popStyle is null
			popStyle = "shadowedAutoClose"
		end
		return ASYM_PopupPage(pgRef, popStyle, pos, captn, curs) of page "Popup Page Mgr" of self
	else
		return false
	end

to get ASYM_MessageBox txt,captn,icn,btns,hlpTag,hlpFile
	oldFocusWindow = focusWindow
	get ASYM_DisableWindows()
	retVal = _ASYM_MessageBox(txt,captn,icn,btns,hlpTag,hlpFile) of page "Message Box" of self
	get ASYM_EnableWindows(it)
	if focusWindow <> oldFocusWindow and isObject(oldFocusWindow) and visible of oldFocusWindow
		focusWindow = oldFocusWindow
	end
	return retVal
end

to get asym_ask _caption, _text, _icon, _buttons, _defText, _width, _position, _frame, _check, _radio, _help
	system _s_ASYM_RequestPageRef
	_type = "ask"

	if _s_ASYM_RequestPageRef = NULL
		basePage = page "askRequest" of self
		_s_ASYM_RequestPageRef = copyObject(basePage,basePage)
	end

	return _asym_ask_request(_caption, _text, _icon, _buttons, _type, _defText, _width, _position, _frame, _check, _radio, _help) of _s_ASYM_RequestPageRef
end

to get ASYM_MessageBox txt,captn,icn,btns,hlpTag,hlpFile
	oldFocusWindow = focusWindow
	get ASYM_DisableWindows()
	retVal = _ASYM_MessageBox(txt,captn,icn,btns,hlpTag,hlpFile) of page "Message Box" of self
	get ASYM_EnableWindows(it)
	if focusWindow <> oldFocusWindow and isObject(oldFocusWindow) and visible of oldFocusWindow
		focusWindow = oldFocusWindow
	end
	return retVal
end

to get asym_ask _caption, _text, _icon, _buttons, _defText, _width, _position, _frame, _check, _radio, _help
	system _s_ASYM_RequestPageRef
	_type = "ask"

	if _s_ASYM_RequestPageRef = NULL
		basePage = page "askRequest" of self
		_s_ASYM_RequestPageRef = copyObject(basePage,basePage)
	end

	return _asym_ask_request(_caption, _text, _icon, _buttons, _type, _defText, _width, _position, _frame, _check, _radio, _help) of _s_ASYM_RequestPageRef
end

to get ASYM_MessageBox txt,captn,icn,btns,hlpTag,hlpFile
	oldFocusWindow = focusWindow
	get ASYM_DisableWindows()
	retVal = _ASYM_MessageBox(txt,captn,icn,btns,hlpTag,hlpFile) of page "Message Box" of self
	get ASYM_EnableWindows(it)
	if focusWindow <> oldFocusWindow and isObject(oldFocusWindow) and visible of oldFocusWindow
		focusWindow = oldFocusWindow
	end
	return retVal
end

to get asym_ask _caption, _text, _icon, _buttons, _defText, _width, _position, _frame, _check, _radio, _help
	system _s_ASYM_RequestPageRef
	_type = "ask"

	if _s_ASYM_RequestPageRef = NULL
		basePage = page "askRequest" of self
		_s_ASYM_RequestPageRef = copyObject(basePage,basePage)
	end

	return _asym_ask_request(_caption, _text, _icon, _buttons, _type, _defText, _width, _position, _frame, _check, _radio, _help) of _s_ASYM_RequestPageRef
end

	oldFocusWindow = focusWindow
	get ASYM_DisableWindows()

	get ASYM_EnableWindows(it)
	if focusWindow <> oldFocusWindow and isObject(oldFocusWindow) and visible of oldFocusWindow
		focusWindow = oldFocusWindow
	end
	return retVal

		basePage = page "askRequest" of self
		_s_ASYM_RequestPageRef = copyObject(basePage,basePage)
	end

	return _asym_ask_request(_caption, _text, _icon, _buttons, _type, _defText, _width, _position, _frame, _check, _radio, _help) of _s_ASYM_RequestPageRef
end

to get ASYM_MessageBox txt,captn,icn,btns,hlpTag,hlpFile
	oldFocusWindow = focusWindow
	get ASYM_DisableWindows()
	retVal = _ASYM_MessageBox(txt,captn,icn,btns,hlpTag,hlpFile) of page "Message Box" of self
	get ASYM_EnableWindows(it)
	if focusWindow <> oldFocusWindow and isObject(oldFocusWindow) and visible of oldFocusWindow
		focusWindow = oldFocusWindow
	end
	return retVal
end

to get asym_ask _caption, _text, _icon, _buttons, _defText, _width, _position, _frame, _check, _radio, _help
	system _s_ASYM_RequestPageRef
	_type = "ask"

	if _s_ASYM_RequestPageRef = NULL
		basePage = page "askRequest" of self
		_s_ASYM_RequestPageRef = copyObject(basePage,basePage)
	end

	return _asym_ask_request(_caption, _text, _icon, _buttons, _type, _defText, _width, _position, _frame, _check, _radio, _help) of _s_ASYM_RequestPageRef
end

	oldFocusWindow = focusWindow
	get ASYM_DisableWindows()
	retVal = _ASYM_MessageBox(txt,captn,icn,btns,hlpTag,hlpFile) of page "Message Box" of self
	get ASYM_EnableWindows(it)
	if focusWindow <> oldFocusWindow and isObject(oldFocusWindow) and visible of oldFocusWindow
		focusWindow = oldFocusWindow
	end
	return retVal
end

to get ASYM_HasFBArray obj
	local FBArray[][]
	ss = sysSuspend
	sysSuspend = false
	clear sysError
	FBArray = ASYM_WID_SummaryFeedback of obj
	sysSuspend = ss
	return (sysError is null)
end

to get ASYM_IsPointClose p1,p2, dist
	if dist is null
		get GetSystemMetrics(36)
		if it is null
			linkDLL "user"
				INT GetSystemMetrics(INT)
			end
			get GetSystemMetrics(36)
		end
		dist = it * item 1 of sysPageUnitsPerPixel
	end
	pop p1 into x1
	pop p1 into y1
	pop p2 into x2
	pop p2 into y2
	return (abs(x2-x1) <= dist) or (abs(y2-y1) <= dist)
end

	return null
end

to get

-- 0xba29d  to get asym_ask _caption, _text, _icon, _buttons, _defText, _width, _position, _frame, _check, _radi
to get asym_ask _caption, _text, _icon, _buttons, _defText, _width, _position, _frame, _check, _radio, _help
	system _s_ASYM_RequestPageRef
	_type = "ask"

	if _s_ASYM_RequestPageRef = NULL
		basePage = page "askRequest" of self
		_s_ASYM_RequestPageRef = copyObject(basePage,basePage)
	end

	return _asym_ask_request(_caption, _text, _icon, _buttons, _type, _defText, _width, _position, _frame, _check, _radio, _help) of _s_ASYM_RequestPageRef
end

to get asym_request _caption, _text, _icon, _buttons, _width, _position, _frame, _check, _radio, _help
	system _s_ASYM_RequestPageRef
	_type = "request"
	_defText = null

	if _s_ASYM_RequestPageRef = NULL
		basePage = page "askRequest" of self
		_s_ASYM_RequestPageRef = copyObject(basePage,basePage)
	end

	return _asym_ask_request(_caption, _text, _icon, _buttons, _type, _defText, _width, _position, _frame, _check, _radio, _help) of _s_ASYM_RequestPageRef
end

to get ASYM_HasFBArray obj
	local FBArray[][]
	ss = sysSuspend
	sysSuspend = false
	clear sysError
	FBArray = ASYM_WID_SummaryFeedback of obj
	sysSuspend = ss
	return (sysError is null)
end

to get ASYM_IsPointClose p1,p2, dist
	if dist is null
		get GetSystemMetrics(36)
		if it is null
			linkDLL "user"
				INT GetSystemMetrics(INT)
			end
			get GetSystemMetrics(36)
		end
		dist = it * item 1 of sysPageUnitsPerPixel
	end
	pop p1 into x1
	pop p1 into y1
	pop p2 into x2
	pop p2 into y2
	return (abs(x2-x1) <= dist) or (abs(y2-y1) <= dist)
end

	return null

	if keyState(keyShift) is down and not sysRuntime and ASYM_ProductPrefix() & ASYM_CBTVersion() & "a.sbk" is in sysbooks
		send author
		if syslevel is author
			break
		end

to get ASYM_AltPgName page obj
	get title of obj
	if it is null
		get pgCaption of obj
	end
	if it is null
		get "ID" && idNumber of obj
	end
	return it
end

	targetBook = book ASYM_InternationalFile(name of self, true)

to get ASYM_HasAnsArray obj
	local AnsArray[][]
	get ASYM_BlockSuspend()
	AnsArray = ASYM_WID_AnsArray of obj
	get ASYM_RestoreSuspend(it)
	return (it is null)
end

to get ASYM_HasFBArray obj
	local FBArray[][]
	ss = sysSuspend
	sysSuspend = false
	clear sysError
	FBArray = ASYM_WID_SummaryFeedback of obj
	sysSuspend = ss
	return (sysError is null)
end

to get ASYM_IsPointClose p1,p2, dist
	if dist is null
		get GetSystemMetrics(36)
		if it is null
			linkDLL "user"
				INT GetSystemMetrics(INT)
			end
			get GetSystemMetrics(36)
		end
		dist = it * item 1 of sysPageUnitsPerPixel
	end
	pop p1 into x1
	pop p1 into y1
	pop p2 into x2
	pop p2 into y2
	return (abs(x2-x1) <= dist) or (abs(y2-y1) <= dist)
end

to get ASYM_LookRealHardForPage
	return null
end

to get ASYM_SuperEncode txt, pwd
	get ASYM_Encode(pwd, "genval") of this page
	return asymEncode(txt, it)
end

-- 0xbc52a  to handle setDefButton btn
to handle setDefButton btn
	clear my refFocus
end

notifyBefore idle
	get focus
	if it <> my refFocus
		my refFocus = it
		get word 1 of it
		if it = NULL or it <> "button" or borderStyle of focus <> "pushbutton"
			get my defBtn
			if not enabled of it
				get my cancelBtn
			end
		else
			get focus
		end
		OK = (it <> null) and (enabled of (it))
		if OK
			lockscreen of targetWindow = true
			my refBtn = it
			u = sysPageUnitsPerPixel
			pop u into x
			pop u into y
			b = bounds of it
			get item 1 of b - x, item 2 of b - y, item 3 of b + x, item 4 of b + y
			if it <> my bounds
				my bounds = it
			end
			show self
		end
	end
end

-- 0xbd94b  to handle adjustcontrols
to handle adjustcontrols
	ssm = syssuspendmessages
	syssuspendmessages = true
	lockscreen of this window = TRUE

	yPix = sysPageUnitsPerPixel
	pop yPix into xPix

	buttonSize = 24*item 2 of syspageunitsperpixel
	parentBounds = bounds of whatStage()

	item 2 of size of self = buttonSize

	myObjs = objects of self
	numberButtons = 0
	step i from 1 to itemcount(myObjs)
		obj = item i of myObjs
		if object of obj = "button"
			move obj to item 1 of parentBounds + (numberButtons * buttonSize), item 4 of parentBounds
			if hasSlider of parent of self = TRUE
				item 1 of size of obj = buttonSize
			end
			increment numberButtons
			oldb of obj = bounds of obj
		end
	end
	if hasSlider of parent of self = TRUE
		move group "slider" of self to item 1 of parentBounds + (numberButtons * buttonSize) + xPix, item 4 of parentBounds
		item 3 of bounds of group "slider" of self = item 3 of parentBounds - xPix

		sliderBounds = bounds of group "slider" of self
		item 1 of bounds of rectangle "back" of group "slider" of self = item 1 of sliderBounds + 5 * xPix
		item 3 of bounds of rectangle "back" of group "slider" of self = item 3 of sliderBounds - 5 * xPix

		item 1 of bounds of group "sliderline" of group "slider" of self = item 1 of sliderBounds + 7 * xPix
		item 3 of bounds of group "sliderline" of group "slider" of self = item 3 of sliderBounds - 7 * xPix

		send sized to button "thumb" of group "slider" of self
		send moved to button "thumb" of group "slider" of self

		oldb of group "slider" of self = sliderBounds
	end


	oldb of self = bounds of self

	lockscreen of this window = FALSE
	syssuspendmessages = ssm
end

-- 0xbf693  to get cmdButtonList
to get cmdButtonList
	local stack cmdButtonList
	btnList = getObjectList(this background, "button", false)
	btnList = btnList, getObjectList(this page, "button", false)
	while btnList is not null
		pop btnList
		if borderStyle of it is "CommandButton"
			push it onto cmdButtonList
		end
	end
	return cmdButtonList
end

to get defCmdButton
	btnList = cmdButtonList()
	while btnList is not null
		pop btnList
		if default of it is true
			return it
		end
	end
	return null
end

to get escCmdButton
	btnList = cmdButtonList()
	while btnList is not null
		pop btnList
		if escape of it is true
			return it
		end
	end
	return null
end

to get hlpCmdButton
	btnList = cmdButtonList()
	while btnList is not null
		pop btnList
		if help of it is true
			return it
		end
	end
	return null
end

to get showDefRect
	ls = lockscreen of this window
	lockScreen of this window = TRUE
	defBtn = defCmdButton()
	get showRect(defBtn)
	lockScreen of this window = ls
	return true
end

to get showRect obj
	if obj is not null
		currentDefButton() = obj
	else
		get hideDefRect()
	end if

	return true
end

notifyBefore enterField
	if eatsEnter of target = TRUE
		get hideDefRect()
	else
		get showDefRect()
	end
end

notifyBefore enterRecordField
	get showDefRect()
end

notifyBefore enterCombobox
	get showDefRect()
end

notifyBefore enterButton
	if borderStyle of target is "CommandButton" \
	   and excludeDefault of target <> TRUE
		get showRect(target)
	else
		get showDefRect()
	end
end

notifyAfter leaveButton
	if borderStyle of target is "CommandButton"
		get hideDefRect()
	end
end

notifyAfter keyDown key, isShift, isCtrl
	local buttonRef

	if not isShift and not isCtrl
		conditions
		when key is keyEscape
			buttonRef = escCmdButton()
		when key is keyEnter
			if focus <> NULL and object of focus = "field" and eatsEnter of focus = TRUE
				break
			end
			buttonRef = currentDefButton()
			if isObject (buttonRef)
				if focus <> NULL and object of focus = "field"
					send leavefield to focus
				end
			else
				buttonRef = NULL
			end
		when key is keyF1
			buttonRef = hlpCmdButton() of self
		end

		if buttonRef is not null and enabled of buttonRef
			if focus <> buttonRef
				focus = NULL
			end
			send buttonClick to buttonRef
		end
	end
end

notifyBefore author
	get hideDefRect()
end

notifyAfter author
	show self
	get showDefRect()
end

notifyBefore reader
	hide self
end

notifyBefore ASYM_Reset
	clear my _currentDefButton
	clear my _ASYM_IgnoreKeyDown
	hide self
end

notifyBefore enterPage
	if alwaysReader of this window = FALSE and sysLevel is author
		show self
	else
		hide self
		--get clearDefRect()
	end
end

notifyBefore leavePage
	if sysLevel is "reader" or alwaysReader of this window
		get showDefRect()
	end
	hide self
end

notifyBefore selectionChanged
	if sysLevel is author and not alwaysReader of this window
		show self
	end
end

notifyBefore setWidgetScript tbk_wid_name, newScript
	if tbk_wid_name = my tbk_wid_name
		set my script to newScript
	end
end

-- 0xc1596  to handle sized
to handle sized
	if target = self
		oList = my objects
		imageRef = item 1 of oList
		captionRef = item 2 of oList

		myBounds = my bounds
		bounds of imageRef = myBounds
		increment item 1 of myBounds by 285
		bounds of captionRef = myBounds
	end
end

to set ASYM_Caption to value
	caption of item 2 of my objects = value
end

to get ASYM_Caption
	return caption of item 2 of my objects
end

to set ASYM_Checked to value
	my ASYM_Value = value

	conditions
	when value contains "true" and "false" is not in value
		my ASYM_State = "checked"
	when value contains "false" and "true" is not in value
		my ASYM_State = "unchecked"
	else
		my ASYM_State = "undefined"
	end
end

to get ASYM_Checked
	local STRING retVal

	currentState = my ASYM_State
	value = my ASYM_Value
	valueCount = itemCount (value)
	conditions
	when currentState = "checked"
		if valueCount > 1
			step i from 1 to valueCount
				push "true" onto retVal
			end
			return retVal
		else
			return "true"
		end
	when currentState = "unchecked"
		if valueCount > 1
			step i from 1 to valueCount
				push "false" onto retVal
			end
			return retVal
		else
			return "false"
		end
	else
		return value
	end
end

to set ASYM_Value to value
	my _ASYM_Value = value
end

to get ASYM_Value
	return my _ASYM_Value
end

to set ASYM_State to value
	my _ASYM_State = value

	imageRef = item 1 of my objects
	if value contains "checked"
		strokeColor of imageRef = black
		checked of imageRef = (value = "checked")
	else
		strokeColor of imageRef = gray
		checked of imageRef = TRUE
	end
end

to get ASYM_State
	return my _ASYM_State
end

to handle buttonDown
	system _ASYM_MultiStateCheckBox_IgnoreButtonClick
	system _ASYM_MultiStateCheckBox_IgnoreButtonUp

	forward to parent

	linkDLL "user"
		INT getSystemMetrics (INT)
	end

	if getSystemMetrics (23) > 0 -- mouse buttons swapped
		leftButton = keyRightButton
	else
		leftButton = keyLeftButton
	end

	obList = my objects
	imageRef = item 1 of obList

	if target = imageRef
		focus = item 2 of obList
	end

	overButton = TRUE
	ASYM_Invert of imageRef = overButton

	while keyState (leftButton) = "down"
		obRef = objectFromPoint (mousePosition of targetWindow, targetWindow)
		if (obRef is in obList) <> overButton
			overButton = not overButton
			ASYM_Invert of imageRef = overButton
		end
	end

	lockScreen of targetWindow = TRUE
	ASYM_Invert of imageRef = FALSE

	if overButton = TRUE
		currentState = my ASYM_State
		value = my ASYM_Value

		if currentState = "unchecked"
			my ASYM_State = "checked"
		else
			if value = NULL or (value contains "true" and value contains "false") -- need 3 states
				if currentState = "undefined"
					my ASYM_State = "unchecked"
				else
					my ASYM_State = "undefined"
				end
			else
				my ASYM_State = "unchecked"
			end
		end
		lockScreen of targetWindow = FALSE
		send ASYM_ButtonClick mousePosition of targetWindow, keyState (keyShift) = "down", keyState (keyControl) = "down"
		lockScreen of targetWindow = TRUE
		_ASYM_MultiStateCheckBox_IgnoreButtonClick = TRUE
	else
		_ASYM_MultiStateCheckBox_IgnoreButtonUp = TRUE
	end
end

to set ASYM_Enabled to value
	my enabled = value
	imageRef = item 1 of my objects
	if value
		fillColor of imageRef = white
	else
		fillColor of imageRef = lightGray
	end
end

to get ASYM_Enabled
	return enabled of item 1 of my objects
end

to set ASYM_Invert to value
	my _ASYM_Invert = value

	imageRef = item 1 of my objects
	if value
		fillColor of imageRef = lightGray
	else
		fillColor of imageRef = white
	end
end

to get ASYM_Invert
	return (my _ASYM_Invert = TRUE)
end

to handle autoSize
	sSM = sysSuspendMessages
	sysSuspendMessages = TRUE

	vRef = item 1 of shownBy of objectContainer (self, "page")
	if vRef <> NULL
		ls = lockScreen of vRef
		lockScreen of vRef = TRUE
	end

	obList = my objects
	imageRef = item 1 of obList
	captionRef = item 2 of obList

	spp = item 1 of SysPageUnitsPerPixel
	h = screenWidth() * spp
	l = 0

	while h-l >= spp
		m = average(h,l)
		item 1 of size of captionRef = m
		if textoverflow of captionRef = 0
			h = m
		else
			l = m
		end
	end
	if m = l
		increment item 1 of size of captionRef by spp
	end

	increment item 1 of size of captionRef by 90

	items 2 to 4 of bounds of imageRef = items 2 to 4 of bounds of captionRef

	sysSuspendMessages = sSM

	send sized

	if vRef <> NULL
		lockScreen of vRef = ls
	end
end

to get ASYM_CheckBox
	return TRUE
end

notifyAfter ASYM_ButtonClick
end

to handle buttonClick pos, isShift, isCtrl
	system _ASYM_MultiStateCheckBox_IgnoreButtonClick

	if _ASYM_MultiStateCheckBox_IgnoreButtonClick = TRUE
		clear _ASYM_MultiStateCheckBox_IgnoreButtonClick
	else
		currentState = my ASYM_State
		value = my ASYM_Value

		if currentState = "unchecked"
			my ASYM_State = "checked"
		else
			if value = NULL or (value contains "true" and value contains "false") -- need 3 states
				if currentState = "undefined"
					my ASYM_State = "unchecked"
				else
					my ASYM_State = "undefined"
				end
			else
				my ASYM_State = "unchecked"
			end
		end
		lockScreen of targetWindow = false
		send ASYM_ButtonClick pos, isShift, isCtrl
	end
end

to handle buttonDoubleClick
	SYSTEM _ASYM_MultiStateCheckBox_IgnoreButtonUp

	_ASYM_MultiStateCheckBox_IgnoreButtonUp = TRUE
end

to handle buttonUp
	SYSTEM _ASYM_MultiStateCheckBox_IgnoreButtonUp

	if _ASYM_MultiStateCheckBox_IgnoreButtonUp = TRUE
		clear _ASYM_MultiStateCheckBox_IgnoreButtonUp
	else
		if target = item 1 of objects of self
			checked of target = not checked of target
		end
	end
end

		if currentState = "unchecked"
			my ASYM_State = "checked"
		else
			if value = NULL or (value contains "true" and value contains "false") -- need 3 states
				if currentState = "undefined"
					my ASYM_State = "unchecked"
				else
					my ASYM_State = "undefined"
				end
			else
				my ASYM_State = "unchecked"
			end
		end
		lockScreen of targetWindow = FALSE
		send ASYM_ButtonClick mousePosition of targetWindow, keyState (keyShift) = "down", keyState (keyControl) = "down"
		lockScreen of targetWindow = TRUE
		_ASYM_MultiStateCheckBox_IgnoreButtonClick = TRUE
	else
		_ASYM_MultiStateCheckBox_IgnoreButtonUp = TRUE
	end
end

to set ASYM_Enabled to value
	my enabled = value
	imageRef = item 1 of my objects
	if value
		fillColor of imageRef = white
	else
		fillColor of imageRef = lightGray
	end
end

to get ASYM_Enabled
	return enabled of item 1 of my objects
end

to set ASYM_Invert to value
	my _ASYM_Invert = value

	imageRef = item 1 of my objects
	if value
		fillColor of imageRef = lightGray
	else
		fillColor of imageRef = white
	end
end

to get ASYM_Invert
	return (my _ASYM_Invert = TRUE)
end

to handle autoSize
	sSM = sysSuspendMessages
	sysSuspendMessages = TRUE

	vRef = item 1 of shownBy of objectContainer (self, "page")
	if vRef <> NULL
		ls = lockScreen of vRef
		lockScreen of vRef = TRUE
	end

	obList = my objects
	imageRef = item 1 of obList
	captionRef = item 2 of obList

	spp = item 1 of SysPageUnitsPerPixel
	h = screenWidth() * spp
	l = 0

	while h-l >= spp
		m = average(h,l)
		item 1 of size of captionRef = m
		if textoverflow of captionRef = 0
			h = m
		else
			l = m
		end
	end
	if m = l
		increment item 1 of size of captionRef by spp
	end

	increment item 1 of size of captionRef by 90

	items 2 to 4 of bounds of imageRef = items 2 to 4 of bounds of captionRef

	sysSuspendMessages = sSM

	send sized

	if vRef <> NULL
		lockScreen of vRef = ls
	end
end

to get ASYM_CheckBox
	return TRUE
end

notifyAfter ASYM_ButtonClick
end

	system _ASYM_MultiStateCheckBox_IgnoreButtonClick

	if _ASYM_MultiStateCheckBox_IgnoreButtonClick = TRUE
		clear _ASYM_MultiStateCheckBox_IgnoreButtonClick
	else
		currentState = my ASYM_State
		value = my ASYM_Value

			my ASYM_State = "checked"

		end

	end
end

	SYSTEM _ASYM_MultiStateCheckBox_IgnoreButtonUp

	_ASYM_MultiStateCheckBox_IgnoreButtonUp = TRUE
end

to handle buttonUp
	SYSTEM _ASYM_MultiStateCheckBox_IgnoreButtonUp

	if _ASYM_MultiStateCheckBox_IgnoreButtonUp = TRUE
		clear _ASYM_MultiStateCheckBox_IgnoreButtonUp
	else
		if target = item 1 of objects of self
			checked of target = not checked of target
		end
	end
end
