-- 0xc3c4c  to handle leaveButton
to handle leaveButton
	if my ASYM_AutoFocus = true
		gRef = my parent
		if object of gRef = "group" and autoRadioButtons of gRef = TRUE
			obList = objects of gRef
			while obList <> NULL
				pop obList into obRef
				if obRef <> self and ASYM_RadioButton of obRef = TRUE and ASYM_State of obRef = "unchecked"
					excludeTab of item 2 of objects of obRef = TRUE
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

to handle keyDown key
	if my ASYM_AutoFocus = true
		conditions
			when key = keyUpArrow or key = keyLeftArrow
				obList = objects of parent of self
				obNum = ASYM_ItemOffset (self, obList)
				if obNum > 1
					step i from obNum - 1 to 1 by -1
						obRef = item i of obList
						if obRef <> self and ASYM_RadioButton of obRef = TRUE and ASYM_Enabled of obRef = true
							ASYM_State of obRef = "checked"
							send ASYM_ButtonClick mousePosition of targetWindow, keyState (keyShift) = "down", keyState (keyControl) = "down" to obRef
							break keyDown
						end
					end
				end
				step i from itemCount (obList) to obNum by -1
					obRef = item i of obList
					if obRef <> self and ASYM_RadioButton of obRef = TRUE and ASYM_Enabled of obRef = true
						ASYM_State of obRef = "checked"
						send ASYM_ButtonClick mousePosition of targetWindow, keyState (keyShift) = "down", keyState (keyControl) = "down" to obRef
						break keyDown
					end
				end
			when key = keyDownArrow or key = keyRightArrow
				obList = objects of parent of self
				obNum = ASYM_ItemOffset (self, obList)
				obCount = itemCount (obList)
				if obNum < obCount
					step i from obNum + 1 to obCount
						obRef = item i of obList
						if obRef <> self and ASYM_RadioButton of obRef = TRUE and ASYM_Enabled of obRef = true
							ASYM_State of obRef = "checked"
							send ASYM_ButtonClick mousePosition of targetWindow, keyState (keyShift) = "down", keyState (keyControl) = "down" to obRef
							break keyDown
						end
					end
				end
				step i from 1 to obNum
					obRef = item i of obList
					if obRef <> self and ASYM_RadioButton of obRef = TRUE and ASYM_Enabled of obRef = true
						ASYM_State of obRef = "checked"
						send ASYM_ButtonClick mousePosition of targetWindow, keyState (keyShift) = "down", keyState (keyControl) = "down" to obRef
						break keyDown
					end
				end
			else
				forward to parent
		end
	else
		forward to parent
	end
end

to handle sized
	if target = self
		obList = my objects
		imageRef = item 1 of obList
		captionRef = item 2 of obList
		myBounds = my bounds
		bounds of imageRef = myBounds
		increment item 1 of myBounds by 285
		bounds of captionRef = myBounds
	end
end

to set ASYM_Caption to value
	caption of item 2 of my objects = value
end

to get ASYM_Caption
	return caption of item 2 of my objects
end

to set ASYM_Checked to value
	my ASYM_Value = value

	conditions
		when value contains "true" and "false" is not in value
			my ASYM_State ("noFocus") = "checked"
		when value contains "false" and "true" is not in value
			my ASYM_State = "unchecked"
		else
			my ASYM_State = "undefined"
	end
end

to get ASYM_Checked
	local STRING retVal
	currentState = my ASYM_State
	value = my ASYM_Value
	valueCount = itemCount (value)
	conditions
		when currentState = "checked"
			if valueCount > 1
				step i from 1 to valueCount
					push "true" onto retVal
				end
				return retVal
			else
				return "true"
			end
		when currentState = "unchecked"
			if valueCount > 1
				step i from 1 to valueCount
					push "false" onto retVal
				end
				return retVal
			else
				return "false"
			end
		else
			return value
	end
end

to set ASYM_Value to value
	my _ASYM_Value = value
end

to get ASYM_Value
	return my _ASYM_Value
end

to set ASYM_State flags to value
	my _ASYM_State = value
	get my objects
	pop it into imageRef
	pop it into captionRef
	if value = "checked"
		checked of imageRef = TRUE
		autoFocus = (my ASYM_AutoFocus = true)
		if autoFocus

			bs = ASYM_BlockSuspend()
			excludeTab of captionRef = FALSE
			setFocus = "noFocus" is not in flags

			if not setFocus and my ASYM_AutoFocus = true and focus <> null and focus <> captionRef
				focusGroup = parent of focus
				if focusGroup is in objects of my parent and ASYM_RadioButton of focusGroup = true
					setFocus = true
				end
			end

			if setFocus
				focus = captionRef
			end

			get ASYM_RestoreSuspend (bs)
		end

		gRef = my parent
		if object of gRef = "group" and autoRadioButtons of gRef = TRUE
			obList = objects of gRef
			while obList <> NULL
				pop obList into obRef
				if obRef <> self and ASYM_RadioButton of obRef = TRUE
					ASYM_State of obRef = "unchecked"
					if autoFocus
						excludeTab of item 2 of objects of obRef = TRUE
					end
				end
			end
		end
	else
		checked of imageRef = FALSE
	end
end

to get ASYM_State
	return my _ASYM_State
end

to handle buttonDown
	system _ASYM_MultiStateCheckBox_IgnoreButtonClick

	forward to parent

	focusRef = item 2 of my objects

	-- TURN OFF EXCLUDE TAB
	excludeTab of focusRef = false

	-- SET FOCUS TO THIS OBJECT
	focus = focusRef

	linkDLL "user"
		INT getSystemMetrics (INT)
	end

	if getSystemMetrics(23) > 0 -- mouse buttons swapped
		leftButton = keyRightButton
	else
		leftButton = keyLeftButton
	end

	obList = my objects
	imageRef = item 1 of obList
	overButton = TRUE
	ASYM_Invert of imageRef = overButton

	while keyState (leftButton) = "down"
		obRef = objectFromPoint (mousePosition of targetWindow, targetWindow)
		if (obRef is in obList) <> overButton
			overButton = not overButton
			ASYM_Invert of imageRef = overButton
		end
	end

	lockScreen of targetWindow = TRUE
	ASYM_Invert of imageRef = FALSE

	if overButton = TRUE
		my ASYM_State = "checked"
		lockScreen of targetWindow = FALSE
		send ASYM_ButtonClick mousePosition of targetWindow, keyState (keyShift) = "down", keyState (keyControl) = "down"
		_ASYM_MultiStateCheckBox_IgnoreButtonClick = TRUE
	else
		lockScreen of targetWindow = FALSE
	end
end

to set ASYM_Enabled to value
	my enabled = value
	imageRef = item 1 of my objects
	if value
		fillColor of imageRef = white
	else
		fillColor of imageRef = lightGray
	end
end

to get ASYM_Enabled
	return enabled of item 1 of my objects
end

to set ASYM_Invert to value
	my _ASYM_Invert = value

	imageRef = item 1 of my objects

	if useWindowsColors of imageRef
		invert of imageRef = value
	else
		if value
			fillColor of imageRef = lightGray
		else
			fillColor of imageRef = white
		end
	end
end

to get ASYM_Invert

end

-- 0xc4272  to get ASYM_Checked
to get ASYM_Checked
	local STRING retVal
	currentState = my ASYM_State
	value = my ASYM_Value
	valueCount = itemCount (value)
	conditions
		when currentState = "checked"
			if valueCount > 1
				step i from 1 to valueCount
					push "true" onto retVal
				end
				return retVal
			else
				return "true"
			end
		when currentState = "unchecked"
			if valueCount > 1
				step i from 1 to valueCount
					push "false" onto retVal
				end
				return retVal
			else
				return "false"
			end
		else
			return value
	end
end

to set ASYM_Value to value
	my _ASYM_Value = value
end

to get ASYM_Value
	return my _ASYM_Value
end

to set ASYM_State flags to value
	my _ASYM_State = value
	get my objects
	pop it into imageRef
	pop it into captionRef
	if value = "checked"
		checked of imageRef = TRUE
		autoFocus = (my ASYM_AutoFocus = true)
		if autoFocus

			bs = ASYM_BlockSuspend()
			excludeTab of captionRef = FALSE
			setFocus = "noFocus" is not in flags

			if not setFocus and my ASYM_AutoFocus = true and focus <> null and focus <> captionRef
				focusGroup = parent of focus
				if focusGroup is in objects of my parent and ASYM_RadioButton of focusGroup = true
					setFocus = true
				end
			end

			if setFocus
				focus = captionRef
			end

			get ASYM_RestoreSuspend (bs)
		end

		gRef = my parent
		if object of gRef = "group" and autoRadioButtons of gRef = TRUE
			obList = objects of gRef
			while obList <> NULL
				pop obList into obRef
				if obRef <> self and ASYM_RadioButton of obRef = TRUE
					ASYM_State of obRef = "unchecked"
					if autoFocus
						excludeTab of item 2 of objects of obRef = TRUE
					end
				end
			end
		end
	else
		checked of imageRef = FALSE
	end
end

to get ASYM_State
	return my _ASYM_State
end

	forward to parent

	focusRef = item 2 of my objects

	-- TURN OFF EXCLUDE TAB
	excludeTab of focusRef = false

	-- SET FOCUS TO THIS OBJECT
	focus = focusRef

	linkDLL "user"
		INT getSystemMetrics (INT)
	end

	if getSystemMetrics(23) > 0 -- mouse buttons swapped
		leftButton = keyRightButton
	else
		leftButton = keyLeftButton
	end

	obList = my objects
	imageRef = item 1 of obList
	overButton = TRUE
	ASYM_Invert of imageRef = overButton

	while keyState (leftButton) = "down"
		obRef = objectFromPoint (mousePosition of targetWindow, targetWindow)
		if (obRef is in obList) <> overButton
			overButton = not overButton
			ASYM_Invert of imageRef = overButton
		end
	end

	lockScreen of targetWindow = TRUE
	ASYM_Invert of imageRef = FALSE

	if overButton = TRUE
		my ASYM_State = "checked"
		lockScreen of targetWindow = FALSE
		send ASYM_ButtonClick mousePosition of targetWindow, keyState (keyShift) = "down", keyState (keyControl) = "down"
		_ASYM_MultiStateCheckBox_IgnoreButtonClick = TRUE
	else

	end

-- 0xc81d9  to handle ASYM_Reset
to handle ASYM_Reset
-----------------------------
	validClip of self = NULL
	clipSpec of self = NULL
	lastStatus of self = NULL
	errorMsg of self = NULL
	isPlayable of self = NULL
	send stopClip to self
	send setClipControls to self
end

-----------------------------
to handle ASYM_Trigger
-----------------------------
	if syslevel <> author
		myClip = validClip of self
		if myClip = NULL
			myClip = myClipSpec()
		end

		if myClip <> NULL
			if mmstatus of myClip = "playing"
				if (preLoadMedia of self = TRUE)
					mmstop myclip
				else
					mmclose myclip
				end
			else
				if (preLoadMedia of self = TRUE)
					send openClip to self
					if (autoShowMedia of self = TRUE)
						send showClip to self
					end
				end
				send playClip to self
				send setClipControls to self
			end
		end
	end
end

-----------------------------
to handle moved
-----------------------------
	if object of self <> "stage" and isObject(group "mmwidget_controls" of self )
		send adjustControls to group "mmwidget_controls" of self
	end
end

-----------------------------
to handle sized
-----------------------------
	if object of self <> "stage" and isObject(group "mmwidget_controls" of self )
		send adjustControls to group "mmwidget_controls" of self
	end
end

-----------------------------
notifyAfter reader
-----------------------------
	send start
end

-----------------------------
to handle start
-----------------------------
	if syslevel <> author

		myClip = myClipSpec()

		if myClip <> NULL then
			-- Make sure the clip can be played in a stage
			validMediaTypes = "animation,bitmap,digitalVideo,overlay"
			mediaType = mmMediaType of myClip
			if ASYM_ItemInList(mediaType, validMediaTypes) = TRUE then

				if (preLoadMedia of self = TRUE) and validClip of self <> NULL
					send openClip to self
					if (autoShowMedia of self = TRUE)
						send showClip to self
					end
				end
				if (autoPlayMedia of self = TRUE)
					send playClip self
				end
				send setClipControls to self
			else
				-- Invalid media type - display error message
				errMsg = ASYM_GetString("Unable to play non-visual clip.")
				captn = ASYM_GetString("Invalid media type")
				get ASYM_MessageBox(errMsg, captn, "WARNING", "OK", NULL, NULL)

				refViewer = myViewerRef()
				if refViewer <> mainWindow then
					close refViewer
				end if
			end if
		end
	end
end

-----------------------------
notifyAfter leavePage
-----------------------------
	if sysLevel <> AUTHOR
		if (autoCloseMedia of self = TRUE) and validClip of self <> NULL
			send closeClip to self
		end
	end
end


-----------------------------
to handle playClip
-----------------------------
	in myViewerRef()
		myClip = myClipSpec()
		if myClip <> NULL and (clipIsPlayable() of self) and sysLevel = "reader"

			-- Make sure the clip can be played in a stage
			validMediaTypes = "animation,bitmap,digitalVideo,overlay"
			mediaType = mmMediaType of myClip
			if ASYM_ItemInList(mediaType, validMediaTypes) = TRUE then

				stageObj = whatStage of self
				doWait = (ASYM_WID_ClipWait of self = TRUE)

				if isObject(stageObj) and ASYM_WID_ClipLoop of self = TRUE
					preEffect of stageObj = NULL
					postEffect of stageObj = NULL
				end

				if mmStatus of myClip = "closed"
					sysCursor = 4
					mmOpen myClip
					sysCursor = 1
				end

				-- If necessary, show the clip in the stage
				if stageObj <> NULL

					if mmVisible of myClip <> TRUE
						mmShow myClip in stageObj wait
						mmYield
						mmYield
						mmYield
					end if

					if doWait
						mmPlay myClip wait notify self
					else
						mmPlay myClip notify self
					end
					mmYield

				else

					if doWait
						mmPlay myClip hold wait notify self
					else
						mmPlay myClip hold notify self
					end

				end if

				send checkStageSize
				send setClipControls to self
			else
				-- Invalid media type - display error message
				errMsg = ASYM_GetString("Unable to play non-visual clip.")
				captn = ASYM_GetString("Invalid media type")
				get ASYM_MessageBox(errMsg, captn, "WARNING", "OK", NULL, NULL)

				refViewer = myViewerRef()
				if refViewer <> mainWindow then
					close refViewer
				end if
			end if
		end
	end
end

-----------------------------
to handle openClip
-----------------------------
	in myViewerRef()
		myClip = validClip of self
		if myClip = NULL
			myClip = myClipSpec()
		end

		if myClip <> NULL and (clipIsPlayable() of self)
			sysCursor = 4
			mmOpen myClip
			mmYield
			send checkStageSize
			sysCursor = 1
		end
	end
end

-----------------------------
to handle closeClip
-----------------------------
	in myViewerRef()
		myClip = validClip of self
		if myClip = NULL
			myClip = myClipSpec()
		end
		if (myClip <> NULL) and isReady(myClip)
			mmClose myClip
			mmYield
		end
	end
end

-----------------------------
to handle pauseClip
-----------------------------
	in myViewerRef()
		myClip = validClip of self
		if myClip = NULL
			myClip = myClipSpec()
		end
		if (myClip <> NULL) and (mmStatus of myClip = "playing")
			mmPause myClip
			mmYield
		end
	end
end

-----------------------------
to handle stopClip
-----------------------------
	in myViewerRef()
		myClip = validClip of self
		if myClip = NULL
			myClip = myClipSpec()
		end
		if (myClip <> NULL) and isReady(myClip)
			mmRewind myClip
			mmYield
		end
	end
end

-----------------------------
to handle showClip
-----------------------------
	in myViewerRef()
		myClip = validClip of self
		if myClip = NULL
			myClip = myClipSpec()
		end
		if (myClip <> NULL) and (clipIsPlayable() of self)
			mmOpen myClip
			mmShow myClip in whatStage()
			mmYield
		end
	end
end

-----------------------------
to handle seekClip argPos
-----------------------------
	in myViewerRef()
		myClip = validClip of self
		if myClip = NULL
			myClip = myClipSpec()
		end
		if (myClip <> NULL) and isReady(myClip)
			mmSeek myClip to argPos wait
			mmYield
		end
	end
end

-----------------------------
to handle seekClipFromEnd argPos
-----------------------------
	in myViewerRef()
		myClip = validClip of self
		if myClip = NULL
			myClip = myClipSpec()
		end
		if (myClip <> NULL) and isReady(myClip)
			mmSeek myClip to argPos from end wait
			mmYield
		end
	end
end

-----------------------------
to handle stepClip
-----------------------------
	in myViewerRef()
		myClip = validClip of self
		if myClip = NULL
			myClip = myClipSpec()
		end
		if (myClip <> NULL) and isReady(myClip)
			if stepDist of self = NULL
				stepSize = truncate(mmLength of myClip / 20)
			else
				stepSize = stepDist of self
			end
			if mmPosition of myClip <= mmLength of myClip - stepSize
				mmStep myClip by stepSize wait
				mmYield
			else
				mmSeek myClip to 0 from end wait
				mmYield
			end
		end
	end
end

-----------------------------
to handle stepClipBack
-----------------------------
	in myViewerRef()
		myClip = validClip of self
		if myClip = NULL
			myClip = myClipSpec()
		end
		if (myClip <> NULL) and isReady(myClip)
			if stepDist of self = NULL
				stepSize = truncate(mmLength of myClip / 20)
			else
				stepSize = stepDist of self
			end
			if mmPosition of myClip > stepSize
				mmStep myClip back by stepSize wait
				mmYield
			else
				mmSeek myClip to 0 wait
				mmYield
			end
		end
	end
end

----------------------------------
to handle mmnotify whatClip, whatCommand, whatStatus
----------------------------------
	_loop = (ASYM_WID_ClipLoop of self = TRUE)

	if _loop and whatCommand = "mmplay" and whatStatus = "successful"
		if keyState(keyEscape) = down
			if sysOpenMedia <> NULL
				mmClose all
				break mmnotify
			end
		end

		send playClip to self

	if syslevel <> author

		if myClip <> NULL then

			validMediaTypes = "animation,bitmap,digitalVideo,overlay"
			mediaType = mmMediaType of myClip
			if ASYM_ItemInList(mediaType, validMediaTypes) = TRUE then

				if (preLoadMedia of self = TRUE) and validClip of self <> NULL
					send openClip to self
					if (autoShowMedia of self = TRUE)
						send showClip to self
					end
				end
				if (autoPlayMedia of self = TRUE)
					send playClip self
				end
				send setClipControls to self
			else
				-- Invalid media type - display error message
				errMsg = ASYM_GetString("Unable to play non-visual clip.")
				captn = ASYM_GetString("Invalid media type")

-----------------------------
to handle playClip
-----------------------------
	in myViewerRef()
		myClip = myClipSpec()
		if myClip <> NULL and (clipIsPlayable() of self) and sysLevel = "reader"

			-- Make sure the clip can be played in a stage
			validMediaTypes = "animation,bitmap,digitalVideo,overlay"
			mediaType = mmMediaType of myClip
			if ASYM_ItemInList(mediaType, validMediaTypes) = TRUE then

				stageObj = whatStage of self
				doWait = (ASYM_WID_ClipWait of self = TRUE)

				if isObject(stageObj) and ASYM_WID_ClipLoop of self = TRUE
					preEffect of stageObj = NULL
					postEffect of stageObj = NULL
				end

				if mmStatus of myClip = "closed"
					sysCursor = 4
					mmOpen myClip
					sysCursor = 1
				end

				-- If necessary, show the clip in the stage
				if stageObj <> NULL

					if mmVisible of myClip <> TRUE
						mmShow myClip in stageObj wait
						mmYield
						mmYield
						mmYield
					end if

					if doWait
						mmPlay myClip wait notify self
					else
						mmPlay myClip notify self
					end
					mmYield

				else

					if doWait
						mmPlay myClip hold wait notify self
					else
						mmPlay myClip hold notify self
					end

				end if

				send checkStageSize
				send setClipControls to self
			else
				-- Invalid media type - display error message
				errMsg = ASYM_GetString("Unable to play non-visual clip.")
				captn = ASYM_GetString("Invalid media type")
				get ASYM_MessageBox(errMsg, captn, "WARNING", "OK", NULL, NULL)

				refViewer = myViewerRef()
				if refViewer <> mainWindow then
					close refViewer
				end if
			end if
		end
	end
end

-----------------------------
to handle openClip
-----------------------------
	in myViewerRef()
		myClip = validClip of self
		if myClip = NULL
			myClip = myClipSpec()
		end

		if myClip <> NULL and (clipIsPlayable() of self)
			sysCursor = 4
			mmOpen myClip
			mmYield
			send checkStageSize
			sysCursor = 1
		end
	end
end

-----------------------------
to handle closeClip
-----------------------------
	in myViewerRef()
		myClip = validClip of self
		if myClip = NULL
			myClip = myClipSpec()
		end
		if (myClip <> NULL) and isReady(myClip)
			mmClose myClip
			mmYield
		end
	end
end

-----------------------------
to handle pauseClip
-----------------------------
	in myViewerRef()
		myClip = validClip of self
		if myClip = NULL
			myClip = myClipSpec()
		end
		if (myClip <> NULL) and (mmStatus of myClip = "playing")
			mmPause myClip
			mmYield
		end
	end
end

-----------------------------
to handle stopClip
-----------------------------
	in myViewerRef()
		myClip = validClip of self
		if myClip = NULL
			myClip = myClipSpec()
		end
		if (myClip <> NULL) and isReady(myClip)
			mmRewind myClip
			mmYield
		end
	end
end

-----------------------------
to handle showClip
-----------------------------
	in myViewerRef()
		myClip = validClip of self
		if myClip = NULL
			myClip = myClipSpec()
		end
		if (myClip <> NULL) and (clipIsPlayable() of self)
			mmOpen myClip
			mmShow myClip in whatStage()
			mmYield
		end
	end
end

-----------------------------
to handle seekClip argPos
-----------------------------
	in myViewerRef()
		myClip = validClip of self
		if myClip = NULL
			myClip = myClipSpec()
		end
		if (myClip <> NULL) and isReady(myClip)
			mmSeek myClip to argPos wait
			mmYield
		end
	end
end

-----------------------------
to handle seekClipFromEnd argPos
-----------------------------
	in myViewerRef()
		myClip = validClip of self
		if myClip = NULL
			myClip = myClipSpec()
		end
		if (myClip <> NULL) and isReady(myClip)
			mmSeek myClip to argPos from end wait
			mmYield
		end
	end
end

-----------------------------
to handle stepClip
-----------------------------
	in myViewerRef()
		myClip = validClip of self
		if myClip = NULL
			myClip = myClipSpec()
		end
		if (myClip <> NULL) and isReady(myClip)
			if stepDist of self = NULL
				stepSize = truncate(mmLength of myClip / 20)
			else
				stepSize = stepDist of self
			end
			if mmPosition of myClip <= mmLength of myClip - stepSize
				mmStep myClip by stepSize wait
				mmYield
			else
				mmSeek myClip to 0 from end wait
				mmYield
			end
		end
	end
end

-----------------------------
to handle stepClipBack
-----------------------------
	in myViewerRef()
		myClip = validClip of self
		if myClip = NULL
			myClip = myClipSpec()
		end
		if (myClip <> NULL) and isReady(myClip)
			if stepDist of self = NULL
				stepSize = truncate(mmLength of myClip / 20)
			else
				stepSize = stepDist of self
			end
			if mmPosition of myClip > stepSize
				mmStep myClip back by stepSize wait
				mmYield
			else
				mmSeek myClip to 0 wait
				mmYield
			end
		end
	end
end

----------------------------------
to handle mmnotify whatClip, whatCommand, whatStatus
----------------------------------
	_loop = (ASYM_WID_ClipLoop of self = TRUE)

	if _loop and whatCommand = "mmplay" and whatStatus = "successful"
		if keyState(keyEscape) = down
			if sysOpenMedia <> NULL
				mmClose all
				break mmnotify
			end
		end

		send playClip to self
	end

	send setClipControls
end

				end
				send setClipControls to self
			else
				-- Invalid media type - display error message
				errMsg = ASYM_GetString("Unable to play non-visual clip.")
				captn = ASYM_GetString("Invalid media type")
				get ASYM_MessageBox(errMsg, captn, "WARNING", "OK", NULL, NULL)

				refViewer = myViewerRef()
				if refViewer <> mainWindow then
					close refViewer
				end if
			end if
		end
	end
end

-----------------------------
notifyAfter leavePage
-----------------------------
	if sysLevel <> AUTHOR
		if (autoCloseMedia of self = TRUE) and validClip of self <> NULL
			send closeClip to self
		end
	end
end


-----------------------------
to handle playClip
-----------------------------
	in myViewerRef()
		myClip = myClipSpec()
		if myClip <> NULL and (clipIsPlayable() of self) and sysLevel = "reader"

			-- Make sure the clip can be played in a stage
			validMediaTypes = "animation,bitmap,digitalVideo,overlay"
			mediaType = mmMediaType of myClip
			if ASYM_ItemInList(mediaType, validMediaTypes) = TRUE then

				stageObj = whatStage of self
				doWait = (ASYM_WID_ClipWait of self = TRUE)

				if isObject(stageObj) and ASYM_WID_ClipLoop of self = TRUE
					preEffect of stageObj = NULL
					postEffect of stageObj = NULL
				end

				if mmStatus of myClip = "closed"
					sysCursor = 4
					mmOpen myClip
					sysCursor = 1
				end

				-- If necessary, show the clip in the stage
				if stageObj <> NULL

					if mmVisible of myClip <> TRUE
						mmShow myClip in stageObj wait
						mmYield
						mmYield
						mmYield
					end if

					if doWait
						mmPlay myClip wait notify self
					else
						mmPlay myClip notify self
					end
					mmYield

				else

					if doWait
						mmPlay myClip hold wait notify self
					else
						mmPlay myClip hold notify self
					end

				end if

				send checkStageSize
				send setClipControls to self
			else
				-- Invalid media type - display error message
				errMsg = ASYM_GetString("Unable to play non-visual clip.")
				captn = ASYM_GetString("Invalid media type")
				get ASYM_MessageBox(errMsg, captn, "WARNING", "OK", NULL, NULL)

				refViewer = myViewerRef()
				if refViewer <> mainWindow then
					close refViewer
				end if
			end if
		end
	end
end

-----------------------------
to handle openClip
-----------------------------
	in myViewerRef()
		myClip = validClip of self
		if myClip = NULL
			myClip = myClipSpec()
		end

		if myClip <> NULL and (clipIsPlayable() of self)
			sysCursor = 4
			mmOpen myClip
			mmYield
			send checkStageSize
			sysCursor = 1
		end
	end
end

-----------------------------
to handle closeClip
-----------------------------
	in myViewerRef()
		myClip = validClip of self
		if myClip = NULL
			myClip = myClipSpec()
		end
		if (myClip <> NULL) and isReady(myClip)
			mmClose myClip
			mmYield
		end
	end
end

-----------------------------
to handle pauseClip
-----------------------------
	in myViewerRef()
		myClip = validClip of self
		if myClip = NULL
			myClip = myClipSpec()
		end
		if (myClip <> NULL) and (mmStatus of myClip = "playing")
			mmPause myClip
			mmYield
		end
	end
end

	in myViewerRef()

			myClip = myClipSpec()
		end
		if (myClip <> NULL) and isReady(myClip)
			mmRewind myClip
			mmYield
		end
	end
end

to handle showClip
-----------------------------

			myClip = myClipSpec()
		end
		if (myClip <> NULL) and (clipIsPlayable() of self)
			mmOpen myClip
			mmShow myClip in whatStage()
			mmYield
		end
	end
end

-----------------------------
to handle stepClip
-----------------------------
	in myViewerRef()
		myClip = validClip of self
		if myClip = NULL
			myClip = myClipSpec()
		end
		if (myClip <> NULL) and isReady(myClip)
			if stepDist of self = NULL
				stepSize = truncate(mmLength of myClip / 20)
			else
				stepSize = stepDist of self
			end
			if mmPosition of myClip <= mmLength of myClip - stepSize
				mmStep myClip by stepSize wait
				mmYield
			else
				mmSeek myClip to 0 from end wait
				mmYield
			end
		end
	end
end

			else
				mmSeek myClip to 0 wait
				mmYield
			end
		end
	end
end

			enabled of button "stop" of self = FALSE
			enabled of button "rewind" of self = FALSE
			enabled of button "step backward" of self = FALSE
			enabled of button "step forward" of self = FALSE
			enabled of button "fast forward" of self = FALSE

			invert of button "stop" of self = FALSE
			invert of button "rewind" of self = FALSE
			invert of button "step backward" of self = FALSE
			invert of button "step forward" of self = FALSE
			invert of button "fast forward" of self = FALSE
		else
			if clipStat  = NULL
				clipStat = mmStatus of myClip

					enabled of button "pause" of self = FALSE
					enabled of button "stop" of self = FALSE
					invert of button "pause" of self = FALSE
					invert of button "play" of self = FALSE
					invert of button "stop" of self = TRUE
				when clipStat is "paused"
				when clipStat is "seeking"
					enabled of button "play" of self = TRUE
					enabled of button "pause" of self = FALSE
					enabled of button "stop" of self = TRUE
					invert of button "pause" of self = FALSE
					invert of button "play" of self = FALSE
					invert of button "stop" of self = FALSE
				when clipStat is "playing"
					enabled of button "play" of self = FALSE
					enabled of button "pause" of self = TRUE
					enabled of button "stop" of self = TRUE
					invert of button "pause" of self = FALSE
					invert of button "play" of self = TRUE
					invert of button "stop" of self = FALSE

					enabled of button "play" of self = TRUE
					enabled of button "pause" of self = FALSE
					enabled of button "stop" of self = FALSE
					invert of button "pause" of self = FALSE
					invert of button "play" of self = FALSE
					invert of button "stop" of self = FALSE

				else
					-- when status is not recognized, stop
					enabled of button "play" of self = TRUE
					enabled of button "pause" of self = FALSE
					enabled of button "stop" of self = FALSE
					invert of button "pause" of self = FALSE
					invert of button "play" of self = FALSE
					invert of button "stop" of self = TRUE
			end
		end
		sysSuspend = ss
		sysError = se


		lockScreen of this window = oldLock
	end

-----------------------------
to get isReady whatClip
-----------------------------
	if whatClip <> NULL and mmStatus of whatClip is in "playingpausedstopped"
		return TRUE
	else
		return FALSE
	end
end

-----------------------------
to get newClip
-----------------------------
	myClip = chooseResource(clip,this book)
	if myClip = NULL
		myClip = item 1 of clipSpec of self
	else
		send setMySize myClip
	end
	return myClip
end

-----------------------------
to get myViewerRef
-----------------------------
	LOCAL pgRef, vRef

	vRef = item 1 of shownBy of my parent
	if vRef = NULL
		vRef = mainWindow
	end
	return vRef
end

-----------------------------
to handle checkStageSize
-----------------------------
	stageObj = whatStage of self
	if stageObj <> self and stageSizing of stageObj = stretchStage and isObject(group "mmwidget_controls" of self)
		 if item 1 of size of stageObj <> item 1 of size of group "mmwidget_controls" of self
		 	send adjustControls to group "mmwidget_controls" of self
		 end
	end
end

-----------------------------
to set mediaSizing to value
-----------------------------
	stageSizing of whatStage() = value
	send setMySize
	forward to parent
end

			myClip = myClipSpec()
		end
		if (myClip <> NULL) and isReady(myClip)
			mmRewind myClip
			mmYield
		end
	end
end

-----------------------------
to handle showClip
-----------------------------
	in myViewerRef()
		myClip = validClip of self
		if myClip = NULL
			myClip = myClipSpec()
		end
		if (myClip <> NULL) and (clipIsPlayable() of self)
			mmOpen myClip
			mmShow myClip in whatStage()
			mmYield
		end
	end
end

-----------------------------
to handle seekClip argPos
-----------------------------
	in myViewerRef()
		myClip = validClip of self
		if myClip = NULL
			myClip = myClipSpec()
		end
		if (myClip <> NULL) and isReady(myClip)
			mmSeek myClip to argPos wait
			mmYield
		end
	end
end

-----------------------------
to handle seekClipFromEnd argPos
-----------------------------
	in myViewerRef()
		myClip = validClip of self
		if myClip = NULL
			myClip = myClipSpec()
		end
		if (myClip <> NULL) and isReady(myClip)
			mmSeek myClip to argPos from end wait
			mmYield
		end
	end
end

-----------------------------
to handle stepClip
-----------------------------
	in myViewerRef()
		myClip = validClip of self
		if myClip = NULL
			myClip = myClipSpec()
		end
		if (myClip <> NULL) and isReady(myClip)
			if stepDist of self = NULL
				stepSize = truncate(mmLength of myClip / 20)
			else
				stepSize = stepDist of self
			end
			if mmPosition of myClip <= mmLength of myClip - stepSize
				mmStep myClip by stepSize wait
				mmYield
			else
				mmSeek myClip to 0 from end wait
				mmYield
			end
		end
	end
end

-----------------------------
to handle stepClipBack
-----------------------------
	in myViewerRef()
		myClip = validClip of self
		if myClip = NULL
			myClip = myClipSpec()
		end
		if (myClip <> NULL) and isReady(myClip)
			if stepDist of self = NULL
				stepSize = truncate(mmLength of myClip / 20)
			else
				stepSize = stepDist of self
			end
			if mmPosition of myClip > stepSize
				mmStep myClip back by stepSize wait
				mmYield
			else
				mmSeek myClip to 0 wait
				mmYield
			end
		end
	end
end

----------------------------------
to handle mmnotify whatClip, whatCommand, whatStatus
----------------------------------
	_loop = (ASYM_WID_ClipLoop of self = TRUE)

	if _loop and whatCommand = "mmplay" and whatStatus = "successful"
		if keyState(keyEscape) = down
			if sysOpenMedia <> NULL
				mmClose all
				break mmnotify
			end
		end

		send playClip to self
	end

	send setClipControls
end

-----------------------------
to handle setClipControls clipStat
-----------------------------

	mmYield

	if this book <> objectContainer(self,"book")
		break setClipControls
	end

	if object of self = "stage" or not isObject(button "play" of self)
		break setClipControls
	end

	in myViewerRef()
		se = sysError
		ss = sysSuspend
		sysSuspend = FALSE

		oldLock = lockScreen of this window
		lockScreen of this window = true
		myClip = validClip of self
		if myClip = NULL
			myClip = myClipSpec()
		end

		if myClip = NULL
			enabled of button "play" of self = FALSE
			enabled of button "pause" of self = FALSE
			enabled of button "stop" of self = FALSE
			enabled of button "rewind" of self = FALSE
			enabled of button "step backward" of self = FALSE
			enabled of button "step forward" of self = FALSE
			enabled of button "fast forward" of self = FALSE

			invert of button "pause" of self = FALSE
			invert of button "play" of self = FALSE
			invert of button "stop" of self = FALSE
			invert of button "rewind" of self = FALSE
			invert of button "step backward" of self = FALSE
			invert of button "step forward" of self = FALSE
			invert of button "fast forward" of self = FALSE
		else
			if clipStat  = NULL
				clipStat = mmStatus of myClip
			end

			enabled of button "rewind" of self = TRUE
			enabled of button "step backward" of self = TRUE
			enabled of button "step forward" of self = TRUE
			enabled of button "fast forward" of self = TRUE

			conditions
				when clipStat is "stopped"
					enabled of button "play" of self = TRUE
					enabled of button "pause" of self = FALSE
					enabled of button "stop" of self = FALSE
					invert of button "pause" of self = FALSE
					invert of button "play" of self = FALSE
					invert of button "stop" of self = TRUE
				when clipStat is "paused"
				when clipStat is "seeking"
					enabled of button "play" of self = TRUE
					enabled of button "pause" of self = FALSE
					enabled of button "stop" of self = TRUE
					invert of button "pause" of self = FALSE
					invert of button "play" of self = FALSE
					invert of button "stop" of self = FALSE
				when clipStat is "playing"
					enabled of button "play" of self = FALSE
					enabled of button "pause" of self = TRUE
					enabled of button "stop" of self = TRUE
					invert of button "pause" of self = FALSE
					invert of button "play" of self = TRUE
					invert of button "stop" of self = FALSE
				when clipStat is "closed"
					enabled of button "play" of self = TRUE
					enabled of button "pause" of self = FALSE
					enabled of button "stop" of self = FALSE
					invert of button "pause" of self = FALSE
					invert of button "play" of self = FALSE
					invert of button "stop" of self = FALSE

				else
					-- when status is not recognized, stop
					enabled of button "play" of self = TRUE
					enabled of button "pause" of self = FALSE
					enabled of button "stop" of self = FALSE
					invert of button "pause" of self = FALSE
					invert of button "play" of self = FALSE
					invert of button "stop" of self = TRUE
			end
		end
		sysSuspend = ss
		sysError = se


		lockScreen of this window = oldLock
	end
end

-----------------------------
to get isReady whatClip
-----------------------------
	if whatClip <> NULL and mmStatus of whatClip is in "playingpausedstopped"
		return TRUE
	else
		return FALSE
	end
end

-----------------------------
to get newClip
-----------------------------
	myClip = chooseResource(clip,this book)
	if myClip = NULL
		myClip = item 1 of clipSpec of self
	else
		send setMySize myClip
	end
	return myClip
end

-----------------------------
to get myViewerRef
-----------------------------
	LOCAL pgRef, vRef

	vRef = item 1 of shownBy of my parent
	if vRef = NULL
		vRef = mainWindow
	end
	return vRef
end

-----------------------------
to handle checkStageSize
-----------------------------
	stageObj = whatStage of self
	if stageObj <> self and stageSizing of stageObj = stretchStage and isObject(group "mmwidget_controls" of self)
		 if item 1 of size of stageObj <> item 1 of size of group "mmwidget_controls" of self
		 	send adjustControls to group "mmwidget_controls" of self
		 end
	end
end

-----------------------------
to set mediaSizing to value
-----------------------------
	stageSizing of whatStage() = value
	send setMySize
	forward to parent
end

-----------------------------
to handle setMySize myClip
-----------------------------
	if myClip = NULL
		myClip = item 1 of clipSpec of self
	end

	myStage = whatStage()
	if stageSizing of myStage = stretchStage and myClip <> NULL
		mediaSize of myStage = mmVisualSize of myClip
	end
	send sized to myStage
end

	if object of self = "stage"
		return self
	else
		return getObjectList(self,"stage",false)

to get clipIsPlayable
	if isPlayable of self = NULL
		if (clipspec of self <> NULL) and (isObject(item 1 of clipspec of self) = true)
			clipRef = item 1 of clipSpec of self
			bs = ASYM_BlockSuspend()
			playable = (mmPlayable of clipRef = TRUE)
			get ASYM_RestoreSuspend(bs)
			isPlayable of self = (playable = TRUE)
		else
			isPlayable of self = FALSE
		end if
	end if
	retVal = (isPlayable of self = TRUE)

		break setClipControls

	in myViewerRef()

			enabled of button "pause" of self = FALSE

			enabled of button "rewind" of self = FALSE
			enabled of button "step backward" of self = FALSE
			enabled of button "step forward" of self = FALSE
			enabled of button "fast forward" of self = FALSE

			invert of button "stop" of self = FALSE
			invert of button "rewind" of self = FALSE
			invert of button "step backward" of self = FALSE
			invert of button "step forward" of self = FALSE
			invert of button "fast forward" of self = FALSE
		else
			if clipStat  = NULL
				clipStat = mmStatus of myClip
			end

			enabled of button "rewind" of self = TRUE
			enabled of button "step backward" of self = TRUE
			enabled of button "step forward" of self = TRUE
			enabled of button "fast forward" of self = TRUE

			conditions
				when clipStat is "stopped"
					enabled of button "play" of self = TRUE
					enabled of button "pause" of self = FALSE
					enabled of button "stop" of self = FALSE
					invert of button "pause" of self = FALSE
					invert of button "play" of self = FALSE
					invert of button "stop" of self = TRUE
				when clipStat is "paused"
				when clipStat is "seeking"
					enabled of button "play" of self = TRUE
					enabled of button "pause" of self = FALSE
					enabled of button "stop" of self = TRUE
					invert of button "pause" of self = FALSE
					invert of button "play" of self = FALSE
					invert of button "stop" of self = FALSE
				when clipStat is "playing"
					enabled of button "play" of self = FALSE
					enabled of button "pause" of self = TRUE
					enabled of button "stop" of self = TRUE
					invert of button "pause" of self = FALSE
					invert of button "play" of self = TRUE
					invert of button "stop" of self = FALSE
				when clipStat is "closed"
					enabled of button "play" of self = TRUE
					enabled of button "pause" of self = FALSE
					enabled of button "stop" of self = FALSE
					invert of button "pause" of self = FALSE
					invert of button "play" of self = FALSE
					invert of button "stop" of self = FALSE

					-- when status is not recognized, stop
					enabled of button "play" of self = TRUE
					enabled of button "pause" of self = FALSE
					enabled of button "stop" of self = FALSE
					invert of button "pause" of self = FALSE
					invert of button "play" of self = FALSE
					invert of button "stop" of self = TRUE

			get ASYM_RestoreSuspend(bs)
			isPlayable of self = (playable = TRUE)
		else
			isPlayable of self = FALSE
		end if
	end if
	retVal = (isPlayable of self = TRUE)
	return retVal
end

-- 0xc8f8d  to handle stepClipBack
to handle stepClipBack
-----------------------------
	in myViewerRef()
		myClip = validClip of self
		if myClip = NULL
			myClip = myClipSpec()
		end
		if (myClip <> NULL) and isReady(myClip)
			if stepDist of self = NULL
				stepSize = truncate(mmLength of myClip / 20)
			else
				stepSize = stepDist of self
			end
			if mmPosition of myClip > stepSize
				mmStep myClip back by stepSize wait
				mmYield
			else
				mmSeek myClip to 0 wait
				mmYield
			end
		end
	end
end

-----------------------------
to handle resizeToPage
-----------------------------
	myPage = objectContainer(self, "page")
	myBkgd = parent of myPage
	pgSize = size of myBkgd
	item 1 of size of self = item 1 of pgSize
	if isObject(group "mmwidget_controls" of self) then
		refControls = group "mmwidget_controls" of self
		refStage = whatStage of self
		item 2 of position of refControls = \
			item 2 of pgSize - item 2 of size of refControls
		item 4 of bounds of refStage = item 2 of position of refControls
	else
		item 4 of bounds of refStage = item 2 of pgSize
	end if
end resizeToPage

			get ASYM_RestoreSuspend(bs)
			isPlayable of self = (playable = TRUE)
		else
			isPlayable of self = FALSE
		end if
	end if
	retVal = (isPlayable of self = TRUE)
	return retVal
end

-----------------------------
to get myClipSpec
-----------------------------
	if my clipSpec <> NULL AND isObject(item 1 of my clipSpec)
		retVal = item 1 of my clipSpec
	else
		retVal = NULL
	end

	if retVal <> NULL
		stat = mmStatus of retVal
		if stat = "closed" and not (clipIsPlayable() of self) and errorMsg of self <> TRUE
			if CDMediaPath of this book <> NULL and mmSearchCD of retVal = TRUE
				msg = ASYM_GetString("msgCannotPlayMediaFile", \
						"The media file: ""%1"" could not be played." & CRLF & \
						 "Make sure the correct CD is installed in the drive.")
			else
				msg = ASYM_GetString("msgCannotPlayMediaFile", \
						"The media file: ""%1"" could not be played.")
			end
			msg = expandString(msg, mmsource of retVal)
			msgCaption = ASYM_GetString("msgCapCannotPlayMediaFile", "Media Problem")
			get ASYM_MessageBox(msg, msgCaption, "Exclamation", "OK")
			errorMsg of self = TRUE
			return NULL
		end
	end
	validClip of self = retVal
	return retVal
end


-----------------------------
to handle resizeToPage
-----------------------------
	myPage = objectContainer(self, "page")
	myBkgd = parent of myPage
	pgSize = size of myBkgd
	item 1 of size of self = item 1 of pgSize
	if isObject(group "mmwidget_controls" of self) then
		refControls = group "mmwidget_controls" of self
		refStage = whatStage of self
		item 2 of position of refControls = \
			item 2 of pgSize - item 2 of size of refControls
		item 4 of bounds of refStage = item 2 of position of refControls
	else
		item 4 of bounds of refStage = item 2 of pgSize
	end if
end resizeToPage

to get mediaPlaying

	_clip = validClip of self

		_clip = myClipSpec()
	end

		if mmIsOpen of _clip = true
			retVal = (mmStatus of _clip = "playing")

		mmYield

		mmYield
	end if
	bs = ASYM_RestoreSuspend(bs)

	return retVal

		end if

to get mediaPosition
	local LONG retVal
	retVal = 0

	_clip = validClip of self
	if _clip = NULL
		_clip = myClipSpec()
	end
	bs = ASYM_BlockSuspend()
	if _clip <> NULL and mmPlayable of _clip
		if mmIsOpen of _clip = true
			oldTimeFormat = mmTimeFormat of _clip
			mmTimeFormat of _clip = "milliseconds"
			retVal = mmPosition of _clip
			mmTimeFormat of _clip = oldTimeFormat
		end if
		mmYield
		mmYield
		mmYield
		mmYield
	end if
	bs = ASYM_RestoreSuspend(bs)

	return retVal
end

-- 0xc97e7  to get newClip
to get newClip
-----------------------------
	myClip = chooseResource(clip,this book)
	if myClip = NULL
		myClip = item 1 of clipSpec of self
	else
		send setMySize myClip
	end
	return myClip
end

-----------------------------
to get myViewerRef
-----------------------------
	LOCAL pgRef, vRef

	vRef = item 1 of shownBy of my parent
	if vRef = NULL
		vRef = mainWindow
	end
	return vRef
end

-----------------------------
to handle checkStageSize
-----------------------------
	stageObj = whatStage of self
	if stageObj <> self and stageSizing of stageObj = stretchStage and isObject(group "mmwidget_controls" of self)
		 if item 1 of size of stageObj <> item 1 of size of group "mmwidget_controls" of self
		 	send adjustControls to group "mmwidget_controls" of self
		 end
	end
end

-----------------------------
to set mediaSizing to value
-----------------------------
	stageSizing of whatStage() = value
	send setMySize
	forward to parent
end

-----------------------------
to handle setMySize myClip
-----------------------------
	if myClip = NULL
		myClip = item 1 of clipSpec of self
	end

	myStage = whatStage()
	if stageSizing of myStage = stretchStage and myClip <> NULL
		mediaSize of myStage = mmVisualSize of myClip
	end
	send sized to myStage
end

-----------------------------
to get whatStage
-----------------------------
	if object of self = "stage"
		return self
	else
		return getObjectList(self,"stage",false)
	end
end

-----------------------------
notifyBefore idle
-----------------------------
	myClip = validClip of self
	if myClip = NULL
		myClip = myClipSpec()
	end

	if myClip <> NULL and objects of self <> NULL
		myStage = whatStage()
		status = mmStatus of myClip
		if status <> my lastStatus
			my lastStatus = status
			if preEffect of myStage <> NULL or postEffect of myStage <> NULL
				send setClipControls status to self
			end
		end
	end
end

to get clipIsPlayable
	if isPlayable of self = NULL
		if (clipspec of self <> NULL) and (isObject(item 1 of clipspec of self) = true)

		else
			isPlayable of self = FALSE
		end if
	end if
	retVal = (isPlayable of self = TRUE)
	return retVal

	else

-- 0xc9b25  to get clipIsPlayable
to get clipIsPlayable
	if isPlayable of self = NULL
		if (clipspec of self <> NULL) and (isObject(item 1 of clipspec of self) = true)
			clipRef = item 1 of clipSpec of self
			bs = ASYM_BlockSuspend()
			playable = (mmPlayable of clipRef = TRUE)
			get ASYM_RestoreSuspend(bs)
			isPlayable of self = (playable = TRUE)
		else
			isPlayable of self = FALSE
		end if
	end if
	retVal = (isPlayable of self = TRUE)
	return retVal
end

-----------------------------
to get myClipSpec
-----------------------------
	if my clipSpec <> NULL AND isObject(item 1 of my clipSpec)
		retVal = item 1 of my clipSpec
	else
		retVal = NULL
	end

	if retVal <> NULL
		stat = mmStatus of retVal
		if stat = "closed" and not (clipIsPlayable() of self) and errorMsg of self <> TRUE
			if CDMediaPath of this book <> NULL and mmSearchCD of retVal = TRUE
				msg = ASYM_GetString("msgCannotPlayMediaFile", \
						"The media file: ""%1"" could not be played." & CRLF & \
						 "Make sure the correct CD is installed in the drive.")
			else
				msg = ASYM_GetString("msgCannotPlayMediaFile", \
						"The media file: ""%1"" could not be played.")
			end
			msg = expandString(msg, mmsource of retVal)
			msgCaption = ASYM_GetString("msgCapCannotPlayMediaFile", "Media Problem")
			get ASYM_MessageBox(msg, msgCaption, "Exclamation", "OK")
			errorMsg of self = TRUE
			return NULL
		end
	end
	validClip of self = retVal
	return retVal
end


-----------------------------
to handle resizeToPage
-----------------------------
	myPage = objectContainer(self, "page")
	myBkgd = parent of myPage
	pgSize = size of myBkgd
	item 1 of size of self = item 1 of pgSize
	if isObject(group "mmwidget_controls" of self) then
		refControls = group "mmwidget_controls" of self
		refStage = whatStage of self
		item 2 of position of refControls = \
			item 2 of pgSize - item 2 of size of refControls
		item 4 of bounds of refStage = item 2 of position of refControls
	else
		item 4 of bounds of refStage = item 2 of pgSize
	end if
end resizeToPage

-- 0xcdc61  to handle openwindow
to handle openwindow
	get ASYM_CBTIniVar("Windows", "RTFHelp")
	if itemCount(it) = 4 and it <> my bounds
		my bounds = it
		my fixit = true
	end
	forward
end

to handle enterWindow
	if my fixit is true
		clear my fixit
		send fixSize to my currentPage
	end
	forward
end

to handle closeWindow
	get SetIniVar("Windows", "RTFHelp", my bounds, ASYM_IniFile())
	forward
end

-- 0xcdfd3  to handle closeWindow
to handle closeWindow
	system s_tb80r_PopViewers
	get ASYM_itemOffset(words 1 to 3 of self,s_tb80r_PopViewers)
	if it > 0
		clear item it of s_tb80r_PopViewers
	end
	forward
end

-- 0xd0633  to handle buttonClick
to handle buttonClick
	if this page = page 1 of this book
		edit script of this book
	else
		edit script of this page
	end
end

-- 0xd159d  to get _ASYM_ModalDialog whatPage, whatCaption
to get _ASYM_ModalDialog whatPage, whatCaption
	system s_ASYM_DlgResult; s_ASYM_DlgResult = FALSE

	ss = sysSuspend; sysSuspend = false; clear sysError
	v = viewer "Generic Dialog" of objectContainer(self,"book")
	sysSuspend = ss
	if sysError = null
		if isOpen of v
			ContStr = ASYM_GetStandardString("<Continue>", "Continue")

			msgTxt = ASYM_GetString("ViewerInUse", "Viewer %1 is already in use.")
			msgTxt = expandString(msgTxt, whatViewer)

			request msgTxt with ContStr or ASYM_GetStandardString("<Cancel>", "Cancel")

			if it <> ContStr
				return FALSE
			else
				if isOpen of v
					close v
				end
			end
		end
		open v
		if isObject("page" && whatPage)
			currentpage of v = page whatPage
			caption of v = whatCaption
			show v as modal
			return (s_ASYM_DlgResult = TRUE)
		end
	end
	return FALSE
end

-- 0xd1f0f  to get _ASYM_AskForPath startPath, dbCaption
to get _ASYM_AskForPath startPath, dbCaption
	oldPath = ASYM_CurrentDirectory()

	while last char of startPath is "\"
		clear last char of startPath
	end
	newPath = ASYM_ChooseDirectoryDlg (dbCaption, startPath)

	if newPath <> null and newPath <> startPath
		if last char of newPath <> "\"
			put "\" after newPath
		end
	else
		clear newPath
	end
	get ASYM_SetCurrentDirectory(oldPath)

	return newPath
end

-- 0xd2bc5  to get _ASYM_TBKFileVersion fileName
to get _ASYM_TBKFileVersion fileName
	local result
	if ASYM_Isfile(fileName)
		get BookVersion(fileName)
		conditions
			when word 1 of it is "1.0"
				result = "1.0"
			when word 1 of it contains "1.5"
				return "1.5"
			when it contains "3.0 M"
				result = "M 3.0"
			when word 1 of it is "3.0"
				result = "3.0"
			when word 1 of it is  ASYM_MTBVersion(TRUE)
				result = ASYM_MTBVersion(TRUE)
			when word 1 of it is  ASYM_CBTVersion(TRUE)
				result = ASYM_CBTVersion(TRUE)
			else
				result = null
		end
	end
	return result
end

-- 0xd56e4  to get _ASYM_FirstNavigablePage

	in ASYM_WorkWindow()
		get firstPage(this book)
	end
	return it

	end
	return it
end


to get _ASYM_NextNavigablePage
	in ASYM_WorkWindow()
		get nextPage(this page)
		if pageNumber of it < pageNumber of this page
			get null
		end
	end
	return it
end


to get _ASYM_PreviousNavigablePage
	in ASYM_WorkWindow()
		get previousPage(this page)
		if pageNumber of it > pageNumber of this page
			get null
		end
	end
	return it
end

-- 0xd5c11  to get _ASYM_IniFile
to get _ASYM_IniFile
	SYSTEM s_ASYM_IniFilePath
	if s_ASYM_IniFilePath is null
		s_ASYM_IniFilePath = ASYM_IniFilePath()
	else
		if last char of s_ASYM_IniFilePath <> "\"
			put "\" after s_ASYM_IniFilePath
		end
		if not ASYM_IsDirectory(s_ASYM_IniFilePath)
			s_ASYM_IniFilePath = ASYM_IniFilePath()
		end
	end
	return s_ASYM_IniFilePath & ASYM_ProductPrefix() & ASYM_CBTVersion() & "r.ini"
end


to get _ASYM_IniFilePath
	SYSTEM s__ASYM_IniFilePath
	if s__ASYM_IniFilePath is null
		get sysToolBookDirectory
		if ASYM_IsDirectoryWriteable(it)
			s__ASYM_IniFilePath = it
		else
			s__ASYM_IniFilePath = "<windir>"
		end
	end
	if s__ASYM_IniFilePath is "<windir>"
		return null
	else
		return s__ASYM_IniFilePath
	end
end

-- 0xd6c49  to get _ASYM_GetDeploymentMethod obj
to get _ASYM_GetDeploymentMethod obj
	if obj = null
		obj = parent of mainWindow
	end

	if word 1 of obj is "book"
		retVal = ASYM_DeploymentMethod of obj
	else
		retVal = ASYM_DeploymentMethod of objectContainer(obj,"book")
	end

	if retVal is not in "NATIVE,HTML"
		retVal = "Native"
	end

	return retVal
end

-- 0xd976b  to handle sized
to handle sized
	ssm = sysSuspendMessages
	sysSuspendMessages = true
	get my bounds
	set bounds of angledLine "TL" of self to it
	set bounds of angledLine "BR" of self to it
	yp = sysPageUnitsPerPixel
	pop yp into xp
	set bounds of item 1 of my objects to \
	  item 1 of it + xp, item 2 of it + yp,\
	  item 3 of it - xp, item 4 of it - yp
	sysSuspendMessages = ssm
end

-- 0xdb743  to get propValue
to get propValue
	return my choice
end

to set propValue to what
	if what is null
		what = "HDMediaPath"
	end
	my choice = what
	get my objects
	while it <> null
		pop it into obj
		checked of obj = (name of obj is what)
	end
end

to handle ASYM_ButtonClick
	forward
	my choice = name of target
end

to handle sized
	forward
	if target is self
		send sizeIt
	end
end

to handle buttonDoubleClick
	myPage = myPage()
	if visible of field "fieldAsk" of myPage = false AND \
	   visible of group "checkbox" of myPage = false AND \
	   defCmdButton of myPage is not null

	   cmdBtn = defCmdButton of myPage

	   send buttonClick to cmdBtn
	end
end

notifyBefore sizeIt
	send sized to self
end

-- 0xe0b18  to handle _ASYM_ShowError txt, winCaption, helpTag, helpFile
to handle _ASYM_ShowError txt, winCaption, helpTag, helpFile
	if winCaption is null
		winCaption = ASYM_GetStandardString("<Error>","")
	end
	if helptag is null and helpFile is null
		get ASYM_MessageBox(txt,winCaption,"exclamation")
		break
	end
	v = viewer "Generic Error" of objectContainer(self,"book")
	defaultPage of v = self
	if isOpen of v
		close v
	end
	open v
	text of field "text" of self = txt
	caption of v = winCaption
	hasHelp = (helpTag <> null and helpFile <> null)
	visible of button "Help" of self = hasHelp
	if hasHelp
		get 866
	else
		get 1586
	end
	item 1 of position of button "OK" of self = it
	my helpTag = helpTag
	my helpFile = helpFile
	show v as modal
end

-- 0xe0e0c  to handle buttonClick
to handle buttonClick
	close this window
end

-- 0xe0f2f  to handle buttonClick
to handle buttonClick
	get helpFile of this page
	if it is null
		get "TB.HLP"
	end
	get ASYM_WinHelp(helpTag of this page,it)
end

-- 0xe1816  to handle make
to handle make
	ssm = sysSuspendMessages
	sysSuspendMessages = ssm
		get size of this background
		if it is "0,0"
			bkgndSize = size of this book
		else
			bkgndSize = it
		end
		topBorder = item 1 of my objects
		bottomBorder = item 2 of my objects

		set vertices of topBorder to item 1 of sysPageUnitsPerPixel,(item 2 of bkgndSize - item 2 of sysPageUnitsPerPixel),item 1 of sysPageUnitsPerPixel,(4 * item 2 of sysPageUnitsPerPixel),item 1 of bkgndSize - item 1 of sysPageUnitsPerPixel, (4 * item 2 of sysPageUnitsPerPixel)
		set vertices of bottomBorder to item 1 of sysPageUnitsPerPixel,(item 2 of bkgndSize - item 2 of sysPageUnitsPerPixel),(item 1 of bkgndSize - item 1 of sysPageUnitsPerPixel),(item 2 of bkgndSize - item 2 of sysPageUnitsPerPixel),(item 1 of bkgndSize - item 1 of sysPageUnitsPerPixel), (4 * item 2 of sysPageUnitsPerPixel)
	sysSuspendMessages = ssm
end

-- 0xe4131  to handle sized

	end

end

to handle moved

	sysSuspendMessages = true
	if oldb of target <> null
		bounds of target = oldb of target

end

to handle adjustControls
	ssm = sysSuspendMessages
	sysSuspendMessages = true
	lockscreen of this window = TRUE
	myObjs = objects of self
	parentbounds = bounds of whatStage()
	move self to item 1 of parentbounds,item 4 of parentbounds
	item 1 of size of self = item 1 of size of whatStage of parent of self
	step i from 1 to itemcount(myObjs)
		objRef = item i of myObjs
		item 2 of size of objRef = 24*item 2 of sysPageUnitsPerPixel
		oldb of objRef = bounds of objRef
	end
	oldb of self = bounds of self
	lockscreen of this window = FALSE
	sysSuspendMessages = ssm
end

-- 0xe67f6  to handle sized
to handle sized
	ssm = syssuspendmessages
	syssuspendmessages = TRUE
	item 1 of size of self = 5*item 1 of syspageunitsperpixel
	syssuspendmessages = ssm
end

to handle moved
	if sysLevel = author
		bnds = position of rectangle "back" of my parent
		ssm = syssuspendmessages
		syssuspendmessages = TRUE
		move self to bnds
		syssuspendmessages = ssm
	end
end

to handle setPos x
	if lastX of self = x
		break setPos
	else
		lastX of self = x
	end

	conditions
		when x = NULL
		when x < 0
			x = 0
		when x > 1
			x = 1
	end

	back = bounds of rectangle "back" of my parent
	bnds = bounds of self
	myWid = (item 3 of bnds - item 1 of bnds)/2
	backWid = item 3 of back - item 1 of back

	ssm = syssuspendmessages
	syssuspendmessages = TRUE
	move self to item 1 of back+(backWid*x)-myWid,item 2 of back
	syssuspendmessages = ssm
end
